rows.translation: Q.COMM收发器
一台Q.COMM收发器

rows.original: A transceiver that’s patched into a private quantum-communications network. Though salvaged from Phaedran equipment, it looks shockingly like Confederate tech. Perhaps of interest to an offworld engineer of superior caliber...
rows.translation: 一台接入私人量子通信网络的收发器。虽然它是从菲德拉设备上回收的，看起来却与邦联技术惊人地相似。或许某位技艺高超的外星工程师会对它感兴趣...
rows.raw: "A transceiver that’s patched into a private quantum-communications network. Though salvaged from Phaedran equipment, it looks shockingly like Confederate tech. Perhaps of interest to an offworld engineer of superior caliber..."

rows.translation: 菲德拉：荒原
坠毁飞船

rows.original:
Beneath your ship, you stand atop a glassy surface that must have once been sand. Apocalyptic nuclear fire long ago scoured it to smooth reflectivity. Your Codex ticks softly with faint background radiation - not enough to concern your body’s enhanced repair and immune systems, but enough to remind you of the danger inherent to this beautiful, bombed-out wasteland.

		The gleaming surface stretches in every direction, though cracks spiderweb through to the south.

		Much further north lies a crater... and beyond another - large enough to swallow a city whole and yet hunger for more.
rows.translation:
你的飞船下方，是一片曾经必定为沙地的玻璃状地表。很久以前，末日般的核火将它烧蚀得光滑如镜。你的CODEX终端因微弱的背景辐射而轻轻作响——这点辐射还不足以让你强化过的修复与免疫系统担忧，却足以提醒你，这片美丽而被轰炸殆尽的荒原中潜藏着危险。

		闪亮的地表向四面八方延伸，南面却有蛛网状的裂纹蔓延开来。

		更远的北方有一座弹坑...后面还有一座——大得足以吞下一整座城市，却依旧贪得无厌。
rows.raw:
"Beneath your ship, you stand atop a glassy surface that must have once been sand. Apocalyptic nuclear fire long ago scoured it to smooth reflectivity. Your Codex ticks softly with faint background radiation - not enough to concern your body’s enhanced repair and immune systems, but enough to remind you of the danger inherent to this beautiful, bombed-out wasteland.

		The gleaming surface stretches in every direction, though cracks spiderweb through to the south.

		Much further north lies a crater... and beyond another - large enough to swallow a city whole and yet hunger for more."

rows.original:
You note faint ripples in the surface of the nuclear-smoothed glass as you explore. At first, they appear to stretch in a linear east-west manner, but as you observe more distant surroundings, you detect a northward arc to their form: these are massive ripples - not straight lines. The blast that carved a massive crater on the horizon struck with such force that it writ the power of its shockwaves into the very surface of the glass.

		A few rocks peek through the glass to west, their northern faces strangely smoothed out like candles left too close to a hearth.
rows.translation:
探索途中，你注意到核火熔平的玻璃表面有些细微波纹。起初，它们看似沿东西方向笔直延伸；但观察更远处的环境后，你发现这些波纹向北弯曲：它们其实是巨大的环状波纹，而非直线。地平线上的巨型弹坑由一次威力惊人的爆炸凿出，冲击波的力量甚至被铭刻在玻璃地表上。

		西边有几块岩石从玻璃中探出，它们的北面被诡异地磨平了，像是放得离炉火太近的蜡烛。
rows.raw: "You note faint ripples in the surface of the nuclear-smoothed glass as you explore. At first, they appear to stretch in a linear east-west manner, but as you observe more distant surroundings, you detect a northward arc to their form: these are massive ripples - not straight lines. The blast that carved a massive crater on the horizon struck with such force that it writ the power of its shockwaves into the very surface of the glass.\n\n\t\tA few rocks peek through the glass to west, their northern faces strangely smoothed out like candles left too close to a hearth."

rows.original: The glass to the south opens into a jagged crevasse. Unsupported from below, the surface layer appears to have collapsed deep into the bottom of the pit - presenting a fatally-spiky landing for anyone or anything unlucky enough to tumble in. Unbroken glass stretches away to the north, east, and west.
rows.translation: 南面的玻璃地表裂开一道嶙峋的深沟。失去下层支撑后，表层似乎一路坍塌到了坑底，任何不幸跌进去的人或物都会落在足以致命的尖刺上。完好的玻璃地表向北、东、西三面延伸。
rows.raw: "The glass to the south opens into a jagged crevasse. Unsupported from below, the surface layer appears to have collapsed deep into the bottom of the pit - presenting a fatally-spiky landing for anyone or anything unlucky enough to tumble in. Unbroken glass stretches away to the north, east, and west."

rows.original:
The glass runs alongside a small crevasse to the north - just wide and jagged enough to block any attempts at traditional locomotion. It appears that the underlying sediment eroded away, leaving the glass "plate" to collapse in under its own weight - and create a pit of spiky death. More than one set of animal bones decorates the bottom like grisly trophies.

		The glass to the southeast is more fractured than elsewhere, riven with spiderweb-like inclusions of white.
rows.translation:
北侧的玻璃地表沿着一条小裂沟延伸；它不算宽，却足够崎岖，足以阻断任何常规移动方式。下层沉积物似乎遭到侵蚀，留下的玻璃“板”承受不住自身重量而坍塌，形成一个遍布致命尖刺的深坑。坑底散落着不止一副动物骨骸，像是阴森的战利品。

		东南面的玻璃比别处破碎得更厉害，白色夹杂物如蛛网般贯穿其中。
rows.raw: 'The glass runs alongside a small crevasse to the north - just wide and jagged enough to block any attempts at traditional locomotion. It appears that the underlying sediment eroded away, leaving the glass "plate" to collapse in under its own weight - and create a pit of spiky death. More than one set of animal bones decorates the bottom like grisly trophies.\n\n\t\tThe glass to the southeast is more fractured than elsewhere, riven with spiderweb-like inclusions of white.'

rows.original:
White moss springs out of cracks between the greenish glass, proving that not even an impermeable ceramic layer can choke off life. Your Codex’s sensors report the moss to be nontoxic and less radioactive than the surrounding material. Life... finds a way.
		
		This strange plant seems to thrive more to the east, south, and west of you. To the north, the glass is unbroken and smooth.
		
		You also notice a burned-out starship hull to the southwest, though judging by its state, any salvage was likely stripped away long ago.
rows.translation:
白色苔藓从绿色玻璃间的裂缝中钻出，证明即使是不透水的陶瓷层也无法扼杀生命。CODEX终端的传感器显示，这些苔藓无毒，放射性也低于周围物质。生命...总会找到出路。
		
		这种奇异植物在你的东、南、西面似乎生长得更为旺盛。北面的玻璃则完整而光滑。
		
		你还注意到西南方有一艘烧毁的星舰船体；不过看它的状态，能回收的东西大概早就被搜刮干净了。
rows.raw:
"White moss springs out of cracks between the greenish glass, proving that not even an impermeable ceramic layer can choke off life. Your Codex’s sensors report the moss to be nontoxic and less radioactive than the surrounding material. Life... finds a way.
		
		This strange plant seems to thrive more to the east, south, and west of you. To the north, the glass is unbroken and smooth.
		
		You also notice a burned-out starship hull to the southwest, though judging by its state, any salvage was likely stripped away long ago."

rows.original:
The smooth glass you parked your ship on gives way to patternless cracking here, splitting into smaller and smaller pieces to the east and south. In the gaps between, a whitish moss has grown in, puffing up softly. At a distance, it looks almost like a spider’s web, woven into the ground itself.
		
		Unbroken glass tantalizes you to the north. The webs continue in every other direction - save for the immediate south, where a burned-out starship hull sits in the way.
rows.translation:
你停放飞船的平滑玻璃地表到了这里便开始不规则开裂，朝东面和南面碎成越来越小的块状。缝隙中长出了蓬松的白色苔藓。远远望去，它几乎像一张织进地面本身的蛛网。
		
		北面完好的玻璃地表颇为诱人。蛛网般的苔藓向其余各个方向延伸，唯独正南方被一艘烧毁的星舰船体挡住。
rows.raw: "The smooth glass you parked your ship on gives way to patternless cracking here, splitting into smaller and smaller pieces to the east and south. In the gaps between, a whitish moss has grown in, puffing up softly. At a distance, it looks almost like a spider’s web, woven into the ground itself.\n\t\t\n\t\tUnbroken glass tantalizes you to the north. The webs continue in every other direction - save for the immediate south, where a burned-out starship hull sits in the way."

rows.original:
A simple shack is standing alongside the edge of the wrecked ship to the southeast. The walls appear to be made from laser-perforated bulkheads - for a breezy interior, perhaps! Salvaged tabletops form the roof, held on with rusted, immobilized machine clamps. Radioactive glass makes for privacy windows, a feature undercut by the complete destruction of the door—now blown in half, painted in scorch marks, and overgrown with white moss.
		
		Someone was living and scrapping here... until it came to an unfortunate end.
		
		Highly radioactive sludge impedes any travel to the north and west, but the mossy ground makes for easy moving to the east and south.
rows.translation:
东南方失事飞船的边缘旁立着一间简陋小屋。墙壁似乎由被激光打穿的舱壁拼成——也许是为了让屋里通风！回收来的桌面组成屋顶，由锈死的机械夹具固定。带有放射性的玻璃充当隐私窗，不过那扇门已经彻底毁坏，如今断成两半、布满焦痕，还爬满了白色苔藓，所谓隐私也就无从谈起。
		
		曾有人住在这里，以拾荒为生...直到不幸降临。
		
		高放射性淤泥阻断了向北和向西的道路，但长满苔藓的地面让你能轻松向东或向南移动。
rows.raw:
"A simple shack is standing alongside the edge of the wrecked ship to the southeast. The walls appear to be made from laser-perforated bulkheads - for a breezy interior, perhaps! Salvaged tabletops form the roof, held on with rusted, immobilized machine clamps. Radioactive glass makes for privacy windows, a feature undercut by the complete destruction of the door—now blown in half, painted in scorch marks, and overgrown with white moss.
		
		Someone was living and scrapping here... until it came to an unfortunate end.
		
		Highly radioactive sludge impedes any travel to the north and west, but the mossy ground makes for easy moving to the east and south."

rows.original: Phaedra II’s glassy surface threads between the boulders to the north and a pool of caustic slime to the southwest. A few splinters of rock linger here, shed by their traumatized brethren to the north, waiting for a chance to stub your [pc.toe]. The glass continues to the east and west. You can squeeze through north through the boulders, but there’s no reason to venture southward into that sludge.
rows.translation: 菲德拉二号的玻璃地表从北侧巨石和西南侧腐蚀性黏液池之间穿过。几块岩石碎片散落在这里，它们从北边那些饱受摧残的巨石身上剥落，正等着找机会磕痛你的[pc.toe]。玻璃地表继续向东、西延伸。你可以从巨石间挤向北方，但完全没理由朝南走进那片淤泥。
rows.raw: "Phaedra II’s glassy surface threads between the boulders to the north and a pool of caustic slime to the southwest. A few splinters of rock linger here, shed by their traumatized brethren to the north, waiting for a chance to stub your [pc.toe]. The glass continues to the east and west. You can squeeze through north through the boulders, but there’s no reason to venture southward into that sludge."

rows.original:
You stand amidst a number of building-sized boulders with their northern faces half-melted into what some might consider art. Phaedra’s surface is truly unique among the cosmos for its beautiful desolation - or so you hope. This level of nuclear devastation shouldn’t be repeated - any more than history already has.

The rocky behemoths hem you in to the west, but you can squeeze north into their midst. A glassy green expanse stretches off to the east and west.
rows.translation:
你站在一群楼房大小的巨石之间，它们的北侧半融化成了某些人或许会称之为艺术的形状。菲德拉的地表因这种美丽的荒凉而在宇宙中独一无二——至少你希望如此。这种程度的核毁灭不应再次发生——历史已经重演过太多次了。

西面的岩石巨兽将你困在其中，但你可以挤进它们之间向北前进。绿色玻璃般的广阔地面向东、西两侧延伸。
rows.raw: "You stand amidst a number of building-sized boulders with their northern faces half-melted into what some might consider art. Phaedra’s surface is truly unique among the cosmos for its beautiful desolation - or so you hope. This level of nuclear devastation shouldn’t be repeated - any more than history already has.\n\nThe rocky behemoths hem you in to the west, but you can squeeze north into their midst. A glassy green expanse stretches off to the east and west."

rows.original: At last, you’re given a break from treading on Phaedra’s hardened surface - by the selfsame moss you’ve been observing for the last little while. The soil must be especially fertile beneath the glass, because it has completely overgrown the bounds it exists within elsewhere. The springy alabaster foliage cushions your movements and emits a faint, sweet fragrance. You feel like this would be a nice place to rest, if it weren’t for the ever-present danger of scrappers, mutants, and worse.
rows.translation: 总算不用继续踩着菲德拉的坚硬地表了，代替它的正是你刚才一路观察的那种苔藓。玻璃下方的土壤一定格外肥沃，因为这里的苔藓已经彻底越过了其他地方限制它生长的边界。雪白而富有弹性的叶片托住你的脚步，并散发出淡淡的甜香。若不是拾荒者、变种生物以及更糟事物带来的持续威胁，这里倒是个不错的休息地点。
rows.raw: "At last, you’re given a break from treading on Phaedra’s hardened surface - by the selfsame moss you’ve been observing for the last little while. The soil must be especially fertile beneath the glass, because it has completely overgrown the bounds it exists within elsewhere. The springy alabaster foliage cushions your movements and emits a faint, sweet fragrance. You feel like this would be a nice place to rest, if it weren’t for the ever-present danger of scrappers, mutants, and worse."

rows.original:
Spores erupt out of the whitish moss when you walk, bursting into the air like harmless snow. They swirl about on the tainted air, riding the breeze till they can find a new piece of ground to colonize—a bit like the UGC, you suppose.
		
		The path threads north and east between impassible mountains, a crashed ship, and radioactive sludge. Further north, the terrain is less obstructed.
rows.translation:
你行走时，孢子从白色苔藓中喷涌而出，如无害的雪花般飞入空中。它们在受污染的空气中盘旋，乘着微风飘荡，直到找到一片新土地建立殖民地——你觉得这倒有点像银河联合邦联。
		
		道路在无法通行的山脉、坠毁飞船和放射性淤泥之间蜿蜒向北、向东。更北方的地形没那么多阻碍。
rows.raw: "Spores erupt out of the whitish moss when you walk, bursting into the air like harmless snow. They swirl about on the tainted air, riding the breeze till they can find a new piece of ground to colonize—a bit like the UGC, you suppose.\n\t\t\n\t\tThe path threads north and east between impassible mountains, a crashed ship, and radioactive sludge. Further north, the terrain is less obstructed."

rows.original:
This place is a literal graveyard - and not just for the ship that smashed itself nose-down in the ground to the north after being riddled with holes. Someone took the time to gather the crew’s bodies and pile them beneath a cairn of metal, glass, and moss. Two beat-up spears stab into the ground alongside it, each with a rusty cog strapped on.
		
		Someone took the time to fish out the bodies and give them a proper burial. The moss now growing over the cairn lends the whole affair an unsettling energy.
		
		The moss-webbed ground stretches around the wreck to the northeast and northwest. The south is still too radioactive to explore, and swampy to boot.
rows.translation:
这里简直就是一座墓地——而且不只是因为北面那艘被打得千疮百孔、船头朝下撞入地面的飞船。有人特意收集了船员遗体，将他们葬在由金属、玻璃和苔藓堆成的石冢下。两支破旧长矛插在一旁的地面上，每支矛上都绑着一个生锈齿轮。
		
		有人费力捞出遗体，让他们得以体面安葬。如今覆盖石冢的苔藓让整片景象透出一股令人不安的气息。
		
		布满苔藓蛛网的地面绕过残骸，向东北和西北延伸。南面依然放射性过强，而且满是沼泽。
rows.raw:
"This place is a literal graveyard - and not just for the ship that smashed itself nose-down in the ground to the north after being riddled with holes. Someone took the time to gather the crew’s bodies and pile them beneath a cairn of metal, glass, and moss. Two beat-up spears stab into the ground alongside it, each with a rusty cog strapped on.
		
		Someone took the time to fish out the bodies and give them a proper burial. The moss now growing over the cairn lends the whole affair an unsettling energy.
		
		The moss-webbed ground stretches around the wreck to the northeast and northwest. The south is still too radioactive to explore, and swampy to boot."

rows.original:
On the southern edge of "the webs," you come across an oddity: a missing chunk of glass. The pentagon-shaped hole in the ground has been filled entirely with the whitish plants that live here, softer than grass and thrice as dense.
		
		It’s a shame the terrain gets sludgy and more radioactive to the south. Not much could survive out there - and you certainly could not without making a whole expedition out of it.
rows.translation:
在“蛛网区”的南缘，你发现了一处怪异景象：玻璃地面缺了一块。地上的五边形孔洞完全被当地的白色植物填满；它们比草更柔软，密度却足有三倍。
		
		可惜南面的地形逐渐泥泞，放射性也更强。那里几乎没有什么东西能够生存，而你若不专门筹备一场远征，也肯定活不下来。
rows.raw: 'On the southern edge of "the webs," you come across an oddity: a missing chunk of glass. The pentagon-shaped hole in the ground has been filled entirely with the whitish plants that live here, softer than grass and thrice as dense.\n\t\t\n\t\tIt’s a shame the terrain gets sludgy and more radioactive to the south. Not much could survive out there - and you certainly could not without making a whole expedition out of it.'

rows.original:
As you move onto a fresh, glassy plate, tiny worms lift out of the surrounding moss, wiggling in the air like stalks of agitated corn. They’re only two or three inches tall, and when you lean down for a better look, they vanish back into the moss. Strange.
		
		A dilapidated spaceship sits embedded in the ground to the west. Every scrap of usable material has already been picked off, and what’s left is a rusted heap. The moss grows extra thick around the base.
		
		This plant-webbed region continues to the north, east, and south.
rows.translation:
当你走上一块新的玻璃板时，细小蠕虫从周围的苔藓中抬起身体，像一排受惊的玉米秆般在空中扭动。它们只有两三英寸高；当你俯身想看得更清楚时，它们又钻回苔藓中消失不见。真奇怪。
		
		西面有一艘破败飞船嵌在地里。所有可用材料都已被拆走，只剩下一堆锈蚀残骸。船体底部周围的苔藓生长得格外茂密。
		
		这片遍布植物蛛网的区域继续向北、东、南延伸。
rows.raw:
"As you move onto a fresh, glassy plate, tiny worms lift out of the surrounding moss, wiggling in the air like stalks of agitated corn. They’re only two or three inches tall, and when you lean down for a better look, they vanish back into the moss. Strange.
		
		A dilapidated spaceship sits embedded in the ground to the west. Every scrap of usable material has already been picked off, and what’s left is a rusted heap. The moss grows extra thick around the base.
		
		This plant-webbed region continues to the north, east, and south."

rows.original:
The webs of white moss died off here, blackened by rot and desiccation. When your [pc.foot] brushes against some, it crackles apart like sun-baked plastic wrap. No apparent cause presents itself. Something chemical could have been poured into the spiderwebbing network of soil, you suppose. In a toxic wasteland like this, it would be nearly impossible which life-obliterating condition is responsible.
		
		Your Codex’s Geiger counter goes crazy whenever you aim it south or east, not that there’s much in that direction aside from more flats all the way to distant, faintly glowing mountains.
rows.translation:
这里的白色苔藓蛛网已经死去，因腐烂和干枯而发黑。你的[pc.foot]擦过其中一些时，它们像晒脆的塑料膜般噼啪碎裂。周围看不出明显成因。你猜，或许某种化学物质被倒进了蛛网状的土壤网络。在这样的有毒荒原上，几乎不可能判断究竟是哪种致命条件造成了这一切。
		
		每当你把CODEX终端的盖革计数器对准南面或东面，它都会疯狂作响；不过那边除了延伸至远方微微发光山脉的更多平原外，也没什么东西。
rows.raw: "The webs of white moss died off here, blackened by rot and desiccation. When your [pc.foot] brushes against some, it crackles apart like sun-baked plastic wrap. No apparent cause presents itself. Something chemical could have been poured into the spiderwebbing network of soil, you suppose. In a toxic wasteland like this, it would be nearly impossible which life-obliterating condition is responsible.\n\t\t\n\t\tYour Codex’s Geiger counter goes crazy whenever you aim it south or east, not that there’s much in that direction aside from more flats all the way to distant, faintly glowing mountains."

rows.original:
A factory used to stand here - you’re sure of it. Bits of the foundation still jut through the ground’s glassy cap, melted into distinct ceramic stalagmites all their own. Bits of metal so rusted that they look like they have reddish-brown fur are piled together beside the foundation. Someone picked over these ruins already, salvaged the valuables, and left the debris in a pile.
		
		Spiderwebbing white moss stretches through the cracked glass in all directions, though the patch to the south looks darkened with decay.
rows.translation:
这里曾经矗立着一座工厂——你很确定。地基残片仍从玻璃地壳中伸出，熔成一根根独特的陶瓷石笋。地基旁堆着一些锈蚀得仿佛长出红褐色毛皮的金属。已经有人搜刮过这片废墟，拿走了值钱货，只把残骸堆在这里。
		
		蛛网状白色苔藓沿玻璃裂缝向四面八方伸展，不过南边那片似乎因腐烂而变黑了。
rows.raw: "A factory used to stand here - you’re sure of it. Bits of the foundation still jut through the ground’s glassy cap, melted into distinct ceramic stalagmites all their own. Bits of metal so rusted that they look like they have reddish-brown fur are piled together beside the foundation. Someone picked over these ruins already, salvaged the valuables, and left the debris in a pile.\n\t\t\n\t\tSpiderwebbing white moss stretches through the cracked glass in all directions, though the patch to the south looks darkened with decay."

rows.original:
Spiderwebbing patterns of moss grow through the myriad cracks in the glassy ground below, thickening to the south and east. Things die off a bit to the north and west, where the glass is less broken and life struggles to take hold among the few opportunities that present themselves.
		
		From time to time, you even see some bugs scurrying around, weaving in lines from subterranean colony to subterranean colony like ants on the march—only these ants have ten legs and bizarre double-abdomens. Maybe they’re mutants, but maybe they’re mere aliens.
rows.translation:
苔藓在下方玻璃地面的无数裂缝中长成蛛网状纹路，越往南、东两面越密。北面和西面的植物稀疏一些，那里玻璃破损较少，生命只能在寥寥无几的缝隙中艰难扎根。
		
		你偶尔甚至能看到虫子匆匆跑过，像行军的蚂蚁般排成线，在一个地下群落与另一个之间穿梭——只不过这些“蚂蚁”有十条腿，还有古怪的双腹部。也许它们是变种，也许只是普通外星生物。
rows.raw: "Spiderwebbing patterns of moss grow through the myriad cracks in the glassy ground below, thickening to the south and east. Things die off a bit to the north and west, where the glass is less broken and life struggles to take hold among the few opportunities that present themselves.\n\t\t\n\t\tFrom time to time, you even see some bugs scurrying around, weaving in lines from subterranean colony to subterranean colony like ants on the march—only these ants have ten legs and bizarre double-abdomens. Maybe they’re mutants, but maybe they’re mere aliens."

rows.original: Phaedra’s bombed-out surface may seem scoured of life at first glance, but your Codex’s sensors tell a different story. A rich biome of anaerobic, radiation-resistant bacteria thrive beneath the sealed-off surface. Above, you even manage to catch sight of a bat-like bird—or is that a bird-like bat? No matter. The planet doesn’t care if its inhabitants nuked themselves to pieces; even then, there’s still plenty of life around judging by tread-shaped cracks in the glassy ground.
rows.translation: 乍看之下，菲德拉被轰炸过的地表仿佛已被彻底抹去生命，但CODEX终端的传感器讲述着另一番故事。密封地表下生活着丰富的厌氧、抗辐射细菌群落。在地面上，你甚至瞥见了一只蝙蝠般的鸟——又或者是鸟般的蝙蝠？无所谓。这个星球并不在乎居民是否把自己炸成碎片；从玻璃地面上那些足迹形状的裂纹来看，即便如此，这里依旧生机勃勃。
rows.raw: "Phaedra’s bombed-out surface may seem scoured of life at first glance, but your Codex’s sensors tell a different story. A rich biome of anaerobic, radiation-resistant bacteria thrive beneath the sealed-off surface. Above, you even manage to catch sight of a bat-like bird—or is that a bird-like bat? No matter. The planet doesn’t care if its inhabitants nuked themselves to pieces; even then, there’s still plenty of life around judging by tread-shaped cracks in the glassy ground."

rows.original:
Petals of greenish glass curl with flower-like concentricity near large cracks in Phaedra’s surface, their gem-like edges tinting from green to a near luminous pink. Though they lack stems, there’s something more to them than mere minerals - enough for your Codex to flag them for potential future study. Their edges are certainly sharp enough for you to stick to the clear spaces between "flower" bunches.

			More of the unclassified exotic "growths" to the north and east. Smoother glass stretches out to the south and west.
rows.translation:
绿色玻璃花瓣在菲德拉地表的大裂缝附近层层卷曲，形似花朵；宝石般的边缘从绿色渐变成近乎发光的粉色。虽然没有茎秆，但它们显然不只是矿物——足以让CODEX终端将其标记为值得日后研究的对象。它们的边缘无疑锋利得很，让你只敢沿着一簇簇“花朵”之间的空地行走。

			北面和东面还有更多尚未分类的奇异“生长物”。更平滑的玻璃向南、西延伸。
rows.raw: 'Petals of greenish glass curl with flower-like concentricity near large cracks in Phaedra’s surface, their gem-like edges tinting from green to a near luminous pink. Though they lack stems, there’s something more to them than mere minerals - enough for your Codex to flag them for potential future study. Their edges are certainly sharp enough for you to stick to the clear spaces between "flower" bunches.\n\n\t\t\tMore of the unclassified exotic "growths" to the north and east. Smoother glass stretches out to the south and west.'

rows.original:
Green-blue wasteland stretches out in all directions, but you presently stand amidst a number of gem-studded rents in the otherwise wavy blue glass. The growths look a bit like flowers - their petals at least, collected in bunches that you might be happy to consider as flora, though for all you know they’re the result of a chemical interaction with the acidic precipitation Phaedra calls rain.

			The beautifully-fringed patches continue to the north and south of here.
rows.translation:
蓝绿色荒原向四面八方延伸，而你此刻站在波浪般的蓝色玻璃上，周围裂隙镶满宝石。那些生长物看起来有点像花，至少层叠成簇的花瓣很像；你或许乐意把它们当作植物，但据你所知，它们也可能只是菲德拉所谓“雨水”的酸性降水引发的化学反应产物。

			这些边缘美丽的斑块继续向南、北延伸。
rows.raw: "Green-blue wasteland stretches out in all directions, but you presently stand amidst a number of gem-studded rents in the otherwise wavy blue glass. The growths look a bit like flowers - their petals at least, collected in bunches that you might be happy to consider as flora, though for all you know they’re the result of a chemical interaction with the acidic precipitation Phaedra calls rain.\n\n\t\t\tThe beautifully-fringed patches continue to the north and south of here."

rows.original:
Phaedra may have had its biosphere burned away in a tide of nuclear fire, but the crystalline, flower-like growths springing out of nearby rents hint at new, life-like processes boldly carving spaces amidst the devastation. Scans struggle to pinpoint the glittering, concentric growths as living flora or the result of natural chemical processes. They may remain a puzzle for future scientists in the years to come.

			Going north is impossible. A sheer, darkened rock juts out of the surface like a sword from a wound.

			Strange green flames flicker to the east, waving like bushes in the breeze. More of them beautiful-but-prickly flowers sprout to the south. Westward, the ground itself seems to be cracked and heaved as if by a mighty explosion.
rows.translation:
菲德拉的生物圈或许已经被核火浪潮焚毁，但附近裂隙中冒出的花状晶体生长物暗示着，新的类生命过程正大胆地在废墟中开辟空间。扫描无法确定这些闪亮的同心生长物究竟是活体植物，还是自然化学过程的产物。未来几年里，它们或许仍会是留给科学家的谜题。

			向北无路可走。一块陡直、焦黑的岩石如伤口中的利剑般刺出地表。

			诡异的绿色火焰在东面闪烁，像灌木般随风摇摆。南面长着更多美丽却扎手的花朵。向西望去，地面本身仿佛被一场猛烈爆炸震裂、拱起。
rows.raw:
"Phaedra may have had its biosphere burned away in a tide of nuclear fire, but the crystalline, flower-like growths springing out of nearby rents hint at new, life-like processes boldly carving spaces amidst the devastation. Scans struggle to pinpoint the glittering, concentric growths as living flora or the result of natural chemical processes. They may remain a puzzle for future scientists in the years to come.

			Going north is impossible. A sheer, darkened rock juts out of the surface like a sword from a wound.

			Strange green flames flicker to the east, waving like bushes in the breeze. More of them beautiful-but-prickly flowers sprout to the south. Westward, the ground itself seems to be cracked and heaved as if by a mighty explosion."

rows.original: Radiation Warning! The Codex won’t stop giving you alarms about the area to the north and northwest. Nothing up there seems worth investigating anyhow; it’s all flat, blasted glass. The immediate area is similarly flattened, with only the faintest rolls and ripples disturbing the glossy surface below. Traversal to the south and west leads to similar terrain, untainted by Codex alarms about things like ‘lethality’ and ‘certain death’. Flickering green flames haunt the area to the east, the origins unclear.
rows.translation: 辐射警告！CODEX终端不断对北面和西北面发出警报。反正那里也没有值得调查的东西，只有平坦而遭受轰击的玻璃地面。 眼前区域同样平坦，光滑地表只有最轻微的起伏和波纹。向南、向西可以走到类似地形，而且CODEX终端不会在那里用“致命”和“必死无疑”之类的警报烦你。幽灵般的绿色火焰在东面闪烁，来源不明。
rows.raw: "Radiation Warning! The Codex won’t stop giving you alarms about the area to the north and northwest. Nothing up there seems worth investigating anyhow; it’s all flat, blasted glass.\n\n\t\t\tThe immediate area is similarly flattened, with only the faintest rolls and ripples disturbing the glossy surface below. Traversal to the south and west leads to similar terrain, untainted by Codex alarms about things like ‘lethality’ and ‘certain death’. Flickering green flames haunt the area to the east, the origins unclear."

rows.original:
If you squint, Phaedra’s green gently rolling surface could almost be mistaken for grass. Of course, grass doesn’t crackle like ice when you step too hard, and actually cushions any [pc.footNoun]-falls. Phaedra doesn’t. It’s been hardened in atomic fire and tempered to unyielding firmness.

			The rolling emerald plains stretch off to the north. To the east, you can spot strangely flickering green fires. South is blocked by a sheer boulder, seemingly extruded from below by enormous pressure. To the west, the green ground has been cracked and broken but remains passable.
rows.translation:
眯起眼睛时，菲德拉绿色而轻缓起伏的地表几乎会被误认为草原。当然，草地不会在你踩得太重时像冰一样噼啪作响，也确实能在[pc.footNoun]摔倒时提供缓冲。菲德拉可不会。它经受过原子烈火的灼烧，已经淬炼得坚硬不屈。

			起伏的翠绿色平原向北延伸。东面可以看到诡异闪烁的绿火。南面被一块陡峭巨石阻挡，那石头像是被巨大的压力从地下挤出来的。西面的绿色地面已经开裂破碎，但依然可以通行。
rows.raw: "If you squint, Phaedra’s green gently rolling surface could almost be mistaken for grass. Of course, grass doesn’t crackle like ice when you step too hard, and actually cushions any [pc.footNoun]-falls. Phaedra doesn’t. It’s been hardened in atomic fire and tempered to unyielding firmness.\n\n\t\t\tThe rolling emerald plains stretch off to the north. To the east, you can spot strangely flickering green fires. South is blocked by a sheer boulder, seemingly extruded from below by enormous pressure. To the west, the green ground has been cracked and broken but remains passable."

rows.original: Your Codex’s alarms start pinging like crazy the farther north you step: Radiation warning! It chirps like a bothersome bird, but you know well enough to trust it. Phaedra’s glassy surface may be even smoother up there, but there isn’t a single visible landmark worth investigating. Anything that once existed in that space must have been obliterated by a point-blank impact from a fission bomb. It would be less radioactive to the south, along the rim a of small, jagged crater. West follows the crater’s lip along the irradiated zone. East offers a smoother path on the glass.
rows.translation: 你越往北走，CODEX终端的警报就响得越疯狂： 辐射警告！ 它像烦人的鸟一样鸣叫，但你知道应该相信它。那边的菲德拉玻璃地表或许更加平滑，却连一个值得调查的明显地标都没有。曾经存在于那片区域的一切，必定都被近距离命中的裂变炸弹彻底抹去了。 向南沿着一座小型嶙峋弹坑的边缘走，放射性会弱一些。向西可沿弹坑边缘贴着辐射区前进。东面则有一条较为平滑的玻璃道路。
rows.raw: "Your Codex’s alarms start pinging like crazy the farther north you step: Radiation warning! It chirps like a bothersome bird, but you know well enough to trust it. Phaedra’s glassy surface may be even smoother up there, but there isn’t a single visible landmark worth investigating. Anything that once existed in that space must have been obliterated by a point-blank impact from a fission bomb. It would be less radioactive to the south, along the rim a of small, jagged crater. West follows the crater’s lip along the irradiated zone. East offers a smoother path on the glass."

rows.original: Iron-rich soil, crystallized by heat, crunches underneath you as you walk, threading your way between stouter shards that might actually deal you damage. A deep crater filled with even sharper rocks looms below to the west. You keep your distance, unwilling to risk toppling into the nuclear-induced geological disturbance. The crater stretches south and twists away to the northwest. The north and east lead to more of the glassy plain you’ve come to expect.
rows.translation: 富含铁质、受热结晶的土壤在你脚下嘎吱作响；你在较粗壮、真正可能伤到你的尖刺间穿行。西面下方横亘着一座深坑，坑内尽是更加锋利的岩石。你不愿冒险跌入这处核爆造成的地质扰动区，因此与它保持距离。弹坑向南延伸，又曲折通往西北。北面和东面则通向你已习以为常的玻璃平原。
rows.raw: "Iron-rich soil, crystallized by heat, crunches underneath you as you walk, threading your way between stouter shards that might actually deal you damage. A deep crater filled with even sharper rocks looms below to the west. You keep your distance, unwilling to risk toppling into the nuclear-induced geological disturbance. The crater stretches south and twists away to the northwest. The north and east lead to more of the glassy plain you’ve come to expect."

rows.original: You stand on the edge of a jagged, foreboding crater. Rusty brown rocks, sharpened by the force of being dislodged from the earth at explosive speed, threaten to rip at your [pc.feet] with every movement. Descent into the pit might be possible, but the danger and lack of any perceivable reward make it seem a fool’s errand. The crater’s lip extends to the north and southwest. Directly south, the terrain grows glassy once more. Eastward lies a strange feature - crystalline-seeming flowers?
rows.translation: 你站在一座嶙峋而阴森的弹坑边缘。锈褐色岩石因爆炸时高速脱离地表而被磨得锋利，每走一步都可能划伤你的[pc.feet]。也许能够下到坑里，但危险巨大又看不出任何回报，尝试下去似乎愚不可及。弹坑边缘向北和西南延伸。正南方的地形重新变成玻璃状。东面则有某种奇特景观——看似晶体构成的花朵？
rows.raw: "You stand on the edge of a jagged, foreboding crater. Rusty brown rocks, sharpened by the force of being dislodged from the earth at explosive speed, threaten to rip at your [pc.feet] with every movement. Descent into the pit might be possible, but the danger and lack of any perceivable reward make it seem a fool’s errand. The crater’s lip extends to the north and southwest. Directly south, the terrain grows glassy once more. Eastward lies a strange feature - crystalline-seeming flowers?"

rows.original: You stand on the border between geological features. Here things are green, glassy, and smoothed aesthetically by the flame of nuclear fire. To the north, the terrain is more reddish brown, awash in hard-edged rocks with heavy coats of oxidation. The rolling glassy plains continue to the south, but in the east something sparkles atop the strange surface.
rows.translation: 你站在两种地质景观的交界处。这里绿色、光滑如玻璃，还被核火打磨出一种别样美感。北面的地形则偏红褐色，遍布边缘锋利、覆盖厚重氧化层的岩石。起伏的玻璃平原继续向南延伸，而东面有某样东西在奇异地表上闪闪发光。
rows.raw: "You stand on the border between geological features. Here things are green, glassy, and smoothed aesthetically by the flame of nuclear fire. To the north, the terrain is more reddish brown, awash in hard-edged rocks with heavy coats of oxidation. The rolling glassy plains continue to the south, but in the east something sparkles atop the strange surface."

rows.original:
Phaedra’s glassy surface ripples just enough to make traversing it a tremendous pain. It stretches on in all directions, though craters to the northwest and more distant north provide ample locales to gather your bearings from.
		
		You’re pretty sure you can still see your ship parked off to the south-south-west.
rows.translation:
菲德拉的玻璃地表起伏得恰到坏处，让穿越此地变成一件极其痛苦的事。它向四面八方延伸，不过西北和更远北方的弹坑提供了充足的参照物，方便你辨认方向。
		
		你很确定自己仍能看见停在南南西方向的飞船。
rows.raw: "Phaedra’s glassy surface ripples just enough to make traversing it a tremendous pain. It stretches on in all directions, though craters to the northwest and more distant north provide ample locales to gather your bearings from.\n\t\t\n\t\tYou’re pretty sure you can still see your ship parked off to the south-south-west."

rows.original: Nuclear-baked glass crunches beneath you as you move through the wasteland. Huge boulders pile up to the west, their northern faces liquefied and refused into a pudding-like appearance. Just north, the glass splits apart around a crater. More sprawling, glassy ripples undulate away to the east and south, leading on to more signs of Phaedra’s molten past.
rows.translation: 你穿过荒原时，核火烤制的玻璃在脚下嘎吱作响。巨石堆积在西面，北侧表面曾经液化，又重新凝固成布丁般的模样。正北方的玻璃围绕着一座弹坑裂开。更多广阔的玻璃波纹向东、南起伏延伸，通往更多菲德拉昔日熔融状态的痕迹。
rows.raw: "Nuclear-baked glass crunches beneath you as you move through the wasteland. Huge boulders pile up to the west, their northern faces liquefied and refused into a pudding-like appearance. Just north, the glass splits apart around a crater. More sprawling, glassy ripples undulate away to the east and south, leading on to more signs of Phaedra’s molten past."

rows.original:
Whoah! You come upon a deep, jagged pit. The interior is filled with massive, reddish-brown spikes of impure iron ore. The ground around the pit is similarly ruddy and littered with smaller, spiky fragments. You’ll have to step carefully on your way around it.

There doesn’t seem to be anything worth investigating at the bottom aside from a nasty case of Tetanus.

Rocks with their northern faces melted into semi-liquid smoothness stand to the west. To the east and south, Phaedra transitions back to its green-glassed ground.
rows.translation:
哇！你来到一座幽深而嶙峋的坑洞前。内部遍布巨大的红褐色不纯铁矿尖刺。坑边地面同样呈铁锈色，散落着较小的尖锐碎片。绕行时必须小心落脚。

坑底除了足以让人严重感染破伤风的东西外，似乎没有任何值得调查之物。

西面矗立着一些岩石，其北侧曾熔化成半液态的平滑表面。东面和南面，菲德拉的地面重新过渡为绿色玻璃。
rows.raw:
"Whoah! You come upon a deep, jagged pit. The interior is filled with massive, reddish-brown spikes of impure iron ore. The ground around the pit is similarly ruddy and littered with smaller, spiky fragments. You’ll have to step carefully on your way around it.

There doesn’t seem to be anything worth investigating at the bottom aside from a nasty case of Tetanus.

Rocks with their northern faces melted into semi-liquid smoothness stand to the west. To the east and south, Phaedra transitions back to its green-glassed ground."

rows.original: Radiation Warning! Your Codex insists you not step further into the flat glass to the north. The point-blank impact of a fission bomb has left a wide swath of the terrain barren, uninhabitable, and unworthy of your attention. To the south lies a jagged pit surrounded by shards of iron-rich rocks, as reddish-brown as dried blood. A quick scan from your Codex identifies the remnants of an underground aquifer explosively vaporized during the planet’s apocalyptic bombardment. Smooth glass surface stretches off to the east and west, offering a less perilous place to stand.
rows.translation: 辐射警告！CODEX终端坚持不让你继续踏入北面的平坦玻璃地。裂变炸弹的近距离冲击在这里留下了一大片荒芜、无法居住且不值得关注的区域。 南面是一座被富铁岩石碎片包围的嶙峋深坑，那些岩石像干涸血液一样呈红褐色。CODEX终端快速扫描后确认，这是一处地下含水层在星球遭受末日轰炸时被爆炸性汽化后留下的遗迹。 平滑的玻璃地表向东、西延伸，提供了危险更少的落脚处。
rows.raw: "Radiation Warning! Your Codex insists you not step further into the flat glass to the north. The point-blank impact of a fission bomb has left a wide swath of the terrain barren, uninhabitable, and unworthy of your attention. To the south lies a jagged pit surrounded by shards of iron-rich rocks, as reddish-brown as dried blood. A quick scan from your Codex identifies the remnants of an underground aquifer explosively vaporized during the planet’s apocalyptic bombardment. Smooth glass surface stretches off to the east and west, offering a less perilous place to stand."

rows.original: Radiation Warning! Your Codex demands you avoid traveling to the north and west - both areas are too contaminated by radiation to safely explore, even with your blood fully infused by self-repairing microsurgeons. If you head east or south, you’ll be stepping on jagged chunks of rust-red earth - apparently explosively excavated from the matching pit to the southeast.
rows.translation: 辐射警告！CODEX终端要求你避免向北和向西移动——两片区域的辐射污染都过于严重，即使血液中充满自我修复的微型外科机器人，也无法安全探索。 如果向东或向南走，你将踩上锯齿状的锈红色土块；它们显然是从东南方相同颜色的坑洞中爆炸挖出的。
rows.raw: "Radiation Warning! Your Codex demands you avoid traveling to the north and west - both areas are too contaminated by radiation to safely explore, even with your blood fully infused by self-repairing microsurgeons.\n\nIf you head east or south, you’ll be stepping on jagged chunks of rust-red earth - apparently explosively excavated from the matching pit to the southeast."

rows.original: Straddling between intense radiation to the west and a pit of metallic, heat-hardened blades of earth to the east, you’ll have to [pc.move] carefully. The pit itself appears empty save for a few unfortunate skeletons that fell - or were tossed - in. It’s not worth the effort and danger of climbing into it yourself. You can follow the lip of the crater south from here, or step north onto a stretch of smooth glass once more.
rows.translation: 你被夹在西面的强辐射区与东面遍布金属质、受热硬化的地刺深坑之间，必须小心[pc.move]。坑里除了几具不幸掉进去——或被扔进去——的骸骨外空无一物。亲自爬下去既费力又危险，根本不值得。你可以从这里沿弹坑边缘向南走，也可以向北重新踏上平滑的玻璃地面。
rows.raw: "Straddling between intense radiation to the west and a pit of metallic, heat-hardened blades of earth to the east, you’ll have to [pc.move] carefully. The pit itself appears empty save for a few unfortunate skeletons that fell - or were tossed - in. It’s not worth the effort and danger of climbing into it yourself. You can follow the lip of the crater south from here, or step north onto a stretch of smooth glass once more."

rows.original:
You stand amongst shards of ruddy earth, as if blasted out of the pit to the east. Most of them are small and fragile enough to shatter underfoot. The rest make you step carefully during your exploration of this alien planet. The pit itself is even worse - absolutely filled with nightmare-like spires of jagged iron formations. You can follow the pit to the north, or work your way to southeast to examine its southern edge.

Rocks with melt-softened faces loom to the south. Westward, you spot what looks like a tree, half-blasted to oblivion and standing all the same.
rows.translation:
你站在一片红褐色土壤碎块之间，它们似乎都是从东面的坑洞里炸出来的。大多数碎块又小又脆，踩在脚下就会碎裂。其余碎块则迫使你在探索这个外星星球时小心落脚。坑洞本身更为糟糕，里面塞满噩梦般嶙峋的铁质尖塔。你可以沿坑洞向北前进，也可以朝东南走，查看它的南缘。

南面耸立着表面被熔化得柔软平滑的岩石。向西望去，你看见某个像树的东西；它有一半被炸得荡然无存，却仍屹立不倒。
rows.raw: "You stand amongst shards of ruddy earth, as if blasted out of the pit to the east. Most of them are small and fragile enough to shatter underfoot. The rest make you step carefully during your exploration of this alien planet. The pit itself is even worse - absolutely filled with nightmare-like spires of jagged iron formations. You can follow the pit to the north, or work your way to southeast to examine its southern edge.\n\nRocks with melt-softened faces loom to the south. Westward, you spot what looks like a tree, half-blasted to oblivion and standing all the same."

rows.original:
Boulders would be one thing you’d expect to handle a nuclear blast better than most, and you suppose these have - by remaining standing in spite of the apocalyptic forces that washed over them not so long ago. Their northern faces clearly liquified for a moment, long enough to leave them looking mushy and soft as mud. A touch confirms they’re still rocks, however much their surface resembles a sloppy mess.

You can’t squeeze through the dense westward stone, but travel south through the melty boulders remains an option - as does heading north or east to the edge of a jagged crater.
rows.translation:
你原以为巨石应该比大多数东西都更能承受核爆，而这些巨石似乎确实做到了——不久前末日般的力量席卷此处，它们却依然站立。它们的北侧显然曾短暂液化，时间长得足以让表面变得像稀泥般软烂。亲手一摸便能确认它们依旧是岩石，无论外表多像一团烂泥。

你无法从西面密集的石群中挤过去，但仍可穿过南面的熔融巨石，也可以向北或向东走到嶙峋弹坑的边缘。
rows.raw: "Boulders would be one thing you’d expect to handle a nuclear blast better than most, and you suppose these have - by remaining standing in spite of the apocalyptic forces that washed over them not so long ago. Their northern faces clearly liquified for a moment, long enough to leave them looking mushy and soft as mud. A touch confirms they’re still rocks, however much their surface resembles a sloppy mess.\n\nYou can’t squeeze through the dense westward stone, but travel south through the melty boulders remains an option - as does heading north or east to the edge of a jagged crater."

rows.original:
You stand amidst a field of semi-melted boulders. Your Codex’s geological analysis function indicates that this may have once been the final resting place of a glacier. It’s strange to think that ice and snow did more to move these behemoths than the nuclear fire that scarred their faces into runny messes.

Once-melted stones stand to the north and south from here. To the east is more of the green, glassy surface you’ve come to expect from Phaedra.
rows.translation:
你站在一片半融化的巨石群中。CODEX终端的地质分析功能显示，这里或许曾是一座冰川的终点。想到搬动这些庞然巨物的冰雪，竟比把它们表面烧熔的核火更有力量，实在奇怪。

曾经熔化的岩石分布在南北两面。东面则是你已熟悉的菲德拉绿色玻璃地表。
rows.raw: "You stand amidst a field of semi-melted boulders. Your Codex’s geological analysis function indicates that this may have once been the final resting place of a glacier. It’s strange to think that ice and snow did more to move these behemoths than the nuclear fire that scarred their faces into runny messes.\n\nOnce-melted stones stand to the north and south from here. To the east is more of the green, glassy surface you’ve come to expect from Phaedra."

rows.original: Your Codex’s Geiger counter chirps a little faster here, warning you of more radiation to the south and west - not that those impassible nuke-blasted mountains are likely to be worth exploring. To the north, the ground’s glassy surface shifts hues through whole rainbows of purple and green shades in a truly beautiful display of desolation.
rows.translation: CODEX终端的盖革计数器在这里鸣叫得稍快，警告你南面和西面辐射更强——不过那些无法逾越、被核爆摧毁的山脉大概也不值得探索。北面玻璃地表的色彩变化万千，从紫色到绿色宛如一道道彩虹，展现出真正美丽的荒凉景象。
rows.raw: "Your Codex’s Geiger counter chirps a little faster here, warning you of more radiation to the south and west - not that those impassible nuke-blasted mountains are likely to be worth exploring. To the north, the ground’s glassy surface shifts hues through whole rainbows of purple and green shades in a truly beautiful display of desolation."

rows.original:
Green gives way to blue, purple, even reds and oranges here! The nuclear-fired glass in this area must cross over numerous geological layers with their own exotic mineral inclusions, resulting in a magical-seeming wonderland of fantastic colors. The unsubtle beeps of your Codex’s geiger counter partly ruin the illusion. You can follow this road of rainbows north, or go south into the expanse of pure emerald.

Sheer irradiated mountains cut you off to the west, and densely packed boulders block travel east.
rows.translation:
这里的绿色渐变为蓝色、紫色，甚至红色与橙色！这一区域经核火烧成的玻璃必定横跨多个地质层，每层都含有不同的奇异矿物，最终形成一片魔法世界般的绚丽色彩。CODEX终端盖革计数器直白的哔哔声让这份幻象稍打折扣。你可以沿彩虹道路向北走，也可以向南进入纯粹的翠绿天地。

西面是陡峭的辐射山脉，东面则被密集巨石阻断。
rows.raw: "Green gives way to blue, purple, even reds and oranges here! The nuclear-fired glass in this area must cross over numerous geological layers with their own exotic mineral inclusions, resulting in a magical-seeming wonderland of fantastic colors. The unsubtle beeps of your Codex’s geiger counter partly ruin the illusion. You can follow this road of rainbows north, or go south into the expanse of pure emerald.\n\nSheer irradiated mountains cut you off to the west, and densely packed boulders block travel east."

rows.original:
The kaleidoscopic waves of colored glass are almost dizzying to behold. Without the surface cracks and blemishes, you’d look to be standing on an undulating palette of brilliant color. It is truly beautiful, but a sterile kind of beautiful - like the twinkling void of space or the rolling dunes of a picturesque yet barren desert.

This colorful glass stretches off to the north, south, and west. Huge rocks with their northern faces half-melted block off any attempts to journey to the east.
rows.translation:
万花筒般的彩色玻璃波浪令人目眩。如果没有表面的裂缝与瑕疵，你看起来就像站在一块起伏的绚丽调色板上。这里确实很美，却是一种没有生命的美——如星光闪烁的太空虚空，又如风景如画却寸草不生的起伏沙丘。

彩色玻璃向北、南、西三面延伸。北侧表面半融化的巨岩阻断了所有向东行进的尝试。
rows.raw: "The kaleidoscopic waves of colored glass are almost dizzying to behold. Without the surface cracks and blemishes, you’d look to be standing on an undulating palette of brilliant color. It is truly beautiful, but a sterile kind of beautiful - like the twinkling void of space or the rolling dunes of a picturesque yet barren desert.\n\nThis colorful glass stretches off to the north, south, and west. Huge rocks with their northern faces half-melted block off any attempts to journey to the east."

rows.original:
The nuclear-melted glass here is different than elsewhere - more vibrant. Awash with hues from the most neon pink to the deepest blues, the glass below feels like a road of rainbow, laid out just for you to [pc.move] upon. A huge chunk of rock flanks the colorful path’s west. On the east, dense stones with the north faces half-melted hem you in. What looks like a single tree lies a short walk to the north. More rainbows wind south.

Your geiger counter clicks a steady tempo - enough radiation to monitor, but not enough to be concerned about in any meaningful way.
rows.translation:
这里被核火熔化的玻璃与别处不同，更加鲜艳。脚下的玻璃浸染着从霓虹粉到深蓝的种种色调，仿佛一条专为你铺设、供你[pc.move]的彩虹道路。一大块岩石位于彩色道路西侧。东面则是密集的石群，它们朝北的表面都已半融化，将你限制在道路上。北面不远处似乎有一棵孤树。更多彩虹向南蜿蜒。

盖革计数器以稳定节奏发出咔嗒声——辐射强度值得监控，但远未到真正需要担忧的程度。
rows.raw: "The nuclear-melted glass here is different than elsewhere - more vibrant. Awash with hues from the most neon pink to the deepest blues, the glass below feels like a road of rainbow, laid out just for you to [pc.move] upon. A huge chunk of rock flanks the colorful path’s west. On the east, dense stones with the north faces half-melted hem you in. What looks like a single tree lies a short walk to the north. More rainbows wind south.\n\nYour geiger counter clicks a steady tempo - enough radiation to monitor, but not enough to be concerned about in any meaningful way."

rows.original: You stop at a tree - the only one on Phaedra you’ve seen
rows.translation: 你在一棵树前停下——这是你在菲德拉见过的唯一一棵
rows.raw: "You stop at a tree - the only one on Phaedra you’ve seen"

rows.original: ! It’s not alive, not by a long shot. The bark is entirely missing from the north face, and both the wood itself and the remaining bits of bark have the whitish-gray look of stone. Indeed, it feels like rock to your touch, and your Codex confirms: this tree is petrified in place, calcified into a stony sentinel by the combination of mineral-rich biology and the searing indifference of nuclear fire. To the east lies a path circling around a jagged, red-brown pit. To the south are more glassy plains, though green you’ve grown accustomed to gives way to rainbows of beautiful hues. Westward leads to more of that plain, crunchy green glass.
rows.translation: ！它早已死去，死得不能再死。北面的树皮完全消失，木材本身与残余树皮都呈现石头般的灰白色。摸起来也确实像岩石，CODEX终端确认：这棵树已经原地石化，富含矿物的生理结构与核火灼烧时的无情共同作用，将它钙化成了一尊石质哨兵。 东面有一条绕过红褐色嶙峋深坑的道路。南面是更多玻璃平原，只是你已熟悉的绿色在那里变为一道道绚丽色彩。向西则通往更多嘎吱作响的绿色玻璃平原。
rows.raw: "! It’s not alive, not by a long shot. The bark is entirely missing from the north face, and both the wood itself and the remaining bits of bark have the whitish-gray look of stone. Indeed, it feels like rock to your touch, and your Codex confirms: this tree is petrified in place, calcified into a stony sentinel by the combination of mineral-rich biology and the searing indifference of nuclear fire.\n\nTo the east lies a path circling around a jagged, red-brown pit. To the south are more glassy plains, though green you’ve grown accustomed to gives way to rainbows of beautiful hues. Westward leads to more of that plain, crunchy green glass."

rows.translation: ——不算远方的辐射林

rows.original: Wedged up against a scorched rock face, you stand on a winding expanse of multi-colored glass. Created by a variety of sub-surface minerals melted into the melange during the blast, this particular part of Phaedra’s surface shines with its own strange beauty. The colorful glass ground offers passage to the north, along the mountainside, and to the east, toward some melty boulders.
rows.translation: 你站在一条蜿蜒的彩色玻璃地带上，身旁紧贴着焦黑的岩壁。爆炸时，多种地下矿物熔入混合物，造就了菲德拉这片独具奇异美感的地表。彩色玻璃地面向北沿山壁延伸，也可向东通往一片融化过的巨石。
rows.raw: "Wedged up against a scorched rock face, you stand on a winding expanse of multi-colored glass. Created by a variety of sub-surface minerals melted into the melange during the blast, this particular part of Phaedra’s surface shines with its own strange beauty. The colorful glass ground offers passage to the north, along the mountainside, and to the east, toward some melty boulders."

rows.original:
Here lies the border between a patch of Phaedra’s typical, greenish-glassed ground, and a more colorful segment of rippling waves of rainbow-hued ceramic. Unlike a rainbow, the colors eschew any particularly pattern or structure. Purple blends directly into orange and straight into blue a step later, dictated by the unique chemical composition of the soil underground.
		
A deeper scan with your Codex indicates that you may stand over an industrial dumping ground - each color matched to a unique pollutant.
rows.translation:
这里是菲德拉常见的绿色玻璃地面与一片彩虹色陶瓷波浪的交界。与真正的彩虹不同，这些颜色没有任何明显顺序或结构。紫色直接融入橙色，走一步又骤然转为蓝色，一切取决于地下土壤独特的化学成分。
		
CODEX终端进行深层扫描后显示，你脚下可能是一座工业倾倒场；每种颜色都对应一种独特污染物。
rows.raw: "Here lies the border between a patch of Phaedra’s typical, greenish-glassed ground, and a more colorful segment of rippling waves of rainbow-hued ceramic. Unlike a rainbow, the colors eschew any particularly pattern or structure. Purple blends directly into orange and straight into blue a step later, dictated by the unique chemical composition of the soil underground.\n\t\t\nA deeper scan with your Codex indicates that you may stand over an industrial dumping ground - each color matched to a unique pollutant."

rows.original:
The immediate north also holds something far more intriguing than any geological feature: several pieces of downed spaceships, all massively scorched as if struck by an immense barrage. Some appear to have residual power coursing through their circuits. Bigger wrecks lie beyond them - larger, almost intact hulks with clearly operational turrets still mounted. Furrows in the ground indicate that they were towed here and positioned in their current location.
			
			To the south, the emerald ground transitions into shimmering, iridescent bans that shift in hue - stark in their ghostly beauty. Meanwhile, the remnants of a tree somehow stand upright to the east. It’s as gray as the boulders to the southeast.
rows.translation:
正北方还有比任何地质景观更吸引人的东西：数艘坠毁飞船的残片，每一块都像遭受过猛烈齐射般严重焦黑。部分残骸的电路中似乎仍有残余电力流动。更大的残骸位于它们后方，那些近乎完整的船体上甚至还装着显然能够运作的炮塔。地上的沟痕表明，它们曾被拖到这里，并按现在的位置摆放。
			
			南面的翠绿地面逐渐变为闪烁的虹彩带，色调不断变化，呈现出鲜明而幽灵般的美。与此同时，东面竟然仍立着一棵树的遗骸。它和东南方的巨石一样灰白。
rows.raw: "The immediate north also holds something far more intriguing than any geological feature: several pieces of downed spaceships, all massively scorched as if struck by an immense barrage. Some appear to have residual power coursing through their circuits. Bigger wrecks lie beyond them - larger, almost intact hulks with clearly operational turrets still mounted. Furrows in the ground indicate that they were towed here and positioned in their current location.\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\tTo the south, the emerald ground transitions into shimmering, iridescent bans that shift in hue - stark in their ghostly beauty. Meanwhile, the remnants of a tree somehow stand upright to the east. It’s as gray as the boulders to the southeast."

rows.original: There’s definitely an order to how the shipwrecks are arranged. Whole vessels and larger pieces are sorted northward, smaller pieces and more brutally detonated ships spread out to the south like dragon’s teeth, effectively preventing approach by wider, armored vehicles. Many hulks still bear their original weapon emplacements too. Some of the huge turrets are still actively sweeping back and forth across the blasted earth, sensors feeding their views to an unseen operator. South leads away from this spacey junkyard, but the other direction holds a tempting structure of its own - a vertically-embedded cruiser that looks disturbingly intact for how deeply its nose is buried in the ground.
rows.translation: 这些飞船残骸的排列方式显然有某种秩序。完整飞船和较大的部件被分拣到北面；较小的部件与炸毁得更彻底的飞船则像拒马般散布在南面，有效阻止体型更宽、带有装甲的车辆接近。许多船体甚至保留着原装武器基座。一些巨型炮塔仍在主动来回扫视焦土，传感器把视野传给某个看不见的操作者。向南可以离开这座太空垃圾场，但另一个方向还有一座诱人的建筑——一艘垂直嵌入地面的巡洋舰，尽管船头深深扎入土中，外观却完整得令人不安。
rows.raw: "There’s definitely an order to how the shipwrecks are arranged. Whole vessels and larger pieces are sorted northward, smaller pieces and more brutally detonated ships spread out to the south like dragon’s teeth, effectively preventing approach by wider, armored vehicles. Many hulks still bear their original weapon emplacements too. Some of the huge turrets are still actively sweeping back and forth across the blasted earth, sensors feeding their views to an unseen operator. South leads away from this spacey junkyard, but the other direction holds a tempting structure of its own - a vertically-embedded cruiser that looks disturbingly intact for how deeply its nose is buried in the ground."

rows.original:
You stand in the shadow of a Pyrite Heavy Industries cruiser, though instead of parking in a stately manner, it’s been slammed nose first into the ground deeply enough to hold its entire aft end upright, like a modest skyscraper from a coreward city. It clearly suffered as much as the rest of this fallen junkyard during its plunge to the planet, but someone has been effecting repairs quite effectively. You can’t spot a single hole in the hull, though plenty of half-scrubbed scorch marks remain.

			The airlock door has even been reworked, detached from its original mooring and rotated ninety degrees to align with Phaedra’s surface. Above it hangs the sort of sign you’d expect to see in a storefront: “Open.”
rows.translation:
你站在一艘黄铁矿重工业巡洋舰的阴影下；它并未端正停靠，而是船头朝下狠狠撞入地面，扎得足够深，让整个船尾像核心星域城市中的中等摩天楼般直立。坠落到星球时，它显然和这座废船场中的其他残骸一样受损严重，但有人一直在进行非常有效的修复。船体上一个破洞也看不到，只剩许多尚未完全擦净的焦痕。

			气闸门甚至经过改造，从原来的固定位置拆下并旋转九十度，以便与菲德拉地表对齐。门上方挂着一块商店门面常见的招牌：“营业中。”
rows.raw: "You stand in the shadow of a Pyrite Heavy Industries cruiser, though instead of parking in a stately manner, it’s been slammed nose first into the ground deeply enough to hold its entire aft end upright, like a modest skyscraper from a coreward city. It clearly suffered as much as the rest of this fallen junkyard during its plunge to the planet, but someone has been effecting repairs quite effectively. You can’t spot a single hole in the hull, though plenty of half-scrubbed scorch marks remain.\n\n\t\t\tThe airlock door has even been reworked, detached from its original mooring and rotated ninety degrees to align with Phaedra’s surface. Above it hangs the sort of sign you’d expect to see in a storefront: “Open.” "

rows.original: It is unlit, the store closed.
rows.translation: 招牌没有亮起，商店已经关门。

rows.original: It has remained brightly lit since your ride here with Gayll.
rows.translation: 自从你和盖尔一同乘车来到这里后，招牌的灯就一直亮着。
rows.raw: "It has remained brightly lit since your ride here with Gayll."

rows.original:
One tree stands before you, alone in this blasted-out wasteland. You aren’t sure how the twisted, knobby plant survived Phaedra’s nuclear fire when so much else did not, or how it’s managing to keep its bouquet of weakened leaves aloft, but it is. This thing saw nuclear fire and lived to tell about it.
		
		The white moss in the ground grows all over its roots, filling every crack and crevice with alabaster. It’s thicker between the glass plates here than elsewhere.
rows.translation:
一棵树孤零零地矗立在这片被炸毁的荒原上。你不知道这株扭曲多节的植物为何能在其他一切都未能幸免时挺过菲德拉的核火，也不知道它如何仍能让那簇衰弱的叶片高悬枝头，但它确实做到了。它亲历核火，并且活了下来。
		
		地面的白色苔藓爬满了树根，以雪白填满每一道裂缝。这里玻璃板之间的苔藓比其他地方都更厚。
rows.raw: "One tree stands before you, alone in this blasted-out wasteland. You aren’t sure how the twisted, knobby plant survived Phaedra’s nuclear fire when so much else did not, or how it’s managing to keep its bouquet of weakened leaves aloft, but it is. This thing saw nuclear fire and lived to tell about it.\n\t\t\n\t\tThe white moss in the ground grows all over its roots, filling every crack and crevice with alabaster. It’s thicker between the glass plates here than elsewhere."

rows.original:
What’s this? A water collector? Rebar posts driven into the soft moss support a jerry-rigged water collector. A cast-iron bucket hangs beneath sheets of clear plastic, enclosed in such a way that morning dew and atmospheric humidity can be condensed for usable drinking water.

		Tire tracks running east-west alongside the collector indicate that this may be a piece of permanent infrastructure for one of Phaedra’s nomadic groups.

		The webs of white moss grow extra thick and lush here, happily drinking down every drop of spilled liquid.
rows.translation:
这是什么？集水器？插进松软苔藓里的钢筋柱支撑着一台临时拼装的集水器。铸铁桶悬在透明塑料片下方；塑料片以特定方式包围起来，能够凝结晨露和空气湿气，收集成可饮用的水。

		集水器旁沿东西方向延伸的轮胎印表明，这可能是菲德拉某个游牧群体设置的固定设施。

		白色苔藓蛛网在这里长得格外浓密繁茂，欣然吸收每一滴溅出的液体。
rows.raw:
"What’s this? A water collector? Rebar posts driven into the soft moss support a jerry-rigged water collector. A cast-iron bucket hangs beneath sheets of clear plastic, enclosed in such a way that morning dew and atmospheric humidity can be condensed for usable drinking water.

		Tire tracks running east-west alongside the collector indicate that this may be a piece of permanent infrastructure for one of Phaedra’s nomadic groups.

		The webs of white moss grow extra thick and lush here, happily drinking down every drop of spilled liquid."

rows.original:
Flowers sprout from Phaedra’s greenish, glassy crust here - or at least something that resembles flowers. The petals curl out of cracks in the glass, beautiful, curved, and razor-sharp. There aren’t stems like you might see on a tulip or rose, just a concentric pattern of curved, jutting danger.

			There’s a stark beauty to your surroundings, even if it makes you doublecheck where you place your [pc.feet]. More of these “flowers” sprout to the north. Things are flatter and smoother to the west. A structure rises to the south, and something resembling a giant beast’s thigh-bone juts from Phaedra’s blasted surface to the east.
rows.translation:
花朵从菲德拉绿色的玻璃地壳上冒出——至少是某种形似花朵的东西。花瓣从玻璃裂缝中卷出，美丽、弯曲且锋利如刀。这里没有郁金香或玫瑰那样的茎，只有一圈圈弯曲突出的危险尖片。

			周围景色有种冷峻之美，即便它迫使你反复确认[pc.feet]落在哪里。北面长着更多这种“花”。西面较为平坦光滑。南面立着一座建筑，东面则有某种像巨兽大腿骨的东西刺出菲德拉被轰炸的地表。
rows.raw: "Flowers sprout from Phaedra’s greenish, glassy crust here - or at least something that resembles flowers. The petals curl out of cracks in the glass, beautiful, curved, and razor-sharp. There aren’t stems like you might see on a tulip or rose, just a concentric pattern of curved, jutting danger.\n\n\t\t\tThere’s a stark beauty to your surroundings, even if it makes you doublecheck where you place your [pc.feet]. More of these “flowers” sprout to the north. Things are flatter and smoother to the west. A structure rises to the south, and something resembling a giant beast’s thigh-bone juts from Phaedra’s blasted surface to the east."

rows.original:
Crystalline growths line the nuke-smoothed ground where its less-than-sturdy crust has fractured. The Codex’s scanners seem too puzzled to mark them as organic or mineral. It flags them for further study post-Rush, once Phaedra has been fully integrated into the U.G.C. proper.

			You move carefully around the razor-sharp petals while considering your options: flat glass to the north and east, or more faceted flowers to the south and west.
rows.translation:
核火磨平的地面并不牢固，裂开之处长满晶体生长物。CODEX终端的扫描器似乎困惑得无法将它们归为有机物或矿物。它将这些东西标记为行星淘金热结束后需要进一步研究的对象，届时菲德拉将正式完全并入银河联合邦联。

			你一边小心绕开锋利如刀的花瓣，一边考虑接下来的路线：向北或向东是平坦玻璃，向南或向西则有更多多面晶花。
rows.raw: "Crystalline growths line the nuke-smoothed ground where its less-than-sturdy crust has fractured. The Codex’s scanners seem too puzzled to mark them as organic or mineral. It flags them for further study post-Rush, once Phaedra has been fully integrated into the U.G.C. proper.\n\n\t\t\tYou move carefully around the razor-sharp petals while considering your options: flat glass to the north and east, or more faceted flowers to the south and west."

rows.original: Fission-baked glass shifts and groans softly as you move around atop it’s flash-fried surface. This desolation ought to be captured on film to show for use as an educational tool across the galaxy. This is what mutually-assured destruction doctrines bring. This is where nuclear grandstanding comes to rest once power falls into the wrong hands, as it inevitably does. If only the older Phaedrans had settled for rail cannons and orbital kinetic bombardment! Travel across the surface ripples is possible in all directions, though strange-looking crystal flowers are visible to the west, and ghostly green flames flicker in the breeze to the north.
rows.translation: 你在裂变火焰烤制的玻璃表面移动时，地面轻轻错动、呻吟。这片荒凉景象应该被拍下来，作为全银河的教育材料。这就是“相互确保摧毁”理论带来的结局。这就是核武叫嚣在权力不可避免地落入错误之手后最终归宿。 要是旧时代的菲德拉人满足于轨道炮和轨道动能轰炸就好了！ 你可以向任意方向穿过地表波纹，不过西面能看到外形奇异的晶体花，北面则有幽灵般的绿色火焰在风中摇曳。
rows.raw: "Fission-baked glass shifts and groans softly as you move around atop it’s flash-fried surface. This desolation ought to be captured on film to show for use as an educational tool across the galaxy. This is what mutually-assured destruction doctrines bring. This is where nuclear grandstanding comes to rest once power falls into the wrong hands, as it inevitably does. If only the older Phaedrans had settled for rail cannons and orbital kinetic bombardment! Travel across the surface ripples is possible in all directions, though strange-looking crystal flowers are visible to the west, and ghostly green flames flicker in the breeze to the north."

rows.original: Radiation warning! According to your Codex, the area to the east is completely uninhabitable, and more than risky to explore, even with your internal microsurgeons clearing away radioactive taint at capacity. It doesn’t have any such warnings about the area to the north, even though you see strange emerald fire flickering atop the glassy surface like bushes and trees shaped of living fire. The plains to the south and west are more like what you’ve come to expect from this planet: largely flat, green, and thoroughly baked to a mirror finish.
rows.translation: 辐射警告！根据CODEX终端的判断，东面区域完全无法居住，探索风险也极高；即使体内的微型外科机器人正全力清除辐射污染也不例外。它对北面倒没有这样的警告，尽管你能看见诡异的翠绿色火焰在玻璃地表闪烁，仿佛由活火构成的灌木和树木。 南面和西面的平原更接近你对这个星球的印象：大体平坦、呈绿色，而且彻底烧结成镜面。
rows.raw: "Radiation warning! According to your Codex, the area to the east is completely uninhabitable, and more than risky to explore, even with your internal microsurgeons clearing away radioactive taint at capacity. It doesn’t have any such warnings about the area to the north, even though you see strange emerald fire flickering atop the glassy surface like bushes and trees shaped of living fire.\n\n\t\t\tThe plains to the south and west are more like what you’ve come to expect from this planet: largely flat, green, and thoroughly baked to a mirror finish."

rows.original: Radiation warning! The Codex’s built-in geiger-counter won’t stop churring, particularly when pointed to the east. Things get uninhabitable that way pretty quick. Travel north, south, and west seems safe enough for now, though there appears to be a giant thigh bone jutting out of the ground to the south. Twinkling gemstones - or something close enough - are visible to the west.
rows.translation: 辐射警告！CODEX终端内置的盖革计数器一直响个不停，尤其在指向东面时。朝那个方向走不了多远，环境就会变得无法生存。目前向北、南、西移动似乎还算安全，不过南面有根巨大的大腿骨刺出地面。西面则能看到闪烁的宝石，或者某种与宝石足够相似的东西。
rows.raw: "Radiation warning! The Codex’s built-in geiger-counter won’t stop churring, particularly when pointed to the east. Things get uninhabitable that way pretty quick. Travel north, south, and west seems safe enough for now, though there appears to be a giant thigh bone jutting out of the ground to the south. Twinkling gemstones - or something close enough - are visible to the west."

rows.original:
From a distance, you might mistake the solitary tree trunk hanging onto the atom-blasted earth as some kind of giant’s bone, embedded halfway. The upper branches are long gone, and the trunk itself calcified as white as white as the skeletal material it resembles. It feels gritty to the touch and provides little shade.

			North are more glassy-looking plains. West lie a field of glassy-looking flowers, and to the south is what looks like some kind of rusted-out pyre - a site of some religious significance perhaps?
rows.translation:
从远处看，你可能会把那根孤零零扒在原子轰炸地表上的树干误认为某种巨人的骨头，半截埋在地里。上方枝杈早已不复存在，树干本身钙化得与它形似的骨骼材料一样惨白。摸起来质地粗糙，也遮不住多少阳光。

			北面是更多玻璃平原。西面有一片玻璃花田，南面则立着某种锈蚀的柴堆——也许是一处具有宗教意义的地点？
rows.raw: "From a distance, you might mistake the solitary tree trunk hanging onto the atom-blasted earth as some kind of giant’s bone, embedded halfway. The upper branches are long gone, and the trunk itself calcified as white as white as the skeletal material it resembles. It feels gritty to the touch and provides little shade.\n\n\t\t\tNorth are more glassy-looking plains. West lie a field of glassy-looking flowers, and to the south is what looks like some kind of rusted-out pyre - a site of some religious significance perhaps?"

rows.original:
You come upon a strange metal shrine. Welded-together exhaust pipes create a gracefully fluted structure, supporting a half dozen shopping carts assembled into a kind of net. Fire-blackened char mars the whole assembly. Beneath lies a pit, similarly blackened by recent fire and half-filled with ash.

		Its purpose is not immediately apparent, but you suspect it to be a place of religious significance, perhaps even some kind of scrapyard funeral pyre.
rows.translation:
你来到一座奇怪的金属圣坛前。焊接在一起的排气管组成优雅的喇叭状结构，上方托着六辆拼成网状的购物车。整座装置都被火熏得焦黑。下方有一座同样被近期火焰熏黑的坑，里面半满灰烬。

		它的用途一时难以看透，但你怀疑这是一处具有宗教意义的地点，或许甚至是某种废料场火葬台。
rows.raw: "You come upon a strange metal shrine. Welded-together exhaust pipes create a gracefully fluted structure, supporting a half dozen shopping carts assembled into a kind of net. Fire-blackened char mars the whole assembly. Beneath lies a pit, similarly blackened by recent fire and half-filled with ash.\n\n\t\tIts purpose is not immediately apparent, but you suspect it to be a place of religious significance, perhaps even some kind of scrapyard funeral pyre."
