rows.original:
Ahead of you, just over the westernmost rise, is a lengthy concrete platform sprawling across the dunes. Intermittent pillars support what’s left of a roof hanging lopsided overhead, the clear victim of a mortar strike at some point in the past. Even still, the structure’s still in use: there are a couple dozen figures milling around on the platform, and the lights are still running in the little kiosk off to one side. 

		A huge sign hangs above the stairs up onto the structure, reading "WELCOME TO SHINEGLASS STATION. ENJOY YOUR TRIP."
rows.translation:
就在你前方、最西侧沙丘的另一边，一座狭长的混凝土站台横跨沙丘。零散立柱支撑着残存的屋顶，屋顶歪斜地悬在上方，显然曾在过去某个时候遭到迫击炮轰击。即便如此，这座建筑仍在使用：几十个人影在站台上走动，一侧小亭里的灯也依旧亮着。 

		通往站台的楼梯上方挂着一块巨型标牌，上面写着：“欢迎来到辉晶站。祝您旅途愉快。”
rows.raw: 'Ahead of you, just over the westernmost rise, is a lengthy concrete platform sprawling across the dunes. Intermittent pillars support what’s left of a roof hanging lopsided overhead, the clear victim of a mortar strike at some point in the past. Even still, the structure’s still in use: there are a couple dozen figures milling around on the platform, and the lights are still running in the little kiosk off to one side. \n\n\t\tA huge sign hangs above the stairs up onto the structure, reading "WELCOME TO SHINEGLASS STATION. ENJOY YOUR TRIP."'

rows.original:
Shineglass Station is less a building and more a gathering place beneath the shade of a roof -- it’s a fifty-yard-long, five-wide concrete platform in the middle of the wasteland that runs parallel to a maglev rail that against all odds is still intact and humming with power. The west end of the station’s been hit by an explosive, collapsing the roof and shattering a few yards of the platform, but otherwise the place has survived the Glass War relatively intact. There’s even a still-functioning kiosk on the east end of the station, beside which is an electronic ticket terminal.

Folk of various races are standing around the place: bird-like taurs, leafy-green reptilians, fluffy caniforms, and even a couple of wary humans.
rows.translation:
辉晶站与其说是一栋建筑，不如说是一处屋顶阴影下的聚集地——它是一座长五十码、宽五码的混凝土站台，坐落在荒原中央，与一条奇迹般依然完整、仍在嗡鸣供能的磁悬浮轨道平行。车站西端曾遭爆炸物击中，屋顶坍塌，数码长的站台也被炸碎；除此之外，这里在玻璃战争中基本保持完好。车站东端甚至还有一座仍能使用的小亭，旁边就是电子售票终端。

各族居民在这里四处站着：鸟类般的兽身人、叶绿色的爬行类、毛茸茸的犬科生物，甚至还有几个警惕的人类。
rows.raw: "Shineglass Station is less a building and more a gathering place beneath the shade of a roof -- it’s a fifty-yard-long, five-wide concrete platform in the middle of the wasteland that runs parallel to a maglev rail that against all odds is still intact and humming with power. The west end of the station’s been hit by an explosive, collapsing the roof and shattering a few yards of the platform, but otherwise the place has survived the Glass War relatively intact. There’s even a still-functioning kiosk on the east end of the station, beside which is an electronic ticket terminal.\n\nFolk of various races are standing around the place: bird-like taurs, leafy-green reptilians, fluffy caniforms, and even a couple of wary humans."

rows.translation: 车票：盾岩
车票

rows.original: Purchase a ticket from the repaired kiosk, and head to the other side of the Shield Mountains.
rows.translation: 从修好的售票机购买车票，前往盾山另一侧。
rows.raw: "Purchase a ticket from the repaired kiosk, and head to the other side of the Shield Mountains."

rows.translation: 一个橙色皮肤的
努卡

rows.original: alien that your Codex helpfully identifies as something called a ‘nuka’ (Codex Entry unlocked!)
rows.translation: 外星人。CODEX终端贴心地将其识别为一种名叫“努卡”的种族（CODEX条目已解锁！）
rows.raw: "alien that your Codex helpfully identifies as something called a ‘nuka’ (Codex Entry unlocked!)"

rows.original: leans against the side of a massive, gleaming hoverbike, its hand-riveted hull polished to a near mirror sheen. Her attention is occupied by the wrist-mounted computer she’s fiddling with.
rows.translation: 靠在一辆巨大而闪亮的悬浮摩托旁，手工铆接的车身被擦得近乎镜面般光洁。她正专心摆弄腕载计算机。
rows.raw: " leans against the side of a massive, gleaming hoverbike, its hand-riveted hull polished to a near mirror sheen. Her attention is occupied by the wrist-mounted computer she’s fiddling with."

rows.translation: 努卡
努卡

rows.original: Approach the Nuka woman with the hoverbike.
rows.translation: 接近那个带着悬浮摩托的努卡女人。
rows.raw: "Approach the Nuka woman with the hoverbike."

rows.original: Gayll is here, resting against her massive, gleaming hoverbike. She fiddles with a small, wrist-mounted computer to pass the time, sneaking glances at the station’s passersby.
rows.translation: 盖尔在这里，靠着她巨大而闪亮的悬浮摩托休息。她摆弄一台小型腕载计算机打发时间，偶尔偷瞄车站的过路人。
rows.raw: "\n\nGayll is here, resting against her massive, gleaming hoverbike. She fiddles with a small, wrist-mounted computer to pass the time, sneaking glances at the station’s passersby."

rows.translation: 盖尔
盖尔

rows.original: Approach the Nuka woman with the hoverbike.
rows.translation: 接近那个带着悬浮摩托的努卡女人。
rows.raw: "Approach the Nuka woman with the hoverbike."

rows.translation: 菲德拉：盾岩

rows.original:
Shieldrock Station is a long, raised concrete platform with a paneled roof overtop it. It’s similar to Shineglass in terms of construction, though it’s in markedly better repair, with an open ticket counter and refreshment kiosk. Everything here’s manned by DEE-SLs, much larger and more heavily armed than those serving on the train — these are hulking warrior machines ready to defend the realm of the Evermind to the death if need be.

		The armored train is parked here, currently undergoing rapid maintenance from a crew of cowled techno-clerics. Elcine is among their number, overseeing a crew working on the engine car.
		
		[flags.SHINEGLASS_ELYSTIEL_FREED|The birdy bard, Elystiel, is sitting more or less where you left her. She’s got her guitar out, strumming a much more peaceful, soothing melody than when you first met her. There’s a tin can in front of her, and every so often one of the passengers waiting by the train drops a bit of the local currency in with a satisfying clatter.]
rows.translation:
盾岩站是一座狭长的高架混凝土月台，上方覆盖着板材屋顶。它的建筑结构与辉晶站相似，不过维护状况明显更好，售票窗口和茶点亭都正常营业。这里的一切都由DEE-SL负责，它们比列车上服务的型号大得多，武装也更加沉重—这些魁梧的战斗机器已经做好准备，必要时会为保卫永恒心智的国度战至死亡。

		装甲列车停靠在这里，目前一群罩袍科技祭司正在对它进行快速维护。艾尔辛也在其中，监督一支检修机车的队伍。
		
		[flags.SHINEGLASS_ELYSTIEL_FREED|鸟族吟游诗人艾莉丝蒂尔大致还坐在你离开她时的位置。她取出吉他，弹奏着比你们初次见面时平和舒缓得多的旋律。她面前放着一个铁罐，等候列车的乘客时不时会把少许当地货币投入其中，发出令人满足的叮当声。]
rows.raw:
"Shieldrock Station is a long, raised concrete platform with a paneled roof overtop it. It’s similar to Shineglass in terms of construction, though it’s in markedly better repair, with an open ticket counter and refreshment kiosk. Everything here’s manned by DEE-SLs, much larger and more heavily armed than those serving on the train — these are hulking warrior machines ready to defend the realm of the Evermind to the death if need be.

		The armored train is parked here, currently undergoing rapid maintenance from a crew of cowled techno-clerics. Elcine is among their number, overseeing a crew working on the engine car.
		
		[flags.SHINEGLASS_ELYSTIEL_FREED|The birdy bard, Elystiel, is sitting more or less where you left her. She’s got her guitar out, strumming a much more peaceful, soothing melody than when you first met her. There’s a tin can in front of her, and every so often one of the passengers waiting by the train drops a bit of the local currency in with a satisfying clatter.]"

rows.translation: 车票：辉晶站

rows.original: You approach the ticket kiosk, queuing up behind a [rand|divrani couple and their baby|another rusher like yourself|a nuka in biker’s leathers|a particularly large golden shalinae]. It takes a minute for you to get to the desk, where you’re greeted by one of the only slimline DEE-SLs working here. "Greetings, favored customer.” "One ticket to Shineglass,” you tell her. The DEE-SL’s fingers dance over a mechanical keyboard. “Understood. By order of the High Enginespeaker, your fees have been waived. Please enjoy your trip.” You take the stub she offers you and climb aboard.
rows.translation: 你走近售票亭，在一名[rand|一对迪尔萨夫妇和他们的孩子|另一名像你一样的冲袭者|一名身穿摩托皮衣的努卡人|一名格外高大的金色沙林纳]身后排队。过了一分钟才轮到柜台前的你，接待者是这里少数采用纤细机型的DEE-SL之一。 “您好，尊贵的顾客。” “一张去辉晶站的票。”你告诉她。 DEE-SL的手指在机械键盘上飞舞。“明白。根据至高引擎传音者的命令，您的费用已获免除。祝您旅途愉快。” 你接过她递来的票根，登上列车。
rows.raw: 'You approach the ticket kiosk, queuing up behind a [rand|divrani couple and their baby|another rusher like yourself|a nuka in biker’s leathers|a particularly large golden shalinae]. It takes a minute for you to get to the desk, where you’re greeted by one of the only slimline DEE-SLs working here. "Greetings, favored customer.” "One ticket to Shineglass,” you tell her. The DEE-SL’s fingers dance over a mechanical keyboard. “Understood. By order of the High Enginespeaker, your fees have been waived. Please enjoy your trip.” You take the stub she offers you and climb aboard.'

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: A few hours later, your train arrives at Shineglass station. Under the watchful eyes of the DEE-SL crew, you and the other passengers disembark back into the heat of the wasteland...
rows.translation: 几小时后，列车抵达辉晶站。在DEE-SL乘务员的注视下，你和其他乘客下车，重新踏入荒原的灼热之中...
rows.raw: "A few hours later, your train arrives at Shineglass station. Under the watchful eyes of the DEE-SL crew, you and the other passengers disembark back into the heat of the wasteland..."

rows.translation: 下一步
辉晶站

rows.original: Get a ticket back to Shineglass Station.
rows.translation: 买一张返回辉晶站的车票。
rows.raw: "Get a ticket back to Shineglass Station."

rows.original: Beyond the ticket kiosk is fare dodger detention.
rows.translation: 售票亭后方是逃票者拘留区。
rows.raw: "\n\nBeyond the ticket kiosk is fare dodger detention."

rows.original: It is empty at the moment, since you freed Hureya.
rows.translation: 你已经救出胡蕾娅，因此里面现在空无一人。
rows.raw: " It is empty at the moment, since you freed Hureya."

rows.original: Hureya is still stuck in it, head down, ass up. She will remain stuck in it until she can work out a way past the DEE-SL’s logic loop, which given her disposition doesn’t seem will happen any time soon. Sucks to be her.
rows.translation: 胡蕾娅仍困在里面，低着头、高高撅着屁股。她必须想出绕过DEE-SL逻辑循环的办法才能脱身，而以她的脾性看来，短时间内恐怕做不到。她可真倒霉。
rows.raw: " Hureya is still stuck in it, head down, ass up. She will remain stuck in it until she can work out a way past the DEE-SL’s logic loop, which given her disposition doesn’t seem will happen any time soon. Sucks to be her."

rows.original: At the far end of the platform is a bizarre sight that takes you a few moments to get your head around. In a box demarcated in hazard yellow is some kind of metallic holding device, and bent over, head and paws trapped in it, is a big, naked hyrax. Her long, messy slice of blonde hair is vaguely familiar.
rows.translation: 站台尽头有一幅怪异景象，你花了片刻才理解。危险黄线划出的方框里摆着某种金属拘束装置，一只高大裸体的蹄兔弯腰困在其中，脑袋和爪子都被锁住。她那一绺凌乱的金发让你隐约觉得眼熟。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the far end of the platform is a bizarre sight that takes you a few moments to get your head around. In a box demarcated in hazard yellow is some kind of metallic holding device, and bent over, head and paws trapped in it, is a big, naked hyrax. Her long, messy slice of blonde hair is vaguely familiar."

rows.translation: 颈手枷

rows.original: The pillory stands empty; you freed the Warmistress.
rows.translation: 颈手枷空着；你已经救出了战争女统领。
rows.raw: "The pillory stands empty; you freed the Warmistress."

rows.translation: 胡蕾娅的车票

rows.original: A ticket is already printing itself for you when you get to the front of the kiosk queue. You look back up the platform to the imprisoned hyrax. You suppose if you let the ex-raider queen go and she immediately embarks on a roaring rampage of revenge, that will mean the end of your status here as a Big Damn Hero, with all the privileges that go with it. Such are the perils of being an Even Bigger Damn Hero. If it’s what you want to do, you’ll just have to risk it.
rows.translation: 你走到售票亭队伍前方时，一张车票已经自动为你打印出来。你回头望向月台上被囚禁的蹄兔。假如你释放这位前掠夺者女王，而她立刻开始咆哮着展开复仇，那大概会终结你在这里作为“超级英雄”的身份，以及随之而来的所有特权。这正是成为“更加超级的英雄”所必须面对的风险。如果这就是你想做的事，那便只能冒险。
rows.raw: "A ticket is already printing itself for you when you get to the front of the kiosk queue. You look back up the platform to the imprisoned hyrax. You suppose if you let the ex-raider queen go and she immediately embarks on a roaring rampage of revenge, that will mean the end of your status here as a Big Damn Hero, with all the privileges that go with it. Such are the perils of being an Even Bigger Damn Hero. If it’s what you want to do, you’ll just have to risk it."

rows.translation: 下一步
胡蕾娅的车票
给胡蕾娅买一张车票。

rows.original: You stand outside the fortified door to a decades old, pre-glass military base.
rows.translation: 你站在一座已有数十年历史、建于玻璃战争之前的军事基地加固门外。
rows.raw: "You stand outside the fortified door to a decades old, pre-glass military base."

rows.original: This room should never be entered. It’s only here to indicate further rooms inside, and the player should be seemlessly teleported first.
rows.raw: "This room should never be entered. It’s only here to indicate further rooms inside, and the player should be seemlessly teleported first."

rows.translation: 菲德拉：辉晶列车
菲德拉：游荡战车

rows.original:
You’re on a flatbed truck hurtling through the dunes beside the train. A massive grapple launcher, something you’d more expect to see on an old ironclad sailing ship, has been bolted to the end of the truck. The line’s been ripped out by the VIP car falling away, and indeed half the bolts have been wrenched out. The whole thing might go flying if you touch it hard enough.

		The wind’s roaring past you, and dust and sand are coming up in thick clouds to either side of you. The only way forward is with a leap, onto the container truck ahead of you in the convoy.
rows.translation:
你站在一辆平板卡车上，与列车并肩冲过沙丘。卡车末端固定着一座巨型抓钩发射器，看起来更像古老铁甲帆船上的设备。贵宾车厢脱落时扯断了绳索，甚至有一半螺栓都被拔了出来。只要用力碰一下，整套装置或许都会飞出去。

		风从身边呼啸而过，尘土和沙粒在两侧扬起浓云。唯一的前进方式是跳到车队前方的货柜卡车上。
rows.raw: "You’re on a flatbed truck hurtling through the dunes beside the train. A massive grapple launcher, something you’d more expect to see on an old ironclad sailing ship, has been bolted to the end of the truck. The line’s been ripped out by the VIP car falling away, and indeed half the bolts have been wrenched out. The whole thing might go flying if you touch it hard enough.\n\n\t\tThe wind’s roaring past you, and dust and sand are coming up in thick clouds to either side of you. The only way forward is with a leap, onto the container truck ahead of you in the convoy."

rows.translation: 跳！
跳！

rows.original: Jump from one vehicle to the next!
rows.translation: 从一辆车跳到下一辆！
rows.raw: "Jump from one vehicle to the next!"

rows.original: The second-to-last truck in the center convoy is a cargo hauler, an empty sheet metal container with a logo on the doors advertising the [silly|Pupperidge|Paleridge] Farms food company. The hyraxi raiders you defeated are sprawled out on the floor, submissively licking their wounds.
rows.translation: 中央车队倒数第二辆卡车是货运车，只有一只空荡荡的金属板货柜，门上印着[silly|帕珀里奇|佩尔里奇]农场食品公司的标志。被你击败的海拉克西掠夺者瘫在地上，顺从地舔舐伤口。
rows.raw: "The second-to-last truck in the center convoy is a cargo hauler, an empty sheet metal container with a logo on the doors advertising the [silly|Pupperidge|Paleridge] Farms food company. The hyraxi raiders you defeated are sprawled out on the floor, submissively licking their wounds. "

rows.original: The container doesn’t have a proper door to the front, but somebody’s hacksawed a door into it anyway, just covering it up with a draped blanket nailed to the top.
rows.translation: 货柜前方没有正规车门，但有人还是用钢锯切出一道门，只用钉在上方的垂毯遮住。
rows.raw: "\n\n\t\tThe container doesn’t have a proper door to the front, but somebody’s hacksawed a door into it anyway, just covering it up with a draped blanket nailed to the top."

rows.original: The boys have left some crates of supplies lying open, ripe for the picking.
rows.translation: 这些家伙留下了几箱敞开的补给，正等着你搜刮。
rows.raw: "The boys have left some crates of supplies lying open, ripe for the picking."

rows.original: You’ve emptied out the crates here, leaving nothing for them to use against you.
rows.translation: 你已经搜空这里的箱子，没有给他们留下任何能用来对付你的东西。
rows.raw: "You’ve emptied out the crates here, leaving nothing for them to use against you."

rows.translation: 搜刮补给

rows.original:
You quickly [silly|bogart|check through] the raiders’ supplies for anything of use to you. There’s some old plastic-case trauma kits that look old enough to have survived the Glass War, and there’s a six pack of energy drinks.

				Not an elegant recharge in the middle of a fight, but bandaids and calories can make the difference sometimes. You take what you need and chuck the rest out the side of the car so the raiders at least can’t benefit from it.
rows.translation:
你迅速[silly|霸占|翻查]掠夺者的补给，寻找能用的东西。这里有几只旧塑料壳创伤急救包，年代久远得仿佛经历过玻璃战争，还有一提六罐能量饮料。

				战斗中途靠这些东西恢复谈不上优雅，但创可贴和热量有时能决定胜负。你拿走需要的物品，把剩下的全扔出车外，至少不让掠夺者利用。
rows.raw: "You quickly [silly|bogart|check through] the raiders’ supplies for anything of use to you. There’s some old plastic-case trauma kits that look old enough to have survived the Glass War, and there’s a six pack of energy drinks.\n\n\t\t\t\tNot an elegant recharge in the middle of a fight, but bandaids and calories can make the difference sometimes. You take what you need and chuck the rest out the side of the car so the raiders at least can’t benefit from it."

rows.translation: 下一步
搜刮补给

rows.original: Check the supplies for anything valuable.
rows.translation: 检查补给中是否有值钱的东西。
搜刮补给
搜刮补给
你已经搜刮过这些补给！
跳！

rows.original: The gap between vehicles feels larger than it really is, the ground rushing past in the space between the unsteady and unsynchronized bounces of the trucks as they rattle across desert at speed. You crouch down, slowly waiting for the perfect moment to leap, fingers snatching the rungs of a ladder securely attached to the rear - a solid place to anchor whilst you swing open the rear door of the cargo hauler.
rows.translation: 车辆间的距离感觉比实际更大。卡车高速驶过沙漠，地面就在车辆起伏不稳、彼此不同步的跳动间飞掠。你蹲下身，耐心等待最佳起跳时机，手指抓住牢牢固定在车尾的梯级，以这个坚固支点稳住身体，同时拉开货运车的后门。
rows.raw:
"The gap between vehicles feels larger than it really is, the ground rushing past in the space between the unsteady and unsynchronized bounces of the trucks as they rattle across desert at speed. You crouch down, slowly waiting for the perfect moment to leap, fingers snatching the rungs of a ladder securely attached to the rear - a solid place to anchor whilst you swing open the rear door of the cargo hauler.

"

rows.original:
You’ve clambered up into the cabin of the artillery trailer-truck, mantling in beside a scared-shitless hyraxi boy who’s decided the best thing to do is just keep his paw on the peddle and keep driving, doing his best to ignore you. Ahead of you is a huge war-rig of a truck, from which comes the thundering, thumping bass that’s been assailing your ears since the attack began. There’s a tower of speakers all piled up on top of each other, surrounding a platform on which you can make out a few figures presumably playing DJ for the raiding party.

		You can also see Johana, Elcine, and [rival.name] have made it nearly halfway up the train. The gunslinger’s exchanging punches with a particularly brawny hyraxi boy while Elcine’s clearing a path around her with that massive wrench-staff. [rival.name]’s contributing a little too, occasionally poking out from behind Johana to snap off a shot with a pocket pistol.
rows.translation:
你攀进火炮拖车卡车的驾驶室，翻身落在一个吓得魂不附体的海拉克西男孩旁边。他认定最好的应对方式就是踩住踏板继续开车，竭力无视你。前方是一辆巨大的战争卡车，从中传出自袭击开始便不断轰击你耳朵的震耳低音。成堆音箱垒成一座高塔，围绕着一处平台；你隐约看到几个人影，大概正为这支掠夺队伍担任DJ。

		你还看到乔安娜、艾尔辛和[rival.name]已经行进到列车将近一半的位置。枪手正和一个格外壮硕的海拉克西男孩互殴，艾尔辛则挥舞巨大的扳手杖清理周围道路。[rival.name]也贡献了少许力量，偶尔从乔安娜身后探头，用袖珍手枪开上一枪。
rows.raw: "You’ve clambered up into the cabin of the artillery trailer-truck, mantling in beside a scared-shitless hyraxi boy who’s decided the best thing to do is just keep his paw on the peddle and keep driving, doing his best to ignore you. Ahead of you is a huge war-rig of a truck, from which comes the thundering, thumping bass that’s been assailing your ears since the attack began. There’s a tower of speakers all piled up on top of each other, surrounding a platform on which you can make out a few figures presumably playing DJ for the raiding party.\n\n\t\tYou can also see Johana, Elcine, and [rival.name] have made it nearly halfway up the train. The gunslinger’s exchanging punches with a particularly brawny hyraxi boy while Elcine’s clearing a path around her with that massive wrench-staff. [rival.name]’s contributing a little too, occasionally poking out from behind Johana to snap off a shot with a pocket pistol."

rows.translation: 跳！

rows.original:
You leap from the artillery truck’s cabin and onto the back of the massive stack of speakers at the back of the next. The bass pounding off it is so loud that even before you jumped you could feel it in your bones - now that you’re clambering up the stack, it’s physically deafening, even drowning out the cavalcade of gunshots and crashing steel echoing from the train at your side. Even the roaring motors of the surrounding war-buggies are just a din in the back of your mind, pushed aside by the banshee’s howl of electric guitar and thundering drums.

			It’s enough to make you start humming along with the tune.
rows.translation:
你从火炮卡车驾驶室跃出，落到下一辆车尾那座巨型音箱塔上。它轰出的低音响到你起跳前都能感到骨头震颤；现在攀爬其上，更是震耳欲聋，甚至盖过身旁列车上传来的密集枪声与钢铁撞击。周围战争越野车咆哮的引擎也只剩脑海背景中的模糊噪声，被电吉他的女妖尖啸和雷鸣般的鼓点压到一旁。

			这旋律甚至让你不由自主地跟着哼唱。
rows.raw: "You leap from the artillery truck’s cabin and onto the back of the massive stack of speakers at the back of the next. The bass pounding off it is so loud that even before you jumped you could feel it in your bones - now that you’re clambering up the stack, it’s physically deafening, even drowning out the cavalcade of gunshots and crashing steel echoing from the train at your side. Even the roaring motors of the surrounding war-buggies are just a din in the back of your mind, pushed aside by the banshee’s howl of electric guitar and thundering drums.\n\n\t\t\tIt’s enough to make you start humming along with the tune."

rows.original: You’re aboard the Warmistress’s very own Thunder Rig, the howling banshee at the head of the armored convoy attacking the train. Dozens of buggies and bikes are circling you menacingly, but with the defeat of their battle-bard, the furor’s gone out of the boys by and large. They aren’t making swipes at you directly now, at least, and there’s a clear shot from the grapple cannon on this rig to the train again.
rows.translation: 你登上了战争女统领自己的雷霆战车，它是进攻列车的装甲车队前端那只尖啸女妖。几十辆越野车和摩托在周围虎视眈眈地盘旋，但随着战斗诗人落败，这些家伙大多没了气势。他们至少没有直接袭击你；而这辆战车上的抓钩炮可以再次射向列车。
rows.raw: "You’re aboard the Warmistress’s very own Thunder Rig, the howling banshee at the head of the armored convoy attacking the train. Dozens of buggies and bikes are circling you menacingly, but with the defeat of their battle-bard, the furor’s gone out of the boys by and large. They aren’t making swipes at you directly now, at least, and there’s a clear shot from the grapple cannon on this rig to the train again."

rows.translation: 菲德拉：辉晶列车

rows.original:
This car’s dedicated to holding the lower-class passengers’ various belongings: suitcases, oversized backpacks, a few gun cases and scooters - anything that can’t fit into the under-seat stowage provided to them.

		There’s also a section marked off for parking a motorbike inside, but it’s instead currently [flags.SHINEGLASS_JOHANA_IN_PARTY|occupied by Howinn Creed, Johana’s wife, who’s currently bound up in bondage ropes. For safe transport, she assures you.|full of an extraordinarily buxom leithan hermaphrodite in a substantial amount of bondage rope.]

		Three DEE-SLs are lying in pieces on the floor in here, two smashed apart by some tremendous force and the other slashed to pieces by a vicious blade. There’s a couple of unconscious hyraxi raider-boys too, slumped against the walls. They have substantial bruising all over their chests, like they both took sledgehammer hits to the ribs.

		The door to the north is labeled “ENGINE. AUTHORIZED EMPLOYEES ONLY.” The very front of the huge, armored train - and it looks like somebody got there ahead of you.
rows.translation:
这节车厢专门存放下层乘客的各种物品：行李箱、超大背包、几个枪械箱和踏板车，任何无法塞进座位下方储物空间的东西都会放在这里。

		这里还有一块划出来供摩托车停放的区域，不过现在那里[flags.SHINEGLASS_JOHANA_IN_PARTY|被乔安娜的妻子豪因·克里德占据了，她此刻正被绳缚用的绳索牢牢捆住。她向你保证，这是为了安全运输。|塞着一个乳房丰满得惊人的莱萨雌雄同体者，身上缠着大量绳缚用的绳索。]

		三台DEE-SL七零八落地躺在这里的地板上，其中两台被某种惊人力量砸碎，另一台则被凶狠利刃斩成了碎片。还有两个失去意识的海拉克西掠夺者男孩靠墙瘫坐着，胸前遍布严重瘀伤，就像两人都挨了大锤猛击肋骨。

		北边的门标着“机车。仅限授权雇员进入。”那里就是这辆巨型装甲列车的最前端，而且看起来已经有人抢先抵达。
rows.raw:
"This car’s dedicated to holding the lower-class passengers’ various belongings: suitcases, oversized backpacks, a few gun cases and scooters - anything that can’t fit into the under-seat stowage provided to them.

		There’s also a section marked off for parking a motorbike inside, but it’s instead currently [flags.SHINEGLASS_JOHANA_IN_PARTY|occupied by Howinn Creed, Johana’s wife, who’s currently bound up in bondage ropes. For safe transport, she assures you.|full of an extraordinarily buxom leithan hermaphrodite in a substantial amount of bondage rope.]

		Three DEE-SLs are lying in pieces on the floor in here, two smashed apart by some tremendous force and the other slashed to pieces by a vicious blade. There’s a couple of unconscious hyraxi raider-boys too, slumped against the walls. They have substantial bruising all over their chests, like they both took sledgehammer hits to the ribs.

		The door to the north is labeled “ENGINE. AUTHORIZED EMPLOYEES ONLY.” The very front of the huge, armored train - and it looks like somebody got there ahead of you."

rows.translation: 莱萨姑娘
莱萨姑娘
调查被捆住的虫马姑娘。
莱萨姑娘

rows.original: Johana’s right there, and seems more than content to leave her wife in bondage.
rows.translation: 乔安娜就在旁边，而且似乎完全乐意让妻子继续被绑着。
rows.raw: "Johana’s right there, and seems more than content to leave her wife in bondage."

rows.original: There’s a handful of terrified-looking divrani huddled up between the seats, but no hyraxi raiders to be seen... on this car.
rows.translation: 几个神情惊恐的迪弗拉尼人挤在座位之间，但这里看不到海拉克西掠夺者...至少这节车厢没有。
rows.raw: "There’s a handful of terrified-looking divrani huddled up between the seats, but no hyraxi raiders to be seen... on this car."

rows.original: You can hear muffled gunshots and crashing metal in the direction of the train’s rear, back the way [rival.name] and [rival.hisHer] little party are... but no commotion ahead. Yet.
rows.translation: 你能听到列车后方传来沉闷的枪声和金属碰撞声，也就是[rival.name]及[rival.hisHer]那支小队所在的方向...但前方没有动静。暂时还没有。
rows.raw: "You can hear muffled gunshots and crashing metal in the direction of the train’s rear, back the way [rival.name] and [rival.hisHer] little party are... but no commotion ahead. Yet."

rows.original: The galley car contains a fully-stocked kitchen, an automated chef, and several cloth-covered tables for dining. It was probably nice, before the whole gunfight and melee - now the place is pock-marked with bullet holes, dented from Johana’s concussion pistol, and broken wine bottles are scattered everywhere. The Hyraxi Alpha is bent over the bar where you left him, and his underlings have either scattered or are cowering.
rows.translation: 餐车里有储备齐全的厨房、自动厨师和几张铺着桌布的餐桌。枪战和混战开始前，这里大概很不错；现在却遍布弹孔，被乔安娜的震荡手枪打得坑坑洼洼，碎酒瓶散落一地。海拉克西首领仍照你离开时那样弯腰趴在吧台上，手下则不是逃散，就是缩成一团。
rows.raw: "The galley car contains a fully-stocked kitchen, an automated chef, and several cloth-covered tables for dining. It was probably nice, before the whole gunfight and melee - now the place is pock-marked with bullet holes, dented from Johana’s concussion pistol, and broken wine bottles are scattered everywhere. The Hyraxi Alpha is bent over the bar where you left him, and his underlings have either scattered or are cowering."

rows.translation: 菲德拉：军事基地

rows.original: (This is as far as the main story quest content goes for now. More coming soon (tm))
rows.translation: （目前主线任务内容到此为止。更多内容即将推出（tm））
rows.raw: "(This is as far as the main story quest content goes for now. More coming soon (tm))"

rows.original:
You are standing in a tall, sunlit room, meeting hall-sized in dimension. The light cascades down from rents in the convex, gun-metal ceiling, the result of natural wear and tear on the ruined complex. Where the beams fall, metal girders have been built, and they are festooned in greenery - crawling vines and bright, orchid-like flowers. The flora is energetic and quite wild, its tendrils reaching upward and outward to colonize some of the roof and floor space as well. The walls are draped with woven tapestries of the Kihan faith, displaying its cog symbol, its tenets, its saints and the beatific face of its god in a rainbow of colors.
			
			Littering this miniature paradise are divrani, as many as 30 of them. The females are dressed in crimson headscarves opened at the back to allow their plant-braids out, the males in red, felt collars; as is common with the stumpy green reptile folk, their everything else is allowed to loll freely all the way out there.
rows.translation:
你站在一间高耸明亮、面积堪比会议厅的房间里。阳光从凸起的炮铜色天花板裂口倾泻而下，那是废墟经自然磨损留下的痕迹。光束落下处竖起金属梁架，上面缀满绿意、爬藤与兰花般的鲜花。植物生机勃勃又颇为野性，卷须向上向外伸展，侵占部分屋顶与地面。墙上悬挂着基罕信仰的编织挂毯，以彩虹般的色彩展示齿轮圣徽、教义、圣徒以及神祇慈悲的面容。
			
			这座微型乐园里散布着多达三十名迪弗拉尼人。女性头戴深红头巾，后方敞开以便植物辫垂出；男性佩戴红色毡领。和这些矮壮绿色爬族的习俗一样，除此之外的一切都自由自在地袒露在外。
rows.raw: "You are standing in a tall, sunlit room, meeting hall-sized in dimension. The light cascades down from rents in the convex, gun-metal ceiling, the result of natural wear and tear on the ruined complex. Where the beams fall, metal girders have been built, and they are festooned in greenery - crawling vines and bright, orchid-like flowers. The flora is energetic and quite wild, its tendrils reaching upward and outward to colonize some of the roof and floor space as well. The walls are draped with woven tapestries of the Kihan faith, displaying its cog symbol, its tenets, its saints and the beatific face of its god in a rainbow of colors.\n\t\t\t\n\t\t\tLittering this miniature paradise are divrani, as many as 30 of them. The females are dressed in crimson headscarves opened at the back to allow their plant-braids out, the males in red, felt collars; as is common with the stumpy green reptile folk, their everything else is allowed to loll freely all the way out there."

rows.original: You are fighting in an area with jagged, crystalline terrain. If you attempt to escape with a ground-based sprint, you'll take damage!
rows.translation: 你正在一处遍布尖锐晶体的地形中战斗。如果尝试在地面冲刺逃跑，你会受到伤害！
rows.raw: "You are fighting in an area with jagged, crystalline terrain. If you attempt to escape with a ground-based sprint, you'll take damage!"

rows.translation: 诱情古龙水
一剂诱情古龙水

rows.original: An invention of science officer Kiara Dorna, distilled from the mind-controlling pheromones of the tauric dhirsa people. This cologne makes the user sexually irresistable, greatly improving the chances of seduction even in the heat of battle.
rows.translation: 科学官琪娅拉·多娜的发明，以半人马形迪尔萨族具有精神控制效果的信息素蒸馏而成。这种古龙水能让使用者在性方面变得不可抗拒，即使在激烈战斗中也能大幅提高诱惑成功率。
rows.raw: "An invention of science officer Kiara Dorna, distilled from the mind-controlling pheromones of the tauric dhirsa people. This cologne makes the user sexually irresistable, greatly improving the chances of seduction even in the heat of battle."

rows.original: You spritz yourself with a dose of Pherologne.
rows.translation: 你往身上喷了一剂诱情古龙水。
rows.raw: "You spritz yourself with a dose of Pherologne."

rows.original:
Doused with mind-affecting alien pheromones.

+10 sexiness
rows.translation:
全身浸透影响心智的外星信息素。

+10性感度

rows.original: It is unwise to waste the Pherologne outside of combat.
rows.translation: 在战斗之外浪费诱情古龙水并不明智。
rows.raw: "It is unwise to waste the Pherologne outside of combat.\n"

rows.original: considers it unwise to waste the Pherologne outside of combat.
rows.translation: 认为在战斗之外浪费诱情古龙水并不明智。
rows.raw: " considers it unwise to waste the Pherologne outside of combat.\n"

rows.translation: 巨型害兽角战利品
一件巨型害兽角战利品

rows.original: The largest carapace horn of a massive savicite-irradiated silicone-eater, no doubt a close relative of the New Texan varmint. Sure to fetch a high price from those who know the danger of such a creature.
rows.translation: 这是一只受萨维石辐射、以硅胶为食的巨型生物身上最大的甲壳角，无疑是新德克萨斯害兽的近亲。熟知这种生物危险性的人一定愿意出高价购买。
rows.raw: "The largest carapace horn of a massive savicite-irradiated silicone-eater, no doubt a close relative of the New Texan varmint. Sure to fetch a high price from those who know the danger of such a creature."

rows.translation: 硅胶吞噬者
这只

rows.original: It’s clearly somehow related to the New Texan varmint, a quadrupedal predator with slavering fangs, huge curling horns, and a lashing tail. Bits of slain gynoids hang ragged from its spiky body like grisly trophies. The thing’s been mutated by the ambient radiation, growing monstrously large and ferociously aggressive -- it’s far bigger than a Terran grizzly bear now, and no doubt even stronger. One good swipe could spell the end of you.
rows.translation: 它显然与新德克萨斯的害兽有某种联系。那是一种四足捕食者，长着淌涎的尖牙、巨大的卷曲犄角和不断抽打的尾巴。被杀死的女性机器人残骸破破烂烂地挂在它布满尖刺的身体上，如同骇人的战利品。这东西受到环境辐射影响而变异，体型长得骇人般庞大，性情也凶残暴戾——如今它远比地球灰熊更大，无疑也更强壮。只要被它狠狠挥中一下，你可能就完了。
rows.raw: "It’s clearly somehow related to the New Texan varmint, a quadrupedal predator with slavering fangs, huge curling horns, and a lashing tail. Bits of slain gynoids hang ragged from its spiky body like grisly trophies. The thing’s been mutated by the ambient radiation, growing monstrously large and ferociously aggressive -- it’s far bigger than a Terran grizzly bear now, and no doubt even stronger. One good swipe could spell the end of you."

rows.original: Claws scrabbling, the silicone eater slips away from your attack.
rows.translation: 硅胶吞噬者四爪乱抓，从你的攻击下滑开。
rows.raw: "Claws scrabbling, the silicone eater slips away from your attack."

rows.original: The armor plates soak up your attack.
rows.translation: 甲片吸收了你的攻击。
rows.raw: "The armor plates soak up your attack."

rows.translation: 爪击
爪击
坚韧兽皮

rows.original: lunges at you with its horns, slamming them
rows.translation: 用犄角朝你猛冲，把它们撞向
rows.raw: " lunges at you with its horns, slamming them"

rows.original: just past you, digging them into the ground.
rows.translation: 你身旁，深深扎进地面。
rows.raw: " just past you, digging them into the ground."

rows.original: into your [pc.leg], giving you a pointy, painful head-butt!
rows.translation: 你的[pc.leg]，给你来了一记又尖又痛的头槌！
rows.raw: " into your [pc.leg], giving you a pointy, painful head-butt!"

rows.original: The hit was hard enough to stun you!
rows.translation: 这一击力道十足，足以让你陷入眩晕！
rows.raw: " The hit was hard enough to stun you!"

rows.original: While you’re on the ground, the oversized varmint leaps onto you, savaging you with its huge teeth! You’re able to get an arm up in time to save your throat, but it still grabs you and shakes its head, tearing into you while drizzling you with spit that sizzles worse than any battery acid.
rows.translation: 你倒在地上时，体型过大的害兽扑到身上，用巨大的牙齿疯狂撕咬你！你及时抬起手臂护住喉咙，但它依然咬住你，甩动脑袋不断撕扯；滴落在你身上的唾液滋滋作响，腐蚀性比任何电池酸液都要强。
rows.raw: "While you’re on the ground, the oversized varmint leaps onto you, savaging you with its huge teeth! You’re able to get an arm up in time to save your throat, but it still grabs you and shakes its head, tearing into you while drizzling you with spit that sizzles worse than any battery acid."

rows.original: leaps at you with its slavering jaws agape, teeth bared!
rows.translation: 张开淌涎的血盆大口，露出利齿朝你扑来！
rows.raw: " leaps at you with its slavering jaws agape, teeth bared!"

rows.original: You slip out of the way.
rows.translation: 你闪身躲开。
rows.raw: " You slip out of the way."

rows.original: Its acid-drenched teeth sink into you, and the sheer weight of its impact against you
rows.translation: 它沾满酸液的牙齿咬进你体内，撞上你时产生的巨大冲力
rows.raw: " Its acid-drenched teeth sink into you, and the sheer weight of its impact against you"

rows.translation: 让你一时踉跄不稳！

rows.original: throws you right to the ground! You are tripped!
rows.translation: 直接把你撞倒在地！你被绊倒了！
rows.raw: " throws you right to the ground! You are tripped!"

rows.translation: 赛恩

rows.original: Your attack fails to damage the ‘bot.
rows.translation: 你的攻击没能伤到这个机器人。
基哈构装体
船长日志
一只害兽？

rows.original: “I don’t see how that’s your business,” you say evenly.
rows.translation: “我看不出这跟你有什么关系，”你平静地说道。
rows.raw: "“I don’t see how that’s your business,” you say evenly."

rows.original: A moment of silence passes before the armored figure nods. “Fair enough, captain. Whatever brings you here will be between you and the Evermind eventually, I’m sure. She’s the god-queen of this planet; you’d do well not to cross her unless you want to end up another part of the spacer graveyard in orbit.”
rows.translation: 沉默片刻后，那个装甲身影点点头。“有道理，船长。无论什么原因把你带来这里，我敢肯定，最终都得由你和永恒心智之间解决。她是这颗星球的神后；除非你想成为轨道上那片太空人坟场的一部分，否则最好别和她作对。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment of silence passes before the armored figure nods. “Fair enough, captain. Whatever brings you here will be between you and the Evermind eventually, I’m sure. She’s the god-queen of this planet; you’d do well not to cross her unless you want to end up another part of the spacer graveyard in orbit.”"

rows.original: “I’m here to take what I can get from this shithole,” you tell her. “Look what the natives did with their world. They clearly lost the right to decide what happens to this planet now.”
rows.translation: “我来这里是为了尽可能从这个鬼地方捞走东西，”你告诉她。“看看原住民把自己的世界糟蹋成了什么样。他们显然已经失去了决定这颗星球命运的权利。”
rows.raw: "“I’m here to take what I can get from this shithole,” you tell her. “Look what the natives did with their world. They clearly lost the right to decide what happens to this planet now.”"

rows.original: The armor might not have a mouth, but you swear you can feel the scowl radiating off it. “I see. You’d best watch yourself out there then, Captain. The Evermind, this planet’s god-queen, is an absolute authority here - and she has no priority higher than protecting the Phaedrans from exactly your type of spacer. Keep that up and you’ll find yourself on her bad side, and from there, it’s a short trip to the spacer graveyard in orbit.”
rows.translation: 这套装甲也许没有嘴，但你发誓自己能感觉到它正散发着怒容。“明白了。那你最好在外面小心一点，船长。永恒心智，也就是这颗星球的神后，在这里拥有绝对权威——她最优先的事项，就是保护菲德拉人免遭你这种太空人的侵害。继续保持这种态度，你很快就会得罪她；到了那一步，离轨道上的太空人坟场也就不远了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe armor might not have a mouth, but you swear you can feel the scowl radiating off it. “I see. You’d best watch yourself out there then, Captain. The Evermind, this planet’s god-queen, is an absolute authority here - and she has no priority higher than protecting the Phaedrans from exactly your type of spacer. Keep that up and you’ll find yourself on her bad side, and from there, it’s a short trip to the spacer graveyard in orbit.”"

rows.translation: “我倒想看看她能拿我怎么样。”

rows.original: She shrugs. “I’m sure you will before long.”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩。“我相信你很快就会看到。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs. “I’m sure you will before long.”"

rows.original: “I’m just here for the adventure of it! Anything else is just a bonus.”
rows.translation: “我来这里就是为了冒险！除此之外得到的任何东西，都只是额外收获。”
rows.raw: "“I’m just here for the adventure of it! Anything else is just a bonus.”"

rows.original: Something like a chuckle escapes the armor’s voice-grill. “I see. Well, take it from me, Captain, there are certainly better worlds for playing space cowboy on. I’d suggest you beat feet while you still can. If not... the Evermind, the planet’s god-queen, is very protective of her subjects. It’s only a matter of time before you end up either on her bad side, or as a guest in her court.”
rows.translation: 装甲的发声格栅里传出近似轻笑的声音。“明白。好吧，听我一句，船长，想扮演太空牛仔的话，肯定还有比这里更好的世界。我建议你趁现在还来得及，赶紧走人。否则...永恒心智，也就是这颗星球的神后，对她的臣民保护欲极强。你要么得罪她，要么成为她宫廷里的座上宾，只是时间问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething like a chuckle escapes the armor’s voice-grill. “I see. Well, take it from me, Captain, there are certainly better worlds for playing space cowboy on. I’d suggest you beat feet while you still can. If not... the Evermind, the planet’s god-queen, is very protective of her subjects. It’s only a matter of time before you end up either on her bad side, or as a guest in her court.”"

rows.original: “See, that sounds like fun!” you grin. “The court of an alien goddess is exactly the sort of place I want to see out here!”
rows.translation: “瞧，这听起来很有意思！”你咧嘴一笑。“外星女神的宫廷，正是我希望能在这里见识的地方！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“See, that sounds like fun!” you grin. “The court of an alien goddess is exactly the sort of place I want to see out here!”"

rows.original: Seventeen shakes her head. “Do as you will, Captain. I’m certainly not going to stop you.”
rows.translation: 十七号摇摇头。“随你便吧，船长。我当然不会阻止你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSeventeen shakes her head. “Do as you will, Captain. I’m certainly not going to stop you.”"

rows.original: “I’m here looking for one of my company’s probes,” you tell her. “It should have arrived on the planet around when the Warp Gate did. Don’t suppose you’ve seen it just lying around, have you?” Something like a chuckle escapes the armor’s voice-grill. “I don’t think the locals would just leave something that precious lying around, no. Thank you for the honesty, though. I wouldn’t have blamed you for keeping company secrets close to your chest.
rows.translation: “我在寻找我们公司的一枚探针，”你告诉她。“它应该在跃迁门抵达前后降落到这颗星球上。你该不会碰巧见过它就那么扔在某处吧？” 装甲的发声格栅里传出近似轻笑的声音。“我想本地人不会把那么珍贵的东西随便扔在外面。还是谢谢你的坦诚。我不会责怪你把公司的秘密紧紧藏在胸前。
rows.raw: "“I’m here looking for one of my company’s probes,” you tell her. “It should have arrived on the planet around when the Warp Gate did. Don’t suppose you’ve seen it just lying around, have you?”\n\nSomething like a chuckle escapes the armor’s voice-grill. “I don’t think the locals would just leave something that precious lying around, no. Thank you for the honesty, though. I wouldn’t have blamed you for keeping company secrets close to your chest."

rows.original: Your, uh, incredibly large chest. I’m sure it’s easy to hide things in there, isn’t it?
rows.translation: 你的，呃，无比硕大的胸前。我敢肯定，在那里藏东西一定很容易，对吧？
rows.raw: " Your, uh, incredibly large chest. I’m sure it’s easy to hide things in there, isn’t it?"

rows.original: A word of advice, though: this system is very close to the Kalas system, so the gate that was sent here would have been one of the first to reach its destination. Ditto your probe. Would have predated the Glass War, so try looking in pre-war vaults or bunkers, anything hardened. An alien artifact would have been kept secure, right? Perhaps given to the Evermind, this planet’s god-queen.”
rows.translation: 不过有一条建议：这个星系离卡拉斯星系很近，所以送来这里的跃迁门应该是最早抵达目的地的一批之一。你的探针也是同理。那应该早于玻璃战争，因此试着去战前的保险库、掩体或任何经过加固的地方找找。外星神器应该会被严密保管，对吧？也许已经交给永恒心智，也就是这颗星球的神后。”
rows.raw: " A word of advice, though: this system is very close to the Kalas system, so the gate that was sent here would have been one of the first to reach its destination. Ditto your probe. Would have predated the Glass War, so try looking in pre-war vaults or bunkers, anything hardened. An alien artifact would have been kept secure, right? Perhaps given to the Evermind, this planet’s god-queen.”"

rows.translation: 这建议倒是不错...
琪哈小队？
琪哈小队？

rows.original: What happened to the rest of that corvette’s crew? Seventeen couldn’t have been the only one aboard?
rows.translation: 那艘轻型护卫舰上的其他船员怎么样了？十七号不可能是舰上唯一的人吧？
rows.raw: "What happened to the rest of that corvette’s crew? Seventeen couldn’t have been the only one aboard?"

rows.translation: 永恒心智
永恒心智

rows.original: What can she tell you about this local ‘goddess’?
rows.translation: 关于这位本地的‘女神’，她能告诉你什么？
rows.raw: "What can she tell you about this local ‘goddess’?"

rows.translation: 玻璃战争
玻璃战争

rows.original: Can she tell you anything more about the great war that devastated Phaedra?
rows.translation: 关于那场摧毁菲德拉的大战，她还能告诉你更多情况吗？
rows.raw: "Can she tell you anything more about the great war that devastated Phaedra?"

rows.translation: 防空系统
防空系统

rows.original: What can Seventeen tell you about the AA-guns protecting the forest?
rows.translation: 关于保护森林的防空炮，十七号能告诉你什么？
rows.raw: "What can Seventeen tell you about the AA-guns protecting the forest?"

rows.translation: 她自己
她自己

rows.original: Ask the thus-far-anonymous armored scout about herself. Assuming that is a ‘her’ under all that plate, anyway.
rows.translation: 向这位至今仍未透露姓名的装甲侦察兵问问她自己的事。前提是，那身装甲下面确实是个‘她’。
rows.raw: "Ask the thus-far-anonymous armored scout about herself. Assuming that is a ‘her’ under all that plate, anyway."

rows.translation: 离开
离开

rows.original: Take your leave of the armored scout.
rows.translation: 告别这位装甲侦察兵。
rows.raw: "Take your leave of the armored scout."

rows.original: “Where’s the rest of your crew?” you ask her.
rows.translation: “你的其他船员在哪？”你问她。
rows.raw: "“Where’s the rest of your crew?” you ask her."

rows.original: Seventeen stands stock still a moment, silent. When she speaks again, it’s slow and quiet. “As far as I know, I’m the only representative of KihaCorp on this planet.”
rows.translation: 十七号一动不动、沉默地站了片刻。再次开口时，她的语速缓慢，声音也很轻。“据我所知，我是这颗星球上基哈公司的唯一代表。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSeventeen stands stock still a moment, silent. When she speaks again, it’s slow and quiet. “As far as I know, I’m the only representative of KihaCorp on this planet.”"

rows.original: “We were deployed in individual dropships around the planet’s equator. There were a dozen of us. I lost contact with the rest of the unit after the Evermind lit up the sky with her anti-air cannons. They may have been attempting to return to the Guardian, and...”
rows.translation: “我们分别乘坐独立登陆艇，部署在星球赤道周围。我们总共有十二个人。永恒心智用防空炮点亮天空后，我和小队其他人失去了联系。他们或许正试图返回守护者号，然后...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We were deployed in individual dropships around the planet’s equator. There were a dozen of us. I lost contact with the rest of the unit after the Evermind lit up the sky with her anti-air cannons. They may have been attempting to return to the Guardian, and...”"

rows.translation: 你明白了。

rows.original: “What can you tell me about the Evermind - this so-called god-queen?”
rows.translation: “关于永恒心智——这位所谓的神后，你能告诉我什么？”
rows.raw: "“What can you tell me about the Evermind - this so-called god-queen?”"

rows.original: “Off-worlders have had little to no contact with her. As you have no doubt seen, she is... unwelcoming to extrasolar interference in her domain. What I can tell you is that she commands the only organized religion left on Phaedra after the Glass War - the natives believe the rest of their pantheon left them or died during the nuclear exchange. She is regarded as the goddess of technology and wisdom in equal measure, a modification of her pre-war portfolio that was entirely based around progressivism and technological advancement at breakneck speed. Perhaps she learned something about unchecked development when her flock killed nearly three quarters of their population overnight.”
rows.translation: “外星人与她几乎没有任何接触。你无疑已经见识过，她对外星系势力干涉自己的领地...很不欢迎。我能告诉你的是，玻璃战争之后，她统领着菲德拉仅存的有组织宗教；原住民相信，他们神系中的其他成员不是离开了他们，就是死于那场核交火。她既被视为技术女神，也被视为智慧女神；这和她在战前的职权有所不同，当时她完全代表进步主义，以及以惊人速度推进技术发展。也许在她的信众一夜之间杀死将近四分之三的人口后，她从不受约束的发展中学到了什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Off-worlders have had little to no contact with her. As you have no doubt seen, she is... unwelcoming to extrasolar interference in her domain. What I can tell you is that she commands the only organized religion left on Phaedra after the Glass War - the natives believe the rest of their pantheon left them or died during the nuclear exchange. She is regarded as the goddess of technology and wisdom in equal measure, a modification of her pre-war portfolio that was entirely based around progressivism and technological advancement at breakneck speed. Perhaps she learned something about unchecked development when her flock killed nearly three quarters of their population overnight.”"

rows.translation: “那当然会给人留下深刻印象。”

rows.original: Seventeen nods slowly. “Yeah, that’s one way of putting it. Either way, she’s real: her cultists can literally speak with her, and she has a temple somewhere in the Radwood where she dwells physically with her inner circle.”
rows.translation: 十七号缓缓点头。“是啊，也可以这么说。无论如何，她是真实存在的：她的信徒真的可以和她交谈；她还在辐射林的某处拥有一座神殿，与自己的核心圈子共同居住在那里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSeventeen nods slowly. “Yeah, that’s one way of putting it. Either way, she’s real: her cultists can literally speak with her, and she has a temple somewhere in the Radwood where she dwells physically with her inner circle.”"

rows.translation: “知道她是什么物种吗？”

rows.original: “If she has a species, none of the natives will say. She’s a goddess, beyond such things. Her cultic iconography often depicts her as a dragon, however.”
rows.translation: “就算她属于某个物种，也没有原住民愿意说。她是女神，超脱于这种概念。不过，她的宗教圣像经常把她描绘成一条龙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If she has a species, none of the natives will say. She’s a goddess, beyond such things. Her cultic iconography often depicts her as a dragon, however.”"

rows.original: “When I landed, a local went on about a ‘Glass War.‘ What do you know about it?”
rows.translation: “我降落时，有个本地人不停念叨一场‘玻璃战争’。你知道些什么？”
rows.raw: "“When I landed, a local went on about a ‘Glass War.‘ What do you know about it?”"

rows.original: “Total global nuclear war. It took place roughly a century ago, not long after the Warp Gate arrived in the system. From what I understand, it was fought between two of the planet’s dominant cultures over control of Confederate technology they had discovered during their late industrial age. These appear to have been the predecessors to the hyraxi mechanized nomads and the nuka living in Fission City - though there doesn’t appear to be much cultural continuity between them and their ancestors beyond their religion and some semblance of technology. I would advise against assuming the same self-destructive chaos lives on in their descendants... though admittedly, hard times can make hard people, can’t they?”
rows.translation: “全球全面核战争。大约发生在一个世纪前，也就是跃迁门抵达这个星系后不久。据我了解，交战双方是这颗星球上的两种主流文化，战争起因则是争夺他们在工业时代晚期发现的邦联技术。它们似乎分别是海拉克西机械游牧民和裂变城努卡人的前身；然而，除了宗教和一点技术痕迹之外，他们和祖先之间似乎没有多少文化延续性。我建议不要假定同样的自毁式混乱仍存在于他们的后代身上...不过不得不承认，艰苦时世会造就强硬的人，不是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Total global nuclear war. It took place roughly a century ago, not long after the Warp Gate arrived in the system. From what I understand, it was fought between two of the planet’s dominant cultures over control of Confederate technology they had discovered during their late industrial age. These appear to have been the predecessors to the hyraxi mechanized nomads and the nuka living in Fission City - though there doesn’t appear to be much cultural continuity between them and their ancestors beyond their religion and some semblance of technology. I would advise against assuming the same self-destructive chaos lives on in their descendants... though admittedly, hard times can make hard people, can’t they?”"

rows.translation: “什么意思？”

rows.original: Seventeen shrugs. “The Evermind is committed to ensuring another Glass War doesn’t happen again, hence why her followers go around collecting as much tech as they can, and keeping anything more advanced than a combustion engine out of the hands of the plebs. Still, reconstruction after the war has been slow, and most of the planet’s population are forced into a life of hunter-gathering, or subsistence farming around the few remaining walled cities. If people with nothing to lose see the opportunity to take what they need, or escape the doldrums of their wretched days with a little pleasure, they will.”
rows.translation: 十七号耸耸肩。“永恒心智决心确保另一场玻璃战争绝不会再次发生，因此她的追随者四处收集尽可能多的技术，并防止任何比内燃机更先进的东西落到平民手里。不过，战后重建一直进展缓慢，星球上的大多数居民不得不过着狩猎采集的生活，或在少数幸存的围墙城市周围从事勉强糊口的农业。如果一无所有的人看见机会，可以夺取自己需要的东西，或用一点欢愉逃离悲惨日子里的乏味，他们就会动手。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSeventeen shrugs. “The Evermind is committed to ensuring another Glass War doesn’t happen again, hence why her followers go around collecting as much tech as they can, and keeping anything more advanced than a combustion engine out of the hands of the plebs. Still, reconstruction after the war has been slow, and most of the planet’s population are forced into a life of hunter-gathering, or subsistence farming around the few remaining walled cities. If people with nothing to lose see the opportunity to take what they need, or escape the doldrums of their wretched days with a little pleasure, they will.”"

rows.original: “When my cousin was trying to land here, [rival.heShe] got shot down by some serious hardware in the mountains near that big forest. Know anything about that?”
rows.translation: “我的表亲试图在这里降落时，[rival.heShe]被大森林附近山区里的某种重型武器击落了。你知道那是什么吗？”
rows.raw: "“When my cousin was trying to land here, [rival.heShe] got shot down by some serious hardware in the mountains near that big forest. Know anything about that?”"

rows.original: The armored woman nods. “The Curtain of Light, the locals call it. Or the Tungsten Dome. There’s a massive hardlight barrier surrounding the Radwoods, projected from hardened installations all around the Shield Mountains. Keeps the radiation exposure to a minimum, and fosters a miniature hydrosystem inside - so it actually rains in the forest. Those same installations have railgun batteries and skyfalcon missile silos that put together have full coverage of the forest all the way up into atmosphere - nothing bigger than a paper plane’s getting to the Curtain, much less through it, without being obliterated.”
rows.translation: 装甲女人点点头。“本地人称它为光幕，或者钨穹顶。辐射林周围环绕着一道巨大的硬光屏障，由屏障山脉各处的加固设施投射。它把辐射暴露降到最低，还在内部维持着一个微型水循环系统，所以森林里真的会下雨。同一批设施还配备了轨道炮阵列和天隼导弹发射井，合起来覆盖了整片森林，一直延伸到大气层；任何比纸飞机更大的东西，别说穿过光幕了，就连靠近它都会被彻底摧毁。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe armored woman nods. “The Curtain of Light, the locals call it. Or the Tungsten Dome. There’s a massive hardlight barrier surrounding the Radwoods, projected from hardened installations all around the Shield Mountains. Keeps the radiation exposure to a minimum, and fosters a miniature hydrosystem inside - so it actually rains in the forest. Those same installations have railgun batteries and skyfalcon missile silos that put together have full coverage of the forest all the way up into atmosphere - nothing bigger than a paper plane’s getting to the Curtain, much less through it, without being obliterated.”"

rows.translation: 真狠。“有什么办法能关闭它吗？”

rows.original: “Do I look like I know?” She shrugs. “But... if I was the Evermind, I would keep the control mechanisms to the Curtain close at hand. Inside the dome.”
rows.translation: “我看起来像是知道吗？”她耸耸肩。“不过...如果我是永恒心智，我会把光幕的控制机构放在自己身边。也就是穹顶内部。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do I look like I know?” She shrugs. “But... if I was the Evermind, I would keep the control mechanisms to the Curtain close at hand. Inside the dome.”"

rows.original: “Tell me about yourself, XAA-0017. Like a real name, maybe?”
rows.translation: “说说你自己吧，XAA-0017。比如告诉我一个真正的名字？”
rows.raw: "“Tell me about yourself, XAA-0017. Like a real name, maybe?”"

rows.original: The armored woman plants a hand on her hip. “We should keep things professional, captain. You represent Steele Tech, and I represent Kiha. In the field, I’m identified by my serial number. As for me personally? You could say I’m archetypal of a company employee: I like hotrod ships, overcharged energy weapons, and spunky artificial intelligences.”
rows.translation: 装甲女人一手叉腰。“我们应该保持职业关系，船长。你代表斯蒂尔科技，我代表基哈公司。在战场上，我用序列号表明身份。至于我个人？你可以说，我是公司雇员的典型：我喜欢改装竞速船、过载能量武器，以及充满活力的人工智能。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe armored woman plants a hand on her hip. “We should keep things professional, captain. You represent Steele Tech, and I represent Kiha. In the field, I’m identified by my serial number. As for me personally? You could say I’m archetypal of a company employee: I like hotrod ships, overcharged energy weapons, and spunky artificial intelligences.”"

rows.original: You remember getting a face full of all three back in orbit. So yeah, archetypal sounds about right.
rows.translation: 你还记得自己在轨道上被这三样东西结结实实地糊了一脸。所以没错，说她典型相当准确。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remember getting a face full of all three back in orbit. So yeah, archetypal sounds about right."

rows.original: “I also happen to like [pc.nmh |good-natured space cowboys |quick wits and charming rogues |hard as nails [pc.mf|men|women] ], especially when they’re [pc.clMulti smuggler mercenary engineer kineticist |dashing smugglers |grizzled mercenaries |canny techies like me |talented kineticists |brave rushers ] too... but sitting around an irradiated wasteland doesn’t hold a candle to a nice VR lounge for getting to know somebody.” You can almost hear the smirk on her face. “So since we’re here, and not in VR... let’s keep on topic, eh Captain?” “[pc.isBimbo|Awwwww...|Of course.]”
rows.translation: “我还刚好喜欢[pc.nmh |心地善良的太空牛仔 |机智敏捷、魅力十足的侠盗 |坚韧如铁的[pc.mf|男人|女人] ]，特别是当他们还是[pc.clMulti smuggler mercenary engineer kineticist |潇洒的走私者 |久经沙场的佣兵 |像我一样精明的技术专家 |才华横溢的灵能操控者 |勇敢的冲袭者 ]时...不过要了解一个人，坐在辐射荒原上远不如舒适的虚拟现实休息室。” 你几乎可以听见她脸上的坏笑。“所以既然我们在这里，而不是虚拟现实中...还是谈正事吧，船长？” “[pc.isBimbo|哎呀呀...|当然。]”
rows.raw: "“I also happen to like [pc.nmh |good-natured space cowboys |quick wits and charming rogues |hard as nails [pc.mf|men|women] ], especially when they’re [pc.clMulti smuggler mercenary engineer kineticist |dashing smugglers |grizzled mercenaries |canny techies like me |talented kineticists |brave rushers ] too... but sitting around an irradiated wasteland doesn’t hold a candle to a nice VR lounge for getting to know somebody.” You can almost hear the smirk on her face. “So since we’re here, and not in VR... let’s keep on topic, eh Captain?” “[pc.isBimbo|Awwwww...|Of course.]”"

rows.original: “I’d better keep moving,” Seventeen says, looking past you to the windswept desert. “Staying too long in one place is just begging for hyraxi warbo[silly|y|i]s to come calling, and I don’t have the facilities to repair this armat - ehem, KihaCorp® Frontiersman Powered Exosuit™ - in the field. I’m sure we’ll meet again, Captain Steele. This world can be a surprisingly small place, especially for us aliens.”
rows.translation: “我最好继续赶路，”十七号望向你身后的狂风沙漠，说道。“在同一个地方待太久，简直就是求着海拉克西战斗机[silly|器|械]人找上门；我可没有条件在野外维修这套装——咳咳，基哈公司®边疆人动力外骨骼™。我相信我们还会再见，斯蒂尔船长。这个世界有时小得惊人，尤其对我们这些外星人来说。”
rows.raw: "“I’d better keep moving,” Seventeen says, looking past you to the windswept desert. “Staying too long in one place is just begging for hyraxi warbo[silly|y|i]s to come calling, and I don’t have the facilities to repair this armat - ehem, KihaCorp® Frontiersman Powered Exosuit™ - in the field. I’m sure we’ll meet again, Captain Steele. This world can be a surprisingly small place, especially for us aliens.”"

rows.original: She takes a step past you, but pauses to glance back at you over an armored shoulder. <i>“
rows.translation: 她从你身边迈出一步，却又停下来，越过装甲覆盖的肩膀回头望向你。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a step past you, but pauses to glance back at you over an armored shoulder. <i>“"

rows.original: Watch yourself out there. The Evermind doesn’t take kindly to people like you, but it’s not too late to get in her good graces. And trust me, you want that.
rows.translation: 在外面小心点。永恒心智不太喜欢你这种人，但现在争取她的好感还不算太晚。相信我，你会希望得到它。
rows.raw: "Watch yourself out there. The Evermind doesn’t take kindly to people like you, but it’s not too late to get in her good graces. And trust me, you want that."

rows.original: You’re making a good first impression so far. Keep it up, and I’m sure you’ll find your way into the Evermind’s good graces before long.
rows.translation: 到目前为止，你留下的第一印象很好。继续保持，我相信你很快就会得到永恒心智的青睐。
rows.raw: "You’re making a good first impression so far. Keep it up, and I’m sure you’ll find your way into the Evermind’s good graces before long."

rows.original: She takes off at a brisk jog, shortly vanishing over the dunes.
rows.translation: 她快步跑开，很快就消失在沙丘另一侧。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes off at a brisk jog, shortly vanishing over the dunes."

rows.translation: 那就继续吧...
继续

rows.translation: 你才不会替一个极其可疑的女性机器人跑什么随机寻物任务。

rows.translation: 你会帮她，但在冒险送命之前，你需要先得到一点激励。

rows.original: “I’ll pass,” you say, taking a step back from the seductive sex-bot.

rows.original: I don’t know why I expected to get through to you, I really don’t. Decency is too much to hope for from you, that much is already clear.
rows.translation: 我真不知道自己为什么会以为能够打动你，真的不知道。指望你表现出体面实在太过奢侈，这一点已经很清楚了。
rows.raw: "I don’t know why I expected to get through to you, I really don’t. Decency is too much to hope for from you, that much is already clear."

rows.original: Such a sudden change... “Who are you?”
rows.translation: 如此突然的变化...“你是谁？”

rows.original: The gynoid gives you a dangerous glare. “Someone better not trifled with. Go then. Waste your life in the dirt; clearly you aren’t the kind to spend it well.”
rows.translation: 这个女性机器人危险地瞪着你。“一个最好别招惹的人。走吧。把你的人生浪费在泥土里；显然，你不是那种懂得好好利用它的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gynoid gives you a dangerous glare. “Someone better not trifled with. Go then. Waste your life in the dirt; clearly you aren’t the kind to spend it well.”"

rows.original: She huffs and turns, striding back around the rock. You take a step after her, but she’s already gone, vanished into the myriad dark crevasses around you.
rows.translation: 她哼了一声，转身大步绕回岩石后方。你跟着迈出一步，可她已经消失了，隐入周围无数幽暗裂隙之中。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe huffs and turns, striding back around the rock. You take a step after her, but she’s already gone, vanished into the myriad dark crevasses around you."

rows.translation: 搞什么鬼...？
下一步

rows.original: “I could be convinced,” you tell her, “but I’d need some encouragement up front...”
rows.translation: “我不是不能答应，”你告诉她，“但你得先给我一点鼓励...”
rows.raw: "“I could be convinced,” you tell her, “but I’d need some encouragement up front...”"

rows.original: Her smirk spreads, just a touch, and her draconic tail coils around your [pc.leg]. “That is how you [silly|meat-bags|organics] comport yourself, isn’t it? A favor for a favor, scratch my back and I’ll scratch yours? I understand.”
rows.translation: 她的坏笑又扩大了些许，龙尾盘上你的[pc.leg]。“你们这些[silly|肉袋|有机体]就是这样行事的，对吧？互相帮忙，投桃报李？我明白。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer smirk spreads, just a touch, and her draconic tail coils around your [pc.leg]. “That is how you [silly|meat-bags|organics] comport yourself, isn’t it? A favor for a favor, scratch my back and I’ll scratch yours? I understand.”"

rows.original: Syne takes your hand with a wink. “Follow me, then.”
rows.translation: 赛恩眨眨眼，牵起你的手。“那就跟我来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyne takes your hand with a wink. “Follow me, then.”"

rows.original: You let the gynoid lead you back around behind some rocks, dropping your kit piece by piece as you go while keeping your eyes firmly glued to her tremendous behind as it sways and jiggles with every dainty step. Her tail lifts invitingly, showing off a silky ring and lipless gryvain pussy already glistening with lubricant.
rows.translation: 你任由这名雌性机器人带你绕到岩石后方，一路走一路脱下装备，同时目不转睛地盯着她硕大的臀部。她每迈出轻盈的一步，臀肉便摇曳晃动。她邀请般抬起尾巴，露出光滑的肛环与没有阴唇、已经泛着润滑液光泽的格里文阴户。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let the gynoid lead you back around behind some rocks, dropping your kit piece by piece as you go while keeping your eyes firmly glued to her tremendous behind as it sways and jiggles with every dainty step. Her tail lifts invitingly, showing off a silky ring and lipless gryvain pussy already glistening with lubricant."

rows.translation: “所以呢？你想让我摆什么姿势？”

rows.original: “Okay,” you say. “I’ll help. Where is this creature?”
rows.translation: “好吧，”你说道。“我会帮忙。那只生物在哪儿？”
rows.raw: "“Okay,” you say. “I’ll help. Where is this creature?”"

rows.original: Syne smiles brightly, offering you her hand. “Not far at all. I’ll take you.”
rows.translation: 赛恩灿烂地笑着，向你伸出手。“一点也不远，我带你去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyne smiles brightly, offering you her hand. “Not far at all. I’ll take you.”"

rows.original: You follow the fulsome gynoid through the dunes, eyes inevitably drawn to the sway and jiggle of her bare, pale ass that comes with every step. The way she moves truly is hypnotic, and it certainly makes the trip across the dustbowl feel like it takes just a matter of moments...
rows.translation: 你跟着体态丰腴的雌性机器人穿过沙丘，目光不可避免地被她赤裸苍白的屁股吸引。每迈一步，那屁股都会摇曳晃动。她的动作实在令人着迷，让穿越尘土盆地的旅途仿佛转瞬即逝...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow the fulsome gynoid through the dunes, eyes inevitably drawn to the sway and jiggle of her bare, pale ass that comes with every step. The way she moves truly is hypnotic, and it certainly makes the trip across the dustbowl feel like it takes just a matter of moments..."

rows.original: The pair of you crest a dune, and you find yourself looking down at a crater gouged into the sand on the other side. The sand around it has been burned into blackened glass, and metal and polymer shrapnel has been scattered around a crash site perhaps a hundred yards wide and three hundred long. The starship’s hull has been torn open in a dozen places, some by impact, certainly, but you see several holes have been punched straight through her flanks as well. Mass driver hits from the surface, judging by the angles, one of which went clean through the engines.
rows.translation: 你们两人登上一座沙丘，发现自己正俯视另一侧沙地中凿出的巨大坑洞。坑边沙粒被烧成焦黑玻璃，金属与聚合物碎片散落在一片约百码宽、三百码长的坠毁现场。星舰船体十几处被撕开，有些肯定源于撞击，但你也看到几处孔洞径直贯穿船侧。从角度判断，那是地表质量投射器留下的命中痕迹，其中一发彻底贯穿了引擎。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pair of you crest a dune, and you find yourself looking down at a crater gouged into the sand on the other side. The sand around it has been burned into blackened glass, and metal and polymer shrapnel has been scattered around a crash site perhaps a hundred yards wide and three hundred long. The starship’s hull has been torn open in a dozen places, some by impact, certainly, but you see several holes have been punched straight through her flanks as well. Mass driver hits from the surface, judging by the angles, one of which went clean through the engines."

rows.original: “Rough landing,” you say quietly, looking over the wreckage. “[pc.nmh|Did anyone else make it out?|Don’t think anybody walked away from that one...|Everyone die on impact?]”
rows.translation: “着陆挺惨烈，”你轻声说着，望向残骸。“[pc.nmh|还有其他人逃出来吗？|看来那一下谁也没能活着离开...|所有人都在撞击时死了吗？]”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rough landing,” you say quietly, looking over the wreckage. “[pc.nmh|Did anyone else make it out?|Don’t think anybody walked away from that one...|Everyone die on impact?]”"

rows.original: “Aside from me, you mean?” Syne says. “No, no organics survived. And now the bones of the vessel are being picked over by a silicone-devouring creature, growing fat on what remains. Look!”
rows.translation: “你是说除了我之外？”赛恩说道。“没有，没有有机体幸存。现在有一只吞食硅胶的生物正在啃食船只遗骸，靠剩下的东西长得越来越肥。看！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aside from me, you mean?” Syne says. “No, no organics survived. And now the bones of the vessel are being picked over by a silicone-devouring creature, growing fat on what remains. Look!”"

rows.original: Something shifts in the wreckage. Syne gasps, withdrawing back behind the dune as a shadow stalks out from one of the tears in the hull, sniffing at the wasteland air.
rows.translation: 残骸中有什么东西动了一下。赛恩倒吸一口气，退回沙丘后方；一道黑影从船体裂口中潜行而出，嗅探着荒原的空气。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething shifts in the wreckage. Syne gasps, withdrawing back behind the dune as a shadow stalks out from one of the tears in the hull, sniffing at the wasteland air."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The beast that stalks out is a muscular quadruped six feet tall at the shoulders, with a whiplike tail and a plated, horned head that looks like it could headbutt titanium and come out unscathed. If it has eyes, they’re too beady to see beneath its cranial ridges, but your gaze is drawn more to its slavering fangs and rending claws anyway.
rows.translation: 潜行出来的野兽是一头肌肉发达的四足生物，肩高六英尺，长着鞭子般的尾巴和覆盖甲片、头生犄角的脑袋，看起来即使一头撞上钛合金也能毫发无损。它即使有眼睛，也小得藏在头骨隆脊下难以看见；不过你的目光本就更多落在涎水淋漓的尖牙与撕裂利爪上。
rows.raw: "The beast that stalks out is a muscular quadruped six feet tall at the shoulders, with a whiplike tail and a plated, horned head that looks like it could headbutt titanium and come out unscathed. If it has eyes, they’re too beady to see beneath its cranial ridges, but your gaze is drawn more to its slavering fangs and rending claws anyway."

rows.original: The thing’s definitely related to a New Texan varmint, no way around it. Perhaps the crew was smuggling one?
rows.translation: 这东西无疑和新德克萨斯害兽有亲缘关系。或许船员一直在走私一只？
rows.raw: " The thing’s definitely related to a New Texan varmint, no way around it. Perhaps the crew was smuggling one?"

rows.original: The creature sniffs at the air, whipping its tail behind it as it stalks through the shadows. It steps over something as it walks, compressing the middle with enough weight that the top of another gynoid’s head is lifted from the sand covering it. The same model as Syne, you’d guess, but it’s hard to tell for sure from what little is left of the ‘bot; it’s little more than a horned skeleton, synthetic eyes staring vacantly into the air.
rows.translation: 那生物嗅着空气，潜行穿过阴影时，尾巴在身后甩动。它行走时踩过某样东西，重量将其腰部压下，令另一名雌性机器人的头顶从覆盖她的沙土中翘起。你猜她和赛恩是同一型号，但从这个“机器人”剩下的部分很难确定；她只剩一具长角骨架，合成眼睛空洞地望向空中。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe creature sniffs at the air, whipping its tail behind it as it stalks through the shadows. It steps over something as it walks, compressing the middle with enough weight that the top of another gynoid’s head is lifted from the sand covering it. The same model as Syne, you’d guess, but it’s hard to tell for sure from what little is left of the ‘bot; it’s little more than a horned skeleton, synthetic eyes staring vacantly into the air."

rows.original: You draw your [pc.weapon] and slide down the shipward face of the dune. The scaled monstrosity looks up and bares its fangs, letting out a trilling howl that echoes for miles around. When that doesn’t deter you, though, it raises its horns... and bolts back into the ship’s wreckage, stopping only to grab the ravaged gynoid’s neck in its jaws and drag her along with it.
rows.translation: 你拔出[pc.weapon]，沿沙丘朝飞船的一面滑下去。覆鳞怪物抬起头，露出尖牙，发出传遍方圆数英里的颤鸣嚎叫。见这仍吓不退你，它扬起犄角...然后猛冲回飞船残骸，只在途中停下来，用嘴咬住那具破烂雌性机器人的脖子，将她一并拖走。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou draw your [pc.weapon] and slide down the shipward face of the dune. The scaled monstrosity looks up and bares its fangs, letting out a trilling howl that echoes for miles around. When that doesn’t deter you, though, it raises its horns... and bolts back into the ship’s wreckage, stopping only to grab the ravaged gynoid’s neck in its jaws and drag her along with it."

rows.translation: 该死。
下一步
搜索中...

rows.original: You start rifling around through the crew’s belongings. Luckily their footlockers are bolted to the floor and sturdily made, meaning much of their effects were able to survive the crash. You find the usual assortment of personal items you’d expect from Rushers in the lockers: hair brushes, collars, negligee, spent credit chits, and booze whose bottles most regrettably did not survive impact.
rows.translation: 你开始翻找船员的私人物品。幸运的是，他们的床脚柜固定在地板上，做工也很坚固，因此许多东西在坠毁后幸存下来。你在柜子里找到淘金客常见的各类私人物品：发刷、项圈、性感睡衣、用过的信用券，以及一些酒，可惜装酒的瓶子没能承受住撞击。
rows.raw: "You start rifling around through the crew’s belongings. Luckily their footlockers are bolted to the floor and sturdily made, meaning much of their effects were able to survive the crash. You find the usual assortment of personal items you’d expect from Rushers in the lockers: hair brushes, collars, negligee, spent credit chits, and booze whose bottles most regrettably did not survive impact."

rows.original: This crew was definitely mostly ausar: from the holo-pics to the petplay paraphernalia tucked away, you can’t imagine there were more than one or two other races represented on the Son of Jissara’s crew. Hmm, now that you think of it... every last crewman’s locker you look through has at least one lovely, supple leather collar tucked away in it. Sometimes several.
rows.translation: 这批船员绝大多数肯定是奥萨尔人：从全息照片到藏起来的宠物扮演用具，你很难想象吉萨拉之子号的船员中还有超过一两个其他种族。嗯，说起来...你翻过的每个船员柜子里，都至少藏着一条漂亮柔软的皮项圈，有时甚至有好几条。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis crew was definitely mostly ausar: from the holo-pics to the petplay paraphernalia tucked away, you can’t imagine there were more than one or two other races represented on the Son of Jissara’s crew. Hmm, now that you think of it... every last crewman’s locker you look through has at least one lovely, supple leather collar tucked away in it. Sometimes several."

rows.original: Setting that discovery aside... you pick out a keychain from the assorted knick knacks, holding it up to the light. Aside from a rabbit’s foot charm, there’s a dozen old-style tumbler-bumpers on the chain, and a single digital card with no markings on it other than a winking face drawn in marker.
rows.translation: 暂且把这个发现放到一旁...你从各色小玩意中挑出一串钥匙，举到光下。除了兔脚挂饰，钥匙圈上还有十几把老式弹子锁钥匙，以及一张没有任何标记的数字卡，只有人用记号笔画了一张眨眼的脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nSetting that discovery aside... you pick out a keychain from the assorted knick knacks, holding it up to the light. Aside from a rabbit’s foot charm, there’s a dozen old-style tumbler-bumpers on the chain, and a single digital card with no markings on it other than a winking face drawn in marker."

rows.original: You pocket the keychain and move on.
rows.translation: 你把钥匙串装进口袋，继续前进。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pocket the keychain and move on."

rows.translation: （获得关键物品：坠毁飞船钥匙）
下一步

rows.original: You tap another button on the captain’s armrest, pulling up an emergency diagnostic of the ship’s systems. Aside from the obvious hull breaches and structural integrity failures, your attention is immediately drawn to an all-caps alert: WARNING: REACTOR BREACH DETECTED. ENGINEERING SEALED. Damn. The automated damage control systems have activated throughout the ship, sealing off the engineering deck’s power reactor from the rest of the Son. Radiation shields have also dropped to protect the crew quarters as well; they would have sealed the bridge, if the door hadn’t been hit by so much shrapnel that the bulkhead couldn’t move down. Lucky you, considering the only other possible way in is buried six feet down.
rows.translation: 你按下舰长扶手上的另一个按钮，调出飞船系统的紧急诊断。除了明显的船体破口与结构完整性故障，一条全大写警报立即吸引了你的注意：警告：侦测到反应堆破损。工程区已封闭。该死。自动损害管制系统已在全舰启动，将工程甲板的动力反应堆与吉萨拉之子号其余区域隔绝。辐射护盾也已降下，用来保护船员舱；它们原本也会封锁舰桥，只是舱门被太多碎片击中，隔板无法降下。你真走运，毕竟唯一可能的其他入口埋在六英尺深的地下。
rows.raw: "You tap another button on the captain’s armrest, pulling up an emergency diagnostic of the ship’s systems. Aside from the obvious hull breaches and structural integrity failures, your attention is immediately drawn to an all-caps alert: WARNING: REACTOR BREACH DETECTED. ENGINEERING SEALED. Damn. The automated damage control systems have activated throughout the ship, sealing off the engineering deck’s power reactor from the rest of the Son. Radiation shields have also dropped to protect the crew quarters as well; they would have sealed the bridge, if the door hadn’t been hit by so much shrapnel that the bulkhead couldn’t move down. Lucky you, considering the only other possible way in is buried six feet down."

rows.original: From here you could choose to end the damage control lockdown, which would get you into engineering at least. And also unleash whatever those bulkheads dropped to protect the crew from...
rows.translation: 你可以从这里选择解除损害管制封锁，至少这样便能进入工程区。当然，也会释放那些隔板为了保护船员而封住的东西...
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom here you could choose to end the damage control lockdown, which would get you into engineering at least. And also unleash whatever those bulkheads dropped to protect the crew from..."

rows.translation: 解除护盾
解除护盾

rows.original: End the damage control alert manually.
rows.translation: 手动结束损害管制警报。
护盾：已解除
护盾：已解除

rows.original: You’ve already released the shields. Now it’s time to hurry up and get what you came for...
rows.translation: 你已经解除护盾。现在该抓紧时间，拿到此行的目标...
rows.raw: "You’ve already released the shields. Now it’s time to hurry up and get what you came for..."

rows.translation: 返回

rows.original: You take a deep breath of the stale but safe air and then press the button to release the lockdown. Half a note blares from the emergency klaxon before it chokes out in a shower of sparks that sends you ducking. The deck rumbles underfoot as shields grind up on half-destroyed gears, releasing a cloud of noxious, irradiated gasses from deep inside engineering.
rows.translation: 你深吸一口陈腐却安全的空气，随后按下按钮解除封锁。紧急警报器只响出半个音符，便在一阵火花中哑火，吓得你急忙低头闪避。护盾在半毁齿轮上摩擦着升起，甲板在脚下震动，从工程区深处释放出一团有毒的辐射气体。
rows.raw: "You take a deep breath of the stale but safe air and then press the button to release the lockdown. Half a note blares from the emergency klaxon before it chokes out in a shower of sparks that sends you ducking. The deck rumbles underfoot as shields grind up on half-destroyed gears, releasing a cloud of noxious, irradiated gasses from deep inside engineering."

rows.original: Alerts pop up on the holos, telling you that dangerous radiation is spilling out from engineering. Further, because of the radiological alert, the crew quarters are still sealed directly from engineering. You won’t be able to countermand the seal until the reactor breach is dealt with.
rows.translation: 全息屏幕上弹出警报，告诉你危险的辐射正在从工程区泄漏。此外，由于辐射警报，船员舱与工程区之间仍处于封闭状态。反应堆破损处理完毕前，你无法越权解除封锁。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlerts pop up on the holos, telling you that dangerous radiation is spilling out from engineering. Further, because of the radiological alert, the crew quarters are still sealed directly from engineering. You won’t be able to countermand the seal until the reactor breach is dealt with."

rows.original: Better get a move on before the radiation becomes too severe...
rows.translation: 最好赶在辐射变得过于严重之前行动起来...
rows.raw: "\n\nBetter get a move on before the radiation becomes too severe..."

rows.translation: 下一步
舰长日志

rows.original: You tap the replay button on the command throne’s arm, bringing back the holographic figure of the femboy kitty-captain. It looks like there are still several log entries still stored in the chair’s memory bank, sorted by date.
rows.translation: 你按下指挥王座扶手上的重播按钮，那个猫科伪娘舰长的全息身影再次出现。王座记忆库里似乎还储存着几条日志，按日期排序。
rows.raw: "You tap the replay button on the command throne’s arm, bringing back the holographic figure of the femboy kitty-captain. It looks like there are still several log entries still stored in the chair’s memory bank, sorted by date."

rows.original: “Captain’s log, supplemental. It is the eve of the 14th Great Planet Rush, and the start of our grand adventure. The Son of Jissara has been commissioned by the Akkadi Research and Development Group to survey a group of seven select planets as potential points of interest to their science department. As part of this new contract, the Son has undergone extensive refit, giving us vastly improved sensor and scientific suites on par with the most cutting-edge research ships.”
rows.translation: “舰长日志，补充记录。第十四次行星开拓潮前夕，我们伟大冒险的起点。阿卡迪研发集团已委托吉萨拉之子号勘察七颗指定行星，判断它们是否值得科研部门关注。作为新合同的一部分，吉萨拉之子号接受了大规模改装，传感器与科研设备得到极大提升，已能比肩最尖端的科研船。”
rows.raw: "“Captain’s log, supplemental. It is the eve of the 14th Great Planet Rush, and the start of our grand adventure. The Son of Jissara has been commissioned by the Akkadi Research and Development Group to survey a group of seven select planets as potential points of interest to their science department. As part of this new contract, the Son has undergone extensive refit, giving us vastly improved sensor and scientific suites on par with the most cutting-edge research ships.”"

rows.original: “And, of course, we’ve taken on new crew as well. Commander Kiara Dorna, formerly of her family’s Warp Field Institute, has left a decidedly very long lasting impression on me already. I look forward to seeing her bonding with the rest of our tight-knit crew over the coming years. In addition, we’ve been joined by crewman M’tera Vhess, formerly a specialist in artificial intelligence at KihaCorp. She’s a beta dzaan, though she certainly has an alpha’s aura in the most delightful ways, and marks the only non-ausar on my crew aside from myself. She came highly recommended, however, including a personal mark of excellence from Kiha herself, so while our own computers expert is out on maternity leave I’m willing to make an exception for this tour.”
rows.translation: “当然，我们也接收了新船员。琪娅拉·多娜指挥官原先任职于家族的曲速场研究所，而且已经给我留下了非常持久的深刻印象。我期待未来几年她与我们关系紧密的船员增进感情。此外，船员姆特拉·维斯也加入了我们。她原先是基哈公司的人工智能专家。她是个贝塔德赞人，但在最令人愉悦的方面无疑散发着阿尔法的气场，也是全舰除我之外唯一的非奥萨尔人。不过她得到高度推荐，甚至有基哈本人签发的卓越评价；既然我们自己的计算机专家正在休产假，我愿意为这次航程破例。”
