I look forward to seeing her bonding with the rest of our tight-knit crew over the coming years. In addition, we’ve been joined by crewman M’tera Vhess, formerly a specialist in artificial intelligence at KihaCorp. She’s a beta dzaan, though she certainly has an alpha’s aura in the most delightful ways, and marks the only non-ausar on my crew aside from myself. She came highly recommended, however, including a personal mark of excellence from Kiha herself, so while our own computers expert is out on maternity leave I’m willing to make an exception for this tour.”"

rows.original: “With the crew back to full strength and our new upgrades installed, we only have to wait until midnight and the activation of the Fourteenth Rush’s new gates. At Commander Dorna’s suggestion, I’ve had a case of Hauâ Maian red brought aboard to toast with. Let’s make Ms. Vhess feel welcome!”
rows.translation: “船员重新满编，新升级也已安装完毕，现在只需等待午夜以及第十四次开拓潮的新星门启动。按照多娜指挥官的建议，我让人带了一箱豪阿·迈安红酒上船庆祝。让维斯女士感受到我们的欢迎吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“With the crew back to full strength and our new upgrades installed, we only have to wait until midnight and the activation of the Fourteenth Rush’s new gates. At Commander Dorna’s suggestion, I’ve had a case of Hauâ Maian red brought aboard to toast with. Let’s make Ms. Vhess feel welcome!”"

rows.original: “Captain’s log, R14-point-one-point-forty-two. With crewman Vhess having recovered from her ordeal on DeLuca VII, we’ve charted course for the second new planet we’re to explore as part of our Akkadi contract: Nyphea. Initial scans show it to be an incredibly lush, verdant forested world teeming with fauna, including what appears to be a quadrupedal sapient species. There is no sign of technology on the planet more advanced than the bow and arrow, however, so Akkadi’s interest in the planet is likely to be minimal. Still, in the name of due diligence, we will conduct a thorough scan of the planet from orbit before moving on to Phaedra.”
rows.translation: “舰长日志，R14点一点四十二。船员维斯已从德卢卡七号星的磨难中恢复，我们正驶向阿卡迪合同要求探索的第二颗新行星：尼菲娅。初步扫描显示，这是一颗极其繁茂葱郁、遍布森林的世界，动物种类丰富，其中似乎还有一种四足智慧种族。不过星球上没有发现比弓箭更先进的技术，因此阿卡迪对它的兴趣可能十分有限。尽管如此，为了尽职尽责，我们仍会从轨道上彻底扫描该行星，再前往菲德拉。”

rows.original: There is a long pause before you hear the kaithrit’s voice again. The hologram shifts to show him reclining in his throne with an ausar woman in his lap, wearing a high heeled version of the same jumpsuit, though zipped down to the navel. It, too, has a conspicuous bulge. “Captain’s log, supplemental. Severe atmospheric interference in the equatorial jungles forced the crew to make landfall to complete our analysis of the planet, and inevitably we have made first contact with the primitive tauric natives. The native race, the dhrisa, have proven... remarkably accommodating to my fully female crew, but staunchly refused to so much as speak to myself, Commander Dorna, or crewman Vhess. The ladies were given the honor of participating in a native religious ritual ongoing at the time of our arrival, dedicated to their goddess of fertility. Communications with our away team are out, leaving the three of us back aboard the Son with little to do but get to know each other a little better...”
rows.translation: 过了很久，你才再次听到凯斯里特人的声音。全息影像变成他斜靠在王座上的画面，腿上坐着一个奥萨尔女人。她穿着同款连体衣的高跟版本，拉链却一路敞至肚脐，胯间同样有一处醒目的隆起。“舰长日志，补充记录。赤道丛林中的严重大气干扰迫使船员登陆，以完成对该行星的分析，而我们也不可避免地与原始的半人马形原住民首次接触。原生种族迪尔萨人已经证明...她们格外愿意配合我这支全女性船员，却坚决拒绝与我、多娜指挥官或船员维斯说哪怕一句话。女士们获准参与我们抵达时正在进行的一项原住民宗教仪式，该仪式献给她们的生育女神。我们与登陆队的通讯已经中断，只剩我们三人在吉萨拉之子号上无所事事，只能更加深入地了解彼此...”

The hologram shifts to show him reclining in his throne with an ausar woman in his lap, wearing a high heeled version of the same jumpsuit, though zipped down to the navel. It, too, has a conspicuous bulge. “Captain’s log, supplemental. Severe atmospheric interference in the equatorial jungles forced the crew to make landfall to complete our analysis of the planet, and inevitably we have made first contact with the primitive tauric natives. The native race, the dhrisa, have proven... remarkably accommodating to my fully female crew, but staunchly refused to so much as speak to myself, Commander Dorna, or crewman Vhess. The ladies were given the honor of participating in a native religious ritual ongoing at the time of our arrival, dedicated to their goddess of fertility. Communications with our away team are out, leaving the three of us back aboard the Son with little to do but get to know each other a little better...”"

rows.original: Another pause. This time the kaithrit’s wearing a supple leather collar and a short sarong, both beautifully stitched with floral patterns. “Captain’s log, supplemental. The away team has returned from their cultural exchange in high spirits and bearing gifts. I have been invited down to the surface to meet with their high priestess now that the crew has uncovered the cultural faux-pas we stumbled into. Apparently ‘breeders’ - that is, those of us with breeding poles between our legs - are not to be so much as acknowledged in public without a collar on to denote which ‘seed-bearer’ we belong to, nor are we allowed to wear any clothing that conceals our privates. Doctor Gyse has offered to be my, ah, chaperone down to the surface. She insists that I will find the meeting of great interest, and won’t take no for an answer.”
rows.translation: 又是一阵停顿。这次凯斯里特人戴着柔软的皮项圈，穿着短围裙，两者都缝有精美花卉图案。“舰长日志，补充记录。登陆队带着高涨的情绪与礼物结束文化交流，返回舰上。船员们终于弄清了我们误触的文化禁忌，现在我受邀前往地表拜见大祭司。原来‘育种者’，也就是我们这些两腿之间长着播种棒的人，若没有佩戴项圈标明自己属于哪位‘持种者’，就不配在公共场合得到任何承认；而且我们也不准穿遮住私处的衣物。盖斯医生主动提出当我的，呃，地表陪同人。她坚称我一定会觉得这次会面非常有趣，而且根本不接受拒绝。”

The away team has returned from their cultural exchange in high spirits and bearing gifts. I have been invited down to the surface to meet with their high priestess now that the crew has uncovered the cultural faux-pas we stumbled into. Apparently ‘breeders’ - that is, those of us with breeding poles between our legs - are not to be so much as acknowledged in public without a collar on to denote which ‘seed-bearer’ we belong to, nor are we allowed to wear any clothing that conceals our privates. Doctor Gyse has offered to be my, ah, chaperone down to the surface. She insists that I will find the meeting of great interest, and won’t take no for an answer.”"

rows.original: “Captain’s log, R14-point-one-point-fifty-two. Commander Dorna discovered a curative to the pheromonal mind control the natives had used to take control of the away team. She and crewman Vhess led a rescue mission to the surface that ended my week long captivity in the high priestess’s harem. During the ensuing battle, we discovered a subterranean chamber beneath the fertility temple that housed a starship of unknown provenance. The ship was ancient, carbon dated to at least a thousand years ago. Crewman Vhess was able to program an artificial intelligence to brute force the ship’s security, and we’ve downloaded its memory banks for Akkadi analysis once we return to port. At first glance, the ship appears to be incredibly advanced, possibly overmatching anything in the Confederate arsenal, but we’ll be saving detailed investigations for the corporate research unit. With any luck, they’ll pay a bonus bounty for the pheromonal countermeasures Commander Dorna developed.”
rows.translation: “舰长日志，R14点一点五十二。多娜指挥官发现了一种解药，能治疗原住民利用信息素实施的精神控制。她与船员维斯率领救援任务前往地表，结束了我在大祭司后宫中长达一周的囚禁。随后的战斗中，我们在生育神殿下方发现了一间地下密室，里面存放着一艘来历不明的星舰。飞船极其古老，碳定年至少有一千年历史。船员维斯成功编写了人工智能程序，以暴力破解飞船安保；我们已经下载它的记忆库，返回港口后交给阿卡迪分析。初看之下，这艘船先进得不可思议，甚至可能胜过邦联军械库里的任何装备，不过详细调查将留给公司的研究部门。运气好的话，他们还会为多娜指挥官开发的信息素对抗措施支付额外赏金。”

Crewman Vhess was able to program an artificial intelligence to brute force the ship’s security, and we’ve downloaded its memory banks for Akkadi analysis once we return to port. At first glance, the ship appears to be incredibly advanced, possibly overmatching anything in the Confederate arsenal, but we’ll be saving detailed investigations for the corporate research unit. With any luck, they’ll pay a bonus bounty for the pheromonal countermeasures Commander Dorna developed.”"

rows.original: A pause, and the captain smirks. “In the meantime, Kiara has also synthesized the dhrisan pheromones into a cologne. It appears to put fertile women into a suggestible but sexually aggressive state. Initial research shows that, when mixed with masculine sex pheromones, the cologne makes you nearly irresistible... whether you like it or not. By way of apology for their behavior, the ladies have all agreed to a few days of rigorous field testing before we move on to our next survey world, Phaedra.”
rows.translation: 停顿片刻后，舰长坏笑起来。“与此同时，琪娅拉也把迪尔萨人的信息素合成为古龙水。它似乎会令有生育能力的女性进入易受暗示、但性欲极具攻击性的状态。初步研究显示，与男性性信息素混合后，这种古龙水会让你变得几乎不可抗拒...不管你愿不愿意。为了对她们先前的行为表示歉意，女士们一致同意，在我们前往下一颗调查行星菲德拉之前，进行几天严谨的实地测试。”

By way of apology for their behavior, the ladies have all agreed to a few days of rigorous field testing before we move on to our next survey world, Phaedra.”"

rows.original: The recording hitches, and the captain reappears wearing a collar and sarong, looking utterly disheveled and exhausted. “Captain’s log... is very fucking sore. Let the record show that women are not the only ones affected by the cologne. Kiara, uh, Commander Dorna... is suffering from acute dehydration and fatigue. Ship’s lube supply: virtually exhausted. Condom supply: utterly depleted. Doctor Gyse:
rows.translation: 录像忽然卡顿，舰长重新出现，仍戴着项圈、穿着围裙，整个人蓬头垢面又疲惫不堪。“舰长日志...他妈的疼死了。日志注明：女性不是唯一会受到古龙水影响的人。琪娅拉，呃，多娜指挥官...正遭受急性脱水与疲劳。舰上润滑剂储备：几乎耗尽。安全套储备：彻底见底。盖斯医生：

rows.original: “Captain’s log, R14-point-one-point-fifty-five. Having finished our survey of Nyphea, one of the most beautiful garden worlds I’ve ever seen, the Son of Jissara has just arrived in orbit of Phaedra II. The contrast is striking. Initial scans indicate that this world has suffered a prolonged radiological event, possibly indicative of nuclear war. While we detect humanoid life signs, they are scattered and number only in the tens of millions across the planet, and there is little evidence of advanced technology on the surface. We have, however, detected numerous satellites in orbit, suggesting the natives at one point at least achieved a primitive space age. We have received no response from the surface to any hails. In order to fulfill our mission, we’ll have to do things the hard way...”
rows.translation: “舰长日志，R14点一点五十五。我们已经完成对尼菲娅的调查，那是我见过最美丽的花园世界之一；吉萨拉之子号刚刚抵达菲德拉二号轨道。反差十分强烈。初步扫描表明，这颗星球经历过漫长的辐射事件，可能意味着发生过核战争。我们虽然探测到类人生物的生命迹象，但他们散布各地，整颗星球只有数千万人，地表也几乎没有先进技术的证据。不过，我们在轨道上探测到大量卫星，说明原住民至少曾进入过原始太空时代。地表没有回应任何呼叫。为了完成任务，我们只能采用麻烦的方式...”

rows.original: “Captain’s log, R14-point-one-point-fifty-seven. We have made contact with several small tribes living in the wastelands of Phaedra using our emergency backup radios - an excellent suggestion on the part of crewman Vhess. It appears that the natives are recovering from a total nuclear exchange some hundred years ago, which wiped out their society and reduced their developmental progress to a state of, to quote Doctor Gyse, ‘techno-barbarism.‘ Despite Vhess’s objections, we’ve decided to make landfall near the home of a particularly tech-savvy tribe of hyraxi, a species superficially similar to the ausar, to attempt to trade our food and medical supplies for local technology so we can begin our analysis.”
rows.translation: “舰长日志，R14点一点五十七。我们使用紧急备用无线电，与菲德拉荒原中的几个小部落取得联系；船员维斯提出的建议非常出色。原住民似乎正从大约一百年前的全面核交火中恢复，那场战争摧毁了他们的社会，使发展水平倒退到盖斯医生所说的‘科技蛮族主义’。尽管维斯反对，我们仍决定在一个技术格外娴熟的海拉克西部落住地附近着陆。这个种族表面上与奥萨尔人相似。我们将尝试用食品和医疗物资交换本地技术，以便开始分析。”
rows.raw: "“Captain’s log, R14-point-one-point-fifty-seven. We have made contact with several small tribes living in the wastelands of Phaedra using our emergency backup radios - an excellent suggestion on the part of crewman Vhess. It appears that the natives are recovering from a total nuclear exchange some hundred years ago, which wiped out their society and reduced their developmental progress to a state of, to quote Doctor Gyse, ‘techno-barbarism.‘ Despite Vhess’s objections, we’ve decided to make landfall near the home of a particularly tech-savvy tribe of hyraxi, a species superficially similar to the ausar, to attempt to trade our food and medical supplies for local technology so we can begin our analysis.”"

rows.original: The captain grins and leans back in his chair, steepling his fingers. “From what we’ve exchanged with the hyraxi tribe, I have at least one thing in common with them: a love of jetbikes. Perhaps there’s something in the inventory I can trade with them for one. We’ll be landing momentarily!”
rows.translation: 舰长咧嘴一笑，靠回椅中，十指相抵。“从与海拉克西部落的交流来看，我和他们至少有一个共同点：都热爱喷气摩托。或许库存里有东西可以拿来换一辆。我们马上着陆！”

Perhaps there’s something in the inventory I can trade with them for one. We’ll be landing momentarily!”"

rows.original: There’s a fritz in the hologram, and suddenly the captain’s been replaced by a dzaan woman so thick that she’s visibly struggling to fit into the command throne. There’s a massive bulge in her jumpsuit sitting heavy over her pressed-together thighs. She’s got several techno-gadgets strapped to her belt and arms, including a holo-bracer she’s quickly typing on.
rows.translation: 全息影像出现一阵故障，舰长突然被一个丰腴到明显难以塞进指挥王座的德赞女人取代。她并拢的大腿上压着连体衣内一处巨大隆起。腰带和手臂上绑着几件科技装置，包括一块正被她飞快输入内容的全息臂环。

There’s a massive bulge in her jumpsuit sitting heavy over her pressed-together thighs. She’s got several techno-gadgets strapped to her belt and arms, including a holo-bracer she’s quickly typing on."

rows.original: “Chief systems operator’s log, supplemental,” she says hurriedly. “While Captain Leoric and the others are engaging in trade with the Phaedran natives, I’ve confirmed my theory regarding extranet ‘ghost’ signals on the planet’s surface. Someone, or something, is running a dark Q-COMM network separated from the public net. There’s no way to breach it without a hardwire connection to a port, but the reverse isn’t necessarily true. We’ve got so many Q-COMM devices running in the science department alone, it’s like hanging out a ‘please hack me’ sign to anybody who knows their way around EWS. There’s already evidence that our flight systems have been probed by an outside source. I need to tell the captain before it’s too late!”
rows.translation: “首席系统操作员日志，补充记录，”她急促地说道。“利奥里克舰长与其他人正在和菲德拉原住民交易，而我已经证实了有关地表外联网‘幽灵’信号的理论。有人或某种东西正在运行一个与公共网络隔离的暗网Q-COMM。没有接入端口的硬线连接就无法侵入，但反过来却未必如此。单是科研部门就在运行太多Q-COMM设备，简直像给任何懂得EWS的人挂出‘欢迎入侵’的牌子。已经有证据表明，外部来源探测过我们的飞行系统。我必须赶在为时太晚前告诉舰长！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Chief systems operator’s log, supplemental,” she says hurriedly. “While Captain Leoric and the others are engaging in trade with the Phaedran natives, I’ve confirmed my theory regarding extranet ‘ghost’ signals on the planet’s surface. Someone, or something, is running a dark Q-COMM network separated from the public net. There’s no way to breach it without a hardwire connection to a port, but the reverse isn’t necessarily true. We’ve got so many Q-COMM devices running in the science department alone, it’s like hanging out a ‘please hack me’ sign to anybody who knows their way around EWS. There’s already evidence that our flight systems have been probed by an outside source. I need to tell the captain before it’s too late!”"

rows.original: She heaves herself up and goes running, and the recording ends.
rows.translation: 她费力起身，拔腿奔跑，录像随之结束。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe heaves herself up and goes running, and the recording ends."

rows.original: You swipe the keycard across the reader, watching as its lock light switches from red to green.
rows.translation: 你让钥匙卡划过读卡器，看着锁灯从红色变成绿色。
rows.raw: "You swipe the keycard across the reader, watching as its lock light switches from red to green."

rows.original: The object of your search should be just inside...
rows.translation: 你寻找的东西应该就在里面...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe object of your search should be just inside..."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You reach out and pluck up the computer core. There’s a mechanical whir from the server stack, and then they begin powering down one by one. Such a small prize for so much trouble...
rows.translation: 你伸手取出计算机核心。服务器堆传出机械嗡鸣，随后一台接一台地关闭。费了这么大力气，奖品却如此小巧...
rows.raw: "You reach out and pluck up the computer core. There’s a mechanical whir from the server stack, and then they begin powering down one by one. Such a small prize for so much trouble..."

rows.original: A computer core from the crashed ship Son of Jissara, desired by the Kihan gynoid Syne.
rows.translation: 坠毁飞船吉萨拉之子号的计算机核心，基罕雌性机器人赛恩想要得到它。
rows.raw: "A computer core from the crashed ship Son of Jissara, desired by the Kihan gynoid Syne."

rows.translation: （获得关键物品：坠毁核心）
下一步

rows.original: The Son of Jissara’s secured lockers aren’t a proper cargo hold - that’s down below - but between the blast shields you had to raise to get in here and an intimidatingly dense lock bolted over them, they certainly offer a lot more security for the ship’s most valuable cargo. The lock has a password input on it:
rows.translation: 吉萨拉之子号的安全储物柜算不上正规的货舱，真正的货舱在下层；不过你必须升起防爆护盾才能进入这里，再加上柜门上固定着厚实得吓人的锁，它们无疑能为飞船最贵重的货物提供更多保障。锁上有一个密码输入框：
rows.raw: "The Son of Jissara’s secured lockers aren’t a proper cargo hold - that’s down below - but between the blast shields you had to raise to get in here and an intimidatingly dense lock bolted over them, they certainly offer a lot more security for the ship’s most valuable cargo. The lock has a password input on it:"

rows.translation: 输入
输入
按“输入”提交密码。
返回

rows.original: The lock beeps green and issues a loud ka-thunk as it disengages. You crank the locker open to reveal several small spray bottles on a plastic rack, a large credit chit, and several data cards from the science lab. You pocket the chit right away, then lean in to examine the bottles. They’re full of a murky off-pink liquid that froths immediately when you poke the bottles. Thankfully they were so well secured, as there’s no way these glass phials would have survived the crash without all the padding in here.
rows.translation: 锁亮起绿灯，解除时发出响亮的咔嗵声。你转动把手打开储物柜，看见塑料架上的几只小喷瓶、一张大额信用券和几张科研实验室的数据卡。你立刻把信用券装进口袋，随后俯身检查瓶子。瓶中装满浑浊的浅粉色液体，你一碰瓶身，液体立刻泛起泡沫。幸亏它们固定得如此严实；没有这里的所有填充物，这些玻璃小瓶绝不可能在坠毁后完好无损。
rows.raw: "The lock beeps green and issues a loud ka-thunk as it disengages. You crank the locker open to reveal several small spray bottles on a plastic rack, a large credit chit, and several data cards from the science lab. You pocket the chit right away, then lean in to examine the bottles. They’re full of a murky off-pink liquid that froths immediately when you poke the bottles. Thankfully they were so well secured, as there’s no way these glass phials would have survived the crash without all the padding in here."

rows.translation: 信用点）
下一步

rows.original: The locker’s security system makes an obnoxious, grating BZZZT, and the password input resets.
rows.translation: 储物柜安保系统发出刺耳恼人的BZZZT声，密码输入框随之重置。
rows.raw: "The locker’s security system makes an obnoxious, grating BZZZT, and the password input resets."

rows.translation: 看来密码不对...
下一步

rows.original: You hurry over to the engineering console, tapping at its cracked holokeys until something coherent finally flickers into view from its projectors. The several dozen flashing red warning alerts aren’t very helpful at this late stage, though, and the console insistently informs you that it absolutely will not unlock the ship’s secondary sections until the reactor breach is contained.
rows.translation: 你匆忙走向工程控制台，不断敲击开裂的全息按键，直到投影仪终于闪出一段连贯内容。可到了这个阶段，几十条闪烁的红色警报已经帮不上什么忙；控制台还一再强调，在反应堆破损得到控制前，它绝对不会解锁飞船的次要区域。
rows.raw: "You hurry over to the engineering console, tapping at its cracked holokeys until something coherent finally flickers into view from its projectors. The several dozen flashing red warning alerts aren’t very helpful at this late stage, though, and the console insistently informs you that it absolutely will not unlock the ship’s secondary sections until the reactor breach is contained."

rows.original: You glance at the core, blown wide open by a railgun slug. Yeah, not happening. With a grunt of frustration, you rip the access panel off the side of the console and poke your head into the wires. Gonna have to do this the hard way...
rows.translation: 你瞥向被轨道炮弹丸彻底轰开的核心。对，这根本不可能。你沮丧地哼了一声，扯掉控制台侧面的检修面板，把头探进线路里。只能用麻烦的办法了...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance at the core, blown wide open by a railgun slug. Yeah, not happening. With a grunt of frustration, you rip the access panel off the side of the console and poke your head into the wires. Gonna have to do this the hard way..."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: You recoil as sparks fly from the console. Shit, that wasn’t it - and failure’s left you sitting uselessly in radiation all this time.
rows.translation: 控制台迸出火花，你猛地缩回身体。该死，不是这根线；而这次失败让你一直毫无意义地坐在辐射中。
rows.raw: "You recoil as sparks fly from the console. Shit, that wasn’t it - and failure’s left you sitting uselessly in radiation all this time."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The console beeps, drawing your attention up from its guts to a green holoscreen, telling you that all the emergency shielding has been lifted. You breathe a sigh of relief and get your head out of the wires - time to go!
rows.translation: 控制台发出提示音，将你的注意力从内部线路引向绿色全息屏幕。屏幕告诉你所有紧急护盾都已升起。你松了一口气，把头从线路中拔出；该走了！
rows.raw: "The console beeps, drawing your attention up from its guts to a green holoscreen, telling you that all the emergency shielding has been lifted. You breathe a sigh of relief and get your head out of the wires - time to go!"

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The monstrosity is on you in a heartbeat, taking advantage of your momentary weakness to trample you down and go for your throat.
rows.translation: 怪物转瞬便扑到你身上，趁你一时虚弱将你踩倒，直取咽喉。
rows.raw: "The monstrosity is on you in a heartbeat, taking advantage of your momentary weakness to trample you down and go for your throat."

rows.original: The pain only lasts a moment, before darkness consumes you.
rows.translation: 疼痛只持续了片刻，黑暗便将你吞噬。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe pain only lasts a moment, before darkness consumes you."

rows.original: The blue-scaled monstrosity crumples, giving one last plaintive whine before it falls still. The deck rumbles under the weight of the creature’s collapse, and then... silence falls. You keep your weapon leveled at the beast a moment longer until you’re sure it’s down for good before finally relaxing, turning your attention back towards the console on the wall.
rows.translation: 蓝鳞怪物瘫倒在地，发出最后一声哀鸣，随后再无动静。它倒下的重量令甲板震颤，接着...一切陷入寂静。你继续用武器瞄准野兽片刻，确认它再也起不来后才终于放松，把注意力转回墙上的控制台。
rows.raw: "The blue-scaled monstrosity crumples, giving one last plaintive whine before it falls still. The deck rumbles under the weight of the creature’s collapse, and then... silence falls. You keep your weapon leveled at the beast a moment longer until you’re sure it’s down for good before finally relaxing, turning your attention back towards the console on the wall."

rows.original: Even if that threat’s been dealt with, you’re still soaking up an unhealthy amount of radiation
rows.translation: 即使那个威胁已经解决，你仍在吸收对健康不利的大量辐射
rows.raw: "\n\nEven if that threat’s been dealt with, you’re still soaking up an unhealthy amount of radiation"

joinAfter.expression:
pc.hasAirtightSuit()
                ? " and your sealed armor isn’t going to protect your forever"
                : ""

rows.original: and your sealed armor isn’t going to protect your forever
rows.translation: ，而密封护甲也不可能永远保护你
rows.raw: " and your sealed armor isn’t going to protect your forever"

rows.original: “I’ll be, you actually made it back!” the gynoid muses, rising from her hiding place behind the sand-swept dune. “I really do know how to pick ‘em. So, did you get the core?”
rows.translation: “真没想到，你居然真回来了！”雌性机器人若有所思地说道，从风沙覆盖的沙丘后方藏身处站起。“我确实很会挑人。所以，你拿到核心了吗？”
rows.raw: "“I’ll be, you actually made it back!” the gynoid muses, rising from her hiding place behind the sand-swept dune. “I really do know how to pick ‘em. So, did you get the core?”"

rows.original: You nod, fishing the silicone sphere out of your pack. Syne’s eyes light up, quite literally, as she closes the distance between you. Her milk-white fingers brush the surface of the orb, and a faint smile spreads across her dark lips. “Thank you, captain. You have no idea what this means to me.”
rows.translation: 你点点头，从背包里取出硅胶球体。赛恩的双眼亮了起来，而且是字面意义上的发亮；她缩短与你的距离，乳白色手指拂过球体表面，深色双唇泛起淡淡微笑。“谢谢你，舰长。你根本不知道这对我意味着什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, fishing the silicone sphere out of your pack. Syne’s eyes light up, quite literally, as she closes the distance between you. Her milk-white fingers brush the surface of the orb, and a faint smile spreads across her dark lips. “Thank you, captain. You have no idea what this means to me.”"

rows.original: It occurs to you what you learned is on the Son of Jissara’s computer core: all the information about the ancient starship its crew discovered. You hesitate in handing the core over to Syne, mind racing with possibilities.
rows.translation: 你忽然想到自己发现的东西就在吉萨拉之子号的计算机核心中：关于船员发现的那艘古代星舰的全部信息。你迟疑着没有把核心交给赛恩，各种可能性在脑海中飞驰。
rows.raw: " It occurs to you what you learned is on the Son of Jissara’s computer core: all the information about the ancient starship its crew discovered. You hesitate in handing the core over to Syne, mind racing with possibilities."

rows.original: “Something on your mind, captain?” Syne asks innocently, leaning in pressing her shoulders together in a way that heaves up her bosom. “Perhaps thinking about the way I’m going to show my gratitude for your help? Because I’m very grateful for what you’ve done for me, risking your very life for a stranger!”
rows.translation: “在想什么吗，舰长？”赛恩天真地问道，靠近你的同时挤拢双肩，托起丰满胸脯。“或许在想我会怎么感谢你的帮助？因为你为一个陌生人冒生命危险，我对你所做的一切非常感激！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something on your mind, captain?” Syne asks innocently, leaning in pressing her shoulders together in a way that heaves up her bosom. “Perhaps thinking about the way I’m going to show my gratitude for your help? Because I’m very grateful for what you’ve done for me, risking your very life for a stranger!”"

rows.translation: 质问
提问

rows.original: You have some questions for Syne before you hand the core over...
rows.translation: 把核心交出去之前，你还有些问题想问赛恩...
rows.raw: "You have some questions for Syne before you hand the core over..."

rows.translation: 交出核心
交出核心
把计算机核心交给赛恩。
辐射治疗
辐射治疗

rows.original: Can Syne do anything about how sick you’re feeling after going onto the wreck?
rows.translation: 进入残骸后你感觉很不舒服，赛恩能做些什么吗？
rows.raw: "Can Syne do anything about how sick you’re feeling after going onto the wreck?"

rows.translation: 辐射治疗
辐射治疗

rows.original: You’re not sick (but you’re not well.)
rows.translation: 你没有生病（但身体也不算健康。）

rows.original: You place the sphere of circuitry into the gynoid’s waiting hand. Her draconic tail swishes with delight as she takes it, pressing the treasure to her chest. “Thank you so very much, captain. Your kindness and bravery shall not be forgotten! I need to transmit the data here as soon as possible, but please, come and see me at Shineglass Station just as soon as you can. I promise I’ll show you the kind of gratitude only a tireless, devoted companion gynoid can.”
rows.translation: 你把电路球体放进等待已久的女性机器人手中。她接过宝物并按在胸前，龙尾开心地来回摆动。“万分感谢，船长。你的善意与勇气绝不会被遗忘！我必须尽快把这里的数据传输出去，不过请你一有机会就来辉晶站找我。我保证会向你展示，只有不知疲倦、全心奉献的伴侣型女性机器人才懂得如何表达的感激。”
rows.raw: "You place the sphere of circuitry into the gynoid’s waiting hand. Her draconic tail swishes with delight as she takes it, pressing the treasure to her chest. “Thank you so very much, captain. Your kindness and bravery shall not be forgotten! I need to transmit the data here as soon as possible, but please, come and see me at Shineglass Station just as soon as you can. I promise I’ll show you the kind of gratitude only a tireless, devoted companion gynoid can.”"

rows.original: She gives you a wink and flicks one of her nipple rings for emphasis. “Until then, take care out here. It’s an awfully dangerous wasteland these days.”
rows.translation: 她朝你眨眼，又弹了一下乳环加以强调。“在那之前，千万小心。如今这片荒原危险得可怕。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a wink and flicks one of her nipple rings for emphasis. “Until then, take care out here. It’s an awfully dangerous wasteland these days.”"

rows.original: The gynoid turns on a heel and struts away, giving you another mouthwatering view of her rear swaying off into the sunset...
rows.translation: 女性机器人踩着脚跟转身离开，摇曳后臀走向落日，再次让你大饱眼福...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gynoid turns on a heel and struts away, giving you another mouthwatering view of her rear swaying off into the sunset..."

rows.translation: （关键物品已移除：坠毁核心）
继续

rows.original: “Before I hand this over,” you say, “something’s been bothering me...” Syne quirks her head to the side in the perfect mimic of human bemusement. “Oh? Please, Captain, speak your mind... I would hate for you to come away from this anything less than pleased with our arrangement.”
rows.translation: “交出去之前，”你说，“有件事一直令我不安...” 赛恩把头偏向一侧，完美模仿人类困惑的样子。“哦？船长，请尽管说出想法...我可不希望你对我们的安排有任何不满。”
rows.raw: "“Before I hand this over,” you say, “something’s been bothering me...”\n\nSyne quirks her head to the side in the perfect mimic of human bemusement. “Oh? Please, Captain, speak your mind... I would hate for you to come away from this anything less than pleased with our arrangement.”"

rows.original: “I saw some of the captain’s log,” you tell her. “He never mentioned you. And I saw another gynoid that looked just like you inside, torn up by that creature.”
rows.translation: “我看过一些船长日志，”你告诉她。“他从未提到你。我还在里面看到另一个和你一模一样的女性机器人，被那头生物撕得粉碎。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I saw some of the captain’s log,” you tell her. “He never mentioned you. And I saw another gynoid that looked just like you inside, torn up by that creature.”"

rows.original: “Mmm? Does that surprise you, Captain - do you speak of your own sentient masturbatory aids when you’re setting down your official records; is it unusual to own multiple gynoids if you can afford them? Hm, I’m well acquainted with a wealthy executrix who has a whole harem of companion A.I.s modeled after every race in the Confederacy, just for variety. Her leithan catamite was custom-made by Kiha herself, with an ass that could shape diamonds and legs like a show-pony. Don’t read too much into a wealthy man or woman’s taste in sex-bots, Captain. We’re more like lingerie than a lifestyle: something private, just for yourself and your partners to enjoy. At least, that’s the way most people treat us.” She gives you a wink, swishing her tail like an eager puppy. She’s so disarming when she wants to be... “So about the data on the core...” “Ah, the ancient starship. Fascinating, isn’t it, knowing there are more advanced species somewhere out there than even your own? Or is it frightening?” She laughs, tapping her chin. “Who’s to say. Either way, that information is very important, as you can imagine. Those in power within the Confederacy should know what might be lurking out beyond their borders, no?”
rows.translation: “嗯？这令你意外，船长——你撰写正式记录时会提及自己具有知觉的自慰工具；负担得起的人拥有多个女性机器人又很罕见吗？嗯，我认识一位富有的女性高管，她为丰富体验，建立了一个伴侣人工智能后宫，以邦联每个种族为原型。她的利森娈童是琪哈亲自定制的，屁股能把钻石夹出形状，双腿则像表演小马。船长，别对富人的性爱机器人品味过度解读。比起生活方式，我们更像内衣：是私密之物，只供你和伴侣享受。至少大多数人都这样对待我们。” 她朝你眨眼，尾巴像兴奋小狗般摆动。只要想，她就能让人彻底放下戒心... “那么，核心中的数据...” “啊，那艘古老星舰。知道外面某处存在比你们更先进的物种，难道不迷人吗？又或者令人恐惧？”她笑着轻点下巴。“谁说得准。无论如何，你能想象那些信息有多重要。邦联中的掌权者理应知道边界之外可能潜伏着什么，对吧？”
rows.raw: " “Mmm? Does that surprise you, Captain - do you speak of your own sentient masturbatory aids when you’re setting down your official records; is it unusual to own multiple gynoids if you can afford them? Hm, I’m well acquainted with a wealthy executrix who has a whole harem of companion A.I.s modeled after every race in the Confederacy, just for variety. Her leithan catamite was custom-made by Kiha herself, with an ass that could shape diamonds and legs like a show-pony. Don’t read too much into a wealthy man or woman’s taste in sex-bots, Captain. We’re more like lingerie than a lifestyle: something private, just for yourself and your partners to enjoy. At least, that’s the way most people treat us.” She gives you a wink, swishing her tail like an eager puppy. She’s so disarming when she wants to be... “So about the data on the core...” “Ah, the ancient starship. Fascinating, isn’t it, knowing there are more advanced species somewhere out there than even your own? Or is it frightening?” She laughs, tapping her chin. “Who’s to say. Either way, that information is very important, as you can imagine. Those in power within the Confederacy should know what might be lurking out beyond their borders, no?”"

rows.original: “Then why am I giving it to you, out here in the middle of nowhere?”
rows.translation: “那为什么我要在这个荒无人烟的地方把它交给你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then why am I giving it to you, out here in the middle of nowhere?”"

rows.original: Syne rests her hands on her hips, giving you a look that’s borderline condescending. “Why? Because my whole reason for being out here is to retrieve it! When you give me the core, I’ll transmit the data on it back to headquarters, as was the Son of Jissara’s purpose. So, may I have it, Captain?”
rows.translation: 赛恩双手叉腰，以近乎居高临下的目光看你。“为什么？因为我来到这里的全部目的就是取回它！你把核心给我后，我会按照吉萨拉之子号的任务，将其中数据传回总部。那么，可以把它给我了吗，船长？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSyne rests her hands on her hips, giving you a look that’s borderline condescending. “Why? Because my whole reason for being out here is to retrieve it! When you give me the core, I’ll transmit the data on it back to headquarters, as was the Son of Jissara’s purpose. So, may I have it, Captain?”"

rows.translation: 保留核心
保留核心

rows.original: Steele Tech could use that data instead, you know. And why should you trust this strange gynoid anyway?
rows.translation: 要知道，斯蒂尔科技也能利用那些数据。而且你凭什么信任这个陌生女性机器人？
rows.raw: "Steele Tech could use that data instead, you know. And why should you trust this strange gynoid anyway?"

rows.translation: 交出核心
交出核心
把计算机核心交给赛恩。

rows.original: You close your hand around the core. “I think I’ll be keeping this, then. Steele Tech can use this data instead.”
rows.translation: 你握紧核心。“那我想还是自己留下吧。斯蒂尔科技也能利用这些数据。”
rows.raw: "You close your hand around the core. “I think I’ll be keeping this, then. Steele Tech can use this data instead.”"

rows.original: “Aren’t you the clever one. There are one or two corporations that at least have a chance of treating Phaedra fairly, but most of the Confederacy just looks at undeveloped planets like a platter ripe for the picking. Can you honestly say the corporations have actually helped a planet they’ve influenced? Profit-driven geriatrics beholden to endlessly avaricious shareholders are hardly known for their benevolence. A planet as damaged as Phaedra requires a gentler touch if it is to prosper. The touch of someone that actually reaches out to see these worlds for themselves; who takes the risks to actually experience the galaxy, rather than sending out minions to harvest it like a bloated carcass.”

rows.translation: “[pc.nmh|当然，|你明明知道！|那还用说，]”你告诉她，在抵达空间站前将手深深陷进龙形后臀。

rows.original: Syne grins, wagging her tail happily. “Then I’m sure I’ll see you again very soon. Take care out there, Captain. There are some dangers on this world even the Evermind or Nuka City fear, and Phaedra can ill afford to lose a gem such as you.”
rows.translation: 赛恩咧嘴笑着，开心摇晃尾巴。“那么我肯定很快又会见到你。外出小心，船长。这个世界有些危险，就连永恒心智或核子城也会害怕，而菲德拉可经不起失去你这样的宝石。”

rows.original: “Syne, I’m feeling kinda queasy after being on that ship,” you admit. “I don’t suppose you know any way to help...?” “Oh dear,” the gynoid gasps, stepping closer and cupping your chin. “You’ve been exposed to radiation, Captain. I assumed your medical nanomachines would be able to repair any long-term damage - and perhaps they will - but it seems I overestimated their ability for the short term. Luckily for you, there’s a reason the natives have come to see me as something of a goddess.”
rows.translation: “赛恩，我上过那艘船后觉得有点恶心，”你承认道。“你有没有什么办法能帮忙...？” “哦，亲爱的，”女性机器人倒吸一口气，走近并托住你的下巴。“你暴露在辐射中了，船长。我原以为医疗纳米机械能修复任何长期损伤，也许它们确实能，但看来我高估了短期能力。你很幸运，当地人把我视为某种女神是有原因的。”

rows.translation: 战争机器人凶狠的一拳将你击飞，撞上尘土盆地的地面。你一屁股倒下，它伴着金属受力的野兽低吼，笼罩在上方。
rows.raw: "You’re thrown back against the dustbowl ground by a savage punch from the war ‘bot. It puts you on your ass, looming over you with a bestial groan of straining metal."

rows.original: Closing your eyes, you brace for the end... but it never comes. Warily, you open one eye, only to see the mechanical monstrosity slowly righting itself. Its grating mechanical horn drones out “Target neutralized. Termination protocol overridden remotely. Returning to base.”
rows.translation: 你闭上双眼，准备迎接终结... 可它始终没有到来。你警惕地睁开一只眼，却只看见机械怪物缓缓站直。刺耳的机械号角低沉宣布：“目标已失去行动能力。终结协议遭远程覆盖。正在返回基地。”

rows.translation: 巨型机械摇晃着向后退去，火花从碎裂膝部飞溅。它发出震撼骨骼的痛苦低吼，随后轰然倒下；撞击地面扬起的尘云让你失明了好几秒。

rows.original: Something large is jutting up from the sand just ahead, catching the light on what might well be polished steel. Just as the realization dawns that what you’re looking at is a suit of light power armor, the figure moves, rising off a knee and turning to face you. A plasma rifle’s magnetized to the suit’s back, and a pair of long, curved swords ride on its hips, but its hands are empty for now, thumbs hooked through its dust-streaked web gear. The suit’s face plate is occluded, a solid black sheet of impassive metal broken up only by a speaker grille and a pair of red optics above the eyes. “You’re not native,” says a voice through the armor’s speakers. There’s a faintly feminine lilt to it, at least to your ear, though it’s not strong enough to say for certain. “Sorry. Stating the obvious. Not a lot of Confederate explorers made it through the planet’s anti-air defenses. I take it you’re the one that punched through the drone ship in orbit?” [pc.nmh|You nod. “That’s right. And you are?”|“Maybe,” you say with a smirk. “Depends who’s asking.”|“Damn right I did. Who’s asking?”] The armored figure gives you a slight nod. “I’m a scout-pioneer with KihaCorp. Serial XAA-0017. Our unit was dispatched on the Guardian of Flame to survey Phaedra for potential new research installations.” “That was your ship?” You blink. “Do you have any idea what damage it was doing up there?” “I’m keenly aware. Once the Evermind seized direct control of the ship’s automated systems, though, there was nothing a unit of marines could do about it. KihaCorp’s artificial intelligences are second to none, you know. It would take god-like computational power to brute force it through a remote comms connection. No amount of emergency overrides from the ground were stopping it.” The figure shakes her head. “I’m just glad somebody was eventually able to take it down, even if that means I’m stranded here until company headquarters sends another ship. Speaking of which, who should I tell them to thank?” “Steele. [pc.name] Steele.” Another slow nod. “Steele. So those idents I picked up coming through atmos weren’t scuffed, huh? A Steele Tech ship and a MaxCorp ship coming to the surface on each others’ heels. Poetic. So, Captain Steele, what brings the two of you to a backwater like Phaedra? There doesn’t seem to be much worthwhile here, between the rad-taint - er, the severe radiation storms afflicting the planet, that is - and the general lack of resources and tech.”
rows.translation: 前方沙地中探出一件大型物体，表面可能是抛光钢材，正在反射光线。你刚意识到眼前是一套轻型动力装甲，那个身影便动了起来，从单膝跪地的姿势站起，转身面对你。装甲背后磁吸着一把等离子步枪，髋部佩着一对弯曲长剑，不过目前双手空空，拇指勾在沾满尘土的织带上。面甲被完全遮蔽，是一整片冷漠黑色金属，只被扬声器格栅与眼睛上方的一对红色光学镜头打破。 “你不是本地人，”一个声音通过装甲扬声器说道。至少在你听来，声音略带女性腔调，不过还不足以完全确定。“抱歉。只是陈述显而易见的事实。没多少邦联探索者能穿过这颗星球的防空系统。我猜你就是击穿轨道上无人舰的人？” [pc.nmh|你点头。“没错。你又是谁？”|“也许吧，”你坏笑道。“那得看是谁在问。”|“没错，就是我。谁在问？”] 装甲身影朝你微微点头。“我是基哈公司的侦察开拓者，序列号XAA-0017。我们的小队搭乘烈焰守护者号抵达，奉命勘察菲德拉，寻找可能的新研究设施地点。” “那是你们的船？”你眨了眨眼。“你知道它在上面造成了多大破坏吗？” “我非常清楚。但永恒心智直接夺取舰船自动系统的控制权后，一队陆战队员根本无能为力。你知道，基哈公司的人工智能首屈一指。要通过远程通信连接进行暴力破解，需要神明般的算力。地面发出再多紧急覆盖指令也无法阻止它。” 那个身影摇摇头。“我只庆幸最后有人成功击落它，即使这意味着公司总部派来另一艘船前，我都会被困在这里。说到这里，我该告诉他们感谢谁？” “斯蒂尔。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。” 她又缓缓点头。“斯蒂尔。所以我穿过大气层时捕捉到的识别信号没有受损，对吧？一艘斯蒂尔科技飞船和一艘马克斯公司飞船前后脚抵达地表。真有诗意。那么斯蒂尔船长，你们两个来菲德拉这种偏远地方做什么？这里似乎没多少有价值的东西；既有辐射腐化，呃，我是说困扰这颗星球的严重辐射风暴，也普遍缺乏资源与技术。”
rows.raw: "Something large is jutting up from the sand just ahead, catching the light on what might well be polished steel. Just as the realization dawns that what you’re looking at is a suit of light power armor, the figure moves, rising off a knee and turning to face you. A plasma rifle’s magnetized to the suit’s back, and a pair of long, curved swords ride on its hips, but its hands are empty for now, thumbs hooked through its dust-streaked web gear. The suit’s face plate is occluded, a solid black sheet of impassive metal broken up only by a speaker grille and a pair of red optics above the eyes. “You’re not native,” says a voice through the armor’s speakers. There’s a faintly feminine lilt to it, at least to your ear, though it’s not strong enough to say for certain. “Sorry. Stating the obvious. Not a lot of Confederate explorers made it through the planet’s anti-air defenses. I take it you’re the one that punched through the drone ship in orbit?” [pc.nmh|You nod. “That’s right. And you are?”|“Maybe,” you say with a smirk. “Depends who’s asking.”|“Damn right I did. Who’s asking?”] The armored figure gives you a slight nod. “I’m a scout-pioneer with KihaCorp. Serial XAA-0017. Our unit was dispatched on the Guardian of Flame to survey Phaedra for potential new research installations.” “That was your ship?” You blink. “Do you have any idea what damage it was doing up there?” “I’m keenly aware. Once the Evermind seized direct control of the ship’s automated systems, though, there was nothing a unit of marines could do about it. KihaCorp’s artificial intelligences are second to none, you know. It would take god-like computational power to brute force it through a remote comms connection. No amount of emergency overrides from the ground were stopping it.” The figure shakes her head. “I’m just glad somebody was eventually able to take it down, even if that means I’m stranded here until company headquarters sends another ship. Speaking of which, who should I tell them to thank?” “Steele. [pc.name] Steele.” Another slow nod. “Steele. So those idents I picked up coming through atmos weren’t scuffed, huh? A Steele Tech ship and a MaxCorp ship coming to the surface on each others’ heels. Poetic. So, Captain Steele, what brings the two of you to a backwater like Phaedra? There doesn’t seem to be much worthwhile here, between the rad-taint - er, the severe radiation storms afflicting the planet, that is - and the general lack of resources and tech.”"

rows.original: “Same thing you are, I should think,” she says. “Exploring. Learning. Entertaining the locals. Trying not to get irreparably irradiated... which is not a small ask on this planet, as I’m sure you’ve noticed. Right now, though: I’m watching you.”
rows.translation: “我想，做的事情和你一样，”她说道。“探索、学习、招待当地人。努力避免遭受无法修复的辐射损伤... 我确信你已经注意到，这在这颗星球上绝非简单要求。不过眼下，我在看着你。”

rows.original: You seem like a reasonable sort, after all. Not like most of the wastelanders.
rows.translation: 毕竟你看起来像个讲道理的人，不像大多数荒地居民。
rows.raw: " You seem like a reasonable sort, after all. Not like most of the wastelanders."

rows.translation: 嗯。其实我想知道，你能不能帮我一个小忙？”
rows.raw: " Mmm. I was actually wondering if you’d do me a little favor?”"

rows.original: “[pc.nmh|I can certainly give it a try,|Well I guess that depends!|We just meet and you’re already asking for handouts?]” you say. “What is it?”
rows.translation: “[pc.nmh|当然可以试试，|好吧，那得看情况！|我们才刚见面，你就已经来伸手要东西？]”你说道。“什么事？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.nmh|I can certainly give it a try,|Well I guess that depends!|We just meet and you’re already asking for handouts?]” you say. “What is it?”"

rows.original: “Mmm. I was the property of a Confederate citizen, you see, but I crash-landed on this planet a while ago. I’ve... been by myself ever since. It’s been hard. The locals have taken a liking to me, for reasons I’m sure you can guess at,” she smiles, flicking one of her hardlight rings. “But there are certain things I can’t ask them to do. Exploring a crashed KihaCorp dropship being one of them.”
rows.translation: “嗯。你看，我曾是一名邦联公民的财产，不过一段时间前坠毁在这颗星球上。从那以后，我... 一直独自生活。很艰难。当地人很喜欢我，原因我相信你能猜到，”她微笑着弹了一下硬光环饰。“不过有些事我不能让他们去做，其中之一便是探索一艘坠毁的基哈公司登陆艇。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm. I was the property of a Confederate citizen, you see, but I crash-landed on this planet a while ago. I’ve... been by myself ever since. It’s been hard. The locals have taken a liking to me, for reasons I’m sure you can guess at,” she smiles, flicking one of her hardlight rings. “But there are certain things I can’t ask them to do. Exploring a crashed KihaCorp dropship being one of them.”"

rows.original: Arching a brow, you say, “You haven’t even told me your name yet.”
rows.translation: 你挑起眉说道：“你甚至还没告诉我名字。”
rows.raw: "\n\nArching a brow, you say, “You haven’t even told me your name yet.”"

rows.original: A delicate giggle answers you, utterly incongruous with the sinfully sexual nude body circling you. “Aha, my apologies, Captain. Like I said, I’ve been on my own for a long time. I’m, well, you can call me Syne. A silicone-eating specimen of radtwisted fauna has inhabited the wreckage, and would positively shred this armature of mine if I got close. I just need you to slip inside and pull the computer core for me. I don’t have any credits, not like they’re much use down here anyway, but I’m entirely confident I can make it worth your while. What do you say?”
rows.translation: 一阵轻柔咯咯笑声回应了你，与围绕你打转的淫荡赤裸身体完全不相称。“啊哈，抱歉，船长。就像我说的，我已经独自生活很久了。我叫，嗯，你可以叫我赛恩。一只吞食硅质、受辐射扭曲的动物占据了残骸；我要是靠近，它肯定会把我的这副构装体撕成碎片。我只需要你溜进去，替我取出计算机核心。我没有信用点，不过这东西在这里也派不上什么用场，但我完全有信心让你觉得不虚此行。你觉得怎么样？”
