I just need you to slip inside and pull the computer core for me. I don’t have any credits, not like they’re much use down here anyway, but I’m entirely confident I can make it worth your while. What do you say?”"

rows.original: She gives you a broad smirk, one hand on a egg-layer’s hip and the other still looping fingers through her nipple ring.
rows.translation: 她朝你露出灿烂坏笑，一只手搭在产卵者般的髋部，另一只手仍用手指绕着乳环。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a broad smirk, one hand on a egg-layer’s hip and the other still looping fingers through her nipple ring."

rows.original:
You’re standing at the edge of the dunes overlooking the downed starship. Shards of polymer and metal stick out of the ground like new buds. To the east, the sand has been burned into a blackened glass by the flaming impact of the crash. You can just make out an airlock on that flank of the hull too, its door long since fallen away.

Syne is hiding behind the dune, watching you intently.
rows.translation:
你站在沙丘边缘，俯视那艘坠毁的星舰。聚合物与金属碎片如新芽般探出地面。东方的沙地被坠毁时的烈焰烧成焦黑玻璃。你还能隐约看见船体那一侧的一扇气闸，舱门早已脱落。

赛恩躲在沙丘后，专注地看着你。
rows.raw: "You’re standing at the edge of the dunes overlooking the downed starship. Shards of polymer and metal stick out of the ground like new buds. To the east, the sand has been burned into a blackened glass by the flaming impact of the crash. You can just make out an airlock on that flank of the hull too, its door long since fallen away.\n\nSyne is hiding behind the dune, watching you intently."

rows.translation: 赛恩
赛恩

rows.original: Talk to Syne again, now that you have what she sent you here for.
rows.translation: 既然已经拿到赛恩让你来取的东西，再和她谈谈。
rows.raw: "Talk to Syne again, now that you have what she sent you here for."

rows.translation: 赛恩
赛恩

rows.original: You’ll need to find that computer core before talking to her again.
rows.translation: 你得先找到那个计算机核心，再去和她谈。
rows.raw: "You’ll need to find that computer core before talking to her again."

rows.original: The ground underfoot here is nothing but blackened glass, super-heated by the ship’s reentry. Every step sends crick-cracks echoing through the ravine.
rows.translation: 脚下地面全是焦黑玻璃，是星舰重返大气层时的高温所致。每走一步，咔嚓咔嚓声都会在峡谷间回荡。
rows.raw: "The ground underfoot here is nothing but blackened glass, super-heated by the ship’s reentry. Every step sends crick-cracks echoing through the ravine."

rows.original: The dune Syne’s hiding behind is back west; the ship’s airlock is east.
rows.translation: 赛恩藏身的沙丘在西边；星舰气闸在东边。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dune Syne’s hiding behind is back west; the ship’s airlock is east."

rows.original: The devastated starship is within arm’s reach from here, canted slightly to starboard and sitting in a field of black glass and shrapnel. You can make out part of the ship’s name still stenciled across the hull: “S N  OF J  S RA,” accompanied by an icon that’s far too burnt to identify. The airlock sits to the north of where you stand, open to the elements now that its door has been peeled away; the dunes stretch back to the west.
rows.translation: 损毁的星舰近在咫尺，略微向右舷倾斜，坐落在一片黑玻璃与弹片之间。船名的一部分仍以模板字喷在船体上：“S N  OF J  S RA”，旁边还有一个烧毁得无法辨认的图标。气闸就在你北边，如今外舱门已被剥落，完全暴露在外；沙丘则向西延伸。
rows.raw: "The devastated starship is within arm’s reach from here, canted slightly to starboard and sitting in a field of black glass and shrapnel. You can make out part of the ship’s name still stenciled across the hull: “S N  OF J  S RA,” accompanied by an icon that’s far too burnt to identify. The airlock sits to the north of where you stand, open to the elements now that its door has been peeled away; the dunes stretch back to the west."

rows.original: The airlock’s open, allowing you to walk between the dunes and the interior of the stricken ship at-will. Everything out here smells burnt, and there’s a melted quality to the walls and consoles - you suppose the outer door must have come off during reentry.
rows.translation: 气闸敞开着，让你可以随意往返于沙丘与失事星舰内部。外面所有东西都散发着焦味，墙壁与控制台也都有融化痕迹——你猜外舱门一定是在重返大气层时脱落的。
rows.raw: "The airlock’s open, allowing you to walk between the dunes and the interior of the stricken ship at-will. Everything out here smells burnt, and there’s a melted quality to the walls and consoles - you suppose the outer door must have come off during reentry."

rows.original: As you step into the crashed ship’s airlock, a robotic voice intones from a melted console beside the outer door: “War...ning... hull... breeeeech... war...ning...” Yeah, no kidding. You slap the cycle button, and watch with a grimace as the inner door simply falls inward when its motors try and actuate. The ship shudders, echo rocking through the sundered hull. “War...ning... rad...eeeeeeee...ation... aleerrrrrrrrtttttttt. Fuel... leek... Fuel... leek... war...ning...” That doesn’t sound good. Better make this quick.
rows.translation: 你踏进坠毁星舰的气闸时，外舱门旁融化的控制台传出机械声音：“警...告... 船体... 破损... 警...告...” 这还用说。你拍下循环按钮，看着内舱门的马达试图启动，舱门却直接向内倒下，不禁面露苦相。星舰随之震颤，回声在断裂船体内摇荡。 “警...告... 辐...射射射射射... 警报警报警报警报...。燃料... 泄漏... 燃料... 泄漏... 警...告...” 听起来可不妙。最好速战速决。
rows.raw: " As you step into the crashed ship’s airlock, a robotic voice intones from a melted console beside the outer door: “War...ning... hull... breeeeech... war...ning...” Yeah, no kidding. You slap the cycle button, and watch with a grimace as the inner door simply falls inward when its motors try and actuate. The ship shudders, echo rocking through the sundered hull. “War...ning... rad...eeeeeeee...ation... aleerrrrrrrrtttttttt. Fuel... leek... Fuel... leek... war...ning...” That doesn’t sound good. Better make this quick."

rows.original: You’re standing in the heart of the downed starship, what once was the crew’s living space. The furniture and appliances have been thrown this way and that by the impact, but you can see a leather sofa, a fridge, and a couple of card tables amidst the wreckage. The stove took a railgun hit directly; there’s not much of it left aside from an outline in the counter and a lot of mechanical bits strewn around.
rows.translation: 你站在坠毁星舰的中心位置，这里曾是船员生活区。家具与电器都被撞击抛得到处都是，不过你仍能在残骸间看到一张皮沙发、一台冰箱和几张牌桌。炉灶直接挨了一发轨道炮；除了台面上的轮廓和散落四周的一堆机械零件，几乎什么也没留下。
rows.raw: "You’re standing in the heart of the downed starship, what once was the crew’s living space. The furniture and appliances have been thrown this way and that by the impact, but you can see a leather sofa, a fridge, and a couple of card tables amidst the wreckage. The stove took a railgun hit directly; there’s not much of it left aside from an outline in the counter and a lot of mechanical bits strewn around."

rows.original: It looks like the crew’s quarters are north,
rows.translation: 船员舱室似乎在北边，
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks like the crew’s quarters are north, "

joinAfter.expression:
1 !== flags.KIHAN_GYNOID_QUEST_OPENED_STOREROOM
                  ? "though the door has been sealed by a blast shield, "
                  : ""

rows.original: though the door has been sealed by a blast shield,
rows.translation: 不过舱门已经被防爆盾封住，
rows.raw: "though the door has been sealed by a blast shield, "

rows.original: and the bridge is to the west. South leads back to the airlock, and east deeper into the ship.
rows.translation: 舰桥则在西边。南边通回气闸，东边通向星舰深处。
rows.raw: "and the bridge is to the west. South leads back to the airlock, and east deeper into the ship."

rows.original: The crew’s quarters are divided up military style: a single high cabin for the captain roomed off from the rest of the crew, who live in a round chamber with bunk beds lining the walls and footlockers beneath them.
rows.translation: 船员舱室采用军用布局：船长独享一间与其他船员隔开的高级舱房，其他人则住在一间圆形舱室里，双层床沿墙排列，床下摆着脚柜。
rows.raw: "The crew’s quarters are divided up military style: a single high cabin for the captain roomed off from the rest of the crew, who live in a round chamber with bunk beds lining the walls and footlockers beneath them."

rows.original: The captain’s quarters took a direct hit from a missile, leaving little left of it besides a bulged door and a few scraps of personal belongings that didn’t get sucked into space. The captain’s desk has crumpled into the impact hole despite its metallic construction, somewhat plugging the breach.
rows.translation: 船长舱室被导弹直接命中，除了鼓胀的舱门和少数没被吸进太空的个人物品，几乎什么也没留下。金属制成的船长桌也塌进了撞击形成的孔洞，多少堵住了缺口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe captain’s quarters took a direct hit from a missile, leaving little left of it besides a bulged door and a few scraps of personal belongings that didn’t get sucked into space. The captain’s desk has crumpled into the impact hole despite its metallic construction, somewhat plugging the breach."

rows.original: There’s a communal shower and commode, with something rusty-hued dripping from the pipes.
rows.translation: 这里有公用淋浴间和厕所，管道中正滴落某种锈色液体。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a communal shower and commode, with something rusty-hued dripping from the pipes."

rows.translation: 搜索
已搜索
已搜索

rows.original: You already searched here, and obtained the crashed ship’s keys as a key item.
rows.translation: 你已经搜索过这里，并获得了坠毁星舰钥匙这一关键物品。
rows.raw: "You already searched here, and obtained the crashed ship’s keys as a key item."

rows.original: You step onto the bridge, carefully planting your [pc.feet] as the ship’s prow takes a steep downwards angle. The forward viewscreen’s been shattered, letting in hundreds of pounds of sand from where the front of the ship plowed under the ground. From the angle, it looks like the nosedive broke the ship’s back. She’ll never fly again if that’s true. Shame.
rows.translation: 你踏上舰桥，星舰舰首以陡峭角度向下倾斜，迫使你小心站稳[pc.feet]。前方观察屏已经粉碎，舰首扎进地面时卷入的数百磅沙土灌了进来。从角度看，这次俯冲折断了星舰的脊梁。如果真是这样，她再也飞不起来了。真可惜。
rows.raw: "You step onto the bridge, carefully planting your [pc.feet] as the ship’s prow takes a steep downwards angle. The forward viewscreen’s been shattered, letting in hundreds of pounds of sand from where the front of the ship plowed under the ground. From the angle, it looks like the nosedive broke the ship’s back. She’ll never fly again if that’s true. Shame."

rows.original: You take a few cautious steps forward, running your hand over the back of the captain’s chair - though perhaps “throne” would be more appropriate. It’s covered in gilded ancient ausari hieroglyphs, like it was looted out of some ancient Star King’s tomb. Hell, maybe it was. It certainly survived the impact better than anything else on the bridge. Your fingers come across a button on the armrest, and a hologram flickers to life in the chair, a ghostly echo of the man that might once have sat it. He’s a boyishly handsome kaithrit lad in a tight bodysuit that hugs an even tighter bulge showing between the legs casually flung over the arm of his chair as he speaks.
rows.translation: 你谨慎向前走了几步，手掌抚过船长座椅的椅背——或许称它为“王座”更合适。椅面覆盖着镀金的古代奥萨象形文字，仿佛从某位古代星王的陵墓里掠夺而来。见鬼，也许它真是。它无疑比舰桥上任何其他东西都更好地挺过了撞击。你的手指碰到扶手上的按钮，一幅全息影像在椅中闪烁亮起，宛如曾经坐在这里的男人留下的幽灵回声。他是个英俊而略显稚气的凯斯瑞特小伙，身穿紧身连体衣，包裹住更加紧绷的胯间隆起。他随意把双腿搭在座椅扶手上，开口说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a few cautious steps forward, running your hand over the back of the captain’s chair - though perhaps “throne” would be more appropriate. It’s covered in gilded ancient ausari hieroglyphs, like it was looted out of some ancient Star King’s tomb. Hell, maybe it was. It certainly survived the impact better than anything else on the bridge. Your fingers come across a button on the armrest, and a hologram flickers to life in the chair, a ghostly echo of the man that might once have sat it. He’s a boyishly handsome kaithrit lad in a tight bodysuit that hugs an even tighter bulge showing between the legs casually flung over the arm of his chair as he speaks."

rows.original: “Captain’s log, R14-point-one-point-fifty-five. Having finished our survey of Nyphea, one of the most beautiful garden worlds I’ve ever seen, the Son of Jissara has just arrived in orbit of Phaedra II. The contrast is striking. Initial scans indicate that this world has suffered a prolonged radiological event, possibly indicative of nuclear war. While we detect humanoid life signs, they are scattered and number only in the tens of millions across the planet, and there is little evidence of advanced technology on the surface. We have, however, detected numerous satellites in orbit, suggesting the natives at one point at least achieved a primitive space age. We have received no response from the surface to any hails. In order to fulfill our mission, we’ll have to do things the hard way...”
rows.translation: “船长日志，R14点一点五十五。我们已经完成对尼菲娅的勘察；那是我见过最美丽的花园世界之一。现在，吉萨拉之子号刚刚抵达菲德拉二号轨道。两者反差鲜明。初步扫描表明，这个世界经历过长期辐射事件，可能意味着曾经爆发核战争。我们探测到类人生物的生命信号，但他们散布在整颗星球上，总数只有数千万，地表也几乎没有先进科技的迹象。然而，我们确实探测到轨道上存在大量卫星，说明当地人至少一度进入过原始太空时代。我们发出的所有呼叫都没有得到地面回应。为了完成任务，我们只能采取麻烦的办法...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captain’s log, R14-point-one-point-fifty-five. Having finished our survey of Nyphea, one of the most beautiful garden worlds I’ve ever seen, the Son of Jissara has just arrived in orbit of Phaedra II. The contrast is striking. Initial scans indicate that this world has suffered a prolonged radiological event, possibly indicative of nuclear war. While we detect humanoid life signs, they are scattered and number only in the tens of millions across the planet, and there is little evidence of advanced technology on the surface. We have, however, detected numerous satellites in orbit, suggesting the natives at one point at least achieved a primitive space age. We have received no response from the surface to any hails. In order to fulfill our mission, we’ll have to do things the hard way...”"

rows.original: The hologram flickers and cuts out.
rows.translation: 全息影像闪烁几下，随即熄灭。

rows.original: At least you’ve got a name for the ship, now...
rows.translation: 至少你现在知道这艘船叫什么了...
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least you’ve got a name for the ship, now..."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: The Son of Jissara’s bridge is a broad, circular affair with a raised command dias and a captain’s chair that looks like a pharaoh’s throne with all the gilding adorning it. The helm and weapons posts are ahead of the captain’s chair and several tactical assessment consoles surround the dias from behind.
rows.translation: 吉萨拉之子号的舰桥宽阔而呈圆形，中央是抬高的指挥台，船长座椅则像一张饰满镀金装饰的法老王座。驾驶席与武器操作席位于船长椅前方，后方则有数台战术评估控制台环绕指挥台。
rows.raw: "The Son of Jissara’s bridge is a broad, circular affair with a raised command dias and a captain’s chair that looks like a pharaoh’s throne with all the gilding adorning it. The helm and weapons posts are ahead of the captain’s chair and several tactical assessment consoles surround the dias from behind."

rows.original: The main viewscreen’s been shattered in the crash, letting in loads of sand and dirt from the wastes; the prow must be buried half a dozen feet underground for how much muck it’s scooped into the bridge. At least the captain‘s hologram display is still working, albeit as a flickering ghost of a projection.
rows.translation: 主观察屏在坠毁时粉碎，大量荒地沙土灌了进来；舰首一定埋入地下至少六英尺，才会把这么多泥沙铲进舰桥。至少船长的全息显示器仍能工作，尽管投影像幽灵般不停闪烁。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe main viewscreen’s been shattered in the crash, letting in loads of sand and dirt from the wastes; the prow must be buried half a dozen feet underground for how much muck it’s scooped into the bridge. At least the captain‘s hologram display is still working, albeit as a flickering ghost of a projection."

rows.translation: 状态检查
状态检查

rows.original: See if you can pull up the ship’s status on the captain’s throne.
rows.translation: 看看能不能通过船长王座调出星舰状态。
rows.raw: "See if you can pull up the ship’s status on the captain’s throne."

rows.translation: 船长日志
船长日志

rows.original: Check out an entry from the captain’s log.
rows.translation: 查看一条船长日志。
rows.raw: "Check out an entry from the captain’s log."

rows.original: The ship’s science labs run the length of the ship between its main living area back west and the engineering section at the eastern rear. There’s a tremendous amount of sensitive equipment here, all utterly destroyed by the crash. Microscopes, test tubes, and analysis devices of every kind are smashed against the walls or crushed beneath furniture. The only thing that’s survived is a travel computer inside a hardened briefcase. The thing’s come open and the screen is cracked, but it’s still functional enough to show that it was in the process of some kind of radiological analysis. You don’t have the degrees necessary to understand what all those numbers mean, but you guess all the red is bad news.
rows.translation: 星舰的科学实验室沿船身延伸，连接西边的主生活区和东侧舰尾的工程区。这里有大量精密设备，但全都被坠毁彻底摧毁。显微镜、试管以及各种分析设备不是撞碎在墙上，就是被家具压烂。唯一幸存的是一台装在加固公文箱里的便携计算机。箱子已经弹开，屏幕也裂了，但仍能正常运行，显示它当时正在进行某种辐射分析。你没有足以理解那些数字含义的学位，不过你猜满屏红色都不是什么好消息。
rows.raw: "The ship’s science labs run the length of the ship between its main living area back west and the engineering section at the eastern rear. There’s a tremendous amount of sensitive equipment here, all utterly destroyed by the crash. Microscopes, test tubes, and analysis devices of every kind are smashed against the walls or crushed beneath furniture. The only thing that’s survived is a travel computer inside a hardened briefcase. The thing’s come open and the screen is cracked, but it’s still functional enough to show that it was in the process of some kind of radiological analysis. You don’t have the degrees necessary to understand what all those numbers mean, but you guess all the red is bad news."

rows.original: The science deck narrows near the rear end, allowing a second deck to run underneath it on the flanks. The ship’s escape pods are docked here, as well as the damage control equipment the crew might need to fight fires or attend to serious injuries. None of the pods have been jettisoned.
rows.translation: 科学甲板靠近舰尾处逐渐变窄，让第二层甲板得以沿两侧从下方穿过。星舰的逃生舱就停靠在这里，还有船员用来灭火或处理重伤的损害管制设备。没有一个逃生舱被弹射出去。
rows.raw: "The science deck narrows near the rear end, allowing a second deck to run underneath it on the flanks. The ship’s escape pods are docked here, as well as the damage control equipment the crew might need to fight fires or attend to serious injuries. None of the pods have been jettisoned."

rows.original: The console for the ship’s automated damage control system has been smashed, leaving it inoperable.
rows.translation: 星舰自动损害管制系统的控制台已经损坏，无法操作。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe console for the ship’s automated damage control system has been smashed, leaving it inoperable."

rows.original: The science deck is back west, and the engineering section is just east of here.
rows.translation: 科学甲板在西边，工程区就在东边不远处。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe science deck is back west, and the engineering section is just east of here."

rows.original: The main engineering area sits through a bulkhead at the back of the ship, dominated by a massive power reactor that stretches down into a lower deck. There’s
rows.translation: 主工程区位于星舰后部的一道舱壁之后，一座向下延伸至下层甲板的巨型动力反应堆占据了整个空间。北侧舱壁上有
rows.raw: "The main engineering area sits through a bulkhead at the back of the ship, dominated by a massive power reactor that stretches down into a lower deck. There’s"

rows.translation: 一扇锁住的
一扇已解锁的

rows.original: door on the north bulkhead with a large label printed over it reading “COMPUTER CORE | SECURE LOCKERS” while to the west, there’s a ladder leading east into the heart of the engines.
rows.translation: 舱门，上方印着“计算机核心 | 安全储物柜”的大型标签；西边还有一架梯子，向东通往引擎核心。
rows.raw: " door on the north bulkhead with a large label printed over it reading “COMPUTER CORE | SECURE LOCKERS” while to the west, there’s a ladder leading east into the heart of the engines."

rows.original: The lower half of a KihaCorp gynoid’s body is draped over the edge, her legs skewed at an impossible angle and bent backwards over the lip. No doubt that the silicone-eater dragged the upper half down into the bowels of the ship.
rows.translation: 一名基哈公司女性机器人的下半身挂在边缘，双腿以不可思议的角度歪斜着，向后弯折过边沿。食硅兽无疑把她的上半身拖进了星舰深处。
rows.raw:
"

The lower half of a KihaCorp gynoid’s body is draped over the edge, her legs skewed at an impossible angle and bent backwards over the lip. No doubt that the silicone-eater dragged the upper half down into the bowels of the ship.

"

rows.original: Blast doors have been lowered around the depths of the generator room, no doubt keeping the worst of the radiation at bay... and protecting the creature’s lair from you.
rows.translation: 发电机室深处四周的防爆门已经降下，无疑阻挡了最严重的辐射... 也保护了那只生物的巢穴，使其免受你的侵扰。
rows.raw: "Blast doors have been lowered around the depths of the generator room, no doubt keeping the worst of the radiation at bay... and protecting the creature’s lair from you."

rows.original: The blast doors have been opened, allowing a hideous heat to seep out into the chamber. It’s enough to make your vision swim...
rows.translation: 防爆门已经开启，一股骇人热浪渗进舱室。热得足以让你的视野摇晃...
rows.raw: "The blast doors have been opened, allowing a hideous heat to seep out into the chamber. It’s enough to make your vision swim..."

rows.translation: 解锁舱门
解锁舱门

rows.original: Use the keycard you picked up to unlock the northern door.
rows.translation: 使用捡到的钥匙卡解锁北侧舱门。
rows.raw: "Use the keycard you picked up to unlock the northern door."

rows.translation: 解锁舱门
解锁舱门

rows.original: You need the ship’s keys to do this. Where could those be?
rows.translation: 你需要星舰钥匙才能这么做。钥匙会在哪里？
rows.raw: "You need the ship’s keys to do this. Where could those be?"

rows.translation: 解锁舱门
解锁舱门

rows.original: You need a keycard of some kind of unlock this door. There’s no chance of bypassing a lock that hardened.
rows.translation: 你需要某种钥匙卡才能解锁这扇门。这种经过加固的锁绝不可能绕过。
rows.raw: "You need a keycard of some kind of unlock this door. There’s no chance of bypassing a lock that hardened."

rows.original: This room contains the ship’s secured equipment lockers, its computer servers, and a particularly large dog crate.
rows.translation: 这个房间里有星舰的安全装备柜、计算机服务器，以及一个格外巨大的狗笼。
rows.raw: "This room contains the ship’s secured equipment lockers, its computer servers, and a particularly large dog crate."

rows.original: You’ve already taken the computer core from the server rack.
rows.translation: 你已经从服务器机架上取走计算机核心。
rows.raw: " You’ve already taken the computer core from the server rack."

rows.translation: 已取走核心
已取走核心

rows.original: You already took the Crash Core key item.
rows.translation: 你已经取走坠毁核心这一关键物品。
rows.raw: "You already took the Crash Core key item."

rows.original: The largest of the computer terminals has a spherical core resting at the top, which looks removable.
rows.translation: 最大的计算机终端顶部放着一个球形核心，看起来可以拆下来。
rows.raw: " The largest of the computer terminals has a spherical core resting at the top, which looks removable."

rows.translation: 拿走核心
拿走核心

rows.original: Take the computer core. It’s what you’re here for, after all.
rows.translation: 拿走计算机核心。毕竟你就是为此而来。
rows.raw: "Take the computer core. It’s what you’re here for, after all."

rows.original: The secured lockers have a password protection system, which
rows.translation: 安全储物柜装有密码保护系统，目前
rows.raw: "\n\nThe secured lockers have a password protection system, which "

rows.translation: 仍处于锁定状态。
储物柜
储物柜
查看安全储物柜。
已经解锁。
拿走瓶子
拿走瓶子
收走一叠诱情古龙水。
储物柜已搜刮
储物柜已搜刮
你已经收走了里面的宝物。

rows.original: You slide down the ladder and duck under the half-raised emergency shielding that separated the reactor core from the rest of the ship. It’s immediately clear what happened here: there’s a hull breach going straight through engine deck, and whatever punched through the core winged the reactor itself on the way, tearing through its shielding. Irradiated savicite’s spilling through the entire ship now that you’ve pulled up the shielding, which means it won’t be long before the ship becomes entirely uninhabitable no matter what you do.
rows.translation: 你滑下梯子，钻过将反应堆核心与星舰其他区域隔开的半升起紧急屏障。这里发生了什么一目了然：引擎甲板被打出一道直穿船体的缺口，而击穿核心翼区的东西顺路擦中了反应堆本身，撕开其屏蔽层。你升起屏障后，受辐射污染的萨维晶正在扩散至整艘船；这意味着无论你做什么，用不了多久这里都会彻底无法居住。
rows.raw: "You slide down the ladder and duck under the half-raised emergency shielding that separated the reactor core from the rest of the ship. It’s immediately clear what happened here: there’s a hull breach going straight through engine deck, and whatever punched through the core winged the reactor itself on the way, tearing through its shielding. Irradiated savicite’s spilling through the entire ship now that you’ve pulled up the shielding, which means it won’t be long before the ship becomes entirely uninhabitable no matter what you do."

rows.original: There’s got to be some way to release the emergency shielding from down here. There has to be...
rows.translation: 这里一定有办法解除紧急屏障。一定有...
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s got to be some way to release the emergency shielding from down here. There has to be..."

rows.original: There it is, on the far wall - a damage control console, still powered up despite the devastation wrought throughout the compartment. In front of the console, though, is a grisly nest of crushed pipes, couch cushions, and the upper half of a desiccated gynoid is strewn out in parts across the ground, looking more like a blue-hued skeleton than a curvy sexbot.
rows.translation: 找到了，就在远处墙上——一台损害管制控制台。尽管整间舱室遭到严重破坏，它仍然通着电。不过控制台前方横着一个骇人的巢穴，由压扁的管道和沙发垫筑成；一名干枯女性机器人的上半身则被拆成零件，散落在地面上，看起来更像一具蓝色骨架，而非曲线玲珑的性爱机器人。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere it is, on the far wall - a damage control console, still powered up despite the devastation wrought throughout the compartment. In front of the console, though, is a grisly nest of crushed pipes, couch cushions, and the upper half of a desiccated gynoid is strewn out in parts across the ground, looking more like a blue-hued skeleton than a curvy sexbot."

rows.original: Your hand tightens on your [pc.weapon]. The ‘bot laying here can only mean the creature that destroyed it is nearby.
rows.translation: 你的手握紧[pc.weapon]。躺在这里的机器人只能说明，摧毁她的生物就在附近。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour hand tightens on your [pc.weapon]. The ‘bot laying here can only mean the creature that destroyed it is nearby."

rows.original: Something moves in the shadows beneath the reactor. Your body tenses instinctively, bracing for attack, but all that comes rolling out from the darkness is one of the gynoid’s synthetic eyes, still trailing what looks like drool...
rows.translation: 反应堆下方的阴影里有什么动了一下。你的身体本能绷紧，准备迎接袭击，但从黑暗中滚出来的只是女性机器人的一只合成眼球，后面还拖着看似口水的东西...
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething moves in the shadows beneath the reactor. Your body tenses instinctively, bracing for attack, but all that comes rolling out from the darkness is one of the gynoid’s synthetic eyes, still trailing what looks like drool..."

rows.original: A low growl from the starboard hull breach draws your eye, just in time to save your hide from a pouncing bipedal monstrosity covered in spikes and bearing wicked fangs. You roll to the side, letting the beast’s momentum carry it to the ground in a flurry of snapping jaws and lashing tail-swipes. It recovers almost instantly, getting low to the deck and snarling, ready to pounce again.
rows.translation: 右舷船体缺口处传来一声低吼，及时吸引了你的目光，让你避开一只浑身尖刺、长着邪恶獠牙的双足怪物扑击。你向旁翻滚，让野兽借着冲势落到地面，利齿乱咬，长尾猛扫。它几乎立刻恢复过来，伏低身体贴着甲板咆哮，准备再次扑击。
rows.raw: "\n\nA low growl from the starboard hull breach draws your eye, just in time to save your hide from a pouncing bipedal monstrosity covered in spikes and bearing wicked fangs. You roll to the side, letting the beast’s momentum carry it to the ground in a flurry of snapping jaws and lashing tail-swipes. It recovers almost instantly, getting low to the deck and snarling, ready to pounce again."

rows.original: No way around it now, time to fight!
rows.translation: 现在无路可退，开打！
rows.raw: "\n\nNo way around it now, time to fight!"

rows.translation: 战斗

rows.original: The reactor core took a glancing hit from a railgun, punching through the hull plating coming in and going back out again - the breach in the ground-facing bulkhead must be how the silicone-eater has been getting in and out, crawling through the ship’s outer hull. Though the reactor was shut down automatically, the breach is still venting radioactive savicite particles throughout the ship, and there’s nothing you can do to stop it without a whole engineering team and a drydock facility.
rows.translation: 反应堆核心被轨道炮擦中；炮弹打穿船体装甲射入，又从另一侧穿出——朝向地面的舱壁缺口一定就是食硅兽进出的通道，它一直通过星舰外壳爬进爬出。虽然反应堆已经自动关闭，但缺口仍在向整艘船释放放射性萨维晶粒子。若没有整支工程团队和干船坞设施，你根本无法阻止。
rows.raw: "The reactor core took a glancing hit from a railgun, punching through the hull plating coming in and going back out again - the breach in the ground-facing bulkhead must be how the silicone-eater has been getting in and out, crawling through the ship’s outer hull. Though the reactor was shut down automatically, the breach is still venting radioactive savicite particles throughout the ship, and there’s nothing you can do to stop it without a whole engineering team and a drydock facility."

rows.original: There’s a console still active on the far wall, near where the beast kept its grisly nest. The emergency lockdown that the radiation sparked
rows.translation: 远处墙上、靠近野兽骇人巢穴的位置仍有一台控制台处于工作状态。由辐射触发的紧急封锁
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a console still active on the far wall, near where the beast kept its grisly nest. The emergency lockdown that the radiation sparked "

rows.original: can be lifted from there, you’d guess
rows.translation: 应该可以从那里解除
rows.raw: "can be lifted from there, you’d guess"

rows.original: has been lifted, allowing you access to non-essential sections of the ship
rows.translation: 已经解除，让你可以进入星舰的非必要区域
rows.raw: "has been lifted, allowing you access to non-essential sections of the ship"

rows.translation: 解除封锁
解除封锁

rows.original: End the emergency lockdown on the ship, which should let you access non-essential sections like the crew’s quarters.
rows.translation: 解除星舰的紧急封锁，这应该能让你进入船员舱室等非必要区域。
rows.raw: "End the emergency lockdown on the ship, which should let you access non-essential sections like the crew’s quarters."

rows.translation: 封锁已解除
封锁已解除
你已经解除封锁。

rows.original: Leaning against one of the pillars by the ticket house is the familiar figure of a synthetic fertility goddess: Syne, the draconic gynoid you aided out in the desert. She’s just as naked now as ever, huge pierced breasts rising and falling with her simulated breaths, while a pair of black balls hang heavy beneath an equine sheath. She gives you a coy little smirk as you walk by
rows.translation: 票务亭旁的一根柱子上倚着一道熟悉身影，宛如合成生育女神：赛恩，也就是你在沙漠里帮助过的龙形女性机器人。她依旧一丝不挂，硕大穿环乳房随模拟呼吸起伏，一对黑色睾丸沉甸甸地垂在马形阴茎鞘下。你走过时，她朝你露出一抹狡黠坏笑
rows.raw: "\n\nLeaning against one of the pillars by the ticket house is the familiar figure of a synthetic fertility goddess: Syne, the draconic gynoid you aided out in the desert. She’s just as naked now as ever, huge pierced breasts rising and falling with her simulated breaths, while a pair of black balls hang heavy beneath an equine sheath. She gives you a coy little smirk as you walk by"

rows.original: , but the way her lizard-like tail swishes behind her betrays her eagerness to see you again.
rows.translation: ，但那条蜥蜴般的尾巴在身后摇摆的模样，暴露了她多么期待再次见到你。
rows.raw: ", but the way her lizard-like tail swishes behind her betrays her eagerness to see you again."

rows.original: , blowing you a kiss and giving you a wink.
rows.translation: ，同时向你送出飞吻，又眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: ", blowing you a kiss and giving you a wink."

rows.translation: 赛恩
赛恩

rows.original: Go and speak to the robotic dragon.
rows.translation: 去和那名龙形机器人交谈。
rows.raw: "Go and speak to the robotic dragon."

rows.original:
The ground trembles underfoot. Softly, at first, so subtly that it takes several seconds to notice something’s amiss... and by the time you do, it’s too late.

The tremble becomes an earthshaking rumble, and you twist around to see a metal monstrosity lumbering towards you at a trot on two stumpy legs. Its arms are both weapons, a clamping crusher and some kind of crackling energy weapon dripping liquid plasma as it charges up. The mech’s bulbous torso rattles with every step, loosing screws and bolts covered in so much rust that you can barely tell it once might have been painted silver. The monstrosity looms over you, blaring something like a foghorn as it moves to attack.
rows.translation:
脚下地面开始颤抖。起初很轻微，细微得让你过了几秒才察觉不对劲... 等你意识到时，已经太迟了。

震颤变成撼动大地的轰鸣。你猛然转身，看见一只金属怪物用两条粗短腿小跑着朝你冲来。它的双臂都是武器，一边是钳式粉碎器，另一边是某种噼啪作响的能量武器，蓄能时不断滴落液态等离子体。机甲球状躯干每走一步都会哐啷震动，松脱的螺钉与螺栓锈迹斑斑，让你几乎看不出它原本可能漆成银色。怪物高高笼罩在你上方，发出类似雾号的巨响，准备发动攻击。
rows.raw:
"

The ground trembles underfoot. Softly, at first, so subtly that it takes several seconds to notice something’s amiss... and by the time you do, it’s too late.

The tremble becomes an earthshaking rumble, and you twist around to see a metal monstrosity lumbering towards you at a trot on two stumpy legs. Its arms are both weapons, a clamping crusher and some kind of crackling energy weapon dripping liquid plasma as it charges up. The mech’s bulbous torso rattles with every step, loosing screws and bolts covered in so much rust that you can barely tell it once might have been painted silver. The monstrosity looms over you, blaring something like a foghorn as it moves to attack."

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: “Anno, take a look a this.” You take the strange transceiver device out and set it on the snowy pup’s desk.
rows.translation: “安诺，看看这个。”你拿出奇怪的收发器装置，放在雪白小狗的桌上。
rows.raw: "“Anno, take a look a this.” You take the strange transceiver device out and set it on the snowy pup’s desk."

rows.original: Her tail does one quick wag as she looks the device over, chewing on the end of her pen and humming to herself. She holds it up to the light, twisting it this way and that to observe every inch before finally taking out a little toolkit from her drawer and prying it open. A couple of sparks fly when she scrapes some still-powered part inside, but that just makes her flinch and not much else. She grumbles and pokes around a little more, glancing between it and you a couple times.
rows.translation: 她查看装置时，尾巴迅速摇了一下；她咬着笔尾，独自哼着小曲。她把装置举到灯光下，翻来覆去观察每一寸，最后从抽屉里拿出小工具箱，将其撬开。她刮到内部某个仍通电的部件，几簇火花随之飞出，不过这只让她缩了一下，没有造成其他影响。她嘟囔着又摆弄一阵，期间几次在它与你之间来回张望。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer tail does one quick wag as she looks the device over, chewing on the end of her pen and humming to herself. She holds it up to the light, twisting it this way and that to observe every inch before finally taking out a little toolkit from her drawer and prying it open. A couple of sparks fly when she scrapes some still-powered part inside, but that just makes her flinch and not much else. She grumbles and pokes around a little more, glancing between it and you a couple times."

rows.original: “Hmmm. Yep, this sure is a model seven local net Q-Comm transceiver. What, um, what am I supposed to be looking for here?”
rows.translation: “嗯。没错，这确实是七型本地网络量子通信收发器。那个，呃，我应该在这里找什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmm. Yep, this sure is a model seven local net Q-Comm transceiver. What, um, what am I supposed to be looking for here?”"

rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛。“七型？”

rows.original: “Yeah?” Anno leans back to her terminal and taps a couple buttons, bringing up an extranet page. A holo-model of the exact same part you gave her pops up, orbiting her display while a red and white dragon silently breathes fire in the background. “This was one of KihaCorp’s best sellers back in my parents’ days. I think dad’s got one in his hunting pack for emergencies.”
rows.translation: “对啊？”安诺靠回终端，按下几个按钮，调出一个外联网页面。你交给她的同款零件全息模型随即弹出，围绕显示屏旋转，背景中一条红白相间的龙无声喷着火。“这在我父母年轻时是基哈公司最畅销的产品之一。我想爸爸的狩猎包里就放着一个，以备不时之需。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah?” Anno leans back to her terminal and taps a couple buttons, bringing up an extranet page. A holo-model of the exact same part you gave her pops up, orbiting her display while a red and white dragon silently breathes fire in the background. “This was one of KihaCorp’s best sellers back in my parents’ days. I think dad’s got one in his hunting pack for emergencies.”"

rows.original: “You’re sure?” you ask her, taking the device back and holding it up to the holo. It’s definitely the same part, down to the wire. “Because I found this on a rusty old war robot on Phaedra.”
rows.translation: “你确定？”你一边问，一边拿回装置，举到全息影像旁。每根电线都一模一样。“因为我是在菲德拉一台生锈的老式战争机器人身上找到它的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re sure?” you ask her, taking the device back and holding it up to the holo. It’s definitely the same part, down to the wire. “Because I found this on a rusty old war robot on Phaedra.”"

rows.original: Anno quirks her head aside. “Well, that’s... weird, considering KihaCorp wasn’t even founded until after the 13th Rush. And, well, Phaedra’s in the 14th Rush zone, so, I’m not sure how they’d have any Confederate products in their ‘bots a hundred years ago. It couldn’t have come with the Warp Gates. Maybe someone with access to modern tech was refurbishing it? Another survivor from the first exploration group?”
rows.translation: 安诺歪过头。“这个... 很奇怪，因为基哈公司直到第十三次星球大开发之后才成立。而且，菲德拉位于第十四次星球大开发区域，所以我不知道一百年前他们的机器人里怎么会有邦联产品。它不可能是和星门一起来的。也许有现代技术的人在翻修它？第一批探索队的另一名幸存者？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnno quirks her head aside. “Well, that’s... weird, considering KihaCorp wasn’t even founded until after the 13th Rush. And, well, Phaedra’s in the 14th Rush zone, so, I’m not sure how they’d have any Confederate products in their ‘bots a hundred years ago. It couldn’t have come with the Warp Gates. Maybe someone with access to modern tech was refurbishing it? Another survivor from the first exploration group?”"

rows.original: Your science-pup shrugs. “Dunno what else to tell you, short of contacting Kiha customer support and looking up the serial num...ber... which this one doesn’t have.” She peers at the bottom of the transceiver. “Look, there’s the molding for the sticker to go on, but no trace of it.”
rows.translation: 你的科学小狗耸耸肩。“我也想不到别的解释，除非联系基哈客服，查询序列编...号... 可这个根本没有。”她凝视收发器底部。“看，这里有贴标签用的模压凹槽，却完全没有贴过的痕迹。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour science-pup shrugs. “Dunno what else to tell you, short of contacting Kiha customer support and looking up the serial num...ber... which this one doesn’t have.” She peers at the bottom of the transceiver. “Look, there’s the molding for the sticker to go on, but no trace of it.”"

rows.original: You sigh. “Great. Thanks for the help, Anno.”
rows.translation: 你叹了口气。“好极了。谢谢帮忙，安诺。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh. “Great. Thanks for the help, Anno.”"

rows.original: She snaps a crisp salute. “Any time, captain!”
rows.translation: 她干脆地敬了个礼。“随时效劳，船长！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snaps a crisp salute. “Any time, captain!”"

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: “Hey, Olympia, what do you make of this?” you ask, tossing the Phaedran device to your gynoid engineer.
rows.translation: “嘿，奥林匹亚，你怎么看这个？”你问道，将菲德拉装置抛给自己的女性机器人工程师。
rows.raw: "“Hey, Olympia, what do you make of this?” you ask, tossing the Phaedran device to your gynoid engineer."

rows.original: She glances at it for a split second before returning to her work. “This is a KihaCorp model seven local quantum network transceiver. As advertised, it can connect devices up to one thousand kilometers away without need of relay, or can allow for global network access with a monthly subscription. It currently has a manufacturer’s suggested retail price of one hundred and ninety-nine credits. It is however six models outdated, so of no particular interest.”
rows.translation: 她只瞥了一眼，便继续工作。“这是基哈公司七型本地量子网络收发器。正如广告所说，它无需中继便可连接一千公里范围内的设备，也能按月订阅以接入全球网络。目前厂商建议零售价是一百九十九信用点。不过它已经落后六代，因此没什么特别之处。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe glances at it for a split second before returning to her work. “This is a KihaCorp model seven local quantum network transceiver. As advertised, it can connect devices up to one thousand kilometers away without need of relay, or can allow for global network access with a monthly subscription. It currently has a manufacturer’s suggested retail price of one hundred and ninety-nine credits. It is however six models outdated, so of no particular interest.”"

rows.original: “Except that it was in a century-old Phaedran war robot.”
rows.translation: “问题是，它装在一台百年前的菲德拉战争机器人里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Except that it was in a century-old Phaedran war robot.”"

rows.original: Olympia pauses, glancing at the part again. “That is... unlikely, Captain. This model was an early product of KihaCorp, which was founded after the 14th Planet Rush’s Warp Gates were dispatched. Meaning there is no way it could have gotten to Phaedra before the planet’s nuclear exchange short of a wormhole or time travel. And scans have shown no evidence of either temporal or spatial anomalies in the system.”
rows.translation: 奥林匹亚停下动作，再次看向零件。“这... 不太可能，船长。这种型号是基哈公司的早期产品，而基哈公司是在第十四次星球大开发的星门发射之后才成立的。也就是说，除非通过虫洞或时间旅行，否则它不可能在菲德拉发生核战前抵达那里。而扫描显示，该星系不存在时间或空间异常的证据。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOlympia pauses, glancing at the part again. “That is... unlikely, Captain. This model was an early product of KihaCorp, which was founded after the 14th Planet Rush’s Warp Gates were dispatched. rows.original: You are distracted from your thoughts by the sight of a liferoot not too far away, but it [pc.hasAirtightSuit | |smells a little different than normal. It’s a gentle fragrance that makes you calm and relaxed, rather than horny as a rabbit. Moreover, it ] looks unusually restrained, its bulbs clamped shut. The strangest part, however, is that you feel something calling out to you from inside those bulbs. Driven by an auspicious presentiment, you decide to approach it. On closer examination, you notice that many of the liferoot’s bulbs are swollen, but in an uneven way, some parts protruding slightly more than others. Suddenly, you see a ripple of movement on the skin of a bulb — there’s something inside it! Something alive! Before you can ponder the meaning of this discovery, the labia start to spread apart little by little, and something pokes out of the bulb: it’s a cute little cockvine the same color as your skin! Realizing that you’re looking at your own child, you immediately feel a fatherly connection with the tentacle. You coo words of encouragement to your broodling as it struggles to make its way out of the bulb, taking its first step(slink?) in the fight for survival. Not forgetting about the mother, you gently stroke the bulb, trying to soothe whatever distress it might be feeling from the unnatural pregnancy. Strangely enough, that seems to work: the bulb’s ring relaxes visibly, allowing your tentacle child to finally extricate the last few inches of itself. Your heart swells with pride as you watch the thick broodling climb down — this one is going to be strong! Shortly thereafter, others begin to emerge from their bulbs, and you spend the next several minutes torn between cooing encouragements to your tentacle spawn and trying to soothe the liferoot. Absent-mindedly, you realize that the sight of a bunch of tentacle phalluses wiggling out of pussy-bulbs should strike you as incredibly lewd, if bizarre, but for some reason it just doesn’t. This is entirely normal, there’s nothing unusual about it. Much to your surprise, each newborn climbs down and waits patiently for the others — [pc.nmh |they must have inherited your sense of companionship. |perhaps they inherited this cooperative behavior from their mother? |perhaps they inherited this cooperative behavior from their mother? It sure as hell doesn’t come from you! ] Unfortunately, the last one is smaller than the others and seems a little too weak to make it out of its bulb. After struggling for several minutes, it only manages to extricate a few inches of itself and all but gives up, hanging limp from exhaustion. It tears your heart to see it fail after fighting so bravely, so you decide to cheat a little in its favor by carefully spreading the liferoot’s lips open with your fingers. Seizing this opportunity, the little one gathers its strength and slithers down, being readily welcomed by the rest of the brood once it reaches the ground. Now complete, your tentacle spawn start to dance around each other and coalesce into a shape more reminiscent of the cockvines you’ve encountered on Myrellion. If you want to send one to your nursery on Tavros, now is the time, before they tangle up irrevocably.

You briefly consider taking your firstborn home, but, as the strongest, you feel like its presence is going to be important for the survival of the brood. Instead, you settle for the small one that you saved. It startles a little bit as you gently reach for it, but then it begins to coil around your [pc.hasClawedHands
			|clawed 
		]fingers, trusting in you, as its father.
		
		This sends a warm, fuzzy feeling through your chest.
		
		A few taps on the Codex, and a probe arrives in short order to collect your newborn, who requires just a little convincing to enter the pod. Before it has a chance to start missing you or its siblings, you press the stasis button and send it on the beginning of a journey through the stars, all the way to Tavros...
		
		Once everything is said and done, the brood slinks away towards [var0
			|some rocks nearby,
			|the nearby undergrowth,
		] though they pause and look back for a moment, as if hesitating to part from you. Putting on a brave smile, you nod and tell them to go live a long, happy life. Despite your [pc.isAss
			|hardened personality
			|tough front
		], your eyes grow teary as you watch your tentacle spawn disappear from view.
		
		Lastly, you approach the liferoot once again, to thank her for [pc.isAss
			|being a good broodmare for
			|carrying
		] your children, and [pc.isNice
			|promise you’ll try to be more careful next time, though you know this promise will be nigh-impossible to keep if she drives you crazy with pheromones
			|promise to fill her or one of her sisters with another clutch soon
		]. You have no idea if the plant understands what you’re saying, but you felt like you should say it anyway.
		
		A few minutes later, it occurs to you that you might have just unleashed a new lifeform in this ecosystem without even pausing to think about the long-term consequences. Oh, well, too late now.

			|parent, you want only what’s best for your kids, even if
		] they happen to be literally a bush of tentacle cocks. You’re sure they’re going to make a special someone (or many someones!) very happy one day.

rows.translation: 你已经把努卡牧场主打得相当虚弱，可她仍不愿投降！她拿出一个半透明小袋，里面装着乳白色、如茶水般的液体，液体中还漂浮着许多乌黑的小气泡。她撕开袋嘴，把饮料送到唇边。想把它从她手里打落，你就得快点！
rows.raw: "You’ve worked the nuka rancher down quite a bit, but she’s not willing to surrender just yet! She produces a translucent pouch filled with a milky, tea-like fluid. Inside the fluid floats a number of small, ebony bubbles. She tears open the spout and brings the refreshment to her lips. If you want to knock it out of her hands, you’ll have to be quick!"

rows.original: She swallows the bubble-filled refreshment greedily, chugging the whole thing in seconds. A flush spreads across her skin, her knees squeeze together, and her eyes cross for a moment. Did she just... orgasm? Regardless, a measure of spring comes back to her step. She looks ready to go another round!
rows.translation: 她贪婪地咽下充满气泡的饮料，几秒内就把整袋灌完。她的皮肤泛起红晕，双膝紧紧夹住，双眼也有一瞬间对在一起。她刚刚是...高潮了？无论如何，她的脚步重新恢复几分活力，看起来已经准备好再战一轮！

Did she just... orgasm? Regardless, a measure of spring comes back to her step. She looks ready to go another round!"

rows.original: [var0|The psionic mirror you’ve been focusing your efforts on collapses onto her knees, her three sets of huge, glowing lips flicking out. Then, like a popped soap bubble, she vanishes with a lusty moan and a wave of psychic energy. One less dupli-nuka to worry about!|Once the second copy vanishes, the wave of mental energy becomes too pressing to ignore. You nearly stagger as wanton desires pour over both sides of the battlefield. For her part, the Rancher seems to drink in the needfulness, refocusing her shields and reinforcing the remaining clone. She really wants to keep that duplicate from collapsing...|The last of the clones pops with a lewd gasp. As she vanishes from sight, the source of all the replicas practically leaps into the air. Reabsorbing her copies is apparently quite an ordeal, because her posture goes from battle-ready to drooling lustful in a second. She rolls her hands, tikku, and tail all over herself, caught up in the cyclone of her quadrupled senses. She’s defenseless and, if her peaking moans are any clue, apparently quite vulnerable. Now’s your chance to knock the fight out of her!]

Her towering, seven-foot high frame is sheltered under a wide-brimmed hat, but is outfitted in some manner of frontier uniform that she seems too comfortable in to be salvaged. Her breasts, which are left unclad, are massive J-cups, each topped by the fat-lipped mouth-nipples inherent to her kind. All three of her tongues have a series of ebony piercings down their lengths and are swollen to nearly tentacle-size. Alarmingly, her tail has been fitted with a metal mace-tip that seems to be a plus-sized buttplug. Though she seems obsessed with protecting her fluid-harvesting operation, the psionic bimbo shows more interest in harvesting YOUR fluids!

rows.original:
Wobbling and unsteady, the lewdly-proportioned fluid farmer finally manages to calm the fuck down. She falls to her knees and rolls her head in the palm of her hand. Pulling her hat off, to fan herself, you can’t help but notice her tikku is bigger than when you started, almost as if the psionic-enhancing head tentacle has swollen up from the scuffle. 
	
	"W-woah. That was a rush. I mighta... kinda... overdone it a bit," she admits, almost sounding apologetic. "Just... just take some of this stuff I found and leave my Evaporator alone, kay?"
	
	You assure her you really weren’t here to steal her water, but the explanation falls on deaf ears. Or ear-holes. Or however nuka hear.
	
	Shaking her head, the overheating rancher looks back up at you with a defiant scowl. "I wouldda won if I’d been properly hydrated, ya know! It’s just so, like... dry out here!" She snaps her lower armor off, exposing her overheated loins to open air. Her tongues unspool themselves from her trio of lips and begin licking up all the sweat and excitement that trickles down her electric blue skin, trying to reclaim the moisture. "Tho thirsthy," she gasps, seemingly to herself but loud enough to make it clear who she was really speaking to.
	
	You can practically feel the tendrils of need radiating from the alien’s psionic frame, trying to coax you closer, but too proud to ask you directly. You gather up the offerings and consider if you want to give this girl the liquid lunch she’s not-so-subtly begging for... or if you just want to move on.
rows.translation:
身材淫荡的液体牧场主摇摇晃晃，终于他妈的冷静下来。她跪倒在地，一手托着脑袋晃了晃。她摘下帽子给自己扇风；你不禁注意到，她的蒂库比开战时更大了，仿佛这根能增强灵能的头部触须在冲突中肿了起来。 
	
	“哇、哇哦。真、真刺激。我可能...有点...做过头了，”她承认道，语气听起来几乎带着歉意。“你就...拿点我找到的东西，然后别碰我的蒸发器，好吗？”
	
	你向她保证，自己真的不是来偷水的，可她完全听不进解释。也可能是耳洞听不进。或者努卡人究竟靠什么听东西。
	
	过热的牧场主摇摇头，重新抬眼，用不服气的怒容瞪着你。“要是我水分充足，肯定就赢了，知道吗！外面就是太...太干了！”她解开下身护甲，让过热的胯间暴露在空气中。三条舌头从三张嘴里舒展开来，开始舔食沿电蓝色皮肤流下的汗水与兴奋汁液，试图回收其中的水分。“好渴哦，”她喘息着，看似在自言自语，声音却响得足以明确让人知道她究竟在说给谁听。
	
	你几乎能感觉到需求的触须从外星人的灵能躯体中辐射出来，试图哄诱你靠近，却又骄傲得不肯直接开口。你收起她献上的东西，考虑要不要给这个女孩一顿她并不含蓄地乞求的液体午餐...还是干脆继续上路。

rows.original: All the fight’s gone out of you and you collapse, totally at the mercy of the Phaedran fluid rancher. The glowing psionic energy serving as an eye-catching lipstick for the nuka flares and a host of spectral, 3-fingered hands surge from behind her to assail your [pc.gear], unhooking, unlatching, and undressing you until you’ve been laid bare to the woman’s desires. She looms over you, giving you a good look up and down. “Well what the-? What’s goin’ on here?” She tilts her head and squints. “Am I missin’ something? Does it, like, come out of a hidden slit somewhere?” She crouches down and pokes experimentally at your smooth pelvis, to no effect. She pursues an exhaustive search for genitals of any type, ultimately coming up empty. “Why, somebody gelded my steer before I even had a chance to milk ‘em!” she mutters, frowning. “T’aint right. Here now, lemme see...” She roots around in your pack, pulling some of your cred sticks out. “Yeah, this just ‘bout oughta cover it...” Straightening up, she clops over to you once more and carefully hands you three little pills with a smiling Tamani Corp logo on them. “Got a whole carton of these from a crashed ship a little while ago. That’ll cure what ails ya. Come on back after you take that and we’ll get ya all taken care of, okies?” She begins packing up her camp, collapsing the Extractor to a portable, wheeled unit and heads out. You’re left alone in the howling wastes of the blasted plains, holding what appears to be a trio of Virection pills and quite a few credits poorer. Well, you guess that could’ve gone worse.

rows.translation: [flags.NUKA_RANCHER_ENCOUNTER |你经过一处格外巨大的岩石露头，等你注意到阴影里架着一台银白色圆筒状蒸发器时，已经太迟了。 “又是你！你该不会是在跟踪我吧？还是说上次根本没尝够？”那个曾与你起过冲突的努卡蒸汽牧场主显然换了个新地方，而你又一次撞上了她。“你这种散养牲口尝一次肯定不够，”她嘲弄道，挺起本就十分可观的胸膛。“你要是真那么欠挤奶，开口就行。蒸汽放牧可是苦差事，不过我有多能干，你看也看得出来。这块石头上没人能像我这样用最少的东西榨出最多的收获，”她骄傲地坚持道。 你张嘴想说话，可还没来得及吐出一个字，这个神经兮兮、好斗的花瓶女就惊慌地向后一跳。她发光的眼睛和嘴唇里涌入大量辉光，亮得如同几颗小太阳。她摆出一个自以为很有威慑力的架势——只不过，她那色情明星般的夸张身材多少削弱了这份威势。 “别想抢先动手！没人能偷袭灵能牧场主！”她坚称。和以前一样，她根本没给你解释的机会就直接跳到了结论。你开始怀疑，比起抓住猎物，她是不是同样享受追逐的过程。“你肯定是个难驯的家伙，不过不管在哪发现水分，我都会把它收走。而我发现你了！”她吹嘘着，三条粗大得惊人的舌头舔过三对嘴唇，挑衅声里带着焦躁难耐的急切。“像头乖牛一样，把你的体液交出来吧！” 你叹了口气，在努卡花瓶女跃入战斗、灵能头部触须在身后扭动时摆好架势。你得保护自己！ |菲德拉荒漠支离破碎的废土，被远方一座高耸的金属轮廓打破。你靠近调查，发现了一台你一时认不出的精密设备。它看起来有点像火箭，由一圈圈浅白色金属同心环组成，下方三条支架让设备保持直立。机器顶端伸出一根杆子，上面悬着两片微型薄板，正缓缓旋转以追随炙热的阳光。 顶端升起淡淡蒸汽，整台机器伴着稳定而沉重的嗡鸣震动。你再靠近一些，勉强听见水在机器内部汩汩流动的声音。有人把这东西安在这里——大概还会回来取——但你还是忍不住想满足一下好奇心，开始寻找能打开内部的闩扣。 “喂！离我的蒸发器远点！”附近传来一道抑扬顿挫的声音。你四下张望，发现一个浅蓝色努卡人踉踉跄跄地从岩层阴影里站起来。这位七英尺高的女巨人似乎刚才正在阴凉处打盹，被你的摆弄惊醒了。这个本地人穿着一套保养得出奇完好的板甲，紧紧包裹住她的曲线，却把丰满的整个胸脯敞给所有人观看。她戴着一顶捡来的帽子，让你想起新德州那些开朗的牧场主，不过她那被金属包住的尾尖看上去未免太过亲昵。事实上，那东西简直就像是...一枚肛塞？ 在帽子下面，你看见[var0 |她的蒂库——努卡人用来引导灵能力量的头部触须——而且这条蒂库可真不得了！ |一条细长光滑、与她脑袋无缝相连的某种触须，正在她身旁扭动，仿佛拥有独立意识。 ]这根粗大的器官看上去肿胀得厉害，正好与她身上最引人注目的器官相配：胸前垂着的那对硕大J罩杯。这个外星女孩不仅身材夸张得像超级色情明星，两座乳峰顶端的嘴唇乳头（以及她脸上的嘴唇）也同样惊人。就算是新德州天赋最异禀的公牛，她也能把对方的肉棒含进去，同时还在那两张厚唇肉洞里给他的睾丸留出位置！ 她揉去眼里的睡意，第一次把你看清。“哦——哦...哦！哦哦哦...”她像你打量她一样从头到脚审视了你，而你显然给她留下了不错的印象。也许好得过头了：她三张嘴先是惊讶地张成宽大的圆环，随后嘴角翘成欣喜的坏笑，发着白光的眼睛也眯了起来。“又有一只迷途牲口，以为能趁我睡觉时偷喝一口，是吧？那你可犯了个天大的错误！我们族里只有最、最强壮的人才会被派出来从空气中收集净水。”她把双臂叠在硕大的乳房上，抬起下巴，斜眼看着你，随后指向自己粗大的蒂库。“...那个人就是我，免得你还没听明白。” [pc.isBimbo |”水？从空气里？哦！所以那是一台降雨机！可是，那个，好像没下雨呀。还是说我正撑着伞，只不过是一把透明伞？”你挠了挠头，伸出一只手，掌心朝上。“没有！没下雨！女士，我觉得你的机器没——” |[pc.nmh |“嘿，我可不是来偷谁的水。我只是随便看看。我们谈谈吧。我——” |“哦，多谢你解释。我还以为最强壮的人是我，只是我一直疏忽了收集水分的职责。看来——” |你翻了个白眼，指了指自己的[pc.gear]。“我看起来像是来抢你的吗？再说，看你身上带着这么多水分，少掉一点似乎反而——” ] ] “闭嘴，掠夺者！”她打断你，摆出战斗架势，却没有拔出任何武器。“准备加入我的牲畜群，像一袋果汁一样被榨干吧，你这个恶棍！” 你试图解释，但那名天蓝色花瓶女周围的空气已经在灵能作用下翻腾沸涌，她的头部触须也向上卷起。你得保护自己！ ]
rows.raw: " [flags.NUKA_RANCHER_ENCOUNTER |You pass by a particularly large, rocky outcropping, noticing too late the white-silver of a cylindrical Evaporator that has been set up in the shade. “You again! Are you, like, following me? Or just couldn’t get enough last time?” The nuka vapor rancher you fell afoul of has apparently found a new spot, and you’ve once again stumbled upon her. “One taste is never enough for free range cattle like you,” she taunts, puffing up her already considerable chest. “If you need a milking so bad, just say the word. Vapor ranching’s a tough job, but I’m as tough as they come. Nobody on this rock gets more from less like I do,” she insists proudly. Your mouth opens to talk, but before you get a word in, the jumpy, quarrelsome bimbo hops back in alarm. Her glowing eyes and lips fill with so much Glow that they flare to small suns. She takes what she probably imagines is an intimidating stance — though her menace is somewhat undercut by her pornstar proportions. “Not so fast! Nobody gets the jump on a Psi-Rancher!” she insists. As ever, she’s skipped right past giving you a chance to explain yourself. You’re beginning to think she enjoys the chase as much as the catch. “You’re an ornery one for sure, but I harvest moisture anywhere I find it. And I found you!” she boasts, anxious impatience coloring her taunt as she licks three sets of lips with three exceedingly hefty tongues. “Prepare to surrender your fluids like a good cow!” You sigh and prepare yourself as the nuka bimbo leaps into battle, psionic head-tentacle wiggling behind her. You’ve got to defend yourself! |The shattered wastes of the Phaedran desert are interrupted by the appearance of a towering metallic shape in the distance. You draw closer to investigate and find an elaborate piece of tech you’re not immediately familiar with. It looks almost like a rocketship, made of concentric bands of pale, white metal and supported by a tripod of limbs that keep the device upright. A pole extends from the peak of the machine, from which a pair of micro-sheets are suspended and gradually rotate to match the baking sunlight. There’s a faint steam rising from the peak and the whole thing thrums with a steady, chugging drone. You lean in closer and find that you can just barely make out the sound of gurgling water traveling through the interior of the machine. Somebody set this thing up here — and will probably be back for it — but you can’t help but indulge a little curiosity. You try to find a latch to look inside. “Woah there! Back up from my Evaporator!” a sing-songy voice calls out from nearby. You look around and find a light blue nuka rising from the shadow of a rock formation, unsteadily. The seven foot tall giantess seems she was napping in the shade and your meddling roused her. The native is fitted with a surprisingly well-maintained outfit of plates and armor that snugly hugs her curves while leaving her entire, voluptuous chest open to all onlookers. She’s wearing a scavenged hat that reminds you of a cheerful New Texan rancher, though the metal-encased tip of her tail seems a little too friendly. In fact, it looks almost like... a buttplug? Under the hat, you can make out [var0 |her tikku — the head-tendril nuka channel their psionic powers through — and what a tikku it is! |a long, smooth tendril of some sort that seamlessly extends from her noggin, wiggling about her as if it were a separate sentience. ] The fat organ seems positively swollen, which makes it a perfect match for her most noticeable organs: the massive pair of J-cups she’s got hanging from her chest. Not only is the alien girl stacked like a hyper-porn star, the lip-nipples at the peak of each (and worn on her face, for that matter) are simply shocking. She could suck off the most gifted bull in all of New Texas, and still have room for their balls in those fat-lipped dick-suckers! She rubs the sleep from her eyes, getting a good look at you for the first time. “O- oh... Oh! Ohhhh...” She gives you the same once-over you gave to her, and it seems you made a good impression. Maybe too good, you wonder as her trio of mouths curl into wide O-rings of shock, then tweak at the ends into delighted smirks while her glowing white eyes narrow. “Another stray thought they could sneak a drink while I was sleeping, huh? Well you made one doozy of a mistake! Only the, like, strongest of our kind are sent out to harvest the air for clean water.” She folds her arms atop her gargantuan tits and tilts her head upward, side-eyeing you before she points at her fat tikku. “...and that’s me, if that wasn’t clear.” [pc.isBimbo |”Water? From the air? Oh! So that’s a rain machine! But, like, it’s not raining. Or am I holding an umbrella, but like, one of those see-through umbrellas?” You scratch your head and hold your hand out, palm-up. “Nope! No rain! Lady, I think your machine’s not-” |[pc.nmh |“Hey now, I’m not here to steal anybody’s water. I was just looking around. Let’s talk about this. I’m-” |“Oh, thanks for the clarification. I’d thought it was me who was the strongest and I’d just been neglecting my water-harvesting duties. Looks-” |You roll your eyes and gesture at your [pc.gear]. “Does it look like I’m here to rob you? Besides, from all that water weight you’re carrying, seems like you could stand to lose a little-” ] ] “Silence, raider!” she interjects, taking a fighting stance, but drawing no weapons. “Prepare to join my herd and get harvested like a juice-pouch, ya scoundrel!” You try to explain yourself, but the air around the cerulean bimbo begins to seethe and boil with psionic energies as her head-tentacle curls upward. You’ve got to defend yourself! ] "

rows.original: With his bike totaled, the hyraxi man has chosen to fight you mano a mano! He’s a lithe, feminine man with dark brown hair that’s surprisingly luscious given how far removed he must be from shampoo. His slender, muscular chest is covered by rugged leather straps and rusty metal plates adorned with spikes. Across the dark skin of his human torso and face are a mural of tattoos, various tribal symbols and swirling shapes leading all across his skin. His arms and legs are covered in spotted fur, terminating in large, beast-like paws. One of said claws is holding a wicked-looking hand axe while the other is held at his side, ready to reach into his large tool belt for anything he might need to fight you with.

rows.original: The mutated hyrax is a strange example of his species. He’s taller than the typical male, standing a bit over seven foot. His hair is longer and wilder than the other males, but it’s still just as soft and luscious. The eerie glow from his eyes and his elongated fangs make him look much more intimidating despite sharing the same soft features as the others. His upper half is built similarly to his brethren, slender, muscular, and slightly feminine. The only differences are his larger paws with longer, more fearsome claws, and a slight bioluminescent glow from his tattoos. From the waist down is a different story. His legs are massively thick and muscular, looking both sensual and frighteningly strong. Between them is a gigantic, constantly throbbing bulge in a pair of horribly torn and stained jeans.
rows.translation: 这个变异海拉克西人是其族群中的奇特个体。他比普通男性更高，身高略超七英尺。他的头发比其他男性更长、更狂野，却依然同样柔软浓密。双眼散发诡异光芒，加长的獠牙也让他比同族更具威慑力，尽管五官同样柔和。上半身与同胞构造相似，纤细、结实，略带女性气质。唯一区别是他的爪子更大，利爪更长、更可怕，而且刺青散发轻微生物荧光。腰部以下则完全是另一番景象。他的双腿无比粗壮结实，看起来既性感又强悍得吓人。双腿之间，一条破烂不堪、污渍斑斑的牛仔裤里鼓着巨大包块，始终不断搏动。

I must be getting too predictable.” She stabs the healing hypo into her own thigh and sighs with sudden relief, wounds closing by the second, leaving angry red lines that could scar if not properly seen to. “Just give me a second. I’ll radio Rummi and she’ll be here with the hoversled to haul me home and lecture me about bike repairs the entire way.” She laughs morosely. “So stupid I let this happen. Never again.” You ask her if there’s anything you can do for her while she’s waiting. “Keep that bike-bitch busy so he doesn’t get any ideas. If you do a good job, I’ll be on my way home before you finish up... and I’ll have to start figuring out how to thank you once I’m back at Rummi’s. rows.original: With a small snack and a hot drink in your hands, you head towards the helm and sit in the captain’s chair. No wonder this place wasn’t found: it’s surrounded by radioactive ruins and toxic shipwrecks. The sporadic radiation might not be strong enough to damage DNA, but they were able to shunt the scouting drones. Even if they could withstand them, the scavenging tribes would have taken them down easily. You spend the next few hours in the comfy chair, binging Sybille on Ausaril, a soap about a kaithrit lady settling down on the ausar’s homeworld.

Through the wild tangle of bush and branch, a faint, melodious sound pricks your ears. Is someone singing? You pick your way through the undergrowth towards it.

Though the song gets louder, loud enough for you to recognize it as a woman’s voice, you cannot pinpoint its source. It seems to be coming from up above, somewhere high in the branches. It’s very still in this part of the forest. You pause for a moment and listen.

[var0
	|It’s a minor key song, a lament with a bitter, tempestuous undercurrent. You’re put in mind of someone singing on a cliff over the sea that swallowed her husband. Your babel software struggles with the translation; there are layers of nuance and ancient form here it cannot parse, and whoever is singing belongs to a race only recently discovered. However, it gives you the gist. 
	
	Somewhere high above, a mother is singing to her as-yet-unborn child. She is telling them they are the progeny of a forced union with one of her people’s enemies, one she deeply resents. She promises that this will not stop her loving the child. She will raise them smart and strong in the traditions of her people, and when the time is right she will direct the child right back at the enemy. A righteous revenge will follow.
	
	It’s certainly moving, in its own haunting way. The antagonist in that song better watch their back, whoever that might be! You feel an odd shiver, and decide to leave the area as quickly and quietly as possible. The song stays with you, though. Lingering in the mind like someone whistling past the graveyard.
	|It’s a sweet song that swaps between gushing major keys and stern minor keys. It’s almost like a military march, but it has so much more going on. Your babel software struggles with the translation; there are layers of nuance and ancient form here it cannot parse, and whoever is singing belongs to a race only recently discovered. However, it gives you the gist.
	
	Somewhere high above, a mother is singing to her as-yet-unborn child. She is telling them she cannot wait to see their face, because they are the progeny of a powerful union, the shaman of their tribe and an angel/great spirit/apex beast. She will raise them smart and strong in the traditions of her people, and should they be obedient and watchful, their destiny will be to become a great leader.
	
	It’s very moving, a song about a mother’s unreserved love shot through with primal fierceness and optimism. You decide to leave quietly, so as not to disturb the music which seems to light the gloomy woods up all around. It stays with you though as you continue on. Lingering in your mind like a shaft of sunlight from a high, strange place.

rows.original:
You pick your way around the colossal wreck of the avian half of the shalin to the upper end. She pauses her maudlin song when you [pc.move] into her sightline, belligerent yellow eyes staring back up at you; then she closes them and continues, unabated, unmoved.

She’s still, which means you have a chance to look at her closely for the first time. She’s younger than perhaps you thought, although who’s to really judge with this race. Beneath the blue daub, wasteland dust and grime she’s quite pale, her skin unblemished. She has a rather narrow and pointed face which accentuates her fierceness, to say nothing of the fiery red hair, the dust almost turning it into braids. She really looks fit — nothing like a gym bunny with access to muscle boosters and targeted work-outs of course, but the tight muscle wadding her arms and her washboard abs speak of someone well used to firing a heavy crossbow and carrying her belongings around on her own. Maybe this is also why she’s flat, pert B cups if that, with dark, itty bitty nipples matter-of-factly out there in the warm air.

They rise and fall over clearly well-practiced lungs, piping her minor key song out. Your translator does its best with it: she laments the travails the gods heap upon those that serve them, and begs them provide her with the strength to prevail. She’s feeling sorry for herself.

You consider your options.
rows.translation:
你绕过沙林鸟类下半身那具庞大的残躯，走向她的上半身。当你[pc.move]进入视野时，她停下忧郁的歌唱，好斗的黄色眼睛从下方瞪着你；随后她闭上双眼，毫不间断、不为所动地继续唱下去。

她一动不动，使你终于有机会第一次仔细观察她。她或许比你原先想的更年轻，不过谁又真能判断这个种族的年龄呢。蓝色涂彩、荒原尘土和污垢之下，她的肤色相当苍白，肌肤毫无瑕疵。她的脸颇为瘦削尖细，更加凸显出凶悍气质；那头火红短发更不必说，尘土几乎把它黏成了辫子。她看起来确实十分健壮——当然不像能使用肌肉强化剂和针对性训练的健身狂——但包裹双臂的紧实肌肉与搓衣板般的腹肌，显然属于一个惯于发射重弩、独自携带全部行李的人。或许这也是她胸部平坦挺翘、顶多只有B罩杯的原因；小巧深色的乳头就这样坦然暴露在温暖空气中。

胸口随着训练有素的呼吸起伏，吹奏出她的小调歌曲。翻译器尽力解析着：她哀叹诸神加诸侍奉者的磨难，并恳求神灵赐予她获胜的力量。她正在自怨自艾。

你考虑着自己的选择。

rows.original:
It’s when the nerves depart your [pc.legs], causing you to fall to the soft, damp moss and then slip into a kind of pleasure coma — maybe five or so multiple orgasms later — that the shalin hunter slips away. One moment those beautiful, warm, nibbling pads are there, and then in a gust of cool wind they are not. A few leaves drift down onto your sweaty, rosy face.

	You stare up at the twisted canopy and sigh. But it does this, because it must. 

	It cannot deny the summery afterglow you take with you, though.
rows.translation:
大约经历五次接连不断的高潮之后，你的[pc.legs]失去知觉，整个人跌在柔软潮湿的苔藓上，继而陷入某种快感昏迷；就在这时，沙林猎手悄然离开了。前一刻，那些美丽、温暖、轻啃着你的肉垫还在那里；下一刻，一阵凉风吹过，它们便消失无踪。几片树叶飘落在你汗湿泛红的脸上。

歌唱！

rows.original: You’re singing. As you normally are, these days. Let those who wish you harm know you’re here. You’ve gathered, from the expressions you’ve gotten, that singing loudly is one of the more alarming things you can do while you draw your weapon.
rows.translation: 你正在唱歌。毕竟如今你平时就是如此。让那些想伤害你的人知道你就在这里。根据他们的表情，你已经发现，在拔出武器时放声高歌，算得上你能做出的最令人不安的事情之一。
rows.raw: "You’re singing. As you normally are, these days. Let those who wish you harm know you’re here. You’ve gathered, from the expressions you’ve gotten, that singing loudly is one of the more alarming things you can do while you draw your weapon."

rows.original: Song bubbles from you like water from a spring. It’s just an innate part of your daily life now. Just woken up? A song to greet the day. Making breakfast? A shanty to enliven proceedings. About to meet someone new? A simple tune to calm your nerves. Your vocal chords sometimes ache a bit, but it’s always the ache of a task well done.
rows.translation: 歌声如泉水般从你口中涌出。如今，歌唱已经成了你日常生活中与生俱来的一部分。刚醒来？唱首歌迎接新的一天。做早餐？唱支船歌活跃气氛。要去见陌生人？哼段简单的旋律安抚紧张情绪。你的声带偶尔会有些酸痛，但那永远是圆满完成任务后的酸痛。
rows.raw: "Song bubbles from you like water from a spring. It’s just an innate part of your daily life now. Just woken up? A song to greet the day. Making breakfast? A shanty to enliven proceedings. rows.original: A couple of the crew have recently made passive-aggressive comments about needing ear plugs around the ship. Fuck ‘em, quite frankly. You’re a pregnant diva. If they don’t want to listen to you siiiiIIIIIIiiiiiing, well, there’s the airlock. Just to spite them, you prepare another spirited performance.
rows.translation: 最近有几个船员阴阳怪气地说，在船上得备着耳塞。坦白说，去他们的。你可是怀了孕的歌后。他们要是不想听你唱——歌——，气闸就在那儿。 为了气他们，你准备再献上一场热情洋溢的表演。

If they don’t want to listen to you siiiiIIIIIIiiiiiing, well, there’s the airlock.\n\nJust to spite them, you prepare another spirited performance."

It’s a bit sad that there’s no-one on board the ship to listen to you sing, because you know you’ve gotten good at it. Your voice echoes back to you along the empty corridors, and for a moment you’re not alone.

Ah, look at that. You made yourself sad. You know what will make you feel better? That’s right, a song!

啊，瞧瞧。你把自己唱伤心了。知道什么能让你好受点吗？没错，再唱一首！

rows.original: It’s a song about sunshine, and how someone feels like it to you. It’s a sentiment that has been expressed across time, and much of space. Discovering suns are huge, and frankly terrifying, nuclear explosions has curbed few culture’s enthusiasm for it.
rows.translation: 这首歌唱的是阳光，以及某个人带给你的阳光般感受。古往今来，浩瀚宇宙之中，无数人都表达过这种情愫。尽管人们发现恒星巨大无比，而且坦白说十分可怕，本质上还是核爆炸，但这几乎没有削减各个文明对此的热情。
rows.raw: "It’s a song about sunshine, and how someone feels like it to you. It’s a sentiment that has been expressed across time, and much of space. Discovering suns are huge, and frankly terrifying, nuclear explosions has curbed few culture’s enthusiasm for it."

rows.original: Your upbeat, peaceful melody fills the air. You slide your hand over your taut, convex stomach happily.
rows.translation: 你欢快平和的旋律充盈四周。你开心地用手抚过绷紧隆起的腹部。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour upbeat, peaceful melody fills the air. You slide your hand over your taut, convex stomach happily."

rows.translation: 继续
歌唱！

rows.original: You sing about swimming towards an island, and when you look back towards shore, you don’t want to see anyone standing there. Perhaps amphibious species would struggle to parse this sentiment. The beauty of music is that the tone would impart, even to them, what it’s really about.
rows.translation: 你唱着向一座岛游去，回头望向岸边时，却不愿看到那里站着任何人。两栖物种或许很难理解这种情感。音乐的美妙之处就在于，即使对他们而言，曲调也能传达出这首歌真正的含义。
rows.raw: "You sing about swimming towards an island, and when you look back towards shore, you don’t want to see anyone standing there. Perhaps amphibious species would struggle to parse this sentiment. The beauty of music is that the tone would impart, even to them, what it’s really about."

rows.original: Your downbeat, mournful melody fills the air. You slide your hand over your taut belly, lost in a rain-filled world of your own.
rows.translation: 你低沉哀伤的旋律充盈四周。你用手抚过绷紧的腹部，沉浸在自己那片落满雨水的世界里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour downbeat, mournful melody fills the air. You slide your hand over your taut belly, lost in a rain-filled world of your own."

rows.translation: 继续
歌唱！

rows.original: You feel good, and your song, bluntly, is about that. So good! Singing about feeling good makes you feel even better; a tremendous feedback loop.
rows.translation: 你感觉很棒，而你的歌直白地唱出了这种感受。太棒了！歌唱这种美好感受，又让你感觉更加美好；由此形成了一个惊人的正反馈循环。
rows.raw: "You feel good, and your song, bluntly, is about that. So good! Singing about feeling good makes you feel even better; a tremendous feedback loop."

rows.original: It’s great you fixed your brain so that you, like, understand these concepts so innately.
rows.translation: 你修好了自己的大脑，让自己能够如此本能地理解这些概念，真是太好了。
rows.raw: " It’s great you fixed your brain so that you, like, understand these concepts so innately."

rows.original: You bop and sway towards your next destination, giving your taut, pregnant belly a loving stroke as you do.
rows.translation: 你踩着节拍、摇摆着走向下一个目的地，同时疼爱地抚摸自己绷紧的孕肚。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bop and sway towards your next destination, giving your taut, pregnant belly a loving stroke as you do."

The right song can unite a people behind your cause, and, but for a few moments, you believe you’re singing the one that does it.

The right song can unite a people behind your cause, and, but for a few moments, you believe you’re singing the one that does it."

[var0 |你本能地俯身扑倒，紧贴枝条与苔藓。弯刀般的利爪抓过你几毫秒前所在的位置。你趴在泥地里急促喘息，看着沙林猎手在前方树林中凶猛回旋：那是一只巨大、裸露胸膛的鸟兽，瘦削肩头生出怪异变异的附肢，上面闪耀着黄铜生物增强件。印有基哈符号的黑色头巾上方，一双黄眼睛以顶级掠食者冷静、不眨的目光追随着你。 他从始至终没发出半点该死的声音。 |某种仿佛全速行驶的PRC列车的东西撞中你的腰背。气息离体而去，仿佛灵魂本身发出受伤的喘息，飘荡进枝叶间，只把肉身留作森林地面上一块震惊皱缩的破布；你脸朝下趴着，被某种沉重、坚硬而温暖的东西压住。 那是一只爪子——覆着羽毛皮层的爪子，尖端长着菜刀般大小的锐利黑爪。你之所以知道，是因为它的主人轻巧挪动重量，把那些利爪分别放到你脸庞两侧，好让你清楚看见。还有别的东西碰到你的脸和肩膀，一路滑向[pc.butt]：奇怪柔软的肉垫，覆盖着类似羽毛的东西；它们探索时令[pc.skinFurScales]一阵抽动刺痒。[pc.hasLowerGarment|一只人形手掌用两根手指勾住[pc.lowerGarments]下缘。] 不管这是什么，在这段该死的时间里始终没发出一丝声音。这反而最清楚地说明了对方是谁，以及他想让你明白什么。让接下来发生的事情发生。别反抗。反抗只会让你更加难受。 ] |在森林里，“太安静”是个毫无意义的说法。这里的寂静意味着鸟兽和猿猴的鸣叫织成丰厚背景；意味着风穿过枝头；意味着生物潜行于浓密灌木时，远处传来的撞击与窸窣。辐射森林始终在自言自语，有时还说着疯狂的语言。 但偶尔也会短暂停顿。有时，你会觉得森林本身正屏住呼吸，幽暗眼睛牢牢盯住你。有时气压下降，是因为高处有一部分从森林脱离，正朝你急速坠来。悄无声息，杀意凛然。 一道幽灵，一抹掠过余光的影子... rows.raw: " [flags.SHALIN_HUNTER_ENCOUNTER |The woods are quiet here. Empty. Not serene; more as if all around you is holding its breath, waiting. As if part of it has come loose, far above, and is now hurtling towards you. Silently and murderously. A white shadow, in your peripheral vision... [var0 |Instinctively, you drop and flatten yourself to the twigs and moss. Claws like scimitars snatch at the space you were occupying milli-seconds earlier. Breathing hard in the dirt, you watch the shalin hunter sweep wickedly around in the trees ahead, a giant, bare-chested bird-taur with bizarre, mutated appendages resplendent with brass bio-augs sprouting from his slim shoulders. Above, a black kerchief emblazoned with the symbol of Kiha, yellow eyes follow you with the calm, unblinking gaze of an apex predator. He never makes a void-damn sound. |You are hit in the small of your back by what feels like a PRC train at full speed. Your breath exits your body like it’s your very spirit, gasping and wounded and wandering away into the boughs, leaving your corporeal form a shocked, shriveled rag on the forest floor, face down and pinned beneath something heavy, hard and warm. It’s a claw — a feather-furred claw tipped with sharp black talons the size of kitchen knives. You know this because whatever owns them shifts its weight delicately and places those talons either side of your face, so you can see them. Something else touches you on your face, your shoulders, trailing down towards your [pc.butt]: strange, soft pads, covered in something like feathers that make your [pc.skinFurScales] twinge and prickle as they explore.[pc.hasLowerGarment| A humanoid hand hooks two fingers beneath your [pc.lowerGarments].] Whatever this is hasn’t made a sound the entire void-damn time. Which is the clearest indication of who it is, and what they’re making clear to you. Let what’s about to happen happen. Don’t fight. It will be worse for you if you fight. ] |’Too quiet’ is a meaningless phrase inside the forest. Here, silence means a rich backdrop of avian and simian calls; the wind shifting through the boughs; the distant crash and rustle of creatures prowling through the thick undergrowth. The Radwood talks to itself constantly, sometimes in the tongues of madness. But sometimes there’s a lull. Sometimes it feels as if the woods themselves are holding their breath, its darkling eyes fixed on you. Sometimes the pressure drops because a part of it has come loose, high above, and is hurtling towards you. Silently and murderously. A ghost, the shadow of something in your peripheral vision... [var0 |Instinctively, you drop and flatten yourself to the twigs and moss. Claws like scimitars snatch at the space you were occupying milli-seconds earlier. From the ground, you watch the creature that apparently wanted to break your spine correct itself in mid-air and sweep wickedly back around through the trees on wings as big as a hang glider’s. It’s a shalin: there’s no mistaking that giant, hawk-like lower body attached to the lithe, elfin upper body. Smaller perhaps than the ones you’ve seen before, with white-and-tawny plumage — not that the knowledge stops your monkey brain from babbling that no bird should be that big. The long, boneless, feathered appendages that sprout from his humanoid shoulders though — coiling and uncoiling themselves — you’ve never seen those on a shalin before. Writhing and salaciously pawing the air with their leaf-like ends, they’re covered in strange, pink, feathery nubs, utterly at odds with the spare, austere figure the creature otherwise cuts. That can only be the touch of the corrupted forest. You gather all this in the bare few seconds it takes for the creature to arc itself around at right angles to the ground and come bearing through the branches towards you again, deadly, feather-furred claws outstretched. Above a black kerchief emblazoned with the symbol of Kiha, yellow eyes gaze at you with the calm, unblinking gaze of an apex predator. You will never get away from him in a million years: you’ll have to fight him off. |You are hit in the small of your back by what feels like a PRC train at full speed. Your breath exits your body like it’s your very spirit, gasping and wounded and wandering away into the boughs, leaving your corporeal form a shocked, shriveled rag on the forest floor, face down and pinned beneath something heavy, hard and warm. You know this because whatever owns them shifts its weight delicately and places those talons either side of your head, so you can see them. Something else touches you, on your face, your shoulders, trailing down towards your [pc.butt]: strange, soft pads, covered in something like dry feathers that make your [pc.skinFurScales] twinge and prickle as they explore.[pc.hasLowerGarment| What feels very much like a human hand hooks two fingers beneath your [pc.lowerGarments].] Whatever this is hasn’t made a sound the entire void-damn time. It has, however, made its intentions crystal clear. Let what’s about to happen, happen. Don’t fight. It will be much worse for you if you fight. ] ] "

rows.original: Hyraxi Witchboys are said to carve their own totems’ tops in a bizarre ritual lasting for days and known as ‘gooning the top.’ Purportedly, inhaling the savicite dust enhances their psionic and reproductive powers alike. This particular totem was carved to resemble the grinning face of a feral hyena - or a local equivalent. All that savicite is sure to boost the effectiveness of psionic abilities.
rows.translation: 据说，海拉克西巫童会在一场持续数日、名为“磨顶”的古怪仪式中亲手雕刻图腾顶端。据称，吸入萨维石粉尘能同时增强他们的灵能与生殖能力。这根图腾被雕成了某种野生鬣狗——或者当地近似生物——咧嘴而笑的面孔。如此大量的萨维石，肯定能提升灵能能力的效果。
