rows.original: There’s a distant horn-blast, and you feel the first hints of a tremorous vibration in your [pc.feet]. You glance over your shoulder in time to see a vast steel behemoth roaring down the tracks towards Shineglass. It’s more than thirty cars long at a guess, all glittering silver with stark red lines painted down their sides. You can imagine the train was sleek and elegant looking once upon a time, but hard years and hard times have left an indelible mark: somebody’s hacked a huge turret onto the engine out of scrap steel, shielding a triple-barreled cannon that looks like it might as well have been ripped off the deck of an atomic-era Terran battleship. Armor plates have been riveted all along the flanks of the train cars, covering up most of the windows and wheels. The whole thing looks like a war-hulk more than a passenger liner, but you guess that’s the grim necessity of this war-ravaged world. The armored train barrels into the station, grinding to a halt with a screech of straining metal. Steam gutters out of vents along the engine car’s top, shrouding its turret and bathing you in the rank smell of diesel exhaust. By now the crowd that’d been milling around on the station platform has congealed into a solid press of bodies waiting to use the ticket machine. A cadre of humanoid robots disembark, stomping heavily onto the platform, each one standing protectively in front of one of the train’s scant few open doors. Elcine crosses her arms in front of herself and bows her head in reverence to the machines. “The blessed Evermind rewards our diligence, Emberian. Behold the holy DEE-SLs!” The nearest of the robots quirks its head when its model is invoked aloud. “Please present your ticket, prospective passenger.” Elcine squeals in excitement. “I never get tired of this. Here, holy one! One ticket - and first class, too!” The DEE-SL takes a step closer, swaying exaggeratedly large hips and a lengthy stabilizing tail as it comes over and takes the ticket from the priestess’s staff. It scans the ticket, nods, and returns it. “You may board, honored first class passenger. And you?” it asks, turning its red-eyed gaze towards you. You present your ticket for the same treatment. Satisfied, it nods its head and steps out of the way of the doors. “Thank you for choosing the Phaedran Railway Corporation, honored first class passenger. You have been assigned seats G1 and F1, in the scenic rear cabin.” The robot sweeps an arm towards the furthest car down the line, which does in fact have panoramic windows - though they’ve been partially armored over from the outside, it’s still a better view than anybody else on the train’s going to get. Elcine grins ear to ear and bounces onto the train, giving you and the rest of the gathered passengers a positively hypnotic view of jiggling cake as she mounts the stairs.
rows.translation: 远处传来一声号角，你的[pc.feet]感受到一丝震颤。你回头望去，正好看见一头巨大的钢铁巨兽沿着轨道咆哮而来，驶向辉晶站。粗略一数，它足有三十多节车厢，通体银光闪闪，车身两侧涂着醒目的红线。你可以想象，这列火车昔日一定流畅而优雅，但艰苦的岁月与世道已留下不可磨灭的痕迹：有人用废钢在车头上拼装了一座巨型炮塔，罩住一门三联装火炮，那玩意看起来简直像从原子时代的地球战列舰甲板上拆下来的一样。列车车厢两侧一路铆满了装甲板，遮住了大部分车窗和车轮。整列火车看起来更像一艘战争巨舰，而非客运列车，不过你想，这也是这个饱受战火蹂躏的世界所迫切需要的。 装甲列车呼啸着驶入车站，在金属不堪重负的刺耳尖啸中停了下来。蒸汽从车头顶部的通风口喷涌而出，笼罩着炮塔，也让你浸在柴油废气的难闻气味中。此时，原本在站台上闲逛的人群已经挤成一堵厚实的人墙，等着使用售票机。 一队人形机器人走下列车，沉重地踏上站台，每一个都守在列车寥寥几扇敞开的车门前。艾尔辛双臂交叠于身前，虔敬地向这些机器低头行礼。“蒙福的永恒心智嘉奖了我们的勤勉，余烬之民。瞻仰神圣的DEE-SL吧！” 最近的机器人听到有人高声念出自己的型号，歪了歪头。“请出示车票，准乘客。” 艾尔辛兴奋得尖叫起来。“我永远都看不腻。给，神圣者！一张车票——还是头等座！” DEE-SL向前迈了一步，夸张地摆动硕大的臀部和修长的平衡尾，走过来从女祭司的法杖上取下车票。它扫描车票，点点头，又把票还了回去。“您可以登车，尊贵的头等座乘客。至于您呢？”它转动红眼，将目光投向你。 你也递上车票，接受同样的检查。确认无误后，它点点头，从车门前让开。“感谢您选择菲德拉铁路公司，尊贵的头等座乘客。为您安排的座位是G1和F1，位于后部观景车厢。”机器人挥臂指向列车最远端的车厢，那里确实装有全景车窗——尽管从外面看，窗户有一部分被装甲板遮住了，但视野仍然比列车上的其他人都好。艾尔辛笑得合不拢嘴，蹦蹦跳跳地登上火车；她上楼梯时，那块不断晃动的大蛋糕让你和其他聚在一起的乘客看得出神。

And now... complementary beverages!” She snags a bottle of water with little flower petals floating in it off a cart at the front of the last car as you finally reach it. There’s about a dozen passenger carriages by your count; one diner with a bar and several cloth-covered tables, four with two sets of three stiff-looking economy seats packed tight together, and your own first-class car at the rear. There’s two rows of paired leather seats along the sides, plush carpets running down the middle, and glittering chandeliers hang from the ceiling in an attempt to disguise the cooling ducts. It’s hardly the fanciest transit you’ve been on thanks to your dad’s wealth and prestige, but it’s no slouch for a comparatively primitive planet. You follow the seat numbering on your ticket, which plants you smack in the middle of the carriage, seated right behind Elcine

rows.original: . Her tail pokes through a gap between the backrest and cushion, wiggling like a puppy’s with her growing excitement. “Have you ever been on a train before, Emberian? This is a great and glorious relic of Phaedra’s golden age, you know! I wonder if your people have such things on their own worlds?” “Yeah, the Confederacy has all kinds of trains,” you tell her. “[pc.nmh|Maybe you’ll get to see them someday.|Though I’ve never seen one cosplaying as a battleship before.|Your world’s not special, Elcine.]” Other passengers begin filtering in, along with one of the robots who’s taken it upon itself to check tickets and ask after your drink orders. You sit back and relax, closing your eyes sinking into the cushions. Supple leather around your body, cool air on your face, a refreshing drink in your hand... this is actually turning out to be a nice trip already. A well-deserved break from the rigors of adventure...
rows.translation: 。她的尾巴从靠背与坐垫之间的缝隙伸了出来，随着愈发高涨的兴奋像小狗的尾巴一样摇个不停。 “余烬之民，你以前坐过火车吗？你知道的，这是菲德拉黄金时代伟大而光荣的遗物！我想知道，你们的世界有没有这样的东西？” “有啊，邦联有各种火车，”你告诉她。“[pc.nmh|也许有一天你会亲眼见到。|不过我还没见过哪列火车把自己装扮成战列舰。|你的世界并不特别，艾尔辛。]” 其他乘客开始陆续上车，其中一台机器人主动检查车票并询问你们想喝什么。你靠在椅背上放松下来，闭上眼睛，陷进坐垫里。身体周围是柔软的皮革，清凉的空气拂过脸庞，手里还拿着一杯清爽饮品...这趟旅程居然已经变得相当惬意。这是在艰苦冒险之后理应获得的休息...

rows.original: You’re roused from your rest by a gentle hand on your shoulder, and the sensation of someone planting into the seat beside you. You groggily open an eye, only to see a familiar lynx[rival.mf|boy|girl] sitting down. That, at least, snaps you awake. “[rival.name]? What’re you doing here?” Your cousin looks beleaguered and dirty, like [rival.heShe]’s been out in the dust and sun non-stop since before you arrived. Probably has been, considering [rival.hisHer] fiery entrance on Phaedra. [rival.HisHer] normally-adroit attire is tattered and patched, and [rival.hisHer] favorite tie has been wrapped around an arm, crusted with some dried blood. “What happened to you?” “I guess you saw what happened to my ship?” [rival.heShe] says. “We’re lucky I splurged for the new MaxCorp Executive Escape Pods system... but we’re hoofing it to the probe, since my ship’s splattered all over the wasteland now. Same boat as you, I guess; nobody’s getting past those air defenses! Lucky we all caught the same train, huh?” You don’t see Feruze anywhere, now that [rival.heShe] mentions. “We?”
rows.translation: 一只手轻轻搭在你的肩上，把你从休息中唤醒，与此同时，有人一屁股坐到了你旁边的座位上。你睡眼惺忪地睁开一只眼，却看见一个熟悉的猞猁[rival.mf|男孩|女孩]坐在那里。 至少这一下让你彻底清醒了。“[rival.name]？你来这儿干什么？” 你的表亲显得疲惫不堪、满身尘土，仿佛在你抵达之前，[rival.heShe]就一直没日没夜地泡在尘埃和烈日里。考虑到[rival.hisHer]在菲德拉那场火光冲天的登场，大概确实如此。[rival.HisHer]往日干练的衣服已经破损，还打满补丁；[rival.hisHer]最喜欢的领带则缠在一条手臂上，沾着些干涸的血迹。“你身上到底发生了什么？” “我想你看到我的飞船出了什么事吧？”[rival.heShe]说。“幸好我舍得花钱装了马克斯公司新出的高管逃生舱系统...不过我的飞船现在已经摔得满荒原都是，所以我们只能徒步去找探针了。看来你也一样；谁都过不了那些防空系统！幸好我们都赶上了同一班火车，对吧？” 既然[rival.heShe]提到了，你才发现费鲁兹根本不在附近。“我们？”

rows.original: “Ugh,” a familiar, sneering [rival.mf|boy|girl]’s voice groans beside you. “You’ve gotta be kidding me.” You slowly open an eye, only to find that damned blonde [rival.isCat|pussycat|[rival.mf|fuckboy|bitch]] looming over you. [rival.name]. There’s a ticket clutched in [rival.hisHer] hand - and you can just see the number of the seat next to yours printed on it. Typical. “You’re like a damn rash, always showing up again,” your cousin seethes. “What are you doing here?” [pc.nmh|“Riding the train,” you tell [rival.himHer]. “Same as you, looks like.”|“Hey, I got here first! What are you doing here?”|“Ignoring your dumb ass,” you groan, closing your eyes again.] [rival.name] huffs. “I guess we both had the same idea, huh? At least you didn’t have to lose your ship in the process. Now look what I’m reduced to.” Your cousin looks beleaguered and dirty, like [rival.heShe]’s been out in the dust and sun non stop since before you arrived. Probably has been, considering [rival.hisHer] fiery entrance on Phaedra. [rival.HisHer] normally-adroit attire is tattered and patched, and [rival.hisHer] favorite tie has been wrapped around an arm, crusted with some dried blood. One of the DEE-SL attendants appears behind [rival.name], clamping a heavy hand on [rival.hisHer] shoulder. “Please take your seat, honored passenger. If you wish to register a complaint, you may visit the Phaedran Rail-” “I get it, I get it, jeez,” [rival.name] says, plonking down in the chair beside you. The robot shifts its attention to you. “Please remember that your comfort and safety are our highest priority.” There’s a crackle of electricity around the ‘bot’s tail and hands before it returns to its patrol down the aisle. [rival.name] pouts, crossing [rival.hisHer] arms.
rows.translation: “呃，”身旁传来熟悉而刻薄的[rival.mf|男孩|女孩]声音。“你他妈在逗我吧。” 你慢慢睁开一只眼睛，只见那个该死的金发[rival.isCat|小猫咪|[rival.mf|混蛋|贱人]]正站在你面前俯视着你。[rival.name]。[rival.hisHer]手里攥着一张车票——你正好能看清上面印着你旁边那个座位的编号。真典型。 “你简直像该死的皮疹，每次都阴魂不散，”你的表亲愤愤地说。“你来这儿干什么？” [pc.nmh|“坐火车，”你告诉[rival.himHer]。“看起来和你一样。”|“嘿，是我先来的！你来这儿干什么？”|“不理你这个蠢货，”你哼了一声，再次闭上眼睛。] [rival.name]哼了一声。“看来我们俩想到一块儿去了，是吧？至少你没为此赔掉自己的飞船。看看我现在沦落成了什么样。” 你的表亲显得疲惫不堪、满身尘土，仿佛在你抵达之前，[rival.heShe]就一直没日没夜地泡在尘埃和烈日里。考虑到[rival.hisHer]在菲德拉那场火光冲天的登场，大概确实如此。[rival.HisHer]往日干练的衣服已经破损，还打满补丁；[rival.hisHer]最喜欢的领带则缠在一条手臂上，沾着些干涸的血迹。 一名DEE-SL乘务员出现在[rival.name]身后，一只沉重的手钳住了[rival.hisHer]肩膀。“请入座，尊贵的乘客。如果您想提出投诉，可以前往菲德拉铁——” “知道了，知道了，真是的，”[rival.name]说着，一屁股坐到你旁边的椅子上。 机器人把注意力转向你。“请记住，您的舒适与安全是我们的首要任务。”那台机器人沿过道继续巡逻之前，尾巴和双手周围闪过一阵电光。[rival.name]撅起嘴，抱起[rival.hisHer]双臂。

rows.original: [rival.name] jerks a thumb over [rival.hisHer] shoulder to the seat across the aisle, to a dusky-skinned human woman leaning back with a wide-brimmed hat pulled down over her eyes, drawing your gaze to freckled cheeks and full red-painted lips. She’s wearing a heavy cloak that only partially hides a gunbelt with a [silly|big iron|big-bore magnum revolver] on her hip. There’s also no clothing on those hips, just a sash above them, a plush expanse of befreckled leg, and then the tops of her thigh-high boots. The woman slowly pushes her hat up with a finger bearing the cleanest thing you’ve seen on this entire planet - an electrum ring with a prominent gem on it - and [var0|gives you a narrowed-eye scowl. “After Feruze failed me again, I’ve got another upgrade!” your cousin says confidently. “this is-”|gives you an almost imperceptible nod. “Don’t worry, Feruze got some real severance pay this time!” your cousin assures you. “But I needed someone a little more, y’know, reliable this time. Someone like-”] “Johana Creed,” the woman drawls. The hand not resting on her gunbelt slowly draws a cigarillo from a pack strapped to one of her bracers, clenching it between those full red lips of hers. Silence hangs in the air as she draws a lighter out and flicks it. Just after she lights up, you feel a gentle lurch under your [pc.hasFeet|feet|ass], and Shineglass Station begins to roll back through the window. A musical note plays through the cabin from speakers hidden above you, followed by a sensually smooth woman’s voice, barely identifiable as artificial by its stilted cadence. “Greetings, honored passengers. We are now leaving Shineglass Station. Our next destination is Shieldrock Station. Our estimated journey duration is three hours. Thank you for choosing the Phaedran Railway Corporation, and we hope you enjoy your trip with us.” “Three hours? Ugh,” [rival.name] groans, sinking back in [rival.hisHer] seat. “If this was a MaxCorp line we’d be there in twenty minutes...” [rival.isFriend|“Guess we’ll just have to pass the time...” you tell [rival.himHer].|“Well it’s not, is it?” And now you’re stuck with this [rival.mf|prick|bitch] for three hours.]
rows.translation: [rival.name]用拇指指了指[rival.hisHer]身后过道对面的座位，让你把目光投向一名靠在椅背上的深肤色人类女子。她把一顶宽边帽压在眼睛上，只露出长着雀斑的双颊与涂成艳红色的丰唇。她穿着一件厚重斗篷，却只能勉强遮住枪带，以及腰间那把[silly|大铁家伙|大口径马格南左轮手枪]。而那副腰胯上再无半件衣服，只有上方的一条饰带、大片长着雀斑的丰腴大腿，以及过膝靴的顶部。女子用一根戴着这颗星球上你所见最干净之物的手指慢慢推起帽子——那是一枚镶有醒目宝石的银金合金戒指——随后[var0|眯起眼瞪了你一眼。 “费鲁兹又一次让我失望后，我又找了个升级版！”你的表亲自信地说。“这位是——”|几乎难以察觉地点了点头。 “别担心，这次费鲁兹真的拿到了一笔遣散费！”你的表亲向你保证。“不过这回我需要的是一个更，呃，可靠的人。比如——”] “乔安娜·克里德，”女子拖着腔调说道。 她将没有搭在枪带上的那只手伸向绑在一只护臂上的烟盒，慢慢抽出一根小雪茄，咬在丰满的红唇之间。她掏出打火机，咔哒一声点火，沉默一直笼罩着周围。就在她点燃小雪茄后，你感觉[pc.hasFeet|脚下|屁股下]轻轻一动，辉晶站开始从窗外向后退去。 隐藏在头顶的扬声器向车厢内播放了一个音符，随后响起一个性感柔和的女声，只有那生硬的语调勉强暴露了它来自人工智能。“各位尊贵的乘客，您好。我们现已驶离辉晶站。下一站为盾岩站车站。预计行程时间为三小时。感谢您选择菲德拉铁路公司，祝您旅途愉快。” “三小时？呃，”[rival.name]抱怨着，缩进[rival.hisHer]座椅里。“如果这是马克斯公司的线路，我们二十分钟就能到...” [rival.isFriend|“看来我们只能找点事消磨时间了...”你告诉[rival.himHer]。|“可这里又不是，对吧？”而现在你得和这个[rival.mf|混蛋|贱人]一起被困三个小时。]

rows.original: You really haven’t had the opportunity to sit down and just talk to [rival.name] in years. Here, trapped together on neutral ground, might be your best -- and maybe last -- chance.
rows.translation: 你已经很多年没有机会坐下来好好和[rival.name]谈谈了。如今你们被困在一块中立地带，这或许是你最好的——也可能是最后的——机会。

交谈：乔安娜
了解一下[rival.name]的新保镖。
睡觉
睡觉

rows.original: You’ve had a hell of a run so far. Take the opportunity to just get some rest in the cool, clean train. [rival.name] can’t get up to much mischief with the DEE-SLs watching, right?
rows.translation: 你至今经历了一段地狱般的旅程。趁此机会在凉爽干净的火车里好好休息一下。有DEE-SL看着，[rival.name]应该搞不出什么花样，对吧？
rows.raw: "You’ve had a hell of a run so far. Take the opportunity to just get some rest in the cool, clean train. [rival.name] can’t get up to much mischief with the DEE-SLs watching, right?"

rows.original: You lean back and close your eyes, content to let the lull in the conversation persist - and to let the steady rumble of the train lull you to sleep...
rows.translation: 你向后靠去，闭上双眼，惬意地任由交谈中的沉默延续下去，也任由列车平稳的隆隆声哄你入睡...
rows.raw: "You lean back and close your eyes, content to let the lull in the conversation persist - and to let the steady rumble of the train lull you to sleep..."

rows.translation: 你在座位上扭过身，正面朝向[rival.name]，[rival.isFriend|这让[rival.himHer]移开目光，露出微笑。“怎么了？”|换来你表亲从喉咙深处发出的一声不满。“呃，你想干什么？”]

猞猁形象

rows.original: So, [rival.heShe] kept the kitty mods, huh?
rows.translation: 所以，[rival.heShe]保留了小猫改造，是吧？
猞猁形象
你已经谈过这件事了。
返回

rows.original: You reach over and give [rival.name]’s kitty-ears a scratch, eliciting an involuntary purr. “So I see you decided to keep these cute little mods.” “Y-yeah, of course,” [rival.heShe] grumbles. “Dad was always such an ass about getting mods, but now that I’m on my own, I’m keeping them! What’s he gonna do, take away the fortune I’m gonna take from you?” You roll your eyes and keep petting. “So you’ve been waiting for these, huh? I remember when we were small you used to doodle lynxes all the time...” Not to mention you’re pretty sure [rival.hisHer] little gunship had a lynx painted on the nose all the way back on Mhen’ga. Same eye colors and all. [rival.name]’s cheeks darken. “Yeah, so? They’re my favorite animal! Don’t pretend like you didn’t say my drawings were cute back then, too. Or that you said I looked cute at the party.” “Wasn’t gonna,” you assure [rival.himHer]. “It’s still true.” Your cousin purrs softly, leaning into your hand despite [rival.himHer]self. “... Dork.” “So you don’t want me to call you a pretty kitty?” “I... wouldn’t hate it.” You smirk. “Pretty kitty.”
rows.translation: 你伸出手挠了挠[rival.name]的猫耳朵，引得[rival.himHer]不由自主地发出呼噜声。“看来你决定保留这些可爱的小改造了。” “对——对啊，当然，”[rival.heShe]抱怨道。“爸爸一直对改造这种事特别混蛋，不过现在我独立了，我要把它们留下！他能拿我怎么办，把我准备从你手里夺来的财产抢走吗？” 你翻了个白眼，继续抚摸。“所以你一直想要这些，对吧？我记得我们小时候，你总爱画猞猁...”更别提你很确定，早在门加时，[rival.hisHer]那艘小炮艇的舰首就画着一只猞猁。连眼睛颜色都一样。 [rival.name]的脸颊变暗了。“对啊，那又怎样？它们是我最喜欢的动物！别装得好像你当年没夸过我的画可爱，也别装得好像你在派对上没说我看起来很可爱。” “我本来也没打算装，”你向[rival.himHer]保证。“现在也还是一样。” 你的表亲轻轻发出呼噜声，尽管不愿承认，还是把身体靠向了你的手。“...呆子。” “这么说，你不想让我叫你漂亮小猫？” “我...也不会讨厌就是了。” 你得意一笑。“漂亮小猫。”

rows.original: “Tell me the truth, [rival.name]. Why are you doing this?” “Because... my ship got shot down and I can’t get past the mountains on foot? I am not walking all that way.” You [rival.isFriend|snort and shake your head. “Not what I meant, [rival.name]. Why are you after what my dad left me? You were never that... that greedy when we were little.”|roll your eyes. “I meant why are you after my inheritance, dumbass.”] Your cousin stiffens for a moment, frowning. “Look: your dad, he lived like a maniac and then burnt out like a torch. [rival.isFriend|I don’t blame him for what he did, but h|H]e stole everything he had from my dad, right from the start of the last Rush when he booked it with my old man’s shuttle. Uncle Vic was a crook and a shyster through and through. ‘Stealing’ your inheritance is just taking back what shoulda been my dad’s in the first place.” Wait, what? That’s bullshit. “And besides,” [rival.name] continues, “pretty much the second your old man flatlined, my dad dragged me and [rival.mf|Jill|Jack] into his office and told us that if we ever wanted to amount to anything, we’d have to take it from you. Get his revenge for him. If we didn’t, he’d cut us off completely. And I am not going out and getting a real job. Not like [rival.mf|Jill|Jack] decided to.” Johana makes a disgusted noise in the back of her throat. “[pc.nmh|God damn. Your dad filled your head full of lies and then put all that on your shoulders. I feel sorry for you.|My dad, a thief? I think you’re getting him confused with Max.|Wow, it’s amazing how delusional your family is. It’s like a skill at this point.] Your dad’s the one that stole everything he has from mine. My dad did all the work, and Max litigated him into the ground to steal it. It’s public record!” “Bullshit,” [rival.name] says. “Everyone knows MaxCorp came first. That’s public record. My dad was successful before yours even got his first mining claim - on a planet my dad was already staked on, by the way!” This is getting you nowhere. You sigh and lean back in your seat before you give your cousin an excuse to start rattling off more of why [rival.hisHer] dad is blameless and yours was awful. You don’t wanna hear it any more. After a few seconds of awkward silence, [rival.name] huffs. “Our dads both put us on this dumb ass quest, in their own way. You ask me? This was probably their idea from the start.” “Hey, my dad wouldn’t-” “Wouldn’t what? Make you fight for your inheritance? Make us fight? Come on. Our dads hated each other. Making us try to one-up each other is exactly the sort of thing they’d do, now that they can’t settle up themselves.” Max, sure. But your dad never seemed that vindictive, did he? Eccentric, sure, but maybe [rival.name]’s projecting a little. Right? “So do you actually want to do this?” you ask [rival.himHer]. “Pfft. [rival.isFriend|What does it matter? I don’t have a cushy legacy waiting for me, not like your dad set up for you. My dad’s gonna be around for centuries still, and if I get cut off... I’d have nothing. I might as well go get a job [rival.mf|feeding hungry galotians|as stress relief for thraggen mercs]. I mean, my twin’s been disowned already because [rival.mf|she|he] refused to play along with Dad’s scheme. I can’t... I can’t handle that.”|Do I wanna nab a fortune out from under your big, stupid nose? Absolutely. It’s not like you actually deserve it - like you worked for that fortune any harder than I have. It’s a fuckin’ hand-me-down, ripe for the taking. And Uncle Vic made sure it was up for grabs for either of us.” Ugh.]
rows.translation: “告诉我实话，[rival.name]。你为什么要这么做？” “因为...我的飞船被击落了，我又没法徒步翻过那些山？我才不要一路走过去。” 你[rival.isFriend|嗤笑着摇摇头。“我不是这个意思，[rival.name]。你为什么想要我爸留给我的东西？我们小时候，你从来没有那么...贪心。”|翻了个白眼。“我是问你为什么想要我的遗产，蠢货。”] 你的表亲僵了一会儿，皱起眉头。“听着：你爸活得像个疯子，最后像火炬一样燃尽了。[rival.isFriend|我不怪他做过的事，但他|他]从一开始就偷走了我爸的一切。上一次星球淘金潮开始时，他开着我家老头的穿梭机跑路了。维克叔叔从头到尾都是个骗子和讼棍。‘偷走’你的遗产，不过是把本来就该属于我爸的东西夺回来。” 等等，什么？这全是胡扯。 “再说了，”[rival.name]继续道，“差不多就在你家老头咽气的那一刻，我爸把我和[rival.mf|吉尔|杰克]拽进他的办公室，告诉我们，要是想有任何出息，就得从你手里夺走这一切。替他报仇。要是做不到，他就会彻底断绝我们的经济来源。而我绝对不会出去找一份真正的工作。才不会像[rival.mf|吉尔|杰克]那样。” 乔安娜从喉咙深处发出一声厌恶的声音。 “[pc.nmh|天啊。你爸满嘴谎话地给你洗脑，然后把这一切压到你肩上。我真替你难过。|我爸是小偷？我看你是把他和麦克斯搞混了。|哇，你们一家人的妄想程度真让人叹为观止。现在都快成一门本事了。]是你爸从我爸那里偷走了他的一切。我爸做了全部工作，麦克斯却靠诉讼把他逼入绝境，夺走成果。这些都是公开记录！” “胡扯，”[rival.name]说。“谁都知道马克斯公司才是先出现的。那才是公开记录。我爸早在你爸拿到第一份采矿权之前就已经事业有成了——而且那颗星球本来就是我爸先占下的！” 这样下去毫无进展。你叹了口气，靠回座椅，以免给表亲借口，让对方继续喋喋不休地列举[rival.hisHer]父亲如何清白无辜，而你的父亲又如何恶劣。你已经不想再听了。 尴尬地沉默几秒后，[rival.name]哼了一声。“我们的父亲都以各自的方式，把我们推上了这场愚蠢的探索。要我说？这一切从一开始可能就是他们的主意。” “嘿，我爸不会——” “不会什么？不会让你为遗产而战？不会让我们争斗？得了吧。我们的父亲彼此憎恨。既然他们没法亲自分出胜负，那就让我们争个高下，这正是他们会干的事。” 麦克斯也许会，但你的父亲从来没有那么睚眦必报，对吧？古怪倒是真的，不过也许[rival.name]多少有些以己度人。 对吧？ “那你真的想这么做吗？”你问[rival.himHer]。 “嘁。[rival.isFriend|这重要吗？我可没有什么舒舒服服等着我继承的遗产，不像你爸都替你安排好了。我爸还会再活几个世纪，要是他断绝我的经济来源...我就一无所有了。那我还不如去找份工作，[rival.mf|喂养饥饿的加洛提安人|给斯拉根佣兵泄压]。我的双胞胎手足已经被逐出家门了，就因为[rival.mf|她|他]拒绝配合爸爸的计划。我不能...我承受不了那种结果。”|我想不想从你那个又大又蠢的鼻子底下夺走一笔财富？当然想。又不是说你真的配得上——说得好像你比我更努力地为那笔财富奋斗过似的。那他妈不过是一笔转手遗产，正好等着人拿。而且维克叔叔保证了，我们谁都有机会抢到它。” 呃。]

rows.original: “You know, we could just team up,” you say, putting a hand on [rival.name]’s leg. “Come join my team. I’ll make sure you’re taken care of.” Your cousin’s cheeks darken for a split second before [rival.heShe] forces [rival.himHer]self to glance away. “I, ah... my dad would never forgive me. And with mom gone, and [rival.mf|Jill|Jack] thrown out on [rival.mf|her|his] ass... he’s all I have left to go home to. I can’t disappoint him.” “Have you ever thought that... maybe somebody who makes you feel that way isn’t worth going home to?” [rival.HeShe] doesn’t answer that, or meet your gaze.
rows.translation: “你知道，我们可以合作，”你说着，把手放在[rival.name]腿上。“加入我的团队吧。我会照顾好你的。” 你表亲的脸颊一瞬间涨红，随后[rival.heShe]强迫[rival.himHer]自己移开目光。“我，呃...我爸永远不会原谅我。而且妈妈走了，[rival.mf|吉尔|杰克]自己也被赶出家门，摔在[rival.mf|她|他]的屁股上...他是我仅剩的归宿。我不能让他失望。” “你有没有想过...也许一个让你有这种感受的人，根本不值得你回去找他？” [rival.HeShe]没有回答，也没有看向你。

rows.original: “So what’s the deal with all these bodyguards? [rival.isFriend|Did Max seriously never teach you how to fight? Or at least hire somebody to?|You clearly can’t take care of yourself, but c’mon. It makes you look even weaker.]” [rival.name] [rival.isCat|hisses|glowers]. “I can handle myself!” [rival.heShe] lies, “But I’m not a psycho like you. Running around all by yourself, in jungles full of horny bees, wasteland worlds, warzones, pirate strongholds? You’ve got to be insane! [rival.isFriend|What if you got hurt, huh? Who’d be around to patch you up, or keep you from getting dragged off? You remember what happened on Myrellion! What if you’d lost too?|I mean, even you’ve got to lose sometimes. And who’s going to drag your ass out of the fire, huh? Certainly not me!” You roll your eyes. “If something ever got the best of me, there’s no way you’d have a chance anyway.” “Exactly,” [rival.name] laughs. “That’s why I’d be sneaking past it while it mauled you.]” “So where’d you find these three anyway?[rival.isFriend|| Evil-Minions-R-Us?]” “Ugh, have you heard of the extranet? There’s a whole bulletin board just for matching Rushers with personal security. You should try it.” You chuckle. “[rival.isFriend|I guess you get what you pay for.|So that’s a yes, then.]
rows.translation: “话说，这些保镖到底是怎么回事？[rival.isFriend|麦克斯真的从没教过你怎么打架吗？至少也该给你雇个人吧？|你显然照顾不了自己，可也别这样啊。这只会让你显得更弱。]” [rival.name][rival.isCat|嘶叫|怒目而视]。“我能照顾自己！”[rival.heShe]撒谎道，“可我不像你这个疯子。独自在充斥着发情蜜蜂的丛林、荒原世界、战区和海盗据点里到处乱跑？你肯定疯了！[rival.isFriend|要是你受伤了怎么办？谁能替你包扎，或者阻止别人把你拖走？你还记得迈瑞利昂发生过什么吧！要是那次输的是你呢？|我是说，就连你也总有输的时候。到时谁能把你从火坑里拖出来？肯定不是我！” 你翻了个白眼。“如果真有东西能打倒我，那你肯定也毫无胜算。” “没错，”[rival.name]笑道。“所以它撕咬你的时候，我会偷偷溜过去。]” “话说，你到底从哪儿找来这三个人？[rival.isFriend||邪恶爪牙用品店？]” “呃，你没听说过星际网吗？那里有个专门替淘金者匹配私人保安的公告板。你也该试试。” 你轻声一笑。“[rival.isFriend|看来真是一分钱一分货。|这么说就是了。]

rows.original: ” For once, Johana speaks up from across the aisle. “Keep runnin’ your mouth, Captain. We’ll see how you really hold up ‘fore long, I’m sure.” [rival.isFriend|Hopefully you won’t have to find out.|Yeah, you’ll see.]
rows.translation: ” 这一次，过道对面的乔安娜开口了。“继续耍嘴皮子吧，船长。我敢说，用不了多久我们就能看看你究竟有多少真本事。” [rival.isFriend|希望你不必亲自验证。|没错，你会看到的。]

rows.original: Shoulda hit up my old boss. Might’ve given you someone who could actually keep up with me.
rows.translation: 早知道就该联系我的老东家。说不定能给你派个真正跟得上我的人。
rows.raw: " Shoulda hit up my old boss. Might’ve given you someone who could actually keep up with me."

rows.original: “So... how is Uncle Max anyway?” you ask. “I haven’t heard anything from him in... well, ever, really.” Damn, now that you think about it, you never even got a birthday card or anything from him, did you? “He’s fine,” your cousin answers noncommittally. “Unlike some people, my dad’s not trying to impress anybody pretending to be a space cowboy - he’s back on Hiemal, leading MaxCorp to another year of record-breaking profits.” Hiemal, the first planet your dad really saved, keeping it from ripping itself apart in a civil war. It was the sort of thing that made your dad famous, a household name. And it became the first planet where Max ripped his brother’s holdings out from under him with underhanded legal tricks. You’re pretty sure you have some royal half-siblings there, but Max made sure you and your dad never set foot there again. You find yourself scowling, which just makes [rival.name] give a haughty laugh. “Steele Tech’s board is just treading water now, you know. [rival.isFriend|Without a real leader, they’re just in-fighting, tugging your dad’s legacy every which way.|They’re a bunch of vultures waiting for you to fail. Or for a real leader to step in. Someone like me.] Meanwhile, MaxCorp’s twenty percent up this year alone.” “Don’t sound so proud,” you grumble. “It’s not like you contributed anything to that.” [rival.name] crosses [rival.hisHer] arms. [rival.isFriend|“I can be proud of my dad, and all my friends at the company.”|“Some of us still have dads to be proud of.” Holy shit, ouch. You groan, trying to ignore [rival.hisHer] cheek rubbing against yours.|[rival.name] shove you out of the way so [rival.heShe] can get a better look out of the window. “God damn it,” you grumble, shoving [rival.himHer] back.] “What’s going on?” “Look!” [rival.heShe] says, pointing at the featureless dunes. You squint against the beating hammer of the sun spilling into the carriage, trying to make out whatever it is your cousin’s trying to point out. There’s a plume of dust billowing over the horizon, you suppose, but... You blink the sleep out of your eyes in a hurry as dark shapes being to manifest from the haze, hurtling towards the train at a pursuing angle. Even over the roar of the engine and the vibration of the car beneath, you’re starting to hear rock music thumping in the distance, thrashing guitar and drumbeats building up to a frenzy of noise. And then there’s a horrific groan from the train itself. Three streaks of flame race from the engine car towards the oncoming vehicles, spinning round and round as they home in on their targets. “Guess those cannons weren’t for show after all,” Johana says, coming up behind you both. “Or rocket tubes, more like?” The car’s DEE-SL stalks up, making a noise reminiscent of clearing its throat - barely audible over the cacophony outside. “There is nothing to worry about, honored passengers. Please return to your seats and fasten your safety harnesses. Security measures will-” The three rockets detonate a hundred yards shy of their targets, blindingly bright. The lead vehicle, a staggeringly-overburdened flatbed stacked thirty feet high with speakers, roars right through the flames unharmed, followed by dozens of buggies and dirtbikes swarming behind it like a host of furious ants. “Aw shit,” Johana says, reaching for her sidearm. “[rival.name], get behind me.” “Stay in your seats and keep your weapons holstered,” the DEE-SL insists. The ridiculous truck drives past you, close enough that you can glimpse the two dozen hyraxi hanging off the sides, armed and armored for war. Another flatbed pulls up alongside your car at the rear, and you see something that looks awfully like a whaling harpoon gun bolted to the back, cranking towards you. “Down!” Johana yells, grabbing you and [rival.name] both and shoving you to the deck. The now-aggravated gynoid behind you starts to speak, its hand crackling with electricity, but its chest erupts with a man-sized harpoon that sends streaks of oil and motor fluid splattering across the back wall of the car. The robot’s slammed hard against the closer wall a second later as the shooter reels the connecting line in, and the windows around you shatter under a weight of rubber bullets that go bouncing all around you. More ropes follow them, grappling hooks latching onto windows or puncturing seats, and then the raiders are on you: hyraxi boys in armor made of leather and scrap metal, brandishing tools as weapons. A few other passengers scream as they’re grabbed, huge paws covering their faces or wrapping around entire limbs. You scramble to your [pc.hasFeet|feet|full height again], pushing Johana and [rival.name] off as you grab your weapon and leap into the aisle. There’s a hyraxi boy facing you down, standing taller and leaner than the raiders around him: dark-furred, wearing a tattered long coat, and carrying a sword in one hand and what you figure to be a machine pistol in the other - actual tools of battle, compared to the salvaged improv of the others. “Hello, every[silly|wan|one]!” he barks, spreading his arms. “I’m here to tell you that you’re being enslaved. Please don’t resist - we’d have to [silly|ruff|rough] you up before our Warmistress sinks her teeth into you. Drop your weapons and your valuables into my associates’ hat here and-” Johana finally clears her gun from its holster and blows the stetson-wannabe out of the boy’s hand with a blast of deafening concussion. Just about everyone in the car winces, covering their ears. She grabs your shoulder before the hyraxi can recover and bellows at you: “Come on! Help me clear these stupid pups out!”
rows.translation: [rival.isFriend|[rival.name]爬过你的大腿，把[rival.hisHer]脸贴到窗户上，将你从睡梦中惊醒。你呻吟一声，试图无视[rival.hisHer]脸颊贴着你的脸摩擦。|[rival.name]把你推开，好让[rival.heShe]看清窗外，将你从睡梦中惊醒。“该死，”你抱怨着，把[rival.himHer]推了回去。]“发生什么了？” “快看！”[rival.heShe]指着毫无特色的沙丘说道。你迎着从车厢洒进来的灼人烈日眯起眼睛，试图看清表亲究竟在指什么。你猜，地平线上扬起了一片尘埃，不过... 你赶紧眨去眼里的睡意。几道漆黑的轮廓开始从尘霾中显现，以拦截角度飞驰着追向列车。即使隔着引擎的轰鸣与脚下车厢的震动，你也开始听见远方砰砰作响的摇滚乐声。激烈的吉他与鼓点不断增强，汇成一片狂乱的噪音。 紧接着，列车本身发出一声可怕的呻吟。三道火焰从车头冲向驶来的车辆，一圈又一圈地旋转，追踪各自的目标。 “看来那些炮果然不是摆设，”乔安娜走到你们身后，说道。“或者更像火箭发射管？” 车厢里的DEE-SL大步走来，发出类似清嗓子的声音——在外面的喧嚣中几乎听不见。“各位尊贵的乘客，请勿担心。请回到座位并系好安全带。安保措施将会——” 三枚火箭在离目标一百码远的地方爆炸，亮得令人目眩。领头的车辆是一辆严重超载的平板卡车，上面的扬声器堆了足足三十英尺高；它毫发无损地咆哮着穿过火焰，后方则跟着几十辆沙滩车和越野摩托，如一群狂怒的蚂蚁般蜂拥而来。 “糟了，”乔安娜一边说，一边去摸腰间的枪。“[rival.name]，躲到我后面。” “请留在座位上，并将武器收在枪套内，”DEE-SL坚持道。 那辆荒唐的卡车从你旁边驶过，距离近得足以让你看清挂在车身两侧的二十多个海拉克西人；他们全副武装，做好了战争准备。另一辆平板车驶到你所在的尾部车厢旁边，你看见一个酷似捕鲸鱼叉炮的东西被固定在车斗上，正缓缓转向你。 “趴下！”乔安娜大喊着，同时抓住你和[rival.name]，把你们按倒在地板上。 你们身后那台已经被激怒的女性机器人刚想开口，手上还闪着电光，一根和人一样粗的鱼叉便贯穿它的胸膛，机油和机械液体飞溅在车厢后壁上。一秒后，射手收紧连接的绳索，机器人被狠狠拽向近侧的墙壁；橡胶子弹的重压击碎你们周围的窗户，在四周弹来弹去。更多绳索紧随而来，抓钩钩住窗框或刺穿座椅，随后劫掠者便扑到了你们身上：身穿皮革和废金属拼成的盔甲、把工具当作武器挥舞的海拉克西男孩。几个其他乘客被抓住，巨大的爪子捂住他们的脸，或是整个缠住他们的四肢，于是尖叫起来。 你一把推开乔安娜和[rival.name]，抓起武器，跃进过道，重新用[pc.hasFeet|双脚站稳|整个身体立起]。 一名海拉克西男孩在你面前摆开架势。他比周围的劫掠者更高、更瘦：一身深色毛发，穿着破烂的长外套，一手持剑，另一手握着一把你认为是冲锋手枪的武器——和其他人用废料临时拼凑的东西相比，这才是真正的战争兵器。 “各位[silly|盆友|朋友]，大家好！”他大叫着张开双臂。“我是来通知各位，你们马上就要沦为奴隶了。请不要反抗——否则在我们的战争女统领把利齿刺进你们身体之前，我们还得先把你们[silly|咬|狠]揍一顿。把武器和值钱的东西都丢进我同伴举着的帽子里，然后——” 乔安娜终于把枪从枪套里拔出来。伴随着震耳欲聋的冲击声，她一枪轰飞了男孩手里那顶仿牛仔帽。车厢里几乎每个人都缩起身体，捂住耳朵。她趁海拉克西人还没缓过来，抓住你的肩膀吼道：“快！帮我把这些蠢狗崽赶出去！”

rows.original: “You’re on your own!” you snarl at your cousin’s bodyguard, shoving her away before you throw yourself at the hyraxi rapscallion. He recovers just enough to parry your first strike, twisting with the impact to throw you around towards the carriage’s door. “Yeah! Just you and me now!” he cackles. Behind him, the rest of the raiders surge towards Johana and [rival.name]. You can just make out your cousin and Elcine grabbing the DEE-SL behind Johana, trying to pull its broken chestplate off while the gunslinger squares up with half a dozen scoundrels. But you’ve got your own problems now!
rows.translation: “你自己应付吧！”你对着表亲的保镖咆哮，将她推开，随后猛扑向那名海拉克西恶棍。他勉强及时恢复过来，挡开你的第一击，又顺着冲击转身，将你甩向车厢门。 “好啊！现在只剩你和我了！”他放声狂笑。在他身后，其余劫掠者朝乔安娜和[rival.name]一拥而上。你勉强看见自己的表亲和艾尔辛抓住乔安娜身后的DEE-SL，试图扯掉它破损的胸甲；与此同时，那名女枪手摆好架势，面对着六个无赖。 可你现在也有自己的麻烦！

rows.original: It’d almost be peaceful, if not for the sounds of battle finally able to reassert themselves. The massive battleship cannon on the front of the train may be out of commission, but there’s still some DEE-SLs blasting back at the raiders zooming around the Thunder Rig like ants, and even further back, you can hear the pounding boom of Johana’s hand cannon. But where you’re standing, the fight’s on pause for the moment. You lower your [pc.weapon] and turn to the snow-feathered birdy bard. You gently lift the blindfold covering her eyes, but find the orbs beneath to be a milky white, unfocused and blind. “H-hello?” she murmurs, letting the guitar hang on the strap around her shoulders and reaching up in the vague direction of you. She manages to find the hand that removed her blindfold and squeezes it. “I feel terrible. Are you here to save me?”
rows.translation: 若不是战斗声终于再次占据耳际，这里几乎称得上平静。列车前端的巨型战舰火炮或许已经停摆，但仍有几台DEE-SL朝像蚂蚁般绕着雷霆战车疾驰的袭击者开火反击；更远处，你还能听见乔安娜手炮沉重的轰鸣。 不过在你所在的地方，战斗暂时停了下来。你放低[pc.weapon]，转向那个长着雪白羽毛的鸟族吟游诗人。你轻轻掀开蒙住她双眼的布，却发现下面的眼珠呈乳白色，目光涣散，显然已经失明。 “你、你好？”她低声说道，让吉他挂在肩带上，朝你大概所在的方向伸出手。她摸到了替自己摘下眼罩的那只手，紧紧握住。“我感觉糟透了。你是来救我的吗？”

rows.original: “Hey, it’s not why I came here, but I’m happy to do it,” you tell her, giving her hand a squeeze. “Let me get those shackles off.” “Praise Toth!” the poor bird sighs, shaking out her feathers once you pull the nails holding her shackles tight around her little legs. She stands back up a little awkwardly, clearly more unsteady on the speeding truck than you are. “I was sure these bastards were going to keep me prisoner until my voice finally broke. It sounds like a battle’s going on? Where are we?” You glance from her to the train. “In the middle of a battle, on a speeding war-truck. I’ve gotta find a way to get you out of here.” The bird-bard flaps her little wings and grimaces. “Uh, you did say speeding truck, no? I’m not sure there’s any getting off here without hitting the brakes!” “There is a grapple cannon,” you tell her. “Can you fly at all?” “I can hold a rope!” she assures you. “Oh, I’m Elystiel. Thank you for saving me.” You take the hand still squeezing your wrist and shake it. “Steele. [pc.name] Steele. [pc.nmh|I’ll try and get you out of here safe, I promise.|Don’t thank me yet - we still might get killed doing this!|Save the praise for when we get out of here.]” She nods and locks her fingers through your hand. “I trust you!” [silly|

艾莉丝蒂尔

rows.original: You take hold of Elystiel, pulling the taur-sized birdwoman close. “This is gonna be windy,” you warn her, wrapping your other arm around the rope. “I’m gonna need you to flap those wings real hard to get us across, okay?” “Can do!” she smiles, shaking out her feathers. “It’s been so long since I’ve soared!” Elystiel takes a few steps back with you and takes off running along the grappling line, spreading her wings as the speeding wind hits you both. She’s strong enough to propel you both forward, and you’ve got a good enough grip on her to keep the both of you from being flung away by the howling wings. It’s awkward, but you manage. Luckily the raiders surrounding you aren’t keen to take a swipe at you now that their psychically-fueled war frenzy is broken, and you’re both able to fling yourselves through a wrenched-open wall on the train and back aboard into a passenger car. There’s a handful of terrified-looking divrani huddled up between the seats, but no hyraxi raiders to be seen... on this car. You can hear muffled gunshots and crashing metal in the direction of the train’s rear, back the way [rival.name] and [rival.hisHer] little party are... but no commotion ahead. Yet. Your shalinae rescue breathes a sigh of relief, but doesn’t let you go until you stand and gently pry her fingers off. “Thanks again,” she says, feeling around the economy seats until she finds a place to sit. “I won’t forget this. Give ‘em hell for me!” You plan to.

rows.original: “If this world is poisoning you,” you say, putting up a hand in the most disarming gesture you dare, “why not leave? I’ve still got a ship that can fly, and I punched a way through the drone ship that was taking everyone out up there. We could take your tribe back to Confederate space and-” “And what?” Hureya barks. “Submit to slavery beneath foreign stars?” “No!” Not that the idea isn’t exactly what she was planning for you, now that she mentions it, but nevermind that. “There’s a whole confederation of species out there, hundreds and hundreds of worlds. There are processes for integrating new species! You wouldn’t have to worry about tainted water or polluted food ever again.” Hureya snorts. “We saw what your so-called confederation of species does already, when their ships first came - came with false promises that led to cages!” “We’re not all like that,” you insist. “Then prove it! Prove your honor with your blade, offworlder. Through combat may your spirit be proven true.” Ah, hell.
rows.translation: “既然这个世界正在毒害你们，”你说道，同时举起一只手，做出你所敢尝试的最不具威胁性的手势，“为什么不离开？我还有一艘能飞的船，而且我已经突破了那艘在上面击落所有人的无人机飞船。我们可以把你的部族带回邦联太空，然后-” “然后怎样？”胡蕾娅厉声道。“在异乡的群星之下沦为奴隶？” “不！”虽然她这么一说，这倒正是她为你安排的打算，不过先别管这个。“外面有一个由众多种族组成的完整邦联，拥有成百上千个世界。那里有接纳新种族的程序！你们再也不用担心受污染的水或有毒的食物。” 胡蕾娅哼了一声。“我们已经见识过你们所谓的种族邦联会做什么了，他们的飞船第一次来时带着虚假的承诺，最终却把我们送进牢笼！” “我们并非全都那样，”你坚持道。 “那就证明给我看！用你的刀刃证明你的荣誉，外星人。让战斗证明你的灵魂真实无伪。” 啊，见鬼。

rows.translation: 战斗！

rows.original: You start things off by whacking the gunslinger over the head while she’s distracted. She grunts, crumpling like a paper back under her own weight. Hureya glances between the two of you and cackles. “Well, that wasn’t very [pc.mf|king|queen]ly. Are you aliens not all in league with each other?” “Hardly,” you say, turning your attention back to her. “Now then...”
rows.translation: 趁女枪手分心时，你率先一击敲在她头上。她闷哼一声，像个纸袋般承受不住自身重量，瘫倒下去。 胡蕾娅在你们两个之间看了看，放声大笑。“嗯，这可不怎么有[pc.mf|国王|女王]风范。你们外星人难道不是一伙的吗？” “当然不是，”你说着，重新把注意力转向她。“那么现在...”

Are you aliens not all in league with each other?” “Hardly,” you say, turning your attention back to her. “Now then...”"

战斗！

rows.raw: "You aren’t going to be made into a breeding slave for a wild band of hyraxi barbarians!"

rows.translation: 提升她？
提升她？

rows.translation: 她做这一切，是为了拯救自己的氏族，使其免遭...基因退化与辐射中毒？那就给她一个逃离这个地狱世界的机会。

接受邀请

rows.translation: 折中一下如何？她可以带走你的表亲和乔安娜用于繁育，而你则让列车抵达目的地——顺便还能除掉你的对手。

rows.translation: 胡蕾娅

rows.original: You pause for a moment. Are you really going to go through with this? You are on the very verge of recovering your father’s fortune - you are this close! - and you are going to throw it all away to become a barbarian’s consort. But what does fortune amount to in the sterile, corporate world of the UGC? You have been given advance warning of the life you will lead at the head of Steele Tech: a trudge through an endless series of boardrooms and starchy parties populated by sharks lying through their expensively straightened teeth at you, where you must lie and backstab them back to stay afloat. A life of savage conquest under Phaedra’s sun, the wind in your hair - this will be something you are both more suited to and will enjoy far more. The more you think about it, the more the wind drowns everything else out. This is what you were meant to find here, not your father’s probe. There is also the fact the armored hyrax looks fucking strong. You really aren’t sure you can beat her - and it doesn’t bear thinking about what will happen to your ass if she defeats you. Maybe it is pragmatism that makes this decision for you. Maybe it is the thought of what it might be like to be held to that bosom, by those brawny arms. “How about we get out of here,” you growl, lowering your [pc.weapon]. “And you show me what needs conquering.” Hureya gazes at you for a while longer, a razor-tipped smile slowly spreading over her face, shafts of bright light from the shifting scenery outside flashing across her features. “First thing’s first,” she says. “Another offworlder is still causing trouble back there, shooting at my boys. I want them taken alive. Prove that I am who you are loyal to, now.” Ah, yes. Your cousin. You don’t have to head back many cars to find them, using a few seats as a barricade, taking potshots at the hyraxi males who are trying to close in on [rival.himHer]. [rival.HisHer] eyes widen as they see you open the door ahead, and [rival.HeShe] straightens, lowering [rival.HisHer] pistol. “[pc.name]! What the hell is going on? Where’s Johana?” “Don’t worry. It’s all been taken care of,” you say, savoring the confusion on [rival.name]’s face as you breezily [pc.move] over to them. You deliver the exact same bop to the head you dealt [rival.hisHer] bodyguard, and they go down like a ninepin. Works like a charm. [rival.isFriend |You suppose you feel a little bad about doing this after you just made peace with [rival.himHer]. But, well... you hardly have to stretch your memory back far to remember an endless series of betrayals and dirty tricks perpetrated by the stunned blonde at your feet. There can be little doubt these are the just wages of the career they have led up to this point! And you’ll be removing ‘mercy’ from your lexicon, anyway. You’ll have little use for it going forward. |And doesn’t looking down at the stunned mostly-human make the whole thing feel complete and right? You don’t have to worry about your rotten cousin taking your rightful birthright. No, they’ll be coming with you! And you’re already thinking of some very entertaining things you can do with them. Any further doubts you were harboring evaporate in the dry, desert air.] “Good,” says a voice behind you. Hureya stands framed in the door, surrounded by a small crowd of hyraxi males, ricocheting looks between you and her, hesitantly covering you with their weapons. The Warmistress strides over to you, flexing her power fist - you have enough time to feel a chill of uncertainty - and then you find yourself grabbed by the [pc.hip] and pushed into her own bulky, armored hip. “This,” she barks at her agog, furry rabble, squeezing you tight to her with her huge paw, “is my [pc.king]-to-be. [pc.He] proved [pc.him]self a greater warrior than any of you, and has now knelt and pledged [pc.his] weapon to our clan! Together, we will be unstoppable! You will obey [pc.his] order as if it were mine. Now - let’s take what we came for, and be away!”
rows.translation: 你停顿片刻。你真的要把这件事进行到底吗？你已经站在夺回父亲财富的最边缘——只差这么一点了！——而你竟要把一切都抛开，去做一个野蛮人的配偶。 可是在联合银河邦联那个毫无生气的公司世界里，财富又算得了什么？你已经提前看见自己执掌斯蒂尔科技后会过上怎样的生活：无休止地跋涉于一间间董事会会议室和拘谨的宴会，在那里，一群鲨鱼会从昂贵矫正过的牙缝间向你撒谎，而你也必须以谎言和背刺回敬，才能不被淹没。相比之下，在菲德拉的太阳下过着野蛮征服的生活，让风吹过头发——这才是更适合你的事情，也会让你快乐得多。你越是思考，风声就越是淹没其他一切。这才是你命中注定要在这里找到的东西，而不是父亲的探针。 还有一个事实：那个披甲的海拉克西人看起来强得要命。你真不确定自己能否击败她——而若被她打败，你的屁股会遭遇什么，根本不堪设想。也许是务实替你做出了这个决定。也许则是想到被那对胸脯、被那双强壮手臂抱住会是什么感觉。 “不如我们离开这里，”你低吼着，放低[pc.weapon]。“然后由你告诉我有什么需要征服。” 胡蕾娅凝视你片刻，刀锋般尖锐的笑容缓缓在脸上展开，外面不断变换的景色投来明亮光束，掠过她的五官。 “第一件事，”她说。“还有一个外星人在后面制造麻烦，向我的男孩们开枪。我要他们活着被抓来。证明你如今效忠的人是我。” 啊，对。你的表亲。你没往回走几节车厢便找到了他们；他们把几张座椅当作路障，朝试图逼近[rival.himHer]的海拉克西雄性不断放冷枪。[rival.HisHer]看见你打开前方车门时双眼睁大，随后[rival.HeShe]站直身体，放低[rival.HisHer]手枪。 “[pc.name]！这到底是怎么回事？乔安娜呢？” “别担心。一切都已经处理好了，”你说着，细细品味[rival.name]脸上的困惑，同时轻快地[pc.move]到他们身边。你照着对付[rival.hisHer]保镖的方式在表亲头上也来了一下，他们便像木瓶般倒地。屡试不爽。 [rival.isFriend |考虑到你才刚刚与[rival.himHer]和解，这样做确实让你略感歉疚。不过，嗯...你根本不必把记忆往前翻多久，就能想起倒在脚边这个金发家伙对你实施过的一连串背叛和卑鄙伎俩。毫无疑问，这正是他们迄今为止那段生涯应得的报酬！反正你也会把“仁慈”从词典里删掉，往后几乎用不上它了。 |而且，俯视这个昏迷的类人家伙，不正让整件事显得圆满而正确吗？你再也不必担心腐烂的表亲夺走你与生俱来的权利。不，他们会跟你一起走！而你已经开始设想一些能在他们身上施展的极其有趣的玩法。你残留的任何疑虑都消散在干燥的沙漠空气里。] “很好，”身后传来一个声音。胡蕾娅站在门框里，周围聚着一小群海拉克西雄性，他们目光在你和她之间来回弹跳，犹豫着用武器指住你。战争女统领大步走向你，屈伸动力拳套——你只来得及感到一丝不安——随后便发现自己被她抓住[pc.hip]，压向她自己厚重披甲的髋部。 “这位，”她朝那群目瞪口呆的毛茸茸乌合之众吼道，用巨大爪子把你紧紧箍在身边，“就是我未来的[pc.king]。[pc.He]证明了[pc.him]自己是比你们任何人都更伟大的战士，如今已经跪下，宣誓将[pc.his]武器献给我们的氏族！我们联手便将势不可挡！你们必须服从[pc.his]命令，如同服从我的命令。现在——拿走我们为之而来的一切，离开这里！”

rows.original: [rival.name], Johana and the rest of the offworlder passengers are shoved onto the caged back of a flatbed truck. You, meanwhile, ride at the front of the convoy, on the thunder rig, standing on top of the amp stacks with Hureya. Below you, Elystiel has been plugged back in. The delirious bird woman strums the opening chords to a triumphant, deafening power ballad. You listen to it, wind whipping

rows.original: your [pc.hair], as you watch the train glimmer at you one last time before it disappears into the desert’s shimmer and the spectacularly be-weaponed convoy of buggies, technicals and war-trucks turns to the dunes with wild laughter and howls. This fucking rules. It’s a long ride back to the hyraxi camp, deep in the ruin-specked wastes. It’s twilight before you see it, rising from the rocky sands. Great metal cargo crates stacked on top of each other, lit by slants of uneven glare thrown down by floodlights, yet more jury-rigged vehicles parked in their stark illumination. The crates form a perimeter around a building of mortar and stone, a lone, largely intact survivor of the war: a great gothic edifice, busts of nuka gazing sightlessly into the distance flanking the marble pillars and steps of the entrance. It’s covered in trailers of colored lights, and as the suns go down it not so much resembles the temple of entertainment it once was, but a yet rawer and more purposeful evolution. “It was a hard fight to take and keep this place,” Hureya tells you. She speaks with a mixture of pride and defensiveness. “It has water and is defensible. The Maretai usually break camp and move every few months, but - I don’t know. What do you think?” To you, it looks like a fine base of operations. A place to inspire awe in your warriors and fear in your enemies. From here, you shouldn’t be forced to move by anyone. “You know, [pc.name]...” Having learned it, the hyrax is enjoying rolling your name around her mouth. She’s looking at you with that slow burn, predatory smile of hers again. “...I feel myself on the path of destiny when I hear you speak.” The guitar reaches a tinnitus-inducing crescendo, and flames gout from the truck at the front, as it passes through a gap in the cargo crates. Scores of hyraxi of all shapes and sizes throng the tops of the crates and the entrances of the tents below, and they howl and cheer and goggle as the post-apocalyptic triumph proceeds to the entrance of the grand building. “MARETAI,” booms Hureya. You watch her speak from a balcony above the entrance, a bulky microphone pressed to her lips. “HUSTINYA SWORE TO YOU THAT OUR CLAN WOULD LIVE, WOULD PROSPER, IF HER BLOOD HELD ITS RIGHT TO LEAD YOU THROUGH THE SANDS, INTO BATTLE AND BEYOND,” she intones through the sound system. “TODAY, HUREYA FULFILLS THAT OATH! WE WILL LIVE, BECAUSE WE HAVE CLAIMED THE SOFT, CLEAN FLESH OF THE OFFWORLDERS FOR OURSELVES.” A floodlight is thrown on the prisoners on the flatbed truck. rows.original: squeezes past you and into the compartment behind you. Her followers yip and giggle and leap down from up above, following their mistress. The door snaps closed. There’s some muffled shouting back there, a single discharge of a holdout pistol, and then silence. The roar of engines outside recedes soon after, leaving you alone with the rattle of the train. You climb up onto the second tier of the engine, where the divrani engineers that are supposed to be driving it are tied up. They babble thanks at you and scurry back to work, arresting the train’s roaring speed and restoring power to the ailing defenses. One of them, wearing a black-striped cap that looks undeniably like something you’ve seen in old children’s books, gives you a deep bow and a vigorous tail-wiggle. “Goddess’s blessings on you for negotiating with that barbarian, Emberian. Sensors indicate the entirety of the raider convoy has broken off, and our cannons are now back online in case they return. We should be entering the great tunnel beneath the Curtain in mere minutes now.” With a nod, you turn and go to find somewhere to sit that’s still got its windows...

rows.original: In a bad, half-remembered dream of grabbing paws, yipping cries, distressed metal and howling wind, you are ripped from the PRC train and shoved into a barred cage which takes up the entirety of the back of a flatbed truck. Cool metal presses itself around your neck and wrists. You gain full cognizance again just in time to watch the train disappear in the distance, a sliver of silver in the desert haze, gleaming at you one last time before peeling away towards the mountains. You suppose it’s something that the hyraxi raiders let whoever’s still on the train go. And, although undoubtedly tech, weapons and valuables were looted from it as well, it couldn’t be more obvious what the real prize was. Your truck is near the front of the convoy; it is surrounded on all sides by smaller buggies, warbikes and armored trucks, forming a jealous cordon - or simply drawing close to get a good eyeful. Neither you nor any of the people you are now chained at the neck to are dressed in anything but the torn scraps of your garments, strange glimmers from other worlds. Whoops, whistles and delirious laughter carry past you on the gritty, exhaust-laden wind. From the front, the opening chords of a triumphant power ballad start up.[var0| Your heart sinks. You guess they were able to grab Elystiel before she was able to fly off.] [var1|“Good going, asshole. Real nice.” [rival.name] throws their head back, yanking the chain and throttling you a bit. “We might have stood a chance if you hadn’t left us in the lurch at the first opportunity. That work out for you, yeah? That brilliant plan stand the test of time, huh?” “Gotta admit, I thought you were exaggerating about [pc.him].” Further back, Johana sounds remarkably calm. “But nah, you were right. [pc.heShe]’s a real useless piece of shit.” Fucking Void and the One together... was kidnapping not bad enough? You had to be chained to your cousin and [rival.hisHer] plus one as well?|[var2|“Guess it was always expecting a little too much of you not to fight like an over-pregged raskvel,” sneers the chain-link behind you. You almost scream up at the merciless glare of Phaedra’s pale sky. Was getting kidnapped by alien barbarians not bad enough? You had to be bound to your rotten cousin and [rival.hisHer] plus one as well? “Maybe if you could fight at all instead of always hiding behind other people, things might be a little different!” you snap. “You’re the dumb muscle!” [rival.heShe] fires back. “The one time I’m relying on you to headbutt a problem to death you can’t manage it! Fucking incredible!” “Can you both shut up?” Further back, Johana sounds remarkably calm. “The only thing that could make this experience any worse is if I get a headache listening to you two.”|[var3|“Gotta say.” [rival.Name] is standing right behind you. They can’t help that; the chain that links you two together is less than two feet long. “The first attempt at cooperation between MaxCorp and Steele Tech does not fill me with much confidence in its future.” You note the tremble beneath [rival.hisHer] words, and try to reach deep for something comforting. At least you buried the hatchet before this happened; imagine how much worse it would be if you couldn’t face what’s coming together. “Yeah.” [rival.Name] sniffles, and then touches your hand. “Thanks. That - actually means something.” “Do wish you two could have settled your lil feud without it involving me being turned into a sex slave,” Johana mutters, from further back.]]] It’s a long ride back to the hyraxi base, deep in the ruin-specked wastes. It’s twilight before you see it, rising from the rocky sands like an unwelcome guest. Great metal cargo crates stacked on top of each other, lit by slants of uneven glare thrown down by floodlights, yet more jury-rigged vehicles parked in their stark illumination. The crates form a perimeter around a building of mortar and stone, a lone, largely intact survivor of the war: a great gothic edifice, busts of nuka gazing sightlessly into the distance flanking the marble pillars and steps of the entrance. It’s covered in trailers of colored lights, and as the suns go down it not so much resembles the temple of entertainment it once was, but a yet more powerful and purposeful evolution. The guitar reaches a tinnitus-inducing crescendo, and flames gout from the truck at the front, as it passes through a gap in the cargo crates. Scores of hyraxi of all shapes and sizes throng the tops of the crates and the entrances of the tents below, and they howl and cheer and goggle as the post-apocalyptic triumph proceeds to the entrance of the grand building. You blink and cringe as a huge spotlight is turned on your cage. “MARETAI,” booms [flags.SHINEGLASS_MET_WARMISTRESS|Hureya’s|a feminine] voice. You see [flags.SHINEGLASS_MET_WARMISTRESS|her|an imposing, armored figure with a slice of blonde hair] emerge above the entrance, around the metal pillar which rises vertically above it, upon which only the faintest ghosts of letters remain. She has a bulky microphone pressed to her lips. “HUSTINYA SWORE TO YOU THAT OUR CLAN WOULD LIVE, WOULD PROSPER, IF HER BLOOD HELD ITS RIGHT TO LEAD YOU THROUGH THE SANDS, INTO BATTLE AND BEYOND,” she intones through the sound system. “TODAY - WITH THE SOFT, CLEAN FLESH OF THOSE WHO COME FROM THE BEYOND, THEY WHO SEEK TO CAGE US - HUREYA HER DAUGHTER FULFILLS THAT OATH. MARETAI LIVES! MARETAI PROSPERS!” Bedlam on the stacks and around the awnings. Some of the males are literally turning air somersaults down there. Glaives and slug-throwers are brandished and fired at the violet sky, and Hureya’s name is howled upwards beyond them. A delirious celebration begins.
rows.translation: 在一场只记得零星片段的噩梦中，抓扯的爪子、尖锐的叫声、金属受压的呻吟与呼啸的狂风混杂在一起。你被硬生生拖出PRC列车，塞进一个占满平板卡车整个后部的铁栏笼子。冰冷的金属扣住你的脖颈与手腕。你彻底恢复意识时，正好看见列车消失在远方；它化作沙漠薄雾中的一道银线，最后一次向你闪耀，随后转向群山离去。 至少，海拉克希劫掠者放走了仍留在列车上的人，这勉强算件好事。毫无疑问，他们也抢走了列车上的科技、武器和贵重物品，但真正的战利品是什么，实在再明显不过。你乘坐的卡车靠近车队前方；四周围满了小型越野车、战争摩托和装甲卡车，形成一道严密而充满占有欲的警戒圈——又或许，他们只是想靠近些，好把你们看个够。你和那些如今与你颈项相连的人身上都只剩衣物的破碎残片，宛如来自其他世界的奇异微光。欢呼、口哨和癫狂的笑声乘着夹杂砂砾与废气的风从你身旁掠过。车队前方响起一首胜利力量情歌的开场和弦。[var0|你的心沉了下去。看来他们在艾莉丝蒂尔飞走前把她抓住了。] [var1|“干得漂亮，混蛋。真是漂亮。”[rival.name]猛地向后仰头，扯动锁链，勒得你一时喘不过气。“要不是你一有机会就把我们扔下，我们或许还有胜算。结果对你很不错，是吧？那个绝妙计划经受住时间考验了吗，嗯？” “得承认，我还以为你夸大了[pc.him]有多糟。”后面的乔安娜听起来出奇地平静。“但没有，你说得对。[pc.heShe]真是个一无是处的废物。” 虚空和唯一神一起见鬼去吧...被绑架还不够糟吗？你居然还得跟表亲和[rival.hisHer]的跟班锁在一起？|[var2|“看来指望你别像怀胎过多的拉斯克维尔一样打架，终究还是要求太高了，”你身后的锁链另一端冷笑道。 你险些对着菲德拉苍白天空中无情的强光放声尖叫。被异星野蛮人绑架还不够糟吗？你居然还得跟那个烂透了的表亲和[rival.hisHer]的跟班绑在一起？ “要是你能真正动手战斗，而不是永远躲在别人身后，事情或许会不一样！”你厉声回敬。 “你才是那个只会蛮力的家伙！”[rival.heShe]反击道。“我唯一一次指望你拿脑袋把问题撞死，你却办不到！真他妈不可思议！” “你们两个能闭嘴吗？”后面的乔安娜听起来出奇地平静。“这段经历唯一还能变得更糟的方式，就是听你俩吵得我头疼。”|[var3|“不得不说。”[rival.Name]就站在你身后。那也是无可奈何；连接你们的锁链还不到两英尺长。“麦克斯公司与斯蒂尔科技的第一次合作尝试，实在无法让我对双方的未来抱有多少信心。” 你察觉到[rival.hisHer]话音下的颤抖，努力从内心深处找出一些能安慰的话。至少事情发生前你们已经握手言和；想象一下，如果你们不能共同面对接下来的一切，情况还会糟糕多少。 “嗯。”[rival.Name]抽了抽鼻子，随后碰了碰你的手。“谢谢。那——真的很重要。” “倒希望你俩解决这场小恩怨时，不必把我也变成性奴，”更后面的乔安娜嘟囔道。]]] 返回海拉克希基地的路途漫长，目的地深入遍布遗迹的荒原。直到暮色降临，你才看见它像不速之客般从遍布岩石的沙海中升起。巨大的金属货柜彼此堆叠，泛光灯投下参差不齐的强光，照亮更多粗制滥造的车辆。货柜围出一道周界，包围着一座砂浆与石块砌成的建筑；这是战争中孤零零幸存下来、基本保持完整的宏伟哥特式建筑，努卡人的半身像在大理石柱和入口台阶两侧茫然凝视远方。建筑上覆盖着一串串彩灯；当太阳落下时，它已经不再像昔日的娱乐圣殿，而更像经历了更加强大、更有目的性的进化形态。 吉他声攀升至令人耳鸣的高潮，车队最前方的卡车穿过货柜间的缺口时，烈焰从车身喷涌而出。大批体型各异的海拉克希人挤满货柜顶部和下方帐篷入口；当这支末日后的凯旋队伍驶向宏伟建筑的入口时，他们嚎叫、欢呼，瞪大眼睛围观。一道巨大的聚光灯照向你的笼子，你眨着眼畏缩起来。 “马雷泰，”[flags.SHINEGLASS_MET_WARMISTRESS|赫蕾娅的|一个女性]声音轰然响起。你看见[flags.SHINEGLASS_MET_WARMISTRESS|她|一名威严的金发装甲身影]出现在入口上方，绕过入口上方垂直耸立、只残留最淡字母痕迹的金属立柱。她把一个硕大的麦克风按在唇边。 “胡斯蒂妮娅曾向你们发誓，只要她的血脉仍有权带领你们穿越沙海、投身战斗并迈向更远之处，我们的氏族便会生存、便会繁荣，”她通过音响系统庄严宣告。“今天——凭借那些来自天外、妄图囚禁我们的家伙们柔软而洁净的血肉——她的女儿赫蕾娅履行了这项誓言。马雷泰生生不息！马雷泰繁荣昌盛！” 货柜堆上和遮棚四周顿时陷入狂乱。有些雄性甚至真的在下面凌空翻起了跟斗。长柄刀和实弹枪械被高高挥舞，朝紫罗兰色的天空开火；赫蕾娅的名字也随着吼声冲上云霄。一场疯狂的庆典就此开始。
rows.raw: "In a bad, half-remembered dream of grabbing paws, yipping cries, distressed metal and howling wind, you are ripped from the PRC train and shoved into a barred cage which takes up the entirety of the back of a flatbed truck. Cool metal presses itself around your neck and wrists. You gain full cognizance again just in time to watch the train disappear in the distance, a sliver of silver in the desert haze, gleaming at you one last time before peeling away towards the mountains. You suppose it’s something that the hyraxi raiders let whoever’s still on the train go. And, although undoubtedly tech, weapons and valuables were looted from it as well, it couldn’t be more obvious what the real prize was. Your truck is near the front of the convoy; it is surrounded on all sides by smaller buggies, warbikes and armored trucks, forming a jealous cordon - or simply drawing close to get a good eyeful. Neither you nor any of the people you are now chained at the neck to are dressed in anything but the torn scraps of your garments, strange glimmers from other worlds. Whoops, whistles and delirious laughter carry past you on the gritty, exhaust-laden wind. From the front, the opening chords of a triumphant power ballad start up.[var0| Your heart sinks. You guess they were able to grab Elystiel before she was able to fly off.] [var1|“Good going, asshole. Real nice.” [rival.name] throws their head back, yanking the chain and throttling you a bit. “We might have stood a chance if you hadn’t left us in the lurch at the first opportunity. That work out for you, yeah? That brilliant plan stand the test of time, huh?” “Gotta admit, I thought you were exaggerating about [pc.him].” Further back, Johana sounds remarkably calm. “But nah, you were right. [pc.heShe]’s a real useless piece of shit.” Fucking Void and the One together... was kidnapping not bad enough? You had to be chained to your cousin and [rival.hisHer] plus one as well?|[var2|“Guess it was always expecting a little too much of you not to fight like an over-pregged raskvel,” sneers the chain-link behind you. You almost scream up at the merciless glare of Phaedra’s pale sky. Was getting kidnapped by alien barbarians not bad enough? You had to be bound to your rotten cousin and [rival.hisHer] plus one as well? “Maybe if you could fight at all instead of always hiding behind other people, things might be a little different!” you snap. “You’re the dumb muscle!” [rival.heShe] fires back. “The one time I’m relying on you to headbutt a problem to death you can’t manage it! Fucking incredible!” “Can you both shut up?” Further back, Johana sounds remarkably calm. “The only thing that could make this experience any worse is if I get a headache listening to you two.”|[var3|“Gotta say.” [rival.Name] is standing right behind you. They can’t help that; the chain that links you two together is less than two feet long. “The first attempt at cooperation between MaxCorp and Steele Tech does not fill me with much confidence in its future.” You note the tremble beneath [rival.hisHer] words, and try to reach deep for something comforting. At least you buried the hatchet before this happened; imagine how much worse it would be if you couldn’t face what’s coming together. “Yeah.” [rival.Name] sniffles, and then touches your hand. “Thanks. That - actually means something.” “Do wish you two could have settled your lil feud without it involving me being turned into a sex slave,” Johana mutters, from further back.]]] It’s a long ride back to the hyraxi base, deep in the ruin-specked wastes. It’s twilight before you see it, rising from the rocky sands like an unwelcome guest. Great metal cargo crates stacked on top of each other, lit by slants of uneven glare thrown down by floodlights, yet more jury-rigged vehicles parked in their stark illumination. The crates form a perimeter around a building of mortar and stone, a lone, largely intact survivor of the war: a great gothic edifice, busts of nuka gazing sightlessly into the distance flanking the marble pillars and steps of the entrance. It’s covered in trailers of colored lights, and as the suns go down it not so much resembles the temple of entertainment it once was, but a yet more powerful and purposeful evolution. The guitar reaches a tinnitus-inducing crescendo, and flames gout from the truck at the front, as it passes through a gap in the cargo crates. Scores of hyraxi of all shapes and sizes throng the tops of the crates and the entrances of the tents below, and they howl and cheer and goggle as the post-apocalyptic triumph proceeds to the entrance of the grand building. You blink and cringe as a huge spotlight is turned on your cage. “MARETAI,” booms [flags.SHINEGLASS_MET_WARMISTRESS|Hureya’s|a feminine] voice. You see [flags.SHINEGLASS_MET_WARMISTRESS|her|an imposing, armored figure with a slice of blonde hair] emerge above the entrance, around the metal pillar which rises vertically above it, upon which only the faintest ghosts of letters remain. She has a bulky microphone pressed to her lips. “HUSTINYA SWORE TO YOU THAT OUR CLAN WOULD LIVE, WOULD PROSPER, IF HER BLOOD HELD ITS RIGHT TO LEAD YOU THROUGH THE SANDS, INTO BATTLE AND BEYOND,” she intones through the sound system. “TODAY - WITH THE SOFT, CLEAN FLESH OF THOSE WHO COME FROM THE BEYOND, THEY WHO SEEK TO CAGE US - HUREYA HER DAUGHTER FULFILLS THAT OATH. MARETAI LIVES! MARETAI PROSPERS!” Bedlam on the stacks and around the awnings. Some of the males are literally turning air somersaults down there. Glaives and slug-throwers are brandished and fired at the violet sky, and Hureya’s name is howled upwards beyond them. A delirious celebration begins."

rows.translation: 继续
胡蕾娅

rows.original: A few more minutes of humiliating, naked display to the crowd later, you are led out of the cage at glaive-point and into the darkness beyond the marble entrance. You pass through the central space - a cave-shaped, theater-like room with a great stage - and then up some stairs, beyond a heavily reinforced door, to a more intimate setting. This room is draped with stolen finery, tattered silk sheets used as curtains, plush seats that look like they were ripped straight from a first class train propped together to form comfy alcoves and cushion piles. In private alcoves and smaller, adjoining rooms there are emperor-size beds built from lashed together mattresses, lamp-posts and pillows over-stuffed with shalin eiderdown. The fixed bar at one end, stocked both with the bright, tattered labels of salvaged pre-war booze and ominously unmarked moonshine, tells you that this used to be some Nuka equivalent to a champagne bar. Your wrists are unshackled and you are unchained from one another. You hear a faint click from somewhere; your collar thrums faintly against your neck. The door opens, and in clumps the tan-and-blonde edifice that is Hureya. “Offworlders,” she says. She addresses you almost as if you were new recruits, straight-backed and calm, huge paws on her armored hips. “This is where you will live. This is where you will work. Understand that it is not my will that you be cattle, mindlessly fed and bred. You need to do more to justify your existences. You must be - entertaining. You must make your Mistress the envy of every clan in the plains. That is your role among the Maretai. Secondary role.” “Entertaining... how, exactly?” says Johana. Hureya waves a brusque paw. “You are from the sky! In ships of silver you come! The wonders you have seen, and done, I cannot even begin to imagine.” She sneers at you toothily, reveling in her fat score. “All of that is mine now. Your minds, your bodies - mine. Those I favor enough to allow up here to rut you, be given a chance to parent the next generation of Maretai - I want them to be dazzled and enriched. I want them leaving here bow-legged, with stars in their eyes. You’ve seen the stars up close. You will put them there.” “And what if we don’t want to?” This, inevitably, and with plenty of feeling, comes from [rival.name]. Hureya gestures at one of the guards, and he throws her a chunky remote with rows of buttons on it. After a couple moments of frowning pause, she presses a button with the delicate tip of a claw. [rival.name] screams, spasms and falls to the floor, clutching at [rival.hisHer] collar. “I hope that’s clear.” Her hazel eyes, calm and composed yet with that predatory undercurrent that puts butterflies in your belly, passes over you all. “You will be well-looked after - if you behave. It is your Mistress’s wish that you be sleek and energetic and smiling, after all! She does not want to use your button. She does not want to chain you up downstairs in the yard for the lowest males to amuse themselves with. But neither is she a fool.” She pauses, eyebrows raised, waiting to see if there is another interjection. There is none, beyond your cousin’s piteous blubbering. “Good.” [flags.SHINEGLASS_MET_WARMISTRESS|The butterflies swarm back in full force as her gaze locks onto you. She steps forward and with a grunt hoists you bodily over her shoulder, your [pc.ass] swung up into the air, her claws nipping your bare [pc.skinFurScales]. “The strongest,” she gloats. “[pc.he] who defeated many a Maretai warrior, but brought to [pc.his] knees before me! Mine to [pc.hasVagina|swell their belly full of heirs.|truly make [pc.himHer] know what defeat tastes like.] A prize truly worthy of a Queen!” She points sharply at the guards as she carries you towards the door at the far end of the room. “Send that Nuka wine and a full needle of the pink stuff up. Then I don’t wish to be disturbed until second sunrise. Got that?” “Yes, your alpha-lency!” yips one of the guards, as the door slams shut behind you.|She suddenly steps forward and with ease sweeps [rival.name] into her paws. [rival.heShe] goes with a comical ‘whoop!‘ that wipes out [rival.hisHer] tears for a moment. “I like a toy with some cheek,” Hureya grins. “So much more fun to make them arch their back and moan... oh, do stop crying,” she sighs, roughly brushing [rival.name]’s face with her paw. “I can be gentle too. You’ll see.” She throws [rival.name] bodily over her shoulder, bare ass in the air, pointing sharply at the guards as she marches towards the door. “Send that Nuka wine and a full needle of the pink stuff up. Then I don’t wish to be disturbed until second sunrise. Got that?” “Yes, your alpha-lency!” yips one of the guards.] “What should we do with the others...?” inquires another, unable to keep the groaning longing out of his voice. “Whatever. You boys have earned it.” She slams the door shut behind her with a burly buttock. After a single, breathless moment, there is a collective tearing off of pants. “Oh good,” mutters Johana, seconds before she is pushed to her knees and presented with a straining, blood-red cat-dog dick.

rows.original: The engine car rumbles violently, and you hear power surging all around you. There’s a moment of deep concern down to your [pc.isGoo|core|bones], before the noise clarifies its intentions with a thunderous kaboom that rattles the train right to the wheels. The naval cannons atop the train announce their return to form with earth-shattering authority. The primitive 2D sensor pane on the control console flashes, and several red dots beside the train vanish. [flags.SHINEGLASS_JOHANA_IN_PARTY|Johana whoops, pumping a fist in the air. ]Spent canisters clatter down from on high, and you hear the power start charging again. The remaining red marks start scattering, veering away from the train and heading for the shelter of the dunes. The cannons thunder again, more marks are turned to dust, and then the remnants of the convoy are off the screen. Breathing out a sigh of relief, you turn back to the defeated Warmistress. “Looks like your friends left you behind.” She answers with a soft snort. “As well they should. rows.original:
. It’s not long before one of the divrani engineers pipes up over the speaker, encouraging everyone to return to their seats or consolidate into undamaged cars before the train reaches the tunnel beneath the Shield Mountains. 

	Frightened divrani and nuka crowd into the cabin as it plunges into darkness. Flashes of red emergency light snap by in a blink on either side of you, and with most of the windows shattered, you’re treated to an incredible howl of wind rushing past.

	The trip through the mountains takes a good ten minutes, even at the train’s breakneck speed. You can see why the idea of crossing the range on foot never crossed Elcine’s mind: the mountains are even more vast than they appeared from space. Still, it’s a welcome reprieve from the chaos and violence you woke up to not that long ago, and by the time the train’s hurtled out of the dark, you’ve caught your second wind in earnest.

	The train begins to slow almost as soon as it’s exited the tunnel, and you’re able to take in the view of what lies beyond the mountains - a whole new world utterly unlike what you’ve seen before. Where before, Phaedra seemed a dry, dying world whose wastelands stretched to the horizon, here now you’re surrounded by such dense foliage you’d be forgiven for thinking you’re back on Mhen’ga. Towering trees and thick, verdant brush flank the tracks on either side, making a canopy of green near as opaque as the tunnel.

	There’s still wildlife here, too, in all its alien glory. Huge bone-crested birds soar overhead, while six-legged felinids leap from the branches to catch doe-eyed lizard prey. Even at your speed you can hear the trill of insects, a chorus of life that seemed utterly washed away by the nuclear wastes you’ve been exploring.

	You’re starting to see why this Evermind is so intent on protecting it.
rows.translation:
。不久，一名迪弗拉尼工程师便通过扬声器发话，敦促所有人在列车抵达盾山下方的隧道之前回到座位，或者集中到未受损的车厢里。

	列车冲入黑暗时，惊恐的迪弗拉尼和努卡挤进车厢。红色应急灯的闪光从你两侧转瞬掠过；由于大部分窗户已经破碎，狂风从旁呼啸而过的惊人声浪毫无遮拦地灌入耳中。

	即便以列车亡命般的速度，穿越山脉也足足花了十分钟。你现在明白，为何艾尔辛从未想过徒步跨越山脉：它们甚至比从太空看时还要广袤。不过，这仍是对不久前醒来后所经历混乱与暴力的一次愉快喘息；等列车冲出黑暗时，你已经彻底恢复了精神。

	列车刚驶出隧道便开始减速，让你得以欣赏山脉另一侧的景象——一个与此前所见截然不同的全新世界。之前的菲德拉仿佛是一颗干旱、垂死的星球，荒原一直延伸到地平线；而此刻，你周围的植被如此浓密，说这里是门加恐怕也有人相信。高耸树木与茂盛翠绿的灌丛分列铁轨两旁，形成的绿色冠盖几乎和隧道一样密不透光。

	这里仍有野生动物，尽显异星奇景。头顶上，长着巨大骨冠的鸟类展翅翱翔；六足猫科动物则从树枝扑下，捕捉眼睛如雌鹿般温顺的蜥蜴猎物。即使列车疾驰，你也能听见昆虫鸣叫；这曲生命合唱仿佛早已被你探索过的核废土彻底冲刷殆尽。

	你开始明白，为何永恒心智如此执着于保护这里。

On behalf of the Phaedran Railway Corporation, we apologize for the disturbance on today’s journey.” The DEE-SL at the head of your car opens the door, and there’s a palpable sigh of relief from your fellow travelers. [flags.SHINEGLASS_JOHANA_IN_PARTY|Your cousin pushes [rival.himHer]self up and stretches. “Wow, what a ride, huh? I knew we were gonna make it.” “You’re welcome.” [rival.HeShe] grins over [rival.hisHer] shoulder. “Oh, I meant because I’m clearly your good luck charm. You never seem to fail when I’m around.” “Yeah, maybe there’s something to that.” [rival.name] sticks out [rival.hisHer] tongue and laces [rival.hisHer] fingers behind [rival.hisHer] head. “See you around, [pc.name].” You’ve got a feeling you know where. You wave as [rival.name] and Johana depart.] [flags.SHINEGLASS_ELYSTIEL_FREED| Elystiel lifts her head from where it’s been resting against your shoulder, rubbing the sleep from her misty grey eyes. “Hmm? The train has stopped. Have we finally arrived?” “We have,” you tell her, running a hand through her downy head-feathers. “Do you know what you’ll do now?” She shakes her head. “I have never been beyond the Curtain before, and I’m afraid I could not find my way back to my tribe even if I wanted. But we are now in the personal domain of the holy Evermind... I cannot imagine anywhere safer for me to stay. At least, if I stick close to the platform. I can’t imagine venturing into the great forest alone! Would you walk me out, please?” She takes your hand with a smile. “My hero!”] You dismount the train a moment later, stepping out onto another covered platform much like the first - though this one has a dozen DEE-SLs standing at attention around the place, more heavily armed and armored than the ones on the train. Divrani and nuka wearing crimson robes are rushing to examine the damage done to the cars and engine, dragging bulky power tools and their generators onto the platform, weaving between dazed passengers. [flags.SHINEGLASS_DEFEATED_WARMISTRESS| A pair of armored DEE-SLs are manhandling Hureya out of the engine. She’s been stripped of her arms and armor, leaving her brazenly nude. A thick, knotted black cock wobbles between her legs as she’s pushed towards a stockade at the far end of the platform.] Above you, the verdant canopy of the forest looms. Birds and small frog-like creatures leap between the branches, filling the air with falling leaves and the sounds of life. It’s hard to believe you’re still on the same planet after all that...
rows.translation: “现已抵达盾岩站。菲德拉铁路公司谨为今日旅途中发生的骚乱致歉。” 你所在车厢前端的DEE-SL打开车门，同行旅客们明显齐齐松了口气。 [flags.SHINEGLASS_JOHANA_IN_PARTY|你的表亲让[rival.himHer]自己撑起身体，伸了个懒腰。“哇，这趟旅程够刺激的，对吧？我早就知道我们肯定能到。” “不用谢。” [rival.HeShe]越过[rival.hisHer]肩头回望，冲你咧嘴一笑。“哦，我的意思是，这显然因为我是你的幸运符。我在场的时候，你好像从来不会失败。” “是啊，也许真有点道理。” [rival.name]吐了吐[rival.hisHer]舌头，把[rival.hisHer]手指交叠在[rival.hisHer]脑后。“回头见，[pc.name]。” 你觉得自己知道会在哪里碰面。你挥手目送[rival.name]和乔安娜离开。] [flags.SHINEGLASS_ELYSTIEL_FREED| 艾莉丝蒂尔从一直倚靠着的你的肩头抬起脑袋，揉去朦胧灰眼里的睡意。“嗯？列车停下了。我们终于到了吗？” “到了，”你一边告诉她，一边用手梳过她覆着绒羽的头部。“你知道接下来要做什么吗？” 她摇了摇头。“我以前从未离开过帷幕，就算想回去，恐怕也找不到通往部族的路。不过我们如今身处神圣永恒心智的私人领域...我想象不出还有哪里比这里更适合我留下。至少，只要我待在站台附近。我可不敢想象独自闯进那片大森林！你能陪我出去吗？” 她微笑着牵起你的手。“我的英雄！”] 片刻后，你走下列车，踏上另一座与先前颇为相似的有顶站台；不过这里有十几台DEE-SL在四周列队戒备，武器和装甲都比列车上的型号更为厚重。身穿深红长袍的迪弗拉尼和努卡人匆忙检查车厢与引擎遭受的损伤，将笨重的电动工具和发电机拖上站台，在神情恍惚的乘客之间来回穿梭。 [flags.SHINEGLASS_DEFEATED_WARMISTRESS| 两台装甲DEE-SL正粗暴地把胡蕾雅从引擎里拖出来。她的武器和护甲已被全部卸下，身体毫无遮掩地赤裸着。一根粗壮、打结的黑色阴茎在她双腿之间摇晃；她被押往站台远端的一座刑枷。] 头顶上方，森林葱郁的树冠高高耸立。鸟类和小型蛙状生物在枝桠间跳跃，纷纷落叶与旺盛的生命之声充盈着空气。 经历了这一切之后，很难相信你仍身处同一颗星球...

rows.original: You escort Elystiel to somewhere open and relatively sheltered for her to sit down.
rows.translation: 你护送艾莉丝蒂尔到一处开阔且相对有遮蔽的地方坐下。
rows.raw: "You escort Elystiel to somewhere open and relatively sheltered for her to sit down. "

rows.original: When you turn to try and find the exit, you find Elcine waiting for you.
rows.translation: 你转身寻找出口时，发现艾尔辛正在等你。
rows.raw: "When you turn to try and find the exit, you find Elcine waiting for you. "

rows.original: She’s grinning and wagging her stumpy little tail. “Thanks to you, we’ve arrived only slightly behind schedule! I am sure you’re interested in consulting with Her Holiness, aren’t you?”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴笑着，不断摇晃短短的尾巴。“多亏了你，我们只比计划稍微晚到一点！我相信你一定很想拜会圣座，对吧？”
rows.raw: "She’s grinning and wagging her stumpy little tail. “Thanks to you, we’ve arrived only slightly behind schedule! I am sure you’re interested in consulting with Her Holiness, aren’t you?”"

rows.original: She’s looking wrung-out and weary. Streaks of hyrax-spooge sully her tattered robes, but it looks like the lady herself made it out mostly alright despite your abandoning her. “Despite everything... we’re only slightly behind schedule,” she sighs. “I suppose you will want to meet with Her Holiness now, right?”
rows.translation: 她看起来疲惫不堪。海拉克西精液的痕迹弄脏了她破烂的长袍，但尽管你抛弃了她，这位女士本人似乎基本安然无恙。“不管怎样...我们只比计划稍微晚到一点，”她叹道。“我想你现在想去拜见圣座，对吧？”
rows.raw: "She’s looking wrung-out and weary. Streaks of hyrax-spooge sully her tattered robes, but it looks like the lady herself made it out mostly alright despite your abandoning her. “Despite everything... we’re only slightly behind schedule,” she sighs. “I suppose you will want to meet with Her Holiness now, right?”"

rows.original: “Is she really here in this forest?” you ask, glancing around. Elcine nods. “Oh, yes, Emberian. The Great Synod is located a short distance from here.” Elcine points north, towards the tallest of the Shield Mountains. “If she wills it, the Evermind will grant you audience.” “And if not?” “Then you’ll probably be atomized for your hubris!” Elcine chirps blithely. “But I’m sure [var0|if that happens, you’ll have deserved it!|that won’t happen!]” Great, so that’s your next destination, then: the Great Synod of the Evermind. “I’ll be here if you need me!” Elcine says, glancing at her compatriots in red. “The DEE-SLs will need several days of maintenance rites after what they’ve been through.”
rows.translation: “她真的就在这片森林里？”你环顾四周问道。 艾尔辛点点头。“哦，是的，余烬人。大议会距离这里不远。”艾尔辛指向北方，盾山最高峰的方向。“如果她愿意，永恒心智会准许你觐见。” “如果不愿意呢？” “那你大概会因为傲慢而被原子化！”艾尔辛轻快地说道。“不过我相信[var0|真发生的话，你肯定也是罪有应得！|不会发生的！]” 太好了，那就是你的下一处目的地：永恒心智大议会。 “有需要的话我就在这里！”艾尔辛瞥向那些红衣同伴说道。“DEE-SL经历了这些事情后，需要进行数日维护仪式。”

rows.original: Give your spare ticket to Hureya. It’s very likely this will mean her disappearing for good.
rows.translation: 把备用车票交给胡蕾娅。这很可能意味着她会永远消失。

rows.translation: 离开
胡蕾娅

rows.original: “Hold your hand out.” Frowning at you suspiciously, the hench hyrax does so. You take the yellowed ticket stub and delicately wedge it between two furry, water bottle-sized claws. She stares at it in almost comic disbelief. “You... uh... hey. HEY!” She yells piercingly down the platform to the DEE-SLs, frantically waving the tiny piece of paper with the small range of motion available to her. “I’ve got a ticket! You have to let me out now!” A worried murmur goes up amongst the assemblage of beings on the platform as one of the curvaceous robots sashays over. Her eyes gleam green as they land on the outstretched ticket. With a hiss and a click, the metal pillory releases at one end. “Thank you, valued customer!” the DEE-SL says sweetly. “Please bear in mind the rules and regulations of PRC Transit in future. We wish you a pleasant journey home.” Hureya pushes the upper block off her and slowly rises to her full seven feet of height. Her dark eyes land on you... and then they close. She puts her hands on her lower back and pushes. There’s an audible series of cracks. “Ahhh fuck,” she groans. “You’ve no idea how good that feels.” She considers you with an unreadable expression, still rubbing her back. “... You defeated me. Now you’re letting me go. Even though you know if our positions were reversed, I never would.” She shakes her head, baring her teeth in confusion. “Why?”
rows.translation: “把手伸出来。” 壮硕的蹄兔人怀疑地皱着眉，还是照做了。你拿起那张发黄的票根，小心翼翼地把它塞进两根毛茸茸、足有水瓶粗细的爪指之间。她盯着票根，脸上写满了近乎滑稽的难以置信。 “你...呃...嘿，嘿！”她疯狂挥动那张小纸片，竭力利用仅剩的少许活动空间，朝站台另一头的DEE-SL发出刺耳高喊。“我有票了！现在你们必须放我出去！” 站台上聚集的众人之间响起一阵不安的低语，一名曲线玲珑的机器人摇曳着走来。她的目光落到伸出的车票上，双眼泛起绿色光芒。伴随一声嘶响与轻响，金属颈枷的一端解锁了。 “感谢您，尊贵的乘客！”DEE-SL甜甜地说道。“今后请牢记菲德拉铁路公司公共交通的规章制度。祝您返程愉快。” 胡蕾娅推开压在身上的上半块枷锁，缓缓站直七英尺高的身躯。她漆黑的双眼落在你身上...随后闭了起来。她双手按住后腰，往前一挺。一连串清脆的关节爆响清晰可闻。 “啊，操。”她呻吟道。“你根本想不到这有多舒服。”她仍揉着后腰，以难以解读的神情审视你。“...你打败了我。现在却要放我走。哪怕你知道，如果我们处境互换，我绝不会这么做。”她摇了摇头，困惑地龇起牙齿。“为什么？”
