rows.original: “So these trains seem like a big deal,” you muse. “Oh, yes!” Elcine says, gesticulating towards the kiosk. “It’s by the grace of these blessed rails that our world remains connected. Almost all communications devices were fried in the Glass War: satellites crashed, phone lines and network cables burned to ashes, and e-pulses burned out most computers. Even roads were obliterated, since most of them were raised above the ground by then! Every community that survived the war became isolated... except for the trains. The rails are seated deep in the ground to protect them from stormwinds and to not inconvenience vehicles, so they survived anything but direct blasts just fine.” “And the trains themselves did, too?” “Mmhm! The Phaedran Railway Corporation hardened all their technology against e-pulses. Ignorant fools called the enlightened President Zemmran a wastrel and worse for his decision, but it is due to his foresight that modern Phaedra endures! Sure, there’s a lotta people that aren’t connected by trains, but there’s enough that are that we can still call ourselves a civilization! We’re doubly blessed that many of the rail company’s robots remain operational, even after more than a century of neglect. The Sisterhood is constantly finding more robots and more stations on unexplored, previously-inaccessible branch routes. The more we explore, the more of the world we connect, and the greater our understanding of robotics becomes!” “But I take it not everyone is as respectful of the railway...” Her shoulders slump a little. “Yeah, that’s one way to put it. Because of how important the trains are — because they’re the only way we can move people and heavy goods around the wasteland — they’re super tempting targets for all kinds of apostates! Raiders and warboys target them all the time, but even they try not to permanently damage the trains. After all, if you know when and where a constant supply of stuff to steal is gonna be, why would you disrupt that? They grapple on and take what they can before the Dee-SL bots manage to drive them off. It’s a vicious cycle we can never really get out of.” “Can’t you just... get rid of the raiders?” “No,” Elcine sighs. “The Evermind’s ability to project that kind of power outside the Curtain of Light is... not what it used to be. The raiders are agile and move their bases all the time, and they rarely if ever really hurt anybody anyway. They want to steal, because they’re desperate and they don’t have access to what we have, and they’re too used to their wild lifestyle to adapt to ours — and we’ve tried so, so many times. It just doesn’t work in over ninety-five percent of cases, and when it does, they just end up feeling like aliens. So they raid the trains, and we fight them off, and it repeats forever. Someday I’m sure the great Evermind will find a way to reincorporate them into civilization, but right now she cleeeeearly has bigger rads to cleanse.”
rows.translation: “所以这些火车似乎非常重要，”你沉吟道。 “哦，当然！”艾尔辛指向售票亭说道。“正是蒙受这些神圣铁轨的恩典，我们的世界才依然彼此相连。几乎所有通信设备都在玻璃战争中烧毁：卫星坠落，电话线和网络电缆化作灰烬，电磁脉冲则烧坏了大多数计算机。就连道路也被摧毁，因为那时大部分道路都架设在地面之上！每个从战争幸存的聚居地都陷入孤立...火车除外。铁轨深埋地下，既能抵御风暴狂风，也不会妨碍车辆，因此除了直接爆炸外，任何灾难都没能摧毁它们。” “列车本身也幸存了？” “嗯哼！菲德拉铁路公司对所有科技都进行了电磁脉冲加固。无知蠢货因为这个决定，把英明的泽姆兰总裁骂成败家子甚至更糟；可现代菲德拉正是凭他的远见才得以延续！当然，有许多人没有火车连接，但被连接的人仍然足够多，让我们还能自称文明！更值得庆幸的是，即使经历超过一个世纪无人维护，铁路公司的许多机器人仍在运作。修女会一直在未探索、过去无法通行的支线上发现更多机器人和车站。探索得越多，我们连接的世界便越广，对机器人技术的理解也越深！” “不过，我猜你说并非所有人都这样尊重铁路...” 她的肩膀微微垂下。“是啊，也可以这么说。正因为列车如此重要——因为它们是我们在荒原运输人员和重型货物的唯一手段——它们对各种异教徒来说都是极具诱惑力的目标！袭击者与战争男孩始终盯着列车，不过就连他们也尽量不造成永久破坏。毕竟，如果你知道稳定战利品会在何时何地出现，又何必打断供应？他们用钩索登车，尽力掠夺，直到DEE-SL机器人将其赶走。这是我们永远无法真正摆脱的恶性循环。” “你们不能直接...消灭袭击者吗？” “不能，”艾尔辛叹道。“永恒心智向光幕外投射这种力量的能力...早已不复从前。袭击者行动敏捷，总在转移基地，而且他们几乎从未真正伤害任何人。他们偷窃是因为走投无路，无法获得我们拥有的东西；他们又太习惯狂野生活，无法适应我们的方式——而且我们已经尝试了许多、许多次。超过百分之九十五的案例都不会成功；即使成功，他们最终也只会感觉自己像异乡人。所以他们袭击列车，我们击退他们，然后永远重复。总有一天，我相信伟大的永恒心智会找到办法，让他们重新融入文明；可眼下，她显——然还有更大片辐射污染需要净化。”

rows.original: “How about you let me take a look at that?” you suggest, nodding towards the ticket machine. Elcine chews her lower lip, thumbing her wrench-staff. “Okay. I gotta admit, I’m kinda stuck. Just, promise you’ll be gentle with it. There’s only one of these, and the train’s not coming until somebody buys a ticket off it one way or another.” You step up and look over the plush lizard-girl’s shoulder. The device’s monochrome CRT screen is currently reading: ++ERROR++ ++CODE 404: SERVER CONNECTION NOT FOUND++ ++PLEASE CONTACT AN EMPLOYEE FOR ASSISTANCE++ Beneath the error is a stylized emblem of a sleek electric train cresting a globe, underneath a crest proudly proclaiming “Phaedran Railway Corporation: Connecting the World Since 1725!” You don’t think you’ll be finding any employees around, so it’s up to you to improvise.
rows.translation: “不如让我看看那个？”你指着售票机提议道。 艾尔辛咬着下唇，手指摩挲着她的扳手法杖。“好吧。我得承认，我确实有点束手无策了。只要答应我，你会温柔地对待它。这东西只有一台，而且不管用什么办法，总得有人从它这里买到票，列车才会来。” 你走上前，越过这名丰满蜥蜴姑娘的肩膀查看。设备的单色阴极射线管屏幕上目前显示着： ++错误++ ++代码404：未找到服务器连接++ ++请联系工作人员寻求协助++ 错误信息下方是一枚设计别致的徽记，一列流线型电气列车正越过一颗星球，徽章底下则自豪地宣称：“菲德拉铁路公司：自1725年起连接世界！” 你觉得这里恐怕找不到任何工作人员，所以只能靠你随机应变了。

rows.original: You rear a [pc.foot] back and give the fritzed machine a good ol’ bonk, hard as you can. The screen is overtaken by static, and a few sparks shoot out from the bottom of the panel Elcine was working on. The lizard-girl squeaks in horror, flailing her arms and all but tripping over herself to try and stop you. But all she does is eat pavement, and you get to watch that giant ass quake like crazy while the computer reboots itself. You must’ve knocked something into place, because the screen flickers one last time and replaces the error message with a loading bar. A second later, and the device plays a cheery musical trill, and the screen swipes away in a rain of blocky pixels that form into the rail company’s logo. A keyboard flicks open under the screen, and you hear a whirring from an open slot that looks ticket-sized. “Y-y-you promised!” Elcine wails, clutching at the device like a protective mother. “How could you hit it!?” “Well, it worked,” you [pc.nmh|say reassuringly, trying to draw her attention to the screen.|chuckle. “See?”|shrug. “Look for yourself.”] She blinks back tears and looks up. Her stubby little tail starts wiggling under her robe, shaking the loose fabric around; before you know it she’s hopped back up to her feet and is eagerly poking at the keyboard and chanting prayers to her techno-god. “Woah, it worked! rows.original: Oh, God. Did you just warp into a graveyard? After a few more long, tense moments, you’re able to navigate your way out of the debris field. Your long range sensors finally spool back up once you’re clear, painting you a picture of the planet below: it’s a dry desert, and seems to have an unusually high radiation index - enough to be dangerous with prolonged exposure, though not so much that it would penetrate your shields or a hardened structure. There’s life down there, but much less than any Rush world you’ve visited before, and hardly any of the Q-COMM traffic that would indicate a presence of other Rushers. Considering the plethora of wrecks drifting in orbit, it’s easy to guess why: your predecessors never made it to the surface. But what happened to them?
rows.translation: 哦，天啊。你刚刚跃迁进了一座墓场？ 又过了几个漫长而紧张的瞬间，你终于成功驶出碎片场。脱离之后，远程传感器终于重新启动，为你描绘出下方星球的景象：那里是一片干旱沙漠，而且似乎有着异常高的辐射指数——长期暴露足以带来危险，但还不至于穿透飞船护盾或加固建筑。下面存在生命，不过远少于你以前去过的任何淘金热世界，也几乎没有表明其他淘金客存在的量子通信流量。考虑到轨道中漂浮的无数残骸，原因不难猜测：你的前辈根本没能抵达地表。但他们究竟遭遇了什么？
rows.raw: " Oh, God. Did you just warp into a graveyard? After a few more long, tense moments, you’re able to navigate your way out of the debris field. Your long range sensors finally spool back up once you’re clear, painting you a picture of the planet below: it’s a dry desert, and seems to have an unusually high radiation index - enough to be dangerous with prolonged exposure, though not so much that it would penetrate your shields or a hardened structure. There’s life down there, but much less than any Rush world you’ve visited before, and hardly any of the Q-COMM traffic that would indicate a presence of other Rushers. Considering the plethora of wrecks drifting in orbit, it’s easy to guess why: your predecessors never made it to the surface. But what happened to them?"

rows.translation: 继续
攻击？!

rows.original: When your airlock finishes cycling, and the boarding ramp descends, you step out into the arid desert of the world for the first time. It’s not as hot as you’d have expected after seeing the desert from orbit. You suppose whatever killed most of the planet’s plant life is more responsible for the wasteland than the sun. The first bold step out of the airlock takes you-
rows.translation: 气闸完成循环、登船坡道降下后，你第一次走入这个世界的干旱沙漠。这里没有从轨道看见沙漠时预想的那么炎热。你猜，摧毁星球大部分植物的东西，比太阳更应该为这片荒原负责。你大胆迈出气闸的第一步——
rows.raw: "When your airlock finishes cycling, and the boarding ramp descends, you step out into the arid desert of the world for the first time. It’s not as hot as you’d have expected after seeing the desert from orbit. You suppose whatever killed most of the planet’s plant life is more responsible for the wasteland than the sun. The first bold step out of the airlock takes you-"

rows.original: BONK! You recoil back into the airlock, palming your [pc.weapon] as something impacts [pc_ship.theName]’s hull. It’s not enough to flare your shields, but the echo of the hit jolts your bones.
rows.translation: 咚！ 你缩回气闸，一手按住[pc.weapon]；某个东西撞上[pc_ship.theName]船体。力道不足以激起护盾，但撞击回声震得你骨头发麻。
rows.raw: " BONK! You recoil back into the airlock, palming your [pc.weapon] as something impacts [pc_ship.theName]’s hull. It’s not enough to flare your shields, but the echo of the hit jolts your bones."

rows.original: BONK! Again! You peer out, warily looking for the source of the attack. You find her far quicker than expected, however...
rows.translation: 咚！ 又来了！你警惕地向外窥视，寻找袭击来源。不过，你比预想更快发现了她...
rows.raw: " BONK! Again! You peer out, warily looking for the source of the attack. You find her far quicker than expected, however..."

rows.translation: 继续

[flags.ELCINE_APPROACH
		|Elcine is [var0
			|intoning prayers of encouragement to the beleaguered ticket machine, filling the air around it with blessed incense.
			|still leaning over the damaged ticket machine, trying to repair it with prayers and incantations as much as with her whirring combi-tool.

rows.raw: "[flags.ELCINE_APPROACH|Have a chat with the techno-lizard cleric.|Investigate the lizardy tech-enthusiast.]"

rows.original: Elcine is still here at Shieldrock Station, along with a group of other red-robed techno-clergy who’re tending to the massive armored train as it recovers from its last sojourn across the wasteland. The pudgy divrani’s treated with a measure of respect and deference not just among the crimson priests, but the commonfolk among the natives too. She seems in her element, relatively speaking, leading the team of engineers with a smile on her face.
rows.translation: 艾尔辛仍在盾岩站，与其他一群红袍科技神职人员待在一起；他们正在照料刚完成上一趟荒原旅程、恢复中的巨型装甲列车。这个丰满迪弗拉尼不仅受到深红祭司相当程度的尊重与礼遇，在本地平民中也是如此。相对而言，她显得如鱼得水，面带微笑地领导工程师队伍。

rows.translation: 看看能否与这位科技牧师私下相处一会儿。

rows.original: Vermillion aims for your face with her Sunfire Fists.
rows.translation: 朱红用阳炎拳瞄准你的脸。
rows.raw: "Vermillion aims for your face with her Sunfire Fists."

rows.original: Vermillion [silly|feeds [target.combatName] a mean knuckle sammich|strikes true]!
rows.translation: 朱红[silly|给[target.combatName]来了一份狠辣的拳头三明治|准确命中]！
rows.raw: " Vermillion [silly|feeds [target.combatName] a mean knuckle sammich|strikes true]!"

rows.original: The red nuka’s strike goes wide.
rows.translation: 红色努卡的一拳打偏了。
rows.raw: " The red nuka’s strike goes wide."

rows.translation: 你被击晕了！
被击晕了！

rows.original: The armored nun spews searing clouds of plasmatic flames your way.
rows.translation: 身穿装甲的修女朝你喷出炽烈的等离子火云。
rows.raw: "The armored nun spews searing clouds of plasmatic flames your way."

rows.translation: 地狱之火灼烧了[target.combatName]！

rows.original: You manage to dodge the infernal heat thanks to your heightened reflexes.
rows.translation: 凭借敏锐反射，你成功躲过了地狱般的高热。
rows.raw: " You manage to dodge the infernal heat thanks to your heightened reflexes."

rows.translation: 烧伤！

rows.original: Vermillion’s brilliant feathers shine brighter than ever as she soars through the air like a beautiful angel. She’ll be harder to hit.
rows.translation: 朱红灿烂的羽毛比以往更加耀眼；她像美丽天使一样飞过空中，变得更难命中。
rows.raw: "Vermillion’s brilliant feathers shine brighter than ever as she soars through the air like a beautiful angel. She’ll be harder to hit."

rows.translation: 她不再处于绊倒状态！

rows.original: Thanks to your quick reflexes, you manage to cover your [pc.eyes] before the sudden flares can blind you.
rows.translation: 多亏反应迅速，你在突然闪光致盲前及时遮住[pc.eyes]。
rows.raw: " Thanks to your quick reflexes, you manage to cover your [pc.eyes] before the sudden flares can blind you."

rows.original: Good thing you can’t be blinded!
rows.translation: 幸好你不会被致盲！
rows.raw: " Good thing you can’t be blinded!"

rows.original: With a sudden flash of light You are blind!
rows.translation: 随着骤然闪光，你失明了！
rows.raw: " With a sudden flash of light You are blind!"

rows.original: Flying, cannot be struck by normal melee attacks!
rows.translation: 正在飞行，普通近战攻击无法命中！
rows.raw: "Flying, cannot be struck by normal melee attacks!"

rows.original: Vermillion’s backpack irradiates with power, power that makes her plasma caster’s coils spin with crackling sparks of infernal particles. “Feel the Everqueen’s might!” In the blink of an eye, her Sunfire Fists unleash a volley of supercharged plasma.
rows.translation: 朱红的背包迸发出强大能量，使等离子炮线圈旋转，噼啪喷溅着地狱粒子火花。 “感受永恒女王的威力！” 转瞬之间，她的阳炎拳便释放出一轮超充能等离子齐射。
rows.raw: "Vermillion’s backpack irradiates with power, power that makes her plasma caster’s coils spin with crackling sparks of infernal particles. “Feel the Everqueen’s might!” In the blink of an eye, her Sunfire Fists unleash a volley of supercharged plasma. "

rows.original: Despite your best efforts to dodge her salvo, the searing bolts of electromagnetic fire burn your [pc.skinFurScales] with their volcanic payload! A loud hiss followed by black fumes coming from the armored nun’s equipment stops the virulent assault; she won’t be able to pull this trick again.
rows.translation: 尽管你尽力闪避齐射，灼热的电磁火焰弹仍以火山般载荷烧伤了[pc.skinFurScales]！一声响亮嘶鸣过后，黑烟从装甲修女的装备冒出，终于结束这场凶猛攻击；她无法再使出这一招。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite your best efforts to dodge her salvo, the searing bolts of electromagnetic fire burn your [pc.skinFurScales] with their volcanic payload! A loud hiss followed by black fumes coming from the armored nun’s equipment stops the virulent assault; she won’t be able to pull this trick again."

rows.original: You evade the many bolts of volcanic energy, forcing the angry paladin to increase her fire rate to dangerous levels. A loud hiss and black fumes coming from the armored nun’s equipment stop the virulent assault a few moments later. Vermillion pouts as she turns her power output down to a more stable setting. She won’t be able to pull this trick again.
rows.translation: 你避开无数火山能量弹，迫使愤怒圣骑士把射速提高到危险程度。片刻后，装甲修女的装备发出响亮嘶鸣并冒出黑烟，终结这场凶猛攻击。朱红噘起嘴，把能量输出调回更加稳定的设置。她无法再使出这一招。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou evade the many bolts of volcanic energy, forcing the angry paladin to increase her fire rate to dangerous levels. A loud hiss and black fumes coming from the armored nun’s equipment stop the virulent assault a few moments later. Vermillion pouts as she turns her power output down to a more stable setting. She won’t be able to pull this trick again."

rows.original: “You are going down!” Vermillion shouts, deploying a crackling whip out of her tail before flailing it your way.
rows.translation: “你死定了！”朱红喊道，从尾巴弹出噼啪作响的长鞭，朝你挥来。
rows.raw: "“You are going down!” Vermillion shouts, deploying a crackling whip out of her tail before flailing it your way."

rows.original: The electric lash hits your where it hurts
rows.translation: 电鞭击中你的痛处
rows.raw: "\n\nThe electric lash hits your where it hurts"

                              )
                            : "".concat(n ? "," : "") + n ? "knocking [target.combatName] back" : ""

rows.translation: ，并吸取你的护盾
，除此之外还
击退[target.combatName]

rows.original: Thanks to your superior reflexes, you evade the shocking lashes with ease.
rows.translation: 凭借更胜一筹的反射速度，你轻松避开电击鞭挞。
rows.raw: "\n\nThanks to your superior reflexes, you evade the shocking lashes with ease."

rows.original: Vermillion squirms, big beads of sweat trickling down her face as her flaring horsecock bubbles with musky alabaster. “Forgive me Goddess, I can’t hold it anymore!” Suddenly, the cleric shoots fat ropes of fresh, virile spunk your way.
rows.translation: 朱红扭动身体，大颗汗珠沿脸颊流下；她勃起的马鸡巴冒出带麝香气味的乳白液体。“女神原谅我，我再也忍不住了！” 修女忽然朝你射出一股股新鲜而充满生机的粗大精液。
rows.raw: "Vermillion squirms, big beads of sweat trickling down her face as her flaring horsecock bubbles with musky alabaster. “Forgive me Goddess, I can’t hold it anymore!”\n\n\t\tSuddenly, the cleric shoots fat ropes of fresh, virile spunk your way."

rows.original: The warm, salty discharge hits you in the face, spiking your lust to new highs and darkening your cheeks with a deep blush. Your opponent’s garnet cheeks and the tension in her loins leave no doubt she won’t be able to pull another shot like this.
rows.translation: 温热咸涩的排液击中你的脸，让欲火飙升到全新高度，双颊也因强烈羞红而变暗。对手石榴红的脸颊和胯间紧绷感无疑表明，她无法再次发动这种射击。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe warm, salty discharge hits you in the face, spiking your lust to new highs and darkening your cheeks with a deep blush. Your opponent’s garnet cheeks and the tension in her loins leave no doubt she won’t be able to pull another shot like this."

rows.original: The viscous payload goes wide, staining the soil with the nuka’s spent splooge. That was close! Vermillion’s garnet cheeks and the tension in her loins leave no doubt she won’t be able to pull another shot like this.
rows.translation: 黏稠载荷从旁掠过，把努卡射出的精液染在土壤上。真险！朱红石榴红的脸颊和胯间紧绷感无疑表明，她无法再次发动这种射击。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe viscous payload goes wide, staining the soil with the nuka’s spent splooge. That was close! Vermillion’s garnet cheeks and the tension in her loins leave no doubt she won’t be able to pull another shot like this."

rows.original: “I’ll suck the evil out of you like one extracts venom out of a wound.” The nuka’s luminous marks shine bright as a strong pressure knocks against your mind. She’s trying to do something nasty!
rows.translation: “我要像从伤口吸出毒液那样，把邪恶从你体内吸出来。”努卡身上的发光纹路变得明亮，一股强大压力撞向你的意识。她正打算做些狠毒的事！
rows.raw: "“I’ll suck the evil out of you like one extracts venom out of a wound.” The nuka’s luminous marks shine bright as a strong pressure knocks against your mind. She’s trying to do something nasty!"

rows.original: Vermillion snatches a big ball of green energy out of [target.combatName] and absorbs it in her body. A feeling of emptiness chills your bones as she savors your lifeforce!
rows.translation: 朱红从[target.combatName]体内夺出一大团绿色能量，吸收进自己身体。当她品尝你的生命力时，空虚感令你寒入骨髓！
rows.raw: "\n\nVermillion snatches a big ball of green energy out of [target.combatName] and absorbs it in her body. A feeling of emptiness chills your bones as she savors your lifeforce!"

rows.translation: 受到深度冻结影响！

rows.original: Thanks to your quick thinking, you manage to escape the leeching force trying to vampirize your lifeforce away.
rows.translation: 多亏思维敏捷，你成功逃离那股试图吸走生命力的汲取力量。
rows.raw: "\n\nThanks to your quick thinking, you manage to escape the leeching force trying to vampirize your lifeforce away."

rows.original: “The Everqueen protects!” Vermillion shouts before surrounding herself in a nimbus of protective light. Her wounds close and a shield of glowing, telekinetic energy covers her with an armor of righteous fury.
rows.translation: “永恒女王庇护！”朱红喊道，随后用保护性光晕笼罩自己。她的伤口闭合，一层闪耀的念动力能量护盾覆盖全身，化作正义怒火的铠甲。
rows.raw: "“The Everqueen protects!” Vermillion shouts before surrounding herself in a nimbus of protective light. Her wounds close and a shield of glowing, telekinetic energy covers her with an armor of righteous fury."

rows.original: An ominous aura surrounds Vermillion’s body with a gloaming light. The twilight shroud reinforces her features’ demonic air while a supernatural vitality infuses the holy warrior with power. “The Evermind lends me her wrath, pray that I don’t unleash all of it against [target.combatName]!”

rows.original: “Can you tell me more about yourself? [flags.VERMI_TLK_HERSELF |It’s been a while since our last meeting |I don’t think I’ve seen anyone like you before ].” The nuka nun nods. “Of course my child. What do you want to know about myself?” “Your origins to start? How were you raised and who’s the woman behind the veil?” “There’s not a lot to tell, to be honest. I was raised in the Radwood, with the Evermind’s flock. I don’t know who my parents were. My adoptive father found my egg in the deepest, darkest parts of our Goddess’s bountiful garden — I’ll let you imagine the surprise on his face when I hatched in his hands.” An adopted nuka? That’s a surprising background. Are her close ones also involved in the tech cult operating in the area? “My family serves the Order of Our Martyred Wires, the Evermind’s scavengers and food providers. I grew up surrounded with divrani brothers and sisters that never remarked on my peculiar skin tone. One of the higher clerics suspects it might be a very rare case of nuka albinism but our scholars didn’t find anything akin to it in my blood, so my predicament is still a mystery to me — even the many nuka I met through my travels were none the wiser.” You slowly tilt your head. “Your travels? Are you a missionary?” The shapely paladin giggles. “Excuse me my child, a glowing thought crossed my mind. To answer your question, I’m more like an adventurer or ruins raider. Don’t get me wrong, I’ll gladly bring the Evermind’s brilliant light to whoever wants to find shelter under her bountiful aura, but my duties are entirely different,” she says before showing you a small map of your surroundings on her ancient datapad. “The Order of Our Martyred Wires — the division I belong to — is tasked with investigating each of the [var0 |mutated glades |tainted derelicts ] and identifying what scourged it. Depending on how dire the corruption is, it’s up to us to decide how the place must be secured, contained, or protected before someone weaker to the glow than I can be injured — or worse — by the dangerous spot. It’s not an easy or safe job but I wouldn’t trade places for all of the sweet lollipops in the world,” she says, tapping a bag full of treats attached to her belt. “It sounds like a very dangerous job. Were you trained specifically for it?” “No, I was supposed to become a field plow- I mean worker — with my other siblings, but one of the dragon warriors picked a few of us to pass tests. To my surprise, I was deemed worthy of serving in the Evermind’s holy guard and had to go through a rough training routine to prepare my body and soul to the dangers of the Glass. My family is always worried for my sake when I leave our Goddess’s verdant shelter, but this is a sacrifice I’m more than willing to make, if it means my siblings and their offspring won’t see the horrors dwelling under the arid rocks and stained sands.” Weird that they’d recruit the only atypical nuka they had into their militia, especially since she wasn’t meant to be a fighter to begin with. Does she know why she was taken and given these tasks? Vermillion nods. “I was integrated in the Order of Our Martyred Wires because of my resistance to the glow and psionic abilities. Not only can I withstand the highest amounts of corrupting waves, but I can also use my powers to channel the Evermind’s might and defend myself against the hyraxi’s witchboys, the shalinae’s shamans, and my own race’s psykers. I’m also very good at tail whips, but that’s a story for another time.” “Thanks to my gift, I can go to the deepest, darkest, most glow-touched places to recover pre-Glass weapons and relics before people with ill intents do and use them against us. I’m a knight-errant, amateur engineer, and self-taught archeologist condensed into a merciful nuka. Today, for example, I recovered an ancient targeting system that was salvaged by a hyraxi warband. It was quite easy to knock them out in the dark, but I still can’t understand why they used satellite-grade electronics to customize their rig’s hooter,” the puzzled priestess mumbles. “Do you miss your family?” Vermillion reaches for her twinkling datapad and swipes a couple of times up before raising her eyes on you. “I miss them a lot. Sometimes I’m away from them for months, so I keep some trinkets and souvenirs of them to stay strong. The Evermind’s love can’t fill all the holes their absence leaves in my heart,” the armored cleric admits before showing you a picture of her surrounded by about a dozen adult divrani, ranging from light yellow to dark green. “My parents are here,” she says, pointing at a couple of more wrinkled reptiles on the left, “their families are fruit gatherers and farmers in the Radwood since before the Glass. All my other siblings are too, except Saku,” she adds, pointing at the only yellow divrani girl clad in robes. “She joined the temple a year before me and quickly became a very skilled techie. I think she claimed a rusty shipwreck for herself somewhere in the wastes. I hope she’s alright, since it’s on hyraxi lands.” Looking at the picture closely, you notice something in Vermillion’s hands, something fuzzy and with big, brown eyes. “It’s Firmin, my sweetheart, the light of my life, my baby boy. I hope he’s eating well and making lots of friends.” Wait, that’s her child? You didn’t expect her to be a mother — and of a hyraxi boy, no less! “I found him in a cave north of Nuka Town. I was about to leave the glow-infested tunnels when I heard something coming from the other side. Listening to my instincts, I followed the cries, expecting a trap from cruel bandits or from a heartless AI ready to do anything to satiate their demonic thirst for blood. Can you imagine my surprise when I found a tiny, famished hyraxi boy wrapped in rags? I did my best to feed him the rations I had and make him drink some water before looking for his parents, but there were no traces of blood, footsteps, or wheels left in the dusty ground. I flew over the canyons for hours with him nested against my belly in search for a [silly |yeen |hyraxi ] settlement in vain. Since I couldn’t find his genitors, I brought him to my mother and spent a couple of months pampering him. He’s been growing a lot lately,” she adds, showing you a couple more pics of her adopted son and her together. He must be about seven years old now, going by his looks. It’s a strange coincidence that the adopted girl ended up adopting a little boy too. “He’s looking good,” you agree. “An adorable ray of sunlight. I wonder what led his parents or tribe to abandon him.” Vermillion shrugs. “Life on this planet is rough and unforgiving. Few can withstand its cruelty and fewer can live comfortably here. According to father, his ancestor was the concubine of a hyraxi warmonger tasked to organize her warband while she and her sisters pillaged the settlements near the mountains. Father thinks that’s why his bloodline is less individualistic and more organized than the other divrani. His species isn’t one to build fortresses and raise civilizations. Divrani villages are extremely rare and familial structures even rarer, but I’m very glad to be his adopted daughter. I’ll see them again when I make my report to the temple. I hope Firmin will love the roasted shalin seeds I got for cleansing a robot-infested shrine,” she says. Before she can elaborate further, a weird glow under her clothes earns your attention. Is her body riddled with taint? “We nuka can regulate and store the insidious corruption better than others, but even I can’t leave unscathed,” she admits. “The more glow I store, the stronger my powers become. But it makes me have very impure thoughts — especially since I recovered this Emberian upgrade from one of the ships the Evermind’s dragon destroyed,” she adds, lifting her robes to reveal a large, animalistic sheath and a pair of musky, scarlet orbs dangling in front of an extra wet pussy. “As soon as I got it, I asked to see the Evermind for an exorcism. The Goddess told me she loved my new adornment and that it suited her righteous daughter well, so I kept it and used it since then to relieve pent-up suitors and spread our Mistress’s love,” she says, a very deep blush darkening her already crimson cheeks. “Good to know. Maybe I’ll need your services sooner or later,” you tease. The serene nun smiles. “And I’ll happily deliver. Is there anything else this faithful paladin can do for you?”
rows.translation: “能多说说你自己吗？[flags.VERMI_TLK_HERSELF |距离我们上次见面已经过去一段时间了 |我以前好像从没见过你这样的人 ]。” 努卡修女点点头。“当然可以，孩子。你想了解我的哪一方面？” “先从你的出身说起？你是怎么长大的，面纱后面的女人又有怎样的经历？” “老实说，没多少可讲的。我在辐射林里随永恒心智的羊群长大。我不知道亲生父母是谁。我的养父在女神丰饶花园最深、最黑暗的角落发现了我的蛋——我破壳而出落在他手里时，他脸上的惊讶就由你自己想象吧。” 一个被收养的努卡人？这出身可真出人意料。她亲近的人是否也加入了这一带活动的科技教团？ “我的家族侍奉殉道导线修会，为永恒心智搜寻物资、供应食物。我身边全是迪弗拉尼兄弟姐妹，他们从未议论过我奇特的肤色。一位高阶教士怀疑这可能是极其罕见的努卡白化现象，但学者们没在我的血液中找到类似迹象，因此我的情况对我仍是个谜——就连旅途中遇见的许多努卡人也毫无头绪。” 你缓缓歪头。“旅途？你是传教士吗？” 身材曼妙的圣骑士咯咯轻笑。“请原谅，孩子，刚才有个闪亮的念头从脑海划过。回答你的问题，我更像冒险家或遗迹掠夺者。别误会，只要有人愿意在永恒心智丰饶的光辉下寻求庇护，我很乐意把她灿烂的光芒带给对方，但我的职责完全不同，”她说着，在古老的数据板上向你展示一张附近地图。“我所属的殉道导线修会负责调查每一处[var0 |变异林间空地 |受污染的废墟 ]，查明是什么祸害侵蚀了那里。腐化程度不同，我们就要决定该封锁、遏制还是保护那片区域，以免比我更难抵抗辉光的人被危险地点伤害——甚至遭遇更糟的下场。这工作既不轻松也不安全，不过就算拿全世界的甜棒棒糖来换，我也不会与别人交换位置，”她说着，轻拍腰带上装满零食的袋子。 “听起来非常危险。你接受过专门训练吗？” “没有，我本来应该和其他手足一起当田间犁地——我是说劳作的工人，可一位龙战士选了我们几个人参加测试。没想到，我被认定有资格加入永恒心智的圣卫，于是接受了严酷训练，让身心做好面对辉晶之灾的准备。每次离开女神青翠的庇护，家人总会为我担忧；但只要能让我的兄弟姐妹和他们的后代不必目睹干旱岩石与污浊沙地之下栖息的恐怖，我非常愿意作出这样的牺牲。” 他们竟把唯一一个与众不同的努卡人征入民兵，而她原本甚至不该成为战士，这实在奇怪。她知道自己为何被选中、被赋予这些任务吗？ 维米利恩点点头。“我之所以被纳入殉道导线修会，是因为我对辉光的抗性和灵能能力。我不仅能承受最高强度的腐化波动，还能用力量引导永恒心智的威能，抵御蹄兔的巫童、沙林纳的萨满，以及我同族的灵能者。我也很擅长用尾巴抽人，不过那是另一个故事了。” “凭借这份天赋，我能进入最深、最黑暗、受辉光侵染最严重的地方，在心怀恶意之人抢先拿到辉晶之灾前的武器与遗物并用来对付我们之前，把它们取回。我是一名游侠骑士、业余工程师，也是自学成才的考古学家——这些全都浓缩在一个仁慈的努卡人身上。比如今天，我取回了一套被蹄兔战帮打捞走的古代瞄准系统。在黑暗里击倒他们很容易，可我还是不明白，他们为什么要用卫星级电子设备改装载具的喇叭，”困惑的女祭司低声嘟囔。 “你想念家人吗？” 维米利恩伸手拿起闪烁的数据板，向上划了几下才抬眼看你。“我非常想念他们。有时我一离开就是几个月，所以会带着一些与他们有关的小物件和纪念品，让自己保持坚强。永恒心智的爱无法填满他们不在时留在我心里的所有空洞，”披甲教士承认道，随后给你看了一张照片；照片中她被大约十二名成年迪弗拉尼围绕，他们的肤色从淡黄到深绿不等。“我的父母在这里，”她指向左侧一对皱纹较多的爬虫人，“早在辉晶之灾发生以前，他们的家族就在辐射林采摘果实、耕种农田。其他兄弟姐妹也都如此，除了萨库，”她又指向唯一穿着长袍的黄色迪弗拉尼女孩。“她比我早一年加入神殿，很快就成了一名技艺高超的技术员。我记得她在荒原某处把一艘锈迹斑斑的失事飞船据为己有。那里属于蹄兔领地，希望她平安无事。” 仔细看着照片，你注意到维米利恩手里有什么毛茸茸的东西，还有一双棕色大眼睛。“这是费尔明，我的心肝、我生命里的光、我的宝贝儿子。希望他吃得好，也交到了许多朋友。” 等等，那是她的孩子？你没想到她已经当了母亲——而且孩子竟然还是个蹄兔男孩！ “我在努卡镇北边的一处洞穴里发现了他。当时我正要离开受辉光侵染的隧道，却听见另一侧传来声音。我听从直觉循着哭声前进，本以为那是残忍强盗设下的陷阱，或是某个不惜一切也要满足嗜血魔欲的无情人工智能。你能想象吗，我最后发现的竟是一个裹着破布、饿得奄奄一息的蹄兔小男孩。我尽力喂他吃随身口粮，又让他喝了些水，随后去寻找他的父母，可布满灰尘的地面上没有留下血迹、脚印或车轮痕迹。我让他贴着腹部安睡，抱着他飞越峡谷好几个小时，徒劳地寻找[silly |鬣狗人 |蹄兔 ]聚落。找不到他的生身父母，我只好把他带给母亲，花了几个月宠爱照顾他。他最近长大了许多，”她补充道，又展示了几张自己与养子的合照。从外表判断，他现在大概七岁。被收养的女孩最后也收养了一个小男孩，真是奇妙的巧合。 “他看起来很好，”你赞同道。“像一道可爱的阳光。我很好奇，他的父母或部族为何会抛弃他。” 维米利恩耸耸肩。“这颗星球上的生活严酷无情，能承受这种残酷的人很少，能在这里过得舒适的人更少。据父亲说，他的祖先曾是某位蹄兔军阀的妾侍；那个军阀和姐妹们洗劫山脉附近的聚落时，她负责组织战帮。父亲认为，正因如此，他的血脉不像其他迪弗拉尼那样崇尚个人，更擅长组织协作。他的种族不善修筑要塞、建立文明。迪弗拉尼村落极其罕见，家庭结构就更少见了，不过我非常庆幸能成为他的养女。向神殿提交报告时，我就能再见到他们。希望费尔明会喜欢我净化一处机器人盘踞的神龛后得到的烤沙林种子，”她说。 她还没来得及继续解释，衣服下方透出的奇异光芒便吸引了你的注意。她的身体难道充满了腐化？ “我们努卡人比其他种族更擅长调节、储存这种阴险的腐化，但即使是我也无法毫发无损地离开，”她承认道。“储存的辉光越多，我的力量就越强。但它也会让我产生非常不洁的念头——尤其是我从一艘被永恒心智之龙摧毁的飞船里找到了这件余烬之民升级部件之后，”她说着掀起长袍，露出一个硕大而野性的肉鞘，以及一对散发浓烈麝香的猩红肉球；它们垂在一只湿漉漉的阴户前。“刚得到它时，我就请求面见永恒心智，接受驱魔仪式。女神告诉我，她很喜欢这件新饰物，它非常适合她正直的女儿，所以我把它留了下来；从那以后，我就用它为欲火难耐的求爱者排解压力，传播女主人的爱，”她说道，深深的红晕让原本就绯红的脸颊变得更暗。 “知道了。也许我迟早会需要你的服务，”你调侃道。 平静的修女微笑起来。“我会欣然效劳。这位忠诚的圣骑士还能为你做些什么吗？”
rows.raw: " “Can you tell me more about yourself? [flags.VERMI_TLK_HERSELF |It’s been a while since our last meeting |I don’t think I’ve seen anyone like you before ].” The nuka nun nods. “Of course my child. What do you want to know about myself?” “Your origins to start? How were you raised and who’s the woman behind the veil?” “There’s not a lot to tell, to be honest. I was raised in the Radwood, with the Evermind’s flock. I don’t know who my parents were. My adoptive father found my egg in the deepest, darkest parts of our Goddess’s bountiful garden — I’ll let you imagine the surprise on his face when I hatched in his hands.” An adopted nuka? That’s a surprising background. Are her close ones also involved in the tech cult operating in the area? “My family serves the Order of Our Martyred Wires, the Evermind’s scavengers and food providers. I grew up surrounded with divrani brothers and sisters that never remarked on my peculiar skin tone. One of the higher clerics suspects it might be a very rare case of nuka albinism but our scholars didn’t find anything akin to it in my blood, so my predicament is still a mystery to me — even the many nuka I met through my travels were none the wiser.” You slowly tilt your head. “Your travels? Are you a missionary?” The shapely paladin giggles. “Excuse me my child, a glowing thought crossed my mind. To answer your question, I’m more like an adventurer or ruins raider. Don’t get me wrong, I’ll gladly bring the Evermind’s brilliant light to whoever wants to find shelter under her bountiful aura, but my duties are entirely different,” she says before showing you a small map of your surroundings on her ancient datapad. “The Order of Our Martyred Wires — the division I belong to — is tasked with investigating each of the [var0 |mutated glades |tainted derelicts ] and identifying what scourged it. Depending on how dire the corruption is, it’s up to us to decide how the place must be secured, contained, or protected before someone weaker to the glow than I can be injured — or worse — by the dangerous spot. It’s not an easy or safe job but I wouldn’t trade places for all of the sweet lollipops in the world,” she says, tapping a bag full of treats attached to her belt. “It sounds like a very dangerous job. Were you trained specifically for it?” “No, I was supposed to become a field plow- I mean worker — with my other siblings, but one of the dragon warriors picked a few of us to pass tests. To my surprise, I was deemed worthy of serving in the Evermind’s holy guard and had to go through a rough training routine to prepare my body and soul to the dangers of the Glass. My family is always worried for my sake when I leave our Goddess’s verdant shelter, but this is a sacrifice I’m more than willing to make, if it means my siblings and their offspring won’t see the horrors dwelling under the arid rocks and stained sands.” Weird that they’d recruit the only atypical nuka they had into their militia, especially since she wasn’t meant to be a fighter to begin with. Does she know why she was taken and given these tasks? Vermillion nods. “I was integrated in the Order of Our Martyred Wires because of my resistance to the glow and psionic abilities. Not only can I withstand the highest amounts of corrupting waves, but I can also use my powers to channel the Evermind’s might and defend myself against the hyraxi’s witchboys, the shalinae’s shamans, and my own race’s psykers. I’m also very good at tail whips, but that’s a story for another time.” “Thanks to my gift, I can go to the deepest, darkest, most glow-touched places to recover pre-Glass weapons and relics before people with ill intents do and use them against us. I’m a knight-errant, amateur engineer, and self-taught archeologist condensed into a merciful nuka. Today, for example, I recovered an ancient targeting system that was salvaged by a hyraxi warband. It was quite easy to knock them out in the dark, but I still can’t understand why they used satellite-grade electronics to customize their rig’s hooter,” the puzzled priestess mumbles. “Do you miss your family?” Vermillion reaches for her twinkling datapad and swipes a couple of times up before raising her eyes on you. “I miss them a lot. Sometimes I’m away from them for months, so I keep some trinkets and souvenirs of them to stay strong. The Evermind’s love can’t fill all the holes their absence leaves in my heart,” the armored cleric admits before showing you a picture of her surrounded by about a dozen adult divrani, ranging from light yellow to dark green. “My parents are here,” she says, pointing at a couple of more wrinkled reptiles on the left, “their families are fruit gatherers and farmers in the Radwood since before the Glass. All my other siblings are too, except Saku,” she adds, pointing at the only yellow divrani girl clad in robes. “She joined the temple a year before me and quickly became a very skilled techie. I think she claimed a rusty shipwreck for herself somewhere in the wastes. I hope she’s alright, since it’s on hyraxi lands.” Looking at the picture closely, you notice something in Vermillion’s hands, something fuzzy and with big, brown eyes. “It’s Firmin, my sweetheart, the light of my life, my baby boy. I hope he’s eating well and making lots of friends.” Wait, that’s her child? You didn’t expect her to be a mother — and of a hyraxi boy, no less! “I found him in a cave north of Nuka Town. I was about to leave the glow-infested tunnels when I heard something coming from the other side. Listening to my instincts, I followed the cries, expecting a trap from cruel bandits or from a heartless AI ready to do anything to satiate their demonic thirst for blood. Can you imagine my surprise when I found a tiny, famished hyraxi boy wrapped in rags? I did my best to feed him the rations I had and make him drink some water before looking for his parents, but there were no traces of blood, footsteps, or wheels left in the dusty ground. I flew over the canyons for hours with him nested against my belly in search for a [silly |yeen |hyraxi ] settlement in vain. Since I couldn’t find his genitors, I brought him to my mother and spent a couple of months pampering him. He’s been growing a lot lately,” she adds, showing you a couple more pics of her adopted son and her together. He must be about seven years old now, going by his looks. It’s a strange coincidence that the adopted girl ended up adopting a little boy too. “He’s looking good,” you agree. “An adorable ray of sunlight. I wonder what led his parents or tribe to abandon him.” Vermillion shrugs. “Life on this planet is rough and unforgiving. Few can withstand its cruelty and fewer can live comfortably here. According to father, his ancestor was the concubine of a hyraxi warmonger tasked to organize her warband while she and her sisters pillaged the settlements near the mountains. Father thinks that’s why his bloodline is less individualistic and more organized than the other divrani. His species isn’t one to build fortresses and raise civilizations. Divrani villages are extremely rare and familial structures even rarer, but I’m very glad to be his adopted daughter. I’ll see them again when I make my report to the temple. I hope Firmin will love the roasted shalin seeds I got for cleansing a robot-infested shrine,” she says. Before she can elaborate further, a weird glow under her clothes earns your attention. Is her body riddled with taint? “We nuka can regulate and store the insidious corruption better than others, but even I can’t leave unscathed,” she admits. “The more glow I store, the stronger my powers become. But it makes me have very impure thoughts — especially since I recovered this Emberian upgrade from one of the ships the Evermind’s dragon destroyed,” she adds, lifting her robes to reveal a large, animalistic sheath and a pair of musky, scarlet orbs dangling in front of an extra wet pussy. “As soon as I got it, I asked to see the Evermind for an exorcism. The Goddess told me she loved my new adornment and that it suited her righteous daughter well, so I kept it and used it since then to relieve pent-up suitors and spread our Mistress’s love,” she says, a very deep blush darkening her already crimson cheeks. “Good to know. Maybe I’ll need your services sooner or later,” you tease. The serene nun smiles. “And I’ll happily deliver. Is there anything else this faithful paladin can do for you?” "

rows.original: “Your outfit is really fancy, where did you get it?” The red nuka’s cheeks take a dark, garnet blush. “Thank you, my child. I put a lot of effort into maintaining my vestment and keeping my protections in stellar shape. I won’t lie to you, it’s a bit ramshackled and tweaked, but it’s really coming together. The priests at the temple and the Evermind were very generous with my gear.” Wait, that’s standard issued gear for her people? “That’d be wonderful, but no. I was referring to the opulent amount of fabric covering my body. My oathsisters and oathbrothers’ robes are usually far more revealing, but I asked if I could get a more chaste one. They also provided me with a few capacitors and batteries to fuel my first shocking gloves and crackling tail whip. I designed a small, primitive exoskeleton with Saku to help me carry my wargear around more easily — I looked a lot more like a hyraxi warmonger’s lieutenant rather than one of the Evermind’s faithfuls,” she giggles. “Wait, I might still have an old pic of it,” she adds before reaching for her ancient datapad. She swipes a dozen times then shows you a slightly pixelated picture of her sister and her standing in their respective gears. Her apparatus of the time looks like a rough conglomerate of thin, bronze plates and archaic cylinders; it’s a miracle she could walk with that many capacitors strapped to her back. “I really rocked the tin can look, didn’t I?” “[pc.kmhbb |Indeed |A really meaty tin can |In more than one way |Yeah! A sexy, shiny tin can |Yeah! A sexy, sturdy tin can ]. I see your sister was a scythe user,” you remark. Vermillion nods. “I used to, as well. We were field plowe-workers before, so we took weapons that we knew we could use proficiently. My trainers and I discovered that I was a mean boxer so I changed career,” she says, punching an invisible opponent. “I still have a radium scythe in my package, in case I really need to finish a downed machine. Saku’s something of an exhibitionist, so she’s always scantily-clad, especially with her wastes-striding gear. It’s a miracle we were allowed to keep and use our findings.” So these elaborate armor and weapons aren’t common? How did she find them? “Correct. I don’t know what my plasma caster used to be, but I know for sure that a hyraxi warchief used similar plasma belchers and cannons to wreak havoc through the shimmering canyons. I remember how big and brutal her ATVs were, spewing disgusting, dark fumes all around the glassed passes. Luckily, the Evermind’s benevolent eyes were on me when I ambushed them. The skies wept all over the narrow rift, bogging her heavy vehicles down long enough to sneak around and pacify her warboys, one after the other. She unleashed a proverbial inferno of electromagnetic fire on me, but I managed to swipe her off her feet with my tail and knock her out using the power our Goddess lent to me. I recovered her dangerous relic and retrofitted it to the bracers on my fulgur fists,” she says, showing you a couple of reinforced metal gloves lined with coils and branded with a cog symbol on top of it. “Fighting all those hyraxi raiders was surely scary,” you remark. “It’s a miracle you came away unscathed.” Vermillion nods before making the cog symbol with her hands. “I was frightened. Fortunately, the Evermind’s might flowed through me and carved a safe road for me. This mission would have been far easier with my power armor but alas, it was one of my first trips and I only discovered it years later.” Yeah, that could have come up handy. Can she tell you how she got it? “Certainly. About two years ago, a bright, green light emerged from the desert in the middle of the night. It’s not unusual, considering how many cities were swallowed underground by the fallout, electromagnetic storms, and tectonic collapses — sometimes their electric grid comes back up and illuminates the Glass with hypnotic colors. This time, it was different. Ancient, rusted machines crawled out of the cursed depths and started to annihilate any form of life they came across. Feeling the danger rise, the temple made a temporary alliance with the local tribes and nomads to turn their assets to shreds. Long story short, we lost a lot of oathsisters and oathbrothers down there, either to the glow or to the merciless, tireless, relentless androids. A couple of shalinae hunters and I found a hidden weapon cache near their main monolithic factory. They took arms that looked like their ancestors’ holy wargear while I recovered a dusty piece of armor.” “Did any of them survive too?” The nun smiles, a sad, forced smile. “Yes, but one of them was greatly-injured and lost his ability to fly. I was almost vaporized by a ray of sick, demonic light, but my newly-acquired defenses tanked almost everything thanks to the unstable shield overcharge I accidentally caused,” she says. “I was never good with polarities. In the end, we reached the inside of the factory and the giant, liquid metal monstrosity that controlled it. This malleable abomination took the shape of a pre-Glass president, albeit a very muscular one. ‘The Insanator’ it called itself,” she whispers, shaking with fear and making intricate moves you suspect are a silent mantra. “To this day, I don’t know how we beat it, but I remember the gold-feathered huntress driving her singing sword through its core and ripping its source out with crackling talons. We cleansed this place with shalinae, nuka, divrani, and hyraxi rituals, then buried our fallen friends together before the truce’s end.” “Do you know if they are still alive? It sounds like you will never see each other again.” “The gold-feathered huntress pronounced vows with a shaman and settled inside a hallowed hollow somewhere south from here. I meet her from time to time. She makes the meanest mixes of roasted seeds and dried fruits around. As for the injured warrior, he returned to the prismatic mountains with his tribe. He came to the temple to ask for our help for an exorcism a year ago. Saku and I followed him through the sharp peaks in the hope to take down a haywire drone,” she replies, showing you a blurry picture of her sister, a burned shalinae, and her posing in front of a downed, manta-like machine. “Couldn’t the Evermind take it down with her anti-aircraft cannons? She could have easily neutralized it,” you remark. The crimson paladin shakes her head. “It swooped too low and had countermeasures ensuring that none of her mighty skylances could hit it. Anything that flew too high immediately became one of its targets. Saku discovered a warehouse full of wing packs, jetpacks, and other high mobility wargear near its lair. Surprisingly, all of them were compatible with my power armor, as if they were designed to be used together. With it, I flew through the ragged mountain range on magnificent wings high enough to lure the corrupted demon into my sister’s electromagnetic trap. As soon as its engines were neutralized, she removed its control AI and disconnected the corrupted avionics. Flying for the first time felt so good, even with a rapacious creature on my trail.”
rows.translation: “你的服装真精美，是从哪里弄来的？” 红色努卡的双颊泛起深深的石榴红。“谢谢你，我的孩子。我花了很多精力维护法衣，让防护始终保持最佳状态。说实话，它确实有点拼凑、经过改装，但正逐渐变得完整。神殿祭司和永恒心智在装备方面对我十分慷慨。” 等等，这是她族人的标准配发装备？ “那当然很好，可惜不是。我指的是覆盖身体的大量奢华布料。我的誓姐妹和誓兄弟通常穿得暴露得多，但我询问能否得到更加端庄的一套。他们还给了我几个电容和电池，为最初的电击手套和噼啪尾鞭供能。我和萨库设计了一套小型原始外骨骼，让我更容易携带战斗装备——我当时看起来更像海拉克西军阀的副官，而不是永恒心智的信徒，”她咯咯笑道。“等等，我可能还留着一张老照片，”她补充道，伸手拿出古老数据板。她划动十几次，随后向你展示一张略显像素化的照片；她和姐妹分别穿着各自装备。她当时的装置看起来是薄青铜板与古老圆筒粗糙拼成的集合体；背上绑着那么多电容还能走路，简直是奇迹。“我当年很驾驭得住铁罐造型，对吧？” “[pc.kmhbb |确实 |一个肉感十足的铁罐 |而且不只一层含义 |没错！性感闪亮的铁罐 |没错！性感结实的铁罐 ]。我看见你姐妹使用镰刀，”你评论道。 朱红点点头。“我以前也用。我们曾是田间耕作工，所以选择了自己熟悉、能够熟练使用的武器。训练师和我发现我是个凶狠拳击手，于是转了行，”她一边说，一边朝不存在的对手挥拳。“包裹里仍有一把镭镰；如果真得彻底解决倒地机器，它能派上用场。萨库有点暴露癖，所以总是穿得很少，尤其穿荒原跋涉装备时。我们居然获准保留并使用发现的东西，简直是个奇迹。” 所以这些精巧盔甲和武器并不常见？她是怎么找到的？ “没错。我不知道等离子炮最初是什么东西，但可以确定，一个海拉克西酋长曾用类似的等离子喷吐器和火炮在闪光峡谷大肆破坏。我记得她的全地形车有多么庞大凶猛，在玻璃化山口四处喷出恶心黑烟。幸运的是，我伏击他们时，永恒心智仁慈的双眼正注视着我。天空在狭窄裂谷降下倾盆大雨，使她的重型车辆深陷泥泞足够长时间，让我潜行绕过，逐个制服她的战争男孩。她朝我释放了名副其实的电磁火焰炼狱，但我用尾巴扫倒了她，再凭女神借给我的力量将其击昏。我回收了她危险的遗物，并将其改装到雷霆拳套的护腕上，”她说着，向你展示一双加固金属手套；上面排列着线圈，并烙有齿轮符号。 “与那么多海拉克西袭击者战斗一定很可怕，”你评论道。“你能毫发无损地回来，真是奇迹。” 朱红点点头，随后双手比出齿轮符号。“我当时很害怕。幸运的是，永恒心智的威能流经我的身体，为我开辟出安全道路。如果有动力装甲，这项任务会轻松得多；可惜那是最初几次远行之一，而我许多年后才发现它。” 没错，那肯定很有用。她能讲讲自己如何获得它吗？ “当然。大约两年前，深夜时分，沙漠中升起一道明亮绿光。考虑到许多城市因辐射沉降、电磁风暴与构造崩塌而被吞入地下，这并不罕见——有时它们的电网会重新启动，用催眠般的色彩照亮玻璃荒原。但那一次不同。古老生锈的机器从受诅深渊爬出，开始消灭遇见的一切生命。感知危险上升后，神殿与当地部族和游牧民暂时结盟，把这些东西撕成碎片。长话短说，我们在地下损失了许多誓姐妹和誓兄弟；有人死于辐光，有人死于冷酷、永不疲倦、永不停歇的机器人。我和几名沙林纳猎手在他们巨型主工厂附近发现一座隐藏武器库。他们拿走了看起来像先祖神圣战具的武器，而我找到一件满是尘土的盔甲。” “他们也有人活下来了吗？” 修女微笑着，那是悲伤而勉强的笑容。“活下来了，可其中一人身受重伤，失去了飞行能力。我差点被一道病态恶魔光束蒸发，不过新获得的防御挡下了几乎全部伤害，多亏我意外造成的不稳定护盾过载，”她说道。“我一直不擅长处理极性。最终，我们进入工厂内部，面对控制那里、由液态金属构成的巨型怪物。这个可塑憎恶化成玻璃战争前某位总裁的模样，尽管肌肉格外发达。它自称‘疯化者’，”她低声说道，因恐惧颤抖，同时做出一串复杂动作；你猜那是一段无声真言。“直到今天，我仍不知道我们如何击败了它；但我记得金羽猎手把歌唱之剑刺穿其核心，再用噼啪作响的利爪扯出能量源。我们用沙林纳、努卡、迪弗拉尼和海拉克西仪式净化那里，随后在停战结束前共同埋葬阵亡朋友。” “你知道他们是否还活着吗？听起来你们再也不会见面。” “金羽猎手与一位萨满立下誓言，定居在这里南方某处的神圣树洞里。我偶尔会见到她。她做的烤籽与果干混合物堪称附近最棒。至于受伤战士，他和部族回到棱彩山脉。一年前，他来到神殿，请求我们帮忙驱魔。萨库和我跟随他穿越尖锐群峰，希望摧毁一架失控无人机，”她回答，同时向你展示一张模糊照片；照片里，她的姐妹、一个烧伤的沙林纳和她一起站在一台倒地的蝠鲼状机器前。 “永恒心智不能用防空炮把它击落吗？她应该能轻易消灭它，”你评论道。 深红圣骑士摇摇头。“它飞得太低，还有反制措施，确保任何强大天矛都无法命中。任何飞得太高的东西立刻会成为它的目标。萨库在巢穴附近发现一座装满翼包、喷气背包与其他高机动战具的仓库。令人惊讶的是，它们全都兼容我的动力装甲，仿佛原本就是配套设计。借助它，我用壮丽双翼飞过崎岖山脉，高度足以把腐化恶魔引入我姐妹的电磁陷阱。引擎刚被瘫痪，她便拆除控制人工智能，断开腐化航空电子设备。即使身后有只贪婪生物紧追不舍，第一次飞行仍然感觉太棒了。”
rows.raw: " “Your outfit is really fancy, where did you get it?” The red nuka’s cheeks take a dark, garnet blush. “Thank you, my child. I put a lot of effort into maintaining my vestment and keeping my protections in stellar shape. I won’t lie to you, it’s a bit ramshackled and tweaked, but it’s really coming together. The priests at the temple and the Evermind were very generous with my gear.” Wait, that’s standard issued gear for her people? “That’d be wonderful, but no. I was referring to the opulent amount of fabric covering my body. My oathsisters and oathbrothers’ robes are usually far more revealing, but I asked if I could get a more chaste one. They also provided me with a few capacitors and batteries to fuel my first shocking gloves and crackling tail whip. I designed a small, primitive exoskeleton with Saku to help me carry my wargear around more easily — I looked a lot more like a hyraxi warmonger’s lieutenant rather than one of the Evermind’s faithfuls,” she giggles. “Wait, I might still have an old pic of it,” she adds before reaching for her ancient datapad. She swipes a dozen times then shows you a slightly pixelated picture of her sister and her standing in their respective gears. Her apparatus of the time looks like a rough conglomerate of thin, bronze plates and archaic cylinders; it’s a miracle she could walk with that many capacitors strapped to her back. “I really rocked the tin can look, didn’t I?” “[pc.kmhbb |Indeed |A really meaty tin can |In more than one way |Yeah! A sexy, shiny tin can |Yeah! A sexy, sturdy tin can ]. I see your sister was a scythe user,” you remark. Vermillion nods. “I used to, as well. We were field plowe-workers before, so we took weapons that we knew we could use proficiently. My trainers and I discovered that I was a mean boxer so I changed career,” she says, punching an invisible opponent. “I still have a radium scythe in my package, in case I really need to finish a downed machine. Saku’s something of an exhibitionist, so she’s always scantily-clad, especially with her wastes-striding gear. It’s a miracle we were allowed to keep and use our findings.” So these elaborate armor and weapons aren’t common? How did she find them? “Correct. I don’t know what my plasma caster used to be, but I know for sure that a hyraxi warchief used similar plasma belchers and cannons to wreak havoc through the shimmering canyons. I remember how big and brutal her ATVs were, spewing disgusting, dark fumes all around the glassed passes. Luckily, the Evermind’s benevolent eyes were on me when I ambushed them. The skies wept all over the narrow rift, bogging her heavy vehicles down long enough to sneak around and pacify her warboys, one after the other. She unleashed a proverbial inferno of electromagnetic fire on me, but I managed to swipe her off her feet with my tail and knock her out using the power our Goddess lent to me. I recovered her dangerous relic and retrofitted it to the bracers on my fulgur fists,” she says, showing you a couple of reinforced metal gloves lined with coils and branded with a cog symbol on top of it. “Fighting all those hyraxi raiders was surely scary,” you remark. “It’s a miracle you came away unscathed.” Vermillion nods before making the cog symbol with her hands. “I was frightened. Fortunately, the Evermind’s might flowed through me and carved a safe road for me. This mission would have been far easier with my power armor but alas, it was one of my first trips and I only discovered it years later.” Yeah, that could have come up handy. Can she tell you how she got it? “Certainly. About two years ago, a bright, green light emerged from the desert in the middle of the night. It’s not unusual, considering how many cities were swallowed underground by the fallout, electromagnetic storms, and tectonic collapses — sometimes their electric grid comes back up and illuminates the Glass with hypnotic colors. This time, it was different. Ancient, rusted machines crawled out of the cursed depths and started to annihilate any form of life they came across. Feeling the danger rise, the temple made a temporary alliance with the local tribes and nomads to turn their assets to shreds. Long story short, we lost a lot of oathsisters and oathbrothers down there, either to the glow or to the merciless, tireless, relentless androids. A couple of shalinae hunters and I found a hidden weapon cache near their main monolithic factory. They took arms that looked like their ancestors’ holy wargear while I recovered a dusty piece of armor.” “Did any of them survive too?” The nun smiles, a sad, forced smile. “Yes, but one of them was greatly-injured and lost his ability to fly. I was almost vaporized by a ray of sick, demonic light, but my newly-acquired defenses tanked almost everything thanks to the unstable shield overcharge I accidentally caused,” she says. “I was never good with polarities. In the end, we reached the inside of the factory and the giant, liquid metal monstrosity that controlled it. This malleable abomination took the shape of a pre-Glass president, albeit a very muscular one. ‘The Insanator’ it called itself,” she whispers, shaking with fear and making intricate moves you suspect are a silent mantra. “To this day, I don’t know how we beat it, but I remember the gold-feathered huntress driving her singing sword through its core and ripping its source out with crackling talons. We cleansed this place with shalinae, nuka, divrani, and hyraxi rituals, then buried our fallen friends together before the truce’s end.” “Do you know if they are still alive? It sounds like you will never see each other again.” “The gold-feathered huntress pronounced vows with a shaman and settled inside a hallowed hollow somewhere south from here. I meet her from time to time. She makes the meanest mixes of roasted seeds and dried fruits around. As for the injured warrior, he returned to the prismatic mountains with his tribe. He came to the temple to ask for our help for an exorcism a year ago. Saku and I followed him through the sharp peaks in the hope to take down a haywire drone,” she replies, showing you a blurry picture of her sister, a burned shalinae, and her posing in front of a downed, manta-like machine. “Couldn’t the Evermind take it down with her anti-aircraft cannons? She could have easily neutralized it,” you remark. The crimson paladin shakes her head. “It swooped too low and had countermeasures ensuring that none of her mighty skylances could hit it. Anything that flew too high immediately became one of its targets. Saku discovered a warehouse full of wing packs, jetpacks, and other high mobility wargear near its lair. Surprisingly, all of them were compatible with my power armor, as if they were designed to be used together. With it, I flew through the ragged mountain range on magnificent wings high enough to lure the corrupted demon into my sister’s electromagnetic trap. As soon as its engines were neutralized, she removed its control AI and disconnected the corrupted avionics. Flying for the first time felt so good, even with a rapacious creature on my trail.” "

rows.original: . How did the story end by the way? “With the mad machine down, the locals organized a big feast to thank us for our help. Saku was allowed to keep some of the fancy, revealing armors and I was allowed to keep my glowing wings by the avian tribe. We brought them back to the temple and had them reviewed by the Evermind. We couldn’t be happier when the Goddess deemed us worthy of keeping them,” the armored nuka squeals, flapping her heavy backpack’s beautiful, projected feathers. She really loves her equipment as much as her family and adopted kid it seems! “One last question. Can you keep it or do you need to return it to the temple once your duties are over?” “Our equipment belongs to the Evermind, so it’s only fair that we maintain it and bring it back in pristine shape. She keeps a very strictly-ordered inventory of her hoarded goods and only gives her servants the relics and technology they’ll need to complete their missions. Since my tasks are very dangerous and risky, I’m only allowed to bring and carry the stuff I made or found. The day I’ll retire, I’ll offer my armor, wings, and gauntlets to the Goddess’s chromed pile and leave it here until somebody else needs it to protect us from the horrors lying under the glassed sands. There’s so many wondrous devices and relics in the temple, I hope you’ll have the chance to gaze at our Lady’s greatness and treasures,” she adds, a serene smile on her face’s impish canvas.

rows.original: “Can you tell me more about your Goddess? I’d like to know as much as possible before meeting her.” The red nuka makes the cog symbol with her hands. “The Evermind protects. She’s a bright beacon of light and hope shining over these [var0 |hallowed grounds |glow-touched sands ]. I don’t even have words to describe her magnificence, her resplendence, her sublime allure and benevolent gaze — just thinking about her makes me shiver,” Vermillion admits, a blissful smile on her face. A luminous halo forms around her, a golden crown of sunlight[pc.cl kineticist | induced by her eldritch powers that ] hugs her exposed face in a shimmering mask of holiness. It’s almost terrifying to see how her faith manifests and fuels her abilities. “So... what is she like? Is she a divrani? A nuka? Something else altogether?” “I can’t describe her without insulting or diminishing her beauty. All I can say is that she’s a magnanimous entity. She always gives people a chance to prove their worth in a divine ordeal of her choice, while all the other leaders have pretty brutal societal systems in comparison. Miscreants in nuka territory must either serve a sentence in jail or walk the demon-riddled wastes for a year to be forgiven. Those convicted in shalinae grounds must be forgiven by their ancestors and tribal gods through ritual combat to earn their place back in society — most of them lead to death or permanent injuries for the parties involved. Last but not least, the hyraxi warbands just enslave anyone that approaches their territories unsolicited. There’s supposedly some stand-alone settlements with their own rules and with more racial and cultural diversity, but they struggle day-to-day just to keep their independence and freedom from the bigger, meaner warmongers.” You tilt your head, intrigued by her explanation. “What’s the Evermind’s policy concerning her neighbors?” “It’s complicated. The Goddess doesn’t deal with other settlements except if they try to invade the Radwood or if they find some form of ancient technology. In the latter’s case, she sends a missionary to them to identify the machine in question and decide what to do with it. We either have to make a mundane report back to the temple if it’s a trivial tool, or take direct action if it represents a big enough threat to anyone bathed in the Evermind’s light. In these cases, we either teach them the correct way to use their findings, trade it for an equivalent, safer device, or we confiscate it and seal it in our sanctum’s depths. Some of us also handle tainted objects. We place them in biohazard canisters then store them in bunkers spread across the irradiated sands,” she adds, passing her fingers over one of the glowing marks gleaming from under her robes. So she isn’t to be messed with. How is she with people? Is she kind? Cruel? Impatient? The nuka nun shakes her head. “The Goddess is curious, so she tries to learn a lot from her guests. I’ve seen her intrigued by very common things while intricate designs didn’t make her bat an eye. Most of the time, she’s patient, especially to younger ones. I once brought my little Firmin with me so that he could see his momma’s beautiful boss — the Evermind found him so cute and pure that she allowed him to give her a big kiss, something only her most favored acolytes can usually do without facing consequences. My baby boy was so happy and excited he did an all-nighter thinking about what kind of present he could offer her,” she giggles. “I’m sure she’ll be kind to you as well. I’ve only seen her annihilate someone in holy fire once, and that was because the demonic-possessed creature in question tried to poison the Radwood and its inhabitants with banemoths.[pc.ra mothrine | You should be fine, don’t worry. ] Her Holiness will love to meet a worthy Emberian, I’m sure of it,” she babbles, fully aware that her boss might be dubious about another outsider asking for her favors.
