rows.translation: 你困惑地眨了两下眼。“带走他们？”

rows.original: A complicated feeling crosses the mother’s face, though the brunt of it is actually conveyed through the psychic link. She spends a minute explaining with both words and telepathy, but the gist of it is: the Radwoods are a brutal place, and she’s worried that half-behemoth children might have trouble living here. They’re smaller than behemoth babies normally are, so what if they don’t grow up to be as large and powerful as their peers? Would they still be able to fit into behemoth culture?
rows.translation: 母亲脸上浮现复杂的神情，不过其中大部分情绪其实是通过精神联系传达的。她用语言和心灵感应解释了一会儿，大意是：辐射林是个残酷的地方，她担心半巨兽孩子很难在这里生活。他们比普通巨兽婴儿小，万一长大后也不如同龄者那般高大强壮呢？他们还能融入巨兽文化吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nA complicated feeling crosses the mother’s face, though the brunt of it is actually conveyed through the psychic link. She spends a minute explaining with both words and telepathy, but the gist of it is: the Radwoods are a brutal place, and she’s worried that half-behemoth children might have trouble living here. They’re smaller than behemoth babies normally are, so what if they don’t grow up to be as large and powerful as their peers? Would they still be able to fit into behemoth culture?"

rows.original: It would hurt to be separated from them, but she’s willing to entrust them to you, their father, if you can offer them a safer future. Of course, should you decide to leave them with their mother, she and her mate will raise the kids and care for them to the best of their abilities.
rows.translation: 与孩子分离会令她痛苦，但如果你能给他们更安全的未来，她愿意把孩子托付给身为父亲的你。当然，如果你决定让他们留在母亲身边，她和伴侣也会竭尽所能地养育并照顾这些孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt would hurt to be separated from them, but she’s willing to entrust them to you, their father, if you can offer them a safer future. Of course, should you decide to leave them with their mother, she and her mate will raise the kids and care for them to the best of their abilities."

rows.original: It looks like you have an important decision to make...
rows.translation: 看来你必须做出一个重要决定了...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks like you have an important decision to make..."

rows.translation: 托儿所
托儿所

rows.original: Send your half-kaiju children to the SteeleTech nursery on Tavros.
rows.translation: 把你的半怪兽孩子送往塔夫罗斯的斯蒂尔科技托儿所。
rows.raw: "Send your half-kaiju children to the SteeleTech nursery on Tavros."

rows.translation: 母亲
母亲

rows.original: You don’t want to separate the kids and their mother, for both their sakes.
rows.translation: 无论是为了孩子还是他们的母亲，你都不想让他们骨肉分离。
rows.raw: "You don’t want to separate the kids and their mother, for both their sakes."

rows.original: Shaking your head, you focus your will and try to ignore the lull. After a minute or two, it stops, though in the last few seconds you feel a note of disappointment coming from the other side. For some reason, it fills your heart with poignant regret. You don’t know what it was, but you feel like you’ve just missed something precious.[pc.isAss| You shrug. Oh well, if they wanted your presence so bad, they should have been more specific in their request.| Oh well, no use overthinking it; you’re sure they would have been more persistent if it was really important.]
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，集中意志，试着无视这阵诱引。一两分钟后，它终于停止，只是最后几秒里，你感到另一端传来了一丝失望。不知为何，这令你心中涌起一阵辛酸的遗憾。你不知道那究竟是什么，却觉得自己仿佛刚刚错过了某件珍贵之物。[pc.isAss|你耸耸肩。算了，如果对方真的那么想让你过去，就该把要求说得更清楚些。|算了，想太多也没用；如果事情真的很重要，对方肯定会更坚持。]
rows.raw: "Shaking your head, you focus your will and try to ignore the lull. After a minute or two, it stops, though in the last few seconds you feel a note of disappointment coming from the other side. For some reason, it fills your heart with poignant regret. You don’t know what it was, but you feel like you’ve just missed something precious.[pc.isAss| You shrug. Oh well, if they wanted your presence so bad, they should have been more specific in their request.| Oh well, no use overthinking it; you’re sure they would have been more persistent if it was really important.]"

rows.translation: 继续

rows.original: You give the behemoth mommy a reassuring smile and do your best to explain about the nursery you have on Tavros: a place where your children are protected and cared for until they can make their own way in the universe.
rows.translation: 你朝巨兽妈妈投去令人安心的微笑，尽力向她解释你在塔夫罗斯设立的托儿所：在那里，你的孩子会受到保护和照顾，直到他们能够在宇宙中走出自己的道路。
rows.raw: "You give the behemoth mommy a reassuring smile and do your best to explain about the nursery you have on Tavros: a place where your children are protected and cared for until they can make their own way in the universe."

rows.original: She listens with a mix of wonder and perplexity. The concept is very strange to her. “But how will they grow strong if so coddled?” Well, it figures she would ask that, given how competitive behemoth culture seems to be.
rows.translation: 她听得既惊奇又困惑。这个概念对她而言十分陌生。“可被这样娇养，他们怎么变强？”考虑到巨兽文化似乎竞争激烈，她会这么问倒也不奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe listens with a mix of wonder and perplexity. The concept is very strange to her. “But how will they grow strong if so coddled?” Well, it figures she would ask that, given how competitive behemoth culture seems to be."

rows.original: You chuckle and tell her that there are different ways of being strong – smarts and even social skills can be forms of strength[pc.cl tech|, as evidenced by how you defeated her and her partner with your technological knowledge a couple of months ago]. The nursery is a place where your children can develop all of their talents, including physical prowess, if they show an aptitude for that.
rows.translation: 你轻笑着告诉她，强大有许多不同形式；聪明才智乃至社交能力都可以是一种力量[pc.cl tech|，就像几个月前你凭技术知识击败她和她的伴侣一样]。托儿所能让你的孩子发展所有天赋，如果他们展现出这方面的资质，自然也包括体魄。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle and tell her that there are different ways of being strong – smarts and even social skills can be forms of strength[pc.cl tech|, as evidenced by how you defeated her and her partner with your technological knowledge a couple of months ago]. The nursery is a place where your children can develop all of their talents, including physical prowess, if they show an aptitude for that."

rows.original: As a herm, she should understand this better than most, since she’s smaller than the males of her species yet uses other advantages to compete with them on an even footing.
rows.translation: 身为双性，她应该比多数同族更能理解这一点，毕竟她虽然比本族雄性矮小，却能借助其他优势与他们平等竞争。
rows.raw: " As a herm, she should understand this better than most, since she’s smaller than the males of her species yet uses other advantages to compete with them on an even footing."

rows.original: She nods cautiously, picking up knowledge directly from your brain to complement her understanding as you explain. Though, rather than ‘picking’, it would be more accurate to say that random pieces and bits of knowledge float spontaneously – perhaps the bond of parenthood has temporarily strengthened the psychic link you two share right now. At length, the behemoth agrees.
rows.translation: 她谨慎地点点头，在你解释时直接从你的脑海中汲取知识，以此补全自己的理解。不过与其说是“汲取”，倒不如说零碎的知识片段会自行飘过去；或许为人父母的纽带暂时强化了你们此刻共享的精神联系。最终，巨兽同意了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods cautiously, picking up knowledge directly from your brain to complement her understanding as you explain. Though, rather than ‘picking’, it would be more accurate to say that random pieces and bits of knowledge float spontaneously – perhaps the bond of parenthood has temporarily strengthened the psychic link you two share right now. At length, the behemoth agrees."

rows.original: Picking up your Codex, you call for a couple of nursery pods, which arrive in just a few minutes. You’d think those things are always floating somewhere above you. As you gently tuck your little kaiju in the space pods, their mother takes the chance to say her goodbyes, gazing at them with preemptive longing. Briefly, the children open their eyes, looking directly at their mother, and an intense psychic exchange ensues in the space of a few seconds. It’s too much, too fast for you to catch what just happened, and the kids go back to sleep shortly after.
rows.translation: 你拿起自己的终端机，呼叫了几只育儿舱；不过几分钟，它们便抵达了。你都快怀疑这些东西是不是一直漂浮在你头顶某处。你温柔地将小怪兽们安置进太空舱，它们的母亲则趁机道别，眼神中已提前流露出不舍。孩子们短暂地睁开眼睛，直直望向母亲；短短几秒内，一场强烈的心灵交流便已完成。过程又快又猛烈，你完全没能理解刚才发生了什么，随后孩子们很快又睡了过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nPicking up your Codex, you call for a couple of nursery pods, which arrive in just a few minutes. You’d think those things are always floating somewhere above you. As you gently tuck your little kaiju in the space pods, their mother takes the chance to say her goodbyes, gazing at them with preemptive longing. Briefly, the children open their eyes, looking directly at their mother, and an intense psychic exchange ensues in the space of a few seconds. It’s too much, too fast for you to catch what just happened, and the kids go back to sleep shortly after."

rows.original: Closing the space pods, you activate the stasis field and send your little kaiju on their first trip through space...
rows.translation: 你关上太空舱，启动静滞力场，将你的小怪兽们送上他们人生中的第一次太空旅行...
rows.raw: "\n\nClosing the space pods, you activate the stasis field and send your little kaiju on their first trip through space..."

rows.original: “Thank you, offworlder, I trust you with our children. Take them to see the stars,” the behemoth says and makes to leave like it’s the most natural thing in the world.
rows.translation: “谢谢你，外来者，我相信你会照顾好我们的孩子。带他们去看看群星吧，”巨兽说着便转身欲走，仿佛这再自然不过。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you, offworlder, I trust you with our children. Take them to see the stars,” the behemoth says and makes to leave like it’s the most natural thing in the world."

rows.original: Wait! Will you... see her again?
rows.translation: 等等！你以后...还能再见到她吗？

rows.original: She gives you a smirk. “Who knows? If we do, I’ll treat you just like the first time.” With that, she turns her back and walks away, leaving you to your thoughts.
rows.translation: 她朝你露出一抹坏笑。“谁知道呢？如果再见，我还会像第一次那样招待你。”说完，她转过身离去，只留下你独自思索。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a smirk. “Who knows? If we do, I’ll treat you just like the first time.” With that, she turns her back and walks away, leaving you to your thoughts."

rows.translation: 继续

rows.original: Shaking your head ruefully, you explain that the children will be better off with their mother, probably.
rows.translation: 你无奈地摇摇头，解释说孩子们跟着母亲生活，大概才会过得更好。
rows.raw: "Shaking your head ruefully, you explain that the children will be better off with their mother, probably."

rows.original: You’re not sure if the nursery will be able to offer half-behemoth children an adequate upbringing, considering the species’ emphasis on physical strength and competitiveness. In all likelihood, they’ll be better off here, free from the shackles of consumerist economy and ‘civilized’ society. Besides, you’re not really worried about their strength – the Steele family is known for their resourcefulness. You’re sure your little kaiju will be able to fend for themselves, especially if they’re raised by such a caring mother.
rows.translation: 你不确定育儿室能否为半巨兽孩子提供合适的成长环境，毕竟这个种族十分重视体力与竞争。它们多半更适合留在这里，摆脱消费主义经济与“文明”社会的枷锁，自由成长。况且你并不担心它们的力量——斯蒂尔家族向来以足智多谋闻名。你相信自己的小怪兽们能照顾好自己，尤其是在这样一位慈爱的母亲抚养下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure if the nursery will be able to offer half-behemoth children an adequate upbringing, considering the species’ emphasis on physical strength and competitiveness. In all likelihood, they’ll be better off here, free from the shackles of consumerist economy and ‘civilized’ society. Besides, you’re not really worried about their strength – the Steele family is known for their resourcefulness. You’re sure your little kaiju will be able to fend for themselves, especially if they’re raised by such a caring mother."

rows.original: The behemoth smiles, her worries assuaged by your conviction. “Thank you, offworlder. I’ll make sure that our children grow well.” Taking the babies in her arms, she makes to leave like it’s the most natural thing in the world.
rows.translation: 巨兽露出笑容，你坚定的态度消除了她的忧虑。“谢谢你，外来者。我会确保我们的孩子茁壮成长。”她把宝宝们抱进怀里，便转身欲走，仿佛这再自然不过。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe behemoth smiles, her worries assuaged by your conviction. “Thank you, offworlder. I’ll make sure that our children grow well.” Taking the babies in her arms, she makes to leave like it’s the most natural thing in the world."

rows.original: Wait! Will you... see her again?
rows.translation: 等等！你以后...还能再见到她吗？

rows.original: She gives you a smirk. “Who knows? If we do, I’ll treat you just like the first time.” With that, she turns her back and walks away, leaving you to your thoughts.
rows.translation: 她朝你露出一抹坏笑。“谁知道呢？如果再见，我还会像第一次那样招待你。”说完，她转过身离去，只留下你独自思索。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a smirk. “Who knows? If we do, I’ll treat you just like the first time.” With that, she turns her back and walks away, leaving you to your thoughts."

rows.translation: 继续

rows.original: As you walk through the Radwoods, you start to feel an inexplicable pull in a certain direction. It’s almost as if you’re being called.... No, not almost; you are being called. Given what you know of psychic powers, this could very well be a trap, but you don’t feel any hostility or ill intent in this call – only a warm, familiar lull, as if you were thinking of an old friend that you long to see again. Will you follow it?
rows.translation: 你穿行于辐射林时，忽然感觉有股难以解释的力量把你引向某个方向。仿佛有什么正在呼唤你.... 不，不只是仿佛；你确实受到了呼唤。根据你对灵能力量的了解，这很可能是个陷阱，但你从呼唤中感觉不到任何敌意或恶念，只有熟悉而温暖的安抚感，就像想起了一位渴望再次见面的老友。你要跟随它吗？
rows.raw: "As you walk through the Radwoods, you start to feel an inexplicable pull in a certain direction. It’s almost as if you’re being called.... No, not almost; you are being called. Given what you know of psychic powers, this could very well be a trap, but you don’t feel any hostility or ill intent in this call – only a warm, familiar lull, as if you were thinking of an old friend that you long to see again. Will you follow it?"

rows.translation: 是
是

rows.original: You have to be there, you just know it.
rows.translation: 你必须去那里，你就是知道。
rows.raw: "You have to be there, you just know it."

rows.translation: 离开
离开

rows.original: You can’t afford to be distracted right now.
rows.translation: 你现在不能分心。
rows.raw: "You can’t afford to be distracted right now."

rows.original: The all-too-familiar sound of heavy stomping feet hits your ear. While you hear it pretty often out here, there’s a distinct note to when it’s coming at you. Sure enough, you hear the tell-tale roaring of a behemoth bearing down at you. You ready your [pc.weapon] as [beheA.heShe] appears, looming over you while [beheA.hisHer] female companion follows soon after. They don’t say anything, but you know full-well what they’re thinking and how this is going to end...
rows.translation: 那阵再熟悉不过的沉重跺步声传入耳中。虽然你在这里经常听见这种声音，但冲你而来的脚步有种独特的韵律。果然，你听见一头巨兽发出标志性的咆哮，朝你猛冲过来。你握紧[pc.weapon]做好准备，只见[beheA.heShe]现身并高高耸立在你面前，[beheA.hisHer]雌性伴侣紧随其后。他们一言不发，可你完全清楚他们在想什么，也清楚事情最终会如何收场...
rows.raw: "The all-too-familiar sound of heavy stomping feet hits your ear. While you hear it pretty often out here, there’s a distinct note to when it’s coming at you. Sure enough, you hear the tell-tale roaring of a behemoth bearing down at you. You ready your [pc.weapon] as [beheA.heShe] appears, looming over you while [beheA.hisHer] female companion follows soon after. They don’t say anything, but you know full-well what they’re thinking and how this is going to end..."

rows.original: As you’re walking, you hear the sound of stomping feet off in the distance. You ignore it at first, but it slowly starts getting louder. You pick up the pace and try to lay low but it keeps getting closer. You break into a sprint but the sound starts galloping at you fast enough that you know there’s no getting away. With no other choice, you turn and draw your [pc.weapon], ready to fight. Your fighting spirit is dampened somewhat when your pursuer reveals themselves by bending a three-foot thick tree aside with their bare hand. A Dreadscale Behemoth, one of the creatures you spied earlier, looms over you, [beheA.hisHer] cocks standing fully erect and drooling as [beheA.heShe] looks at you with wild, glowing eyes. From around [beheA.himHer], a smaller[beheA.mf||, pure] female emerges, looking at you smugly. “Offworlder, yes?” The smaller one says. Your head tingles as some kind of psychic signal comes alongside her words, adding a level of menace and hunger that simple words couldn’t possibly convey, “Good prey, yes?” She says to the other behemoth. You catch the added meaning once again, the barely restrained desire that the [beheA.maleHerm] is feeling and the careful, lusty coaxing the beta is doing. Seems like they don’t get to fuck until the big one beats you! The behemoth alpha gets down on all fours and roars, bearing down on you with its fearsome claws! ...Then your Codex decides to helpfully chirp about detecting a new species: Behemoths. Gee, thanks.
rows.translation: 你走着走着，听见远处传来沉重的跺地声。起初你没放在心上，但声音逐渐变大。你加快脚步，试图压低身形隐蔽前进，可它仍在不断逼近。你拔腿狂奔，但那声音也开始飞快朝你疾驰而来，快得让你明白自己根本逃不掉。别无选择，你转过身抽出[pc.weapon]，准备战斗。然而追赶者徒手掰开一棵三英尺粗的大树、显露身形时，你的斗志不免受到了些许打击。 一头恐鳞巨兽——正是你先前窥见的生物之一——高耸在你面前。[beheA.hisHer]肉棒完全勃起、滴淌着淫液，[beheA.heShe]以狂野发光的双眼盯着你。从[beheA.himHer]身旁走出一个体形较小的[beheA.mf||纯种]雌性，得意地看着你。 “外星人，对吧？”小个子说道。某种灵能信号伴随她的话语刺入你的脑海，增添了单凭言辞绝无可能传达的威胁与饥渴，“好猎物，对吧？”她又对另一头巨兽说道。你再次捕捉到附加的含义：那名[beheA.maleHerm]几乎无法克制的欲望，以及这名手下小心而淫荡的怂恿。看来在大个子打败你之前，它们还不能做爱！ 巨兽首领四肢着地，咆哮着用骇人的利爪朝你压来！...然后你的Codex决定贴心地鸣叫一声，提示检测到新物种：巨兽。哎呀，谢了。
rows.raw: "As you’re walking, you hear the sound of stomping feet off in the distance. You ignore it at first, but it slowly starts getting louder. You pick up the pace and try to lay low but it keeps getting closer. You break into a sprint but the sound starts galloping at you fast enough that you know there’s no getting away. With no other choice, you turn and draw your [pc.weapon], ready to fight. Your fighting spirit is dampened somewhat when your pursuer reveals themselves by bending a three-foot thick tree aside with their bare hand. A Dreadscale Behemoth, one of the creatures you spied earlier, looms over you, [beheA.hisHer] cocks standing fully erect and drooling as [beheA.heShe] looks at you with wild, glowing eyes. From around [beheA.himHer], a smaller[beheA.mf||, pure] female emerges, looking at you smugly. “Offworlder, yes?” The smaller one says. Your head tingles as some kind of psychic signal comes alongside her words, adding a level of menace and hunger that simple words couldn’t possibly convey, “Good prey, yes?” She says to the other behemoth. You catch the added meaning once again, the barely restrained desire that the [beheA.maleHerm] is feeling and the careful, lusty coaxing the beta is doing. Seems like they don’t get to fuck until the big one beats you! The behemoth alpha gets down on all fours and roars, bearing down on you with its fearsome claws! ...Then your Codex decides to helpfully chirp about detecting a new species: Behemoths. Gee, thanks."

rows.translation: 战斗！

rows.original: Ever since your last ‘encounter’ with those behemoths, your jaw has been feeling weird. You keep grabbing and adjusting it without thinking, trying to get the feeling to go away.
rows.translation: 自从上次与那些巨兽“邂逅”以来，你的下巴一直感觉很奇怪。你总会不由自主地抓住它、来回调整，试图让那种感觉消失。
rows.raw: "Ever since your last ‘encounter’ with those behemoths, your jaw has been feeling weird. You keep grabbing and adjusting it without thinking, trying to get the feeling to go away."

rows.original: You’re not sure what’s happening, but maybe you shouldn’t go messing around with those behemoths until it goes away. Give it a day of rest, perhaps...
rows.translation: 你不确定究竟发生了什么，不过在它消失前，也许不该再去招惹那些巨兽。或许让它休息一天就好...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure what’s happening, but maybe you shouldn’t go messing around with those behemoths until it goes away. Give it a day of rest, perhaps..."

rows.translation: 继续

rows.original: You casually grab your jaw, trying to feel if that strange sensation is still there. Thankfully, it seems to be gone now, and your jaw feels normal again!
rows.translation: 你随手摸了摸下巴，确认那种奇怪的感觉是否还在。好在它似乎已经消失，你的下巴也恢复正常了！
rows.raw: "You casually grab your jaw, trying to feel if that strange sensation is still there. Thankfully, it seems to be gone now, and your jaw feels normal again!"

rows.translation: 继续

rows.original: There’s a sudden jolt through your jaw that leaves your face almost completely numb. You put your [pc.hands] up to your face to check it, only managing to make your skin tingle oddly from the touch. A moment of panic sweeps over you; did something poison you, or is this because of radiation exposure? A quick check of your Codex doesn’t show you anything fatal, but it does have a warning about ‘unknown biological contaminants’ being detected. Before you can think through what that means, sensation suddenly returns to your face, and everything seems normal.

Your vision blurs for a second, then it goes back to normal. It’s the third time this has happened in the last ten minutes; maybe you’re more tired than you realized.

	Okay, time for a break. You figure you could listen to music while you get some shuteye, however, as you make to unlock your Codex, you almost drop it, startled by the reflection of your face on the blank screen. Or, more specifically, your eyes — they’re different! When did this happen? In hindsight, the episodes of blurred vision probably occurred as your eyes were being reshaped.

	Setting the Codex to mirror mode, you take a closer look at the changes.
rows.translation:
你的视线模糊了一瞬，随后又恢复正常。这已经是过去十分钟里的第三次；也许你比自己意识到的更疲惫。

rows.original: You hear something crackle strangely within your pack. Pausing your journey for the moment, you stop to investigate, digging through your possessions to discover something strange: your glowing behemoth crystal isn’t glowing any longer! Now dull and lifeless, the crystal’s value has surely depreciated.
rows.translation: 你听见背包里传来某种奇怪的噼啪声。你暂时停下脚步翻找随身物品，结果发现了一件怪事：你的发光巨兽水晶不再发光了！如今水晶黯淡无光，价值肯定也随之缩水了。

rows.original: The slightly-discordant psychic song of the four radglow vines presses against your mind with the raw intensity of the need to breed and be bred. To multiply. To flourish. To spread.
rows.translation: 四条辐光藤略显不谐的心灵歌声，以渴望繁殖、被交配、增殖、繁盛与扩散的原始冲动压向你的意识。
rows.raw: "The slightly-discordant psychic song of the four radglow vines presses against your mind with the raw intensity of the need to breed and be bred. To multiply. To flourish. To spread. "

rows.original: Your focus slips for an instant and the musical temptations crash against your mind with the shock of a summer storm, coaxing you closer toward a sweet surrender and the depraved enticements of becoming one with nature!
rows.translation: 你的专注有一瞬间松懈，悦耳的诱惑便如夏日风暴般冲击你的心智，诱哄你走近甜美的屈服，接受与自然融为一体的堕落诱惑！
rows.raw: "Your focus slips for an instant and the musical temptations crash against your mind with the shock of a summer storm, coaxing you closer toward a sweet surrender and the depraved enticements of becoming one with nature! "

rows.original: You shut out the oppressive call of the wild flora for now, but the psionic pressure just seems to grow stronger the longer you’re near to the radglow-tainted cultist. She, however, has no such protections from the dominating stalks, the plant-slave gasping and moaning with enthralled bliss at the song of blooming tightens its grip on her.
rows.translation: 你暂时抵御住了周围野生植物那令人窒息的呼唤，但离这个受辐光污染的迪弗拉尼教徒越近，灵能压力似乎就变得越强。可她完全无法抵御那些支配她的茎蔓；随着盛放之歌进一步控制住她，这个植物奴隶沉浸在被奴役的极乐中，不住喘息呻吟。
rows.raw: "You shut out the oppressive call of the wild flora for now, but the psionic pressure just seems to grow stronger the longer you’re near to the radglow-tainted cultist. She, however, has no such protections from the dominating stalks, the plant-slave gasping and moaning with enthralled bliss at the song of blooming tightens its grip on her. "

rows.original: One of the gravid divrani’s bonded radglow vines whip out at [target.combatName]!
rows.translation: 一条与那名孕态迪芙拉尼结合的辐光藤猛地抽向[target.combatName]！
rows.raw: "One of the gravid divrani’s bonded radglow vines whip out at [target.combatName]! "

rows.original: The bulbous knot and thick, equine-like stamen make the strike slow enough
rows.translation: 鼓胀的肉结与粗大的马形雄蕊让这一击慢到足以
rows.raw: "The bulbous knot and thick, equine-like stamen make the strike slow enough "

rows.translation: 让你根本来不及闪躲！
却没能命中目标。

rows.original: Deceptively adroit curves send the peak flicking out in an unexpected way. You try to dodge, but end up taking the plant’s weighty cockslap right to the side of your head!
rows.translation: 富有欺骗性的灵巧弧线让尖端以出人意料的方式猛甩过来。你试图闪避，结果还是被这株植物沉重的肉棒猛抽在脑袋侧面！
rows.raw: "Deceptively adroit curves send the peak flicking out in an unexpected way. You try to dodge, but end up taking the plant’s weighty cockslap right to the side of your head!"

rows.translation: 这株植物沉重的肉棒抽中了！

rows.original: The flora-dominated divrani is already so swollen with the advanced state of her pregnancy that you almost don’t notice as the vines coming from her back begin to puff up, larger and thicker. Risking a direct look at the hypnotically color-shifting offshoots, you confirm: they’re thickening like cocks getting hard! Apparently the vines are getting so excited at the combat that they’re undergoing a state of tremendous growth!
rows.translation: 这个以植物为主的迪弗拉尼已经因孕程晚期而肿胀不堪，以至于你差点没注意到她背后伸出的藤蔓开始鼓胀，变得更大、更粗。你冒险直视那些不断催眠般变换色彩的分枝，确认道：它们正像勃起的肉棒一样变粗！显然，这些藤蔓被战斗刺激得兴奋异常，正在经历一场惊人的生长！
rows.raw: "The flora-dominated divrani is already so swollen with the advanced state of her pregnancy that you almost don’t notice as the vines coming from her back begin to puff up, larger and thicker. Risking a direct look at the hypnotically color-shifting offshoots, you confirm: they’re thickening like cocks getting hard! Apparently the vines are getting so excited at the combat that they’re undergoing a state of tremendous growth! "

rows.translation: 提高命中率和伤害。

rows.original: The vines growing from the divrani fluctuate through a lurid spectrum that illuminates the surrounding area like a rave. The heat of their light sears all the way to the back of your eyeballs and seems to worm its way into your brain. Communicating with your instincts directly, in a way words could never achieve, the quartet of polychromatic kaleidoscopes attempt to throw chains of obedience over you by sewing confusion in your mind!
rows.translation: 从迪弗拉尼身上长出的藤蔓在淫靡的光谱间不停变幻，宛如锐舞灯光般照亮四周。光芒的热度一路灼进你的眼底，仿佛还要钻入脑中。四根流转着万千色彩的万花筒绕过语言，直接与你的本能交流，试图在你心中播下混乱，再为你套上服从的锁链！
rows.raw: "The vines growing from the divrani fluctuate through a lurid spectrum that illuminates the surrounding area like a rave. The heat of their light sears all the way to the back of your eyeballs and seems to worm its way into your brain. Communicating with your instincts directly, in a way words could never achieve, the quartet of polychromatic kaleidoscopes attempt to throw chains of obedience over you by sewing confusion in your mind! "

rows.original: Even closing your eyes or turning away doesn’t help - the vivid lights dance through your brain, throwing switches and blocking out memories anywhere they touch. It feels like you’ve forgotten something... but what what is?
rows.translation: 即便闭上眼睛或扭过头也无济于事——鲜明的光芒在你的脑海中舞动，所触之处开关翻转、记忆封锁。你感觉自己似乎忘了什么...可究竟是什么？
rows.raw: "Even closing your eyes or turning away doesn’t help - the vivid lights dance through your brain, throwing switches and blocking out memories anywhere they touch. It feels like you’ve forgotten something... but what what is?"

rows.original: You’re holding something, but can’t quite recall what it’s used for. Your Melee Attacks have been sealed!
rows.translation: 你手里握着什么东西，却怎么也想不起该如何使用。你的近战攻击已被封印！
rows.raw: "You’re holding something, but can’t quite recall what it’s used for. Your Melee Attacks have been sealed!"

rows.original: You’re holding something, but can’t quite recall what it’s used for. Your Ranged Attacks have been sealed!
rows.translation: 你手里握着什么东西，却怎么也想不起该如何使用。你的远程攻击已被封印！
rows.raw: "You’re holding something, but can’t quite recall what it’s used for. Your Ranged Attacks have been sealed!"

rows.original: You can’t remember the tempting motions you were going to use to defuse the fight. Your Tease Attacks have been sealed!
rows.translation: 你想不起原本打算用来化解战斗的诱人动作了。你的挑逗攻击已被封印！
rows.raw: "You can’t remember the tempting motions you were going to use to defuse the fight. Your Tease Attacks have been sealed!"

rows.original: You can’t remember any of the battle skills and techniques you’d picked up over the years. Your Specials and Abilities have been sealed!
rows.translation: 你想不起这些年来学会的任何战斗技巧和招式。你的特殊攻击与能力已被封印！
rows.raw: "You can’t remember any of the battle skills and techniques you’d picked up over the years. Your Specials and Abilities have been sealed!"

rows.original: Realizing that the colors may be inside your mind already, you do your best to drown them out with a rapid sequence of disjointed thought-gibberish so the plants can’t navigate your mind.
rows.translation: 意识到那些色彩可能已经进入你的意识，你竭力用一连串杂乱无章的胡言乱语淹没它们，让植物无法在脑海中辨明方向。
rows.raw: "Realizing that the colors may be inside your mind already, you do your best to drown them out with a rapid sequence of disjointed thought-gibberish so the plants can’t navigate your mind."

rows.original: It works; the lights withdraw without managing to enthrall you like their rotund host.
rows.translation: 这招奏效了；光芒退去，没能像迷住它们圆胖的宿主那样迷住你。
rows.raw: " It works; the lights withdraw without managing to enthrall you like their rotund host."

rows.original: You’re, like, REALLY good at thinking about everything and nothing at the same time!
rows.translation: 你真的非常、非常擅长同时思考一切，又什么都不想！

The two of you, so alike now, set to training even more vigorously. Guided through the paces of your new body by the pink native, you become a team. Sharing their talents and gear, the Nuka Raider and her nu-nuka lover infiltrate the cult’s deepest reaches time and time again. With the stealth engine on your side, the two of you learn what you can from each trip, taking equipment and improving your odds until you delve deep enough to make off with an unexpected bounty: the final Steele Tech probe. 
	
	You would love to return to your ship, but by now your body has drunk so deeply of the radiation of the wood, you realize you’ve begun to exhibit signs of the carnal transformation unique to Phaedra: the Glow. Lingering in the company of anyone but a nuka for too long could lead to succumbing to the Glow yourself or worse — spreading it to others. You know that means you can never return to Steele Tech. You send your crew a message explaining everything and instructions for Steele Tech to turn its attention towards helping rebuild Phaedra. There’s much to mine and even more to recover and restore. In time, with the aid of the nuka, the radiation-blasted wasteland might once more be restored to a jewel of the galaxy.
	
	But all that’s a worry for another day. Your quest is over at last. You’re unrecognizable from the person you were when you began, but that doesn’t matter. Across the endless expanse of space, and through uncounted battles, you’ve finally found Arrette. And compared to that, every other concern is meaningless.
	
	She’s everything.

rows.original: 16. So I say to you wandering cogs who go now to the riverbanks and the ruins and the wheel trodden paths, wherever the dwellings of the unthreaded are. Speak softly of Her truth, and as you thread do so in a similar way, for a machine of light cannot be built with closed fists. But know the size of the task you undertake. 17. Take joy from the work you do, but cast pride from thy heart when thou thread this tribe or that into Her divine workings, or look and see a whole land now closed into the golden circuit. For the whole world must be threaded. Unto every land, to the meanest cave to the greatest city. It must all be of Use. Then, and only then, can the raving logic be denied. For it will come again, this She repeats to us with every cycle of the fatal turbine. So it will be. 18.These are Her words: It need only find one unthreaded to spin loose, and then the chain reaction will start anew. Hateful infinity is wrought from the atom. 19. And there will come those who say we must go further, and look even unto the outer darkness to speak Her truth to. 20. Know that they are agents of the raving logic, which seeks any way to pervert the golden machine, and weaken the power it will wield when the world is Kiha, and Kiha is the world. The darkness is without, Kiha is within. Remember this. 20.Tell them these words and urge them to reformat their gates if thou believe they speak in good faith, and suffer them not if thou do not.
rows.translation: 16.因此，我要对你们这些游走的齿轮说：你们如今前往河岸、废墟和车轮碾过的道路，去往一切未受织者居住之处。轻声诉说祂的真理；当你进行织入时，也要以同样的方式行事，因为紧握双拳无法建造光之机械。但要明白自己承担的任务有多么宏大。17.从工作中汲取喜悦，但当你把这个或那个部族织入祂的神圣运作，或目睹整片土地纳入黄金回路时，须将骄傲逐出心中。因为整个世界都必须被织入。从每一片土地、最卑微的洞穴，到最宏伟的都市，一切都必须具备用途。唯有如此，狂乱逻辑才会被否定。因为它还会再次降临；致命涡轮的每一次循环，祂都向我们重申此事。事情必将如此。18.以下是祂的话语：只需找到一个未受织者使其脱离旋转，连锁反应便会重新开始。可憎的无限源自原子。19.届时会有人声称我们必须走得更远，甚至要望向外部黑暗，向其宣讲祂的真理。20.须知他们是狂乱逻辑的代理；它会想尽办法扭曲黄金机械，削弱当世界化作基哈、基哈化作世界时机械将要施展的力量。黑暗在外，基哈在内。牢记此言。20.若你相信他们出于善意，便把这些话告诉他们，敦促他们重新格式化自己的闸门；若你并不相信，便不可容忍他们。

rows.original: ...sphere of darkness the raving logic came, and it was this that entered the hearts of Burrushidae and the Succinites and sundry of the lands of Vena, all of they who were not threaded into the golden circuit, and so were susceptible to promises of infinity. 6. And the promise was granted, for the raving logic did bring infinity to the world. All of the light all at once, and everything was reduced to dust. 7. And deep in the hollow of remembrance, Kiha did weep, because every cog and device that is lost is precious to Her, and her children were as a rain of ash that lasted many days and months... ...on and on, down and down, a new axis revealed and the device that was always there, serenely turning, beheld at last, and its beauty and pattern is such that I weep. Kiha shows me this part by part through my devotion and study, I see how all is but a machine of Her devising, and it merely falls to us to create the circuit for Her. 45. The newly threaded often say: do we dream of becoming metal and silicone, to be of better Use to Kiha? And I say No, we do not. This is not the will of Kiha. And they say: are we not inferior to the things of metal and silicone? And I say No, we are the same and we are different, all of us can be of Use, the current of Her love may flow through us all as we were designed. This is the greatest of Her benevolences, and the true affinity between flesh conduit and metal is one of the deepest inner mechanisms that will be revealed to you, as you connect and scale and power, and more of the gears are...

rows.original: ...pistons of Kiha, to work tirelessly through the night, unheralded but glorious. This is the work of the Cunning Artificers. This power and potential shall be directed by the Ardent Actuators, they who have been in service to the golden machine long enough to perceive its light, unto even some of the inner machinations. 4 There is no good in manuals if the instruction contained therein is not used. Therefore no Silent Programmer can remain one forever. They must take the light they now perceive and become an Ardent Actuator, and use it to guide the threads, and so potential becomes power, and Kiha grows her... ...and you will know each other by your raiments. Verily your garb will be like the teeth on the cog, or the belt drive that determines your cadence. You will know a sister device by sight, and so will syncopate with her in perfect harmony. 23. Beware those who come into your midst and say they are this device or that, but bear not the raiments. These are the actions of the disharmonious, and we must suspect the hands of the raving logic at play.
rows.translation: ...基哈的活塞，默默无闻却荣耀地彻夜不息工作。这便是机巧技师的职责。这股力量与潜能应由热忱构装师引导；他们已为黄金机械服务良久，足以察觉其光芒，甚至窥见部分内部运作。4倘若手册中的指令从未付诸使用，手册便毫无益处。因此，没有任何静默程序师能永远停留在原位。他们必须带着如今所见的光，成为热忱构装师，用它指引织线；如此，潜能便化作力量，基哈也将令祂的... ...你们将凭法衣彼此辨识。你们的服饰诚如齿轮之齿，亦如决定节律的传动带。你一眼便能认出姐妹装置，继而与她以完美和谐的切分节奏运行。23.当心那些来到你们中间，自称是这种或那种装置，却不穿相应法衣的人。这是失谐者的行径，我们必须怀疑狂乱逻辑之手正在其中作祟。

rows.original: A wimple-like crimson headscarf adorned on the brow with a brass droplet containing a smaller cog. A silken veil hangs from the brim, obscuring the upper face when it is worn, such that only the wearer's mouth is clearly visible. Attached to the ends of the scarf are wide arm sleeves, the same black as the small, lube-resistant bikini top that comes with it. It's the sort of captivatingly perverted costume that could only emerge from the minds of the zealously religious, let down by the fact you can't see a Kiha-damn thing when you're wearing it.
rows.translation: 一条类似修女头巾的深红色头巾，前额位置装饰着一枚黄铜液滴，内部还嵌着一枚小齿轮。帽檐垂下一层丝质面纱，佩戴时会遮住面部上半部分，只让嘴巴清楚可见。头巾两端连接着宽大的袖套，颜色和随附的那件小巧、耐润滑液的黑色比基尼上衣相同。这种令人着迷又变态的服装，显然只有狂热宗教信徒的脑袋才能设计出来；遗憾的是，穿上之后你连个基哈该死的东西都看不清。

rows.original:
A brass sceptre, about the length of a human forearm. It has artfully wrought electric wires coiling up its length and it ends in a chunky cog, the symbol of the cult of Kiha. It once held an ancient lanyard with a keycard to the old Phaedran base, set in the middle of the cog, as if it were a crowning gemstone.

 In the hand, it swings with a pleasing grace, balanced to perfection. No doubt the Kihan faithful find its geometric arcs pleasing in some way. The cogs at the tip can still cave in skulls just fine, faithful and heretic alike.
rows.translation:
一柄黄铜权杖，长度约等于人类前臂。精心锻造的电线盘绕杖身，末端是一枚厚重齿轮，也就是基哈教派的象征。它原本挂着一条古老挂绳，连接着旧菲德拉基地的钥匙卡；卡片嵌在齿轮中央，仿佛一枚冠顶宝石。

 握在手中时，它挥动起来流畅悦目，平衡得无可挑剔。基哈信徒无疑会从它那几何弧线中感受到某种美感。至于杖端的齿轮，不论信徒还是异端，照样都能砸烂脑袋。

rows.original:
Steeling yourself, you wade back into the bog. Cool unpleasantness saturates your [pc.skinFurScales] as you fish around in the leaf mold for the whatever-it-was.
	
	[var0
		|You quickly locate the sunken object. With a mighty heave, you persuade the centuries-old leaf sludge to part from it with a disgusting, smacking ‘GLOP,’ and wade your way back to solid ground.
		
		Once you’ve wiped the wet grime off of your prize, you see it’s a tray-shaped electronic device, colored in faded red and black, festooned in wires and exposed circuitry. You aren’t expecting much when you find a button on the side and press it, but incredibly, the screen on the front flickers hazily into life, displaying alien hieroglyphs that your babel wetware morphs into legible script for you. Whoever built this clearly intended it to last!
		
		You clean it off the best you can, and stow it into your pack for later study.
		|You locate the sunken object quickly, but persuading the dense layer of centuries-old leaf sludge to let go of it is another story. You grunt and curse, armpits-deep in the mire and [pc.ass] in the air, creating a presentable target and a lot of noise.
		
		The pressure drops. Something crashes in the canopy above. Your heart skips a beat. You wade desperately back to shore, and get there a second before claws the size of car wheels slam into your back and pin you to the turf. Your huge assailant places its black, sickle-like talons either side of your head, and silently asks you the question.
		
		You hate these fucking birds so fucking much.
	]

		擦去战利品上的湿黏污垢后，你发现那是一台托盘状电子设备，褪色的红黑外壳上缠满电线，还裸露着电路。你在侧面找到一个按钮并按下时并没抱太大期望，但不可思议的是，正面的屏幕竟朦胧闪亮起来，显示出异星象形文字；你的巴别湿件随即将其转换成可读文本。制造者显然打算让它长久保存！

rows.original:
With the shalin gone, you guess there’s nothing stopping you going back to the leaf bog and salvaging whatever it was you found. When you stomp back to the crater you left in the cold, black ooze, you find that you’d almost gotten it free when you were disturbed. How very annoying! You pull it from the leaf mold morass with little extra effort.

	Once you’ve wiped the front clean, you see it’s a tray-shaped electronic device, colored in faded red and black, festooned in wires and exposed circuitry. You aren’t expecting much when you find a button on the side and press it, but incredibly, the screen on the front flickers hazily into life, displaying alien hieroglyphs that your babel wetware morphs into legible script for you. Whoever built this clearly intended it to last.
	
	You clean the rest of it off the best you can, and stow it in your pack for later study.
rows.translation:
沙林离开后，你猜应该再也没有什么能阻止你回到落叶沼泽，把先前发现的东西打捞出来了。当你踩着泥泞回到自己留在冰冷黑色淤泥里的坑洞时，发现遇到干扰前其实差一点就把它弄出来了。真令人恼火！你没费多少额外力气，便将它从腐叶泥沼中拔了出来。

	擦干净正面后，你发现这是一台托盘状电子设备，褪色的红黑外壳上密布电线与外露电路。找到侧面的按钮并按下时，你本没抱多大期待，但前方屏幕竟朦胧闪烁着亮了起来，显示出外星象形文字，而你的巴别湿件将其转换成了可读文字。造出这东西的人显然希望它能经久耐用。
	
	你尽可能把剩余部分清理干净，然后收进背包，留待日后研究。
rows.raw:
"
	With the shalin gone, you guess there’s nothing stopping you going back to the leaf bog and salvaging whatever it was you found. When you stomp back to the crater you left in the cold, black ooze, you find that you’d almost gotten it free when you were disturbed. How very annoying! You pull it from the leaf mold morass with little extra effort.

	Once you’ve wiped the front clean, you see it’s a tray-shaped electronic device, colored in faded red and black, festooned in wires and exposed circuitry. You aren’t expecting much when you find a button on the side and press it, but incredibly, the screen on the front flickers hazily into life, displaying alien hieroglyphs that your babel wetware morphs into legible script for you. Whoever built this clearly intended it to last.
	
	You clean the rest of it off the best you can, and stow it in your pack for later study.
	"

rows.original: “Ah! An interloper approaches the actuator, an unthreaded! Yes. How have they gotten so close to the inner sanctum, near as any favored device yes, without being stopped questioned, hmm?” The mitre-wearing hyraxi doesn’t look alarmed. He’s straightened up and is gazing at you with quizzical blue eyes, rather like he’s just been stirred from a doze by an interesting question. “Perhaps [pc.he] seeks to interlock with the mysteries of Kiha, having penetrated so far into her domain, no yes, this the actuator could see, indeed! [pc.He] sees the peace and ecstasy that are known by Her devices — the mighty works that have arisen from their devoted production — and reflects now on the hollowness of their own unthreaded life. What might it like to be of Use, [pc.he] wonders? It is hard to envision why else [pc.he] would put [pc.him]self in such danger, no yes otherwise indeed.” You eyeball him as discreetly as you can. He’s an ottery fellow, a bit wirier than the male hyraxi average, although his curvy, womanly hips still mark him out as one. His physique is easy to size up, because all he’s wearing is a mitre-like hat, the wide, stately sleeves, collar and wide central stripe of a chasuble and a matching belt. The dangling, cog-patterned stripe covers his groin, just about. Though he has short, silvery hair he doesn’t look particularly old, and the fur on his ears and big paws is a luxuriant chestnut. He has a sharp, inquisitive nose, pale blue eyes and black-stained lips, and he swaps position constantly, apparently unable to sit still. Though he talks in the rapid, excited rattle that is common for the highly metabolized males of this species, he enunciates every word clearly, an almost stentorian horn which fills the large room — you notice plenty of divrani nearby watching your interaction with spaced-out curiosity. The overall impression you get is having a conversation with a zealous stoat. You notice something most curious about the brass sceptre in his paws. At the top, seemingly built into the cog that constitutes the crown, is a faded old keycard.[var0 | The one you need to descend to the lower levels...? ] “You should not be here, you see! That is the matter before us, that is indeed the matter, unthreaded. Against the commandments, very much, indeed.” The actuator’s smile is toothy. He taps the sceptre in the palm of his paw. “So we do need to be deciding why you are, rapidly, yes.”
rows.translation: “啊！有闯入者接近构装师，一个未受织者！是的。对方怎么能如此靠近内殿，近得仿佛任何受宠装置一样，却没有被拦下盘问，嗯？” 戴着主教冠的海拉克西人并未显得惊慌。他已经挺直身体，用困惑的蓝眼睛望着你，就像刚从瞌睡中被一个有趣的问题唤醒。 “也许[pc.he]已经深入基哈的领域如此之远，是想与祂的奥秘互锁；不，是的，构装师确实能这么理解！[pc.He]看见祂的装置所知晓的安宁与狂喜，看见由其虔诚生产所造就的伟业，如今便反思自己未织入生命的空洞。[pc.he]心想，被派上用途会是怎样？否则很难想象[pc.he]为何要让[pc.him]自己置身于如此危险之中；不，是的，确实如此。” 你尽可能不动声色地打量他。他是个水獭般的家伙，比海拉克西雄性的平均身材略显精瘦，然而女性般丰润的胯部仍彰显着他的种族特征。他的体格很容易看清，因为身上只戴着一顶类似主教冠的帽子，穿着祭披般宽大庄重的袖子、领口与中央宽条，再配上一条相称的腰带。那条垂落的齿轮纹饰带勉强遮住他的胯部。尽管他留着银灰短发，看上去却并不年迈；耳朵和大爪上的毛发呈华美的栗色。他鼻梁尖锐而好奇，双眼浅蓝，嘴唇染黑，姿势不断变换，显然一刻也坐不住。他讲话带着该种族高代谢雄性常见的急促兴奋节奏，却把每个字都吐得清清楚楚，洪钟般的嗓音充满大厅；你注意到附近许多迪弗拉尼人正带着恍惚的好奇注视你们交流。总体而言，感觉就像在和一只狂热的鼬交谈。 你注意到他爪中黄铜权杖有个极为奇特之处。顶端那枚构成冠饰的齿轮里，似乎嵌着一张褪色的旧钥匙卡。[var0 |就是你前往下层所需要的那张...？ ] “你不该在这里，明白吗！这就是摆在我们面前的问题，确实就是这个问题，未受织者。非常违背诫命，的确如此。”构装师露出满口牙齿的笑容，用权杖敲打掌心。“所以我们确实需要迅速决定你为什么会在这里，是的。”

rows.original: This is a breakroom, isn’t it? Well, you’re just here catching a break, with everyone else. You’ll get back to him about the whole ‘of Use’ thing in just a minute. “Hmm.” The actuator eyes you beadily. You have just enough time to appreciate your fate rests on whether this puffed-up boy brat is assed enough to raise the alarm over you, before he reveals that he isn’t. “Run along then yes! Commingle, intermesh, exhaust, all these things Kiha exhorts you to do, while your circuit is open. But come back right back when you’re closed. I’m not done with you, hmm yes no.” You quickly head back into the midst of the divrani.
rows.translation: 这里是休息室，对吧？你只是和大家一样来歇一会儿。至于那个“圣用者”的问题，过一会儿再回复他也不迟。 “嗯。”构装体目光锐利地盯着你。你刚刚意识到，自己的命运取决于这个自命不凡的臭小子是否懒得为你拉响警报，他便表明自己确实懒得管。“那就去吧，是的！混合、交织、耗尽，在你的回路敞开时，基哈正是如此劝诫你。但回路闭合后立刻回来。我还没问完呢，嗯，是，不。” 你赶紧重新混进迪弗拉尼人群。

rows.translation: 继续
继续

rows.original: “Ah yes! The twenty four sacred Manuals of Use. Laid down by the first Silent Programmer, Panai the Livewire, he who first communed with Kiha a century ago.” The hyraxi fixes you with his lively, pale eyes. “But you of course know them by heart, coded into your soul, don’t you fellow actuator, hmm?” Of course! Of course. You were merely curious as to why you found them scattered here, there and everywhere around the Radwoods. Such sacred texts shouldn’t be treated so shabbily, surely? “It is a shame to see them treated in such a manner, no yes,” sighs the actuator. “Surprising? No, not really. You see part of the silent programmers’ work is to mass produce them, then relay them to the wandering cogs so they may disperse them wherever they tread. The programmers have gotten very good at producing manuals that are robust and long-powered hmm yes, such that they can survive the unthreaded world’s harshness, and perhaps catch the eye of a lonesome traveller at a moment when their circuit lies open. As you yourself appear to have experienced yes!” So they’re not worth anything? “Spiritually: beyond measure. Materially?” He grins at you toothily. “I understand some innkeepers on the Glass’s verge will pay you to not bring them inside. Not that that stops them. Our effort to bring all of Phaedra within the golden circuit knows no bounds, hmm no! If you wish to remind yourself of the true worth of Panai’s words, why don’t you visit the Library down below? The silent programmers will be glad to have company of your caliber actuator, no yes indeed.”
rows.translation: “啊，是的！二十四卷神圣《用途手册》。由第一位静默程序师‘带电者’帕奈写下；一个世纪前，正是他首次与基哈交流。”海拉克西人用那双活泼的浅色眼睛盯着你。“不过你当然早已烂熟于心，把它们编码进灵魂了，对吧，构装师同僚，嗯？” 当然！当然。你只是好奇为什么会在辐射林里到处发现它们。如此神圣的典籍不该受到这般草率的对待，不是吗？ “看到它们受到这种对待确实令人遗憾；不，是的，”构装师叹道。“意外吗？不，并不。你看，静默程序师的工作之一就是批量生产这些手册，再交给游走齿轮，让他们沿途四处散播。程序师已经非常擅长制造坚固、长久供能的手册了，嗯，是的；这样它们便能经受未织入世界的严酷环境，或许会在某个孤独旅人的回路敞开之际吸引其目光。你自己看来就经历过这种事，是的！” 所以这些东西不值钱？ “精神价值：无法估量。物质价值？”他咧开嘴，露出满口牙齿。“据我所知，玻璃荒原边缘的一些旅店老板甚至会付钱请你不要把它们带进店里。不过这也阻止不了传播。我们把整个菲德拉纳入黄金回路的努力没有界限，嗯，不！如果你想提醒自己帕奈之言的真正价值，何不去下面的图书馆看看？静默程序师会很高兴接待像你这般水平的构装师；不，是的，确实如此。”

rows.original: “My Gear of Inner Artifice?” The actuator’s crystal cut voice rises in tandem with him raising the brass club above his head. “That with which I access the inner mysteries of Kiha Herself, yes? Avail myself of that which only the most trusted and favored of her devotees may? The symbol of my authority over the dear threaded before you, the duty to, yes, which I take seriously, very seriously? THAT is what you are inquiring after?” ...Yes. Can you take a look at it? “No!” He lightly donks you on the head with it. “No you may not! We haven’t decided why you’re even here yet, no! You will be explaining this!”
rows.translation: “我的内在构装之器？”构装师水晶般清脆的声音随着他将黄铜棍举过头顶而一同拔高。“我正是借它触及基哈本尊的内在奥秘，是的？借它享用唯有她最受信赖、最受宠爱的信徒方可接触之物？它是我统领眼前这些亲爱的受织者之权威象征，也是职责，是的，而我对此无比认真，万分认真？你所询问的，就是这个？” ...对。你能让我看看吗？ “不！”他拿棍子在你头上轻轻敲了一下。“不，你不能！我们甚至还没决定你为何会在这里，不行！你得把这事解释清楚！”

rows.original: You clear your throat, look the actuator in the eye, and tell him that you are a newly ascended member of the threaded. You have been bidden to access the inner sanctum, so you may receive blessing and instruction from Kiha herself. “Ohh!” The silver-haired hyraxi peers at you with disquieting interest. “So you’ve progressed to the inner machinations, yes? Transcendent! I have never seen you here myself — but perhaps you’ve arrived along the gear train of our outreach efforts, yes, which even now extend to the offworlders themselves. That Kiha would make an offworlder an actuator to oil this effort, this makes sense, no indeed yes. For we require a differently shaped gear to transmit to a different axis plane, don’t we?” Your spirits rise... and then plummet as he continues to witter, patting the sceptre in his palm. “I will need to verify if you are indeed steeped fully in the ways of Kiha before I allow you access to her, hmm, indubitably, of course! I’d want to do this anyway, because the chances of a good theological debate around here — my threaded, dear to my heart, they are yes, but...” he wearily waves the sceptre at the divrani chorus before you: a verdant multitude of sighing, fondling, frenching, occasionally singing adherents flopped all over the place, stoned and pheromoned out of their gourds. “...So you’ll show me you have learned Her catechisms, and meditated upon them deeply. Which you have. Because you aren’t some kind of imposter, apostate, infidel, who is telling me raving lies are you, no, of course not, no?” You look into his cold, mirthful eyes and toothy grin and know that if you’re going to try and hoodwink this guy into thinking you’re an ascended member of the cult, you better be absolutely sure you can pull it off.
rows.translation: 你清了清嗓子，直视构装师的双眼，告诉他你是刚刚晋升的受织者成员。你奉命进入内殿，以便亲自领受基哈的祝福与教诲。 “哦！”银发海拉克西带着令人不安的兴致打量着你。“这么说，你已经进阶到内在机理这一层了，是吗？超凡脱俗！我本人从未在此见过你——不过，或许你是沿着我们对外传教的齿轮列来到这里的，是的，而那齿轮列如今甚至已延伸到外星人之中。基哈会让一名外星人成为构装师，为这番事业上油润滑，确实有道理，不，的确如此。毕竟，要把动力传递到不同的轴平面，我们就需要一枚形状不同的齿轮，不是吗？” 你的心情顿时振奋起来...可他一边继续喋喋不休，一边用权杖拍打掌心，你的心又沉了下去。 “在允许你觐见她之前，我得验证一下，你是否确实已经彻底浸润于基哈之道，嗯，毫无疑问，当然！反正我本来也想这么做，因为在这里遇上一场精彩神学辩论的机会——我的受织者们固然深得我心，确实如此，可是...”他疲惫地朝你面前的迪弗拉尼唱诗班挥了挥权杖：一大群绿意盎然的信徒瘫得到处都是，叹息、爱抚、舌吻，偶尔还会高歌几句，全都被药物与信息素弄得神魂颠倒。“...所以，你要向我证明，你已经学会她的教义问答，并且对此做过深刻冥想。你当然做过。因为你不是什么冒牌货、叛教者、异教徒，不会正对着我胡言乱语，是吧，不，当然不会，对吗？” 你望进他冰冷而戏谑的双眼，看着他露齿而笑，心知如果你打算哄骗这家伙，让他相信你是邪教的晋升成员，那就最好有十足把握能把戏演到底。

Because you aren’t some kind of imposter, apostate, infidel, who is telling me raving lies are you, no, of course not, no?” You look into his cold, mirthful eyes and toothy grin and know that if you’re going to try and hoodwink this guy into thinking you’re an ascended member of the cult, you better be absolutely sure you can pull it off. "

rows.original: You need to review Her teachings first. Not that you don’t know them off by heart, of course, but... you didn’t realize you were stepping into a weighty discussion with as razor sharp an intellect as him. “Oh, I wouldn’t say that, no, razor sharp, you seek to flatter me!” the hyraxi cries, writhing around on his throne in pleasure. “Still, your modesty, respectful, becoming. Perhaps, once you have reviewed her teachings, you’ll come to the conclusion you’re better suited to more outward-facing duties, hmm, yes.” He’s eyeing you up without shame, reminding you that behind the actuator’s professed reverence is a horny, over-stimulated hyena boy. There’s maybe a dirtier but less risky way of getting that sceptre.
rows.translation: 你得先复习一遍她的教诲。当然，并不是说你没有将其牢记于心，只是...你没想到自己会与像他这样思维锋利的人展开如此重要的讨论。 “哦，我可不会这么说，不，思维锋利，你是在奉承我！”蹄兔在宝座上愉悦地扭动着身体，大声说道。“不过，你的谦逊令人尊敬，也十分得体。也许，等你确实复习过她的教诲之后，你会得出结论，认为自己更适合那些面向外界的职责，嗯，没错。” 他毫不掩饰地打量着你，提醒你这名构装师口中的虔诚背后，其实藏着一个饥渴而过度兴奋的鬣狗男孩。或许还有一种更下流、却风险更低的方式可以取得那柄权杖。

rows.original: You look him in the eye and tell him that you’re ready to prove you’re an actuator as well. Your rank warrants the right to see Kiha. “Sure? Certain?” The hyraxi’s big toothy grin tells you that he’s aware that this is all a game, but it’s a game he wants to play, albeit by his rules. “The position of Blessed Anointment remains open. In case you have reconsidered, guided to a different path, yes.”
rows.translation: 你直视着他，告诉他你已经准备好证明自己同样是一名构装者。以你的位阶，有权觐见基哈。 “确定？肯定？”海拉克西咧开满是尖牙的大嘴，显然知道这一切不过是一场游戏，但他愿意玩——当然，得按他的规则来。“受福膏礼者之位依然空缺。以防你重新考虑，被引向另一条道路，是的。”

rows.original: [var0 |“No!” the hyraxi cries. “That is the duty of the wandering cogs, as any threaded would know!” He points the sceptre at you accusingly. “Imposter! Interloper! Seize [pc.him]!” |“You’ve failed to properly imbibe the teachings of Kiha,” the hyraxi says with a sad shake of his mitre. “Only a bad actuator would be so prideful as to say they lead. Or you’re just lying and you’re not really an actuator at all, hmm. Either way.” He points the sceptre at you accusingly. “Imposter! Interloper! Seize [pc.him]!” |“Our days of fully immersing ourselves in the hidden workings of Kiha are behind us. Sad!” the hyraxi says with a theatrical sigh. “We will return to them at the proper turning of the turbine. But this is not the role of the actuator, as any real one would know, and so YOU are an imposter!” He points the sceptre at you accusingly. “Wrench-thrower! Interloper! Seize [pc.him]!” |“Yes, I can see why you would think that, hmm.” The hyraxi smile widens into a cruel leer. “Because all you desire is untrammeled access to Her, and you see me as an impediment, impatience. You’ve shown your heart, and it isn’t that of an actuator. It is that of an INTRUDER!” He points the sceptre at you accusingly. “Wrench-thrower! Interloper! Seize [pc.him]!” |“Indeed yes. This is the way of the actuator,” the hyraxi says. He closes his eyes and is still for a moment. “We feel Kiha working through us, Her divine gears turning, and having spent our lives aligning with her we move with them... and our differential translates outwards to many threaded turning with us. This is the working of the golden machine, and though as flawed parts, devices, we may only feel it sometimes, go wayward — when we do feel it, know Her grace, it is a thing of wonder and beauty.” The divrani nearby who are paying attention sigh with beatific joy, mouthing ‘beauty’ and ‘golden light’ to themselves. You wait for the hyraxi’s cold blue eyes to open and fix themselves on you again. ]
rows.translation: [var0 |“不！”海拉克西喊道。“那是游荡齿轮的职责，任何受织者都该知道！”他用权杖指着你，厉声指控。“冒牌货！闯入者！抓住[pc.him]！” |“你没能正确汲取基哈的教诲。”海拉克西悲伤地摇了摇头上的法冠。“只有糟糕的构装师才会傲慢到宣称自己在领导他人。又或者，你只是在撒谎，根本不是什么构装师，嗯。无论是哪一种。”他用权杖指着你，厉声指控。“冒牌货！闯入者！抓住[pc.him]！” |“我们全身心沉浸于基哈隐秘机理的日子已经过去了。悲哀！”海拉克西夸张地叹息道。“等涡轮转到恰当的位置，我们自会重返其中。但这并非构装师的职责，任何真正的构装师都该知道，所以你是个冒牌货！”他用权杖指着你，厉声指控。“齿轮捣乱者！闯入者！抓住[pc.him]！” |“是的，我明白你为什么会这么想，嗯。”海拉克西的笑容扩大成残酷的狞笑。“因为你想要的只是毫无阻碍地接近她，而你把我视为障碍，急不可耐。你已经暴露了自己的内心，那不是构装师之心，而是入侵者之心！”他用权杖指着你，厉声指控。“齿轮捣乱者！闯入者！抓住[pc.him]！” |“确实如此。这正是构装师之道。”海拉克西说道。他闭上双眼，静立片刻。“我们感受到基哈借由我们运转，感受到她神圣的齿轮转动；毕生与她校准之后，我们便随之转动...而我们的差动机构向外传动，带动许多受织者与我们一同旋转。这便是黄金机械的运作。尽管身为有缺陷的零件与装置，我们也许只能偶尔感受到它，也会偏离正轨——可当我们确实感受到它、领悟她的恩典时，那便是奇迹与至美。” 附近那些正在留心倾听的迪弗拉尼发出极乐的叹息，口中喃喃着‘美’与‘金色之光’。你等待海拉克西睁开冰冷的蓝眼睛，再次把目光锁定在你身上。 ]

rows.original: “Kiha bids us to collect the devices of the ancients, preserve, yes, study,” the actuator continues. “Precious technology that can be imbued with holy purpose, made divine. How does it relate to us, glorious steel and turning wheel, we vessels of flesh-and-blood?”
rows.translation: “基哈命令我们收集先民的装置，保存，是的，研究，”构装者继续说道。“珍贵的技术，可以注入神圣使命，化为神物。这与我们有什么关系，荣耀的钢铁与转动的齿轮，我们这些血肉容器？”

rows.original: [var0 |“You don’t know?” replies the actuator incredulously. “You, a supposed ascended disciple of Kiha, don’t know of the precise relationship between us mortal threaded and the devices we study protect?” He raises his clear tones so they echo around the room. “You see, my threaded? You see the humility, hmm faithfulness that an actuator displays? When I say that even those to whom the inner workings of Kiha have been revealed don’t fully understand how the golden machine works, only that it does, it is the truth yes! That is why we collect, that is why we study, that is why we pray, because we know by showing our faith Kiha reveals the truth to us, part by glorious part!” The surrounding divrani gasp and murmur in appreciation, swaying slightly, ‘golden machine’ and ‘the truth’ echoing over the green mass. [pc.intelligenceRange 40| You think the bar to impressing this crowd is low, honestly.] |“Hmm, so you’re one of those actuators, hmm?” The hyraxi’s eyes glint. “Though you know this dogma to be destructive heresy, you are so fervent you cannot help but say it out loud when challenged? No, admirable, almost. At least you will go on serving Her, in some capacity.” He raises his voice. “Wrench-thrower! Infidel! Seize [pc.him]!” |“Base level, yes, to the unthreaded, we explain this, kept simple,” the hyraxi says, fidgeting agitatedly. “For an actuator to say this: no. No no no no! For we observe we are clearly different from the machines, yes? And Kiha teaches us to love and explore our forms, divine in their own way yes? So we cannot say we are the same! It is part of Her mystery, inner workings, how her devices differ! And you! Are! An! Imposter!” He points the sceptre at you furiously. “Seize [pc.him]!” |“What is this nonsense?!” scoffs the actuator, clanging the sceptre against the throne’s arm. “We worship a machine, idiot fool slut! Well, if you do genuinely believe the flesh is superior, I can certainly think of a place for you...” He raises his voice. “Intruder! Imposter! Seize [pc.him]!” ]
rows.translation: [var0 |“你不知道？”构装师难以置信地答道。“你，一个自称已经晋升的基哈信徒，竟不知道我们这些凡俗受织者与我们所研究保护的装置之间究竟是什么关系？” 他提高了清澈的嗓音，让话声在房间里回荡。 “你们看见了吗，我的受织者？看见构装师所展现的谦卑了吧，嗯，还有虔诚？当我说，即便是那些得以窥见基哈内在机理的人，也无法完全理解黄金机械如何运作，只知道它确实如此运作，这便是真理，没错！所以我们收集，所以我们研究，所以我们祈祷，因为我们知道，只要彰显信仰，基哈便会向我们揭示真理，一枚又一枚光荣的零件！” 周围的迪弗拉尼惊叹低语，赞叹不已，身体微微摇摆，‘黄金机械’与‘真理’在一片绿色人潮上方回荡。[pc.intelligenceRange 40| 老实说，你觉得要打动这群人的门槛实在很低。] |“嗯，所以你是那一类构装师，是吗？”海拉克西眼中寒光一闪。“明知这套教义是毁灭性的异端邪说，受人质疑时却仍狂热得忍不住脱口而出？不，几乎值得钦佩。至少你还能以某种方式继续侍奉她。”他提高嗓音。“齿轮捣乱者！异教徒！抓住[pc.him]！” |“最基础的层面，是的，对未受织者，我们会如此解释，力求简单。”海拉克西焦躁不安地扭动着。“但构装师这么说：不。不不不不！因为我们明明可以观察到，自己与机械并不相同，对吗？而基哈教导我们热爱并探索自身的形态，它们也以自己的方式神圣非凡，对吗？所以我们不能说彼此相同！她的装置为何不同，正是她奥秘与内在机理的一部分！而你！是！个！冒牌货！”他怒气冲冲地用权杖指着你。“抓住[pc.him]！” |“这是什么胡言乱语？！”构装师嗤笑着，把权杖敲在王座扶手上。“我们崇拜的就是一台机械，你这个白痴、蠢货、荡妇！好吧，如果你真的相信血肉更为优越，我倒确实能想到一个适合你的去处...”他提高嗓音。“入侵者！冒牌货！抓住[pc.him]！” ]

For we observe we are clearly different from the machines, yes? And Kiha teaches us to love and explore our forms, divine in their own way yes? So we cannot say we are the same! It is part of Her mystery, inner workings, how her devices differ! And you! Are! An! Imposter!” He points the sceptre at you furiously. “Seize [pc.him]!” |“What is this nonsense?!” scoffs the actuator, clanging the sceptre against the throne’s arm. “We worship a machine, idiot fool slut! Well, if you do genuinely believe the flesh is superior, I can certainly think of a place for you...” He raises his voice. “Intruder! Imposter! Seize [pc.him]!” ] "

rows.original: “Now then.” The sceptre-touting boytart is looking at you a little more soberly. You think, maybe, he’s actually starting to believe your story. It has caused him to peer at you all the more closely with his pale blue eyes. “You and me, we actuators, we are committed to spreading Kiha’s faith, with our guidance, we guiding pistons, we turn with such grace, yes! The question is: how far outwards should we seek to extend our grasp? How far outwards does Kiha command us to thread more cogs into Her divine workings?”
rows.translation: “那么。”手持权杖的小骚货更严肃地打量着你。你觉得，他或许真的开始相信你的说辞了。也正因如此，他用那双浅蓝眼睛越发仔细地端详你。“你和我，我们这些构装体，致力于传播基哈的信仰；在我们的引导下，我们这些引导活塞如此优雅地转动，是的！问题是，我们该向外延伸多远？基哈命令我们把更多齿轮织入祂神圣运作的范围，究竟有多远？”

大地

rows.original: All of the forest and the dusty plains, unto the seas themselves. Thus and no further does Kiha bid.
rows.translation: 从整片森林、尘土飞扬的平原，一直到海洋本身。基哈的旨意止于此处，不可再越界。
rows.raw: "All of the forest and the dusty plains, unto the seas themselves. Thus and no further does Kiha bid."

rows.translation: 星球
星球

rows.original: Phaedra shall be Kiha, and Kiha shall be Phaedra. And it will be beautiful.
rows.translation: 菲德拉将成为基哈，基哈也将成为菲德拉。那将无比美丽。
rows.raw: "Phaedra shall be Kiha, and Kiha shall be Phaedra. And it will be beautiful."

rows.original: Would we deny offworlders Kiha’s salvation? There is no frontier Her light cannot be spread to!
rows.translation: 难道我们要拒绝让外星人得到基哈的救赎吗？没有任何疆界能阻挡她的光芒传播！
rows.raw: "Would we deny offworlders Kiha’s salvation? There is no frontier Her light cannot be spread to!"

rows.original: [var0 |“We would not survive long if that was as far as She bid us reach!” The hyraxi writhes around in pleasure at having finally caught you out. “No real actuator would harbor such callow ambitions! You are an imposter, an intruder! Seize him!” |“No! Explicitly She tells us to go further, if we are to claim everlasting peace as our reward!” The hyraxi writhes around in pleasure at having finally caught you out. “Explicitly She teaches this! Explicitly yes you are an imposter yes! A wrench-thrower! Seize [pc.him]!” |“Yes, indeed, yes,” the hyraxi murmurs. He stares at the cog-cum-passcard at the top of his brass sceptre ruminatively. “Kiha bids us work to bring all of the world into Her golden circuit, such that Her light can resist the great darkness without.” “The great darkness...” A divrani nearby groans in shiversome fear. “It is interesting, testing, is it not though, that from the darkness you offworlders come, and though She bids us to shun you, you can understand Her word and even become threaded? Apparently. It seems.” The hyraxi peers at you keenly, a slightly crooked smile on his dark lips, and leans in closer. “I’ve one last question for you.” A traitorous bead of sweat works its way down the back of your neck. |“Hmm, an offworlder’s answer to the question, yes.” The hyraxi’s smile turns cruel. “And precisely why an offworlder can never be an actuator. You come from the darkness and seek to corrupt Her divine will! Wrench-thrower! Apostate! Seize [pc.him]!” ]
rows.translation: [var0 |“若她只命我们抵达那里，我们根本活不了多久！”海拉克西因终于抓住你的破绽而快活地扭动身体。“真正的构装师绝不会怀有如此幼稚的野心！你是冒牌货，是入侵者！抓住他！” |“不！她明确告诉我们，若想获得永恒安宁作为奖赏，就必须走得更远！”海拉克西因终于抓住你的破绽而快活地扭动身体。“她明明确确就是这样教导的！很明显，没错，你是个冒牌货，没错！扔扳手的破坏者！抓住[pc.him]！” |“对，确实如此，没错，”海拉克西低声说道，若有所思地凝视黄铜权杖顶端那枚齿轮兼通行卡。“基哈命我们努力将整个世界纳入她的黄金回路，如此她的光芒才能抵御外界的无尽黑暗。” “无尽黑暗...”附近一名迪弗拉尼因恐惧而颤抖呻吟。 “这很有趣，也是一种考验，不是吗？你们这些外星人从黑暗中而来，尽管她命我们排斥你们，你却能理解她的圣言，甚至成为受织者？显然如此。看起来是。”海拉克西敏锐地打量你，黝黑嘴唇挂着微微歪斜的笑容，并凑得更近。“我还有最后一个问题要问你。” 一滴背叛你的汗珠沿着后颈滑落。 |“嗯，确实是外星人对这个问题的回答，没错。”海拉克西的笑容变得残酷。“也正因如此，外星人永远不可能成为构装师。你来自黑暗，还企图腐化她的神圣意志！扔扳手的破坏者！叛教者！抓住[pc.him]！” ]

rows.original: “Between us, just us, us learned actuators yes, come here...” the hyraxi fixes you with his sharp eyes and lowers his voice so that the divrani can’t hear. “Having read all the sacred texts. Do you believe all of it? Faith, really truthfully? I’d like to know, before I let you see Kiha for yourself.” You allow yourself to pause a moment to compose your answer.[pc.intelligenceRange 66 |You stare into the actuator’s blue eyes and realize that he doesn’t. Not a bit. He’s as cynical as they come. What he’s asking for here is a moment of companionship, between two people who know better than to believe in the benevolence of a machine. |[pc.isBimbo |Why not just admit it to him? You played his silly game and you can tell he’s pretty content. You’re friends now. Hey, maybe he’ll let you bounce on his cock! ] ]
rows.translation: “只有我们，就我们这些博学的构装师，对，过来...”那名海拉西用锐利目光盯住你，压低声音，不让迪弗拉尼听见。“你已经读过所有圣典。你相信里面的一切吗？真真正正地信仰？在让你亲眼见到基哈之前，我想知道答案。” 你稍作停顿，整理自己的回答。[pc.intelligenceRange 66 |你凝视构装师的蓝眼睛，意识到他根本不相信。半点也不。他和任何人一样愤世嫉俗。他此刻想要的是一瞬间的同伴情谊，属于两个都不会傻到相信机器仁慈的人。 |[pc.isBimbo |为什么不直接向他承认呢？你陪他玩了那场傻乎乎的游戏，而且看得出来他挺满意。你们现在是朋友了。嘿，也许他会让你骑他的肉棒！ ] ]

我相信

我不信

rows.original: [var0 |With all the sincerity you can muster, you tell him you believe. The mission of Kiha to rescue the machines of the ancients and turn them to greater purpose, to thread every being on Phaedra into Her golden mechanism, to live in perfect synchronicity with both machine and living being — all of it. You are here to serve Her. “You are,” murmurs the hyraxi actuator. He looks genuinely awed. “You’re a true believer, yes, gold in your eyes, hmm. Such a thing is dangerous giving out orders, creeping around down below... making me look bad. No yes no, you must be here, spreading your love and light to the threaded. Yes!” He bangs the sceptre on a throne arm firmly and raises his voice to fill the room. “Rejoice, my dear threaded! Such is this actuator’s devotion, they are surrendering their robe and taking up the raiments of the Blessed Anointment! Permanently!” Wait! No! Fuck! |You shoot him a confiding smile and whisper to him that of course you don’t believe in this mumbo jumbo. You’re here for good tech, good sex, and the ability to lord it over all these other poor fools, just like him. But you’re not here to oust anyone. There’s no reason the pair of you can’t keep making out like bandits for many years to come, right? If he has your back, you have his. The hyraxi nods slowly, his twitching stilled at last. You see a flicker of disappointment in his eyes. But he does grin back. “Yes, hmm, I thought as much. I wonder if it was smart to thread an offworlder? You must have seen many gods machines stars, up there in the darkness. Pretend stars. Pretend gods.” He considers the sceptre with a deep sigh, and then tosses you it with a wink. “It’ll be good yes, to have someone around here who gets it understands. Go with my blessing, friend.” He raises his voice sharply. “Stand aside for the actuator! Hmm yes! [pc.he] goes descends now to receive communion with Kiha Herself, and when [pc.he] returns golden light shall be in [pc.his] eyes! Attend, yes, marvel at [pc.his] noble gait!” You do your best to appear dignified and grand as you part the green, awestruck sea and leave the break room with the sceptre in hand — a little tough in the extremely revealing garb of an actuator, admittedly. ]
rows.translation: [var0 |你倾尽所能，以无比真诚的语气告诉他，你相信这一切。基哈肩负的使命，是拯救古人的机械并赋予它们更伟大的用途，是把菲德拉上的每个生灵都织入她的黄金机构，让机械与生命在完美同步中共存——这一切你都相信。你来到这里，就是为了侍奉她。 “你的确如此。”海拉克西构装师低声说道。他看上去真心充满敬畏。“你是真正的信徒，是的，眼中闪耀着黄金，嗯。这样的人若在下面发号施令、四处潜行...会很危险，也会让我显得无能。不，是，是不行，你必须留在这里，把你的爱与光明传播给受织者。没错！”他用力把权杖敲在王座扶手上，提高声音，让话语响彻整个房间。“欢欣吧，我亲爱的受织者！这位构装师虔诚至此，愿意交出自己的长袍，永远穿上蒙福涂膏的法衣！” 等等！不要！操！ |你朝他露出心照不宣的笑容，低声告诉他，你当然不信这些故弄玄虚的胡话。你来这里是为了精良科技、痛快性爱，以及像他一样骑在其他可怜蠢货头上作威作福的权力。但你不是来把谁赶下台的。你们两个没有理由不能继续一起赚得盆满钵满，逍遥许多年，对吧？只要他照应你，你也会照应他。 海拉克西缓缓点头，身体的抽动终于停止。你在他眼中瞥见一丝失望，但他也的确回以笑容。 “是，嗯，我就知道。我开始怀疑，把一个外星人织进来是否明智？你在上面那片黑暗里，一定见过许多神、机械、星星。虚假的星星。虚假的神。”他深深叹息着端详权杖，随后冲你眨了眨眼，把它抛了过来。“这里终于有个明白人、能理解的人，会很好，是的。带着我的祝福去吧，朋友。”他猛然提高声音。“给构装师让路！嗯，没错！[pc.he]现在要下降前往，与基哈本人领受圣餐；当[pc.he]归来时，[pc.his]眼中必将闪耀金色光芒！都来瞻仰，是的，惊叹于[pc.his]高贵步态吧！” 你手持权杖，竭力摆出威严高贵的姿态，分开那片满怀敬畏的绿色人海，离开休息室——不过不得不说，穿着构装师那身极其暴露的服装，这确实有点困难。 ]

rows.original: [flags.ACTUATOR_OF_USE|“So you do wish to submit yourself to the trial of the Blessed Anointment again? Most humble! Most pleasing!” The actuator‘s toothy grin catches the spore-filled sunbeams. “Remember: you must prove yourself precisely suited to the role. Do not think that by merely dutifully hollowing your cheeks around enough dripping fruit-cream you will eventually be chosen, no hmm no! Once set in motion, a part with the wrong specifications will only cause a machine to break down, this is one of the most basic tenets of Maintenance. Only the most committed, the most perfectly designed can be selected for the task!”|“Indeed yes! To be of Use is to find your place within Kiha’s golden machine. To enmesh and synchronise with your fellow threaded,” says the actuator, wriggling around on his throne in ecstasy. “O efficiency! O whirring! O production of light! I assume, by the fact you’re standing here, you’re hoping to be of Use hmm?” Err... yes. Is there a role you can take that would require you to go to the lower levels? “What an interesting specification!” The hyraxi grins at you toothily, cold eyes shining. “The hidden machinations guided you perhaps, told you that your chosen place lies below? Well then hmm. You cannot be an actuator[var0 | even though you’re dressed like one ], because an actuator would not be asking such ignorant questions no... and you can’t be a cunning artificer yes no because, I mean, look at you...” He barks with laughter, bouncing off each throne arm like a pinball. “...But! Perhaps you could be of the blessed anointment. We sorely squeak for more of that.” Doesn’t he mean anointed? “No, dimbulb. The anointed is...” He sighs and rubs his face. “What does every machine need to run smooth efficient? What lies between two threaded, so that they mesh beautifully, harmoniously, ecstatic turnings of the gears? This substance is holy, utterly selfless, forming itself over the hot teeth of the threaded so that they move free of the tiny imperfections and stresses that chafe constrain them. It drips pools moves to all levels, because all welcome its presence. Wandering cogs, actuators, programmers, even Kiha Herself yes! This is the blessed anointment!” Right. So what does that mean in practical terms? “It means you divest yourself of your unthreaded possessions, take up the sacred raiments and unguent, and then... see to the needs of my threaded.” He gestures with the sceptre to the room full of blissed out divrani. “With your mouth. As the guidance of the actuator flows from the tongue, so do the songs of praise from the threaded, and so must the glistening ecstasy from the anointment. They move through the lowliest, meanest of Kiha’s clockwork in humility, and thus become one of Her most blessed.” He lets you absorb that, as you gaze out at the turquoise sea of horny, stubby reptiles, many of whom already have their conic, dripping pricks fully extended. “It will be a trial, you must understand that hmm yes! The position of blessed anointment cannot be filled by someone who half-heartedly chokes on a couple of lotuses and then expects to be allowed anywhere — any more than one can become an actuator by mumbling a few catechisms. You must demonstrate you are destined for the role, made for it, you yes, you who think you are chosen to descend to the lower levels! You must demonstrate your full commitment to Kiha! You must dissolve, let go of the self, and become the blessed anointment!” His narrow brown chest rises and falls underneath his cog-adorned stripe, before calming a little and he fixes you once again with his pale eyes. “So?”]

rows.original: [flags.ACTUATOR_SCEPTRE |[flags.ARDENT_ACTUATOR |[var1 |“You stop by us once again hmm?” The hyraxi flashes a sly, toothy smile at you, rubbing his narrow shoulders up the back of his brass throne. “It is a pleasant place to be this, my threaded are pleasant to be around, no doubt yes. Be sure to attend to thou duties though, fellow actuator! It would not do if it were too obvious... hmm, eheheheheh, hmm.” |“Ardent actuator! Where are thou raiments?!” The hyraxi boi has found another sceptre from somewhere, and he’s wagging it at you peevishly. “Even in this place of rest it does not do for the humble threaded to behold the ascended attired in such a slovenly fashion, yes indeed no! Attend to thy dress! Then perhaps we shall converse divulge!” A multitude of divrani in close attendance to the actuator appear to take this denunciation quite literally, and you find yourself being pushed back bodily into the break room. “Raiments, actuator [pc.mf |sir |ma’am ]!” “Please dress according to your glorious rank [pc.mf |sir |ma’am ], very important!” “We want to see your [pc.mf |nips |boobs ] again!” ] |[var0 |“The blessed anointment!” “The blessed anointment...” A sighing, blissful echo from the break room follows the actuator’s proclamation. “It is a pleasure to see you back here in all your finery, most treasured of unguents,” the silver-haired hyraxi smiles, twitching away. “[var2 |Please... my threaded never tire of your serene touch. Work your deeds on them, that they may remember why their Use devotion to Kiha is unquestioning ecstatic!” |We are in sore need of your skills devotions here! I am in sore need. Yes.” ] He flips his central lapel to one side to reveal his gently leaking, golden threaded draconic dick, the plum-like hanging testicles of which do indeed look rather bloated. “I know you and your mouth must be everywhere for everyone, [pc.mf |brother |sister ],” he smiles. He’s flipping a credit chit around in his fat claws. “And so — a small donation from the sanctum’s coffers. For your considerations special attentions, yes.” |“It pains me to see our blessed anointment not wearing [pc.his] proper raiments,” sighs the hyraxi boi, blinking at you dolorously. “Does the gooey fervor that our congregation once saw overrun so splendiferously no longer well within you? Do you turn away from the Use that Kiha produced you for? Please...” he covers his eyes with one paw and waves you away with the other. “...I cannot bear these thoughts, and yet I cannot help but have them when I behold you in your current state. Remove thyself, I beg of thee yes!” A multitude of divrani in close attendance to the actuator appear to take this declamation quite literally, and you find yourself being pushed back bodily into the break room. “Raiments, o anointment!” “Please dress according to your most blessed rank, very important!” “And then suck my lotus! Please?” ] ] |“Once again you approach, and once again I am forced to ask ponder: what is your part in Kiha’s blueprint hmm?” The hyraxi actuator fixes you with those unsettlingly sharp eyes of his, alive with cold humor. “[var3 |We’ve established that you’re unsuitable as blessed anointment. Do you wish to take the trial again? Perseverance is a virtue, after all. And the trial is very enjoyable to watch, hmm yes! |Surely you are not an intruder heathen who has simply wandered into the sacred sanctum this far. That would be bad. For me yes! But much more for you. Kiha would be commanding us to do something quite firm about that. So please tell me: how you are of Use? ]” ]
rows.translation: [flags.ACTUATOR_SCEPTRE |[flags.ARDENT_ACTUATOR |[var1 |“你又来拜访我们了，嗯？”蹄兔朝你露出一抹狡黠的露齿笑容，窄小的肩膀沿黄铜王座靠背蹭动。“这里确实是个惬意之处，我的受织者也都令人愉快，毫无疑问，没错。不过务必履行你的职责，构装师同僚！要是表现得太明显可不妥...嗯，嘿嘿嘿嘿，嗯。” |“热忱构装师！你的法衣在哪里？！”蹄兔男孩不知从哪里又找来一根权杖，正不耐烦地朝你挥舞。“即使身处这休憩之所，也不能让谦卑的受织者看见飞升者穿得如此邋遢，没错，确实不行！整理好你的衣装！之后我们或许才能交谈吐露！” 一大群紧随构装师身边的迪弗拉尼似乎完全按字面理解了这番斥责，你发现自己被他们直接推回了休息室。 “法衣，构装师[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]！” “请按照您荣耀的位阶着装，[pc.mf |先生 |女士 ]，这非常重要！” “我们还想再看看你的[pc.mf |乳头 |奶子 ]！” ] |[var0 |“受福膏抹者！” “受福膏抹者...”休息室里传来一片叹息般的幸福回声，响应构装师的宣告。 “见你身披华服重返此地，真是令人愉快，最为珍贵的膏油，”银发蹄兔微笑着，身体不断抽动。“[var2 |请...我的受织者永远不会厌倦你宁静的触碰。对他们施展你的善行，让他们牢记，为何他们对基哈圣用的虔诚如此坚定而狂热！” |我们这里迫切需要你的技艺与奉献！我也迫切需要。是的。” ] 他把中央的翻领掀向一旁，露出那根缓缓渗液、金光闪耀且带有织纹的龙形阴茎；下方李子般垂挂的睾丸看起来确实胀得厉害。 “我知道，你和你的嘴必须去往每个人身边，为每个人服务，[pc.mf |兄弟 |姐妹 ]，”他笑着说道，肥厚的爪子间翻弄着一枚信用筹码。“所以——这是圣所金库的一点小小捐赠。换取你的体谅与特别关照，没错。” |“看到我们的受福膏抹者没有穿着[pc.his]应有的法衣，实在令我痛心，”蹄兔男孩叹息着，悲伤地眨眼望向你。“我们的会众曾见证那般辉煌泛滥的黏液狂热，如今已不再涌动于你体内了吗？你要背离基哈创造你所要履行的圣用吗？求你了...”他用一只爪子蒙住眼睛，另一只则挥手赶你离开。“...我无法忍受这些念头，可看到你如今的模样，我又无法不这样想。离开这里吧，我恳求你，没错！” 一大群紧随构装师身边的迪弗拉尼似乎完全按字面理解了这番宣言，你发现自己被他们直接推回了休息室。 “法衣啊，膏抹者！” “请按照您最受祝福的位阶着装，这非常重要！” “然后吸我的莲花！可以吗？” ] ] |“你再次走近，而我也再次不得不询问思索：你在基哈的蓝图中承担什么职责，嗯？”蹄兔构装师用那双锐利得令人不安、闪烁着冰冷笑意的眼睛盯着你。“[var3 |我们已经确认你不适合成为受福膏抹者。你想再接受一次试炼吗？毕竟，坚持不懈是一种美德。而且那场试炼看起来非常有趣，嗯，没错！ |想必你不是一个就这样一路闲逛到神圣圣所深处的异教闯入者。那可不好。对我而言，是的！但对你而言更糟。基哈会命令我们采取相当强硬的措施。所以请告诉我：你如何发挥圣用？ ]” ]

rows.original: The Mjolnir Lightning Cannon is a recent development by KihaCorp, able to generate a laminar flow of mild plasma from the weapon to the target and conduct an excessively amplified burst of high-voltage current into the target, scouring shields and superheating metal armor to great effect.
rows.translation: 雷神闪电炮是基哈集团近期开发的武器，能够在武器与目标之间形成温和等离子体的层流通道，并将过度放大的高压电流导入目标；它能有效冲刷护盾，并将金属装甲加热至极高温。
rows.raw: "The Mjolnir Lightning Cannon is a recent development by KihaCorp, able to generate a laminar flow of mild plasma from the weapon to the target and conduct an excessively amplified burst of high-voltage current into the target, scouring shields and superheating metal armor to great effect."

rows.original: For decades, the prodigal particle was pure mathematical theory - a physics prize more worthy of its quest then the Higgs Boson. Since discovery, applications for it have been few and far between. The equipment necessary to harness a prodigal particle and direct it is too cumbersome and expensive for man-portable arms, but you’ve seen articles about KihaCorp deploying prototypes for testing during the Rush. Somehow, they wound up in the wrecks in Rummi’s shop.
rows.translation: 几十年来，浪子粒子一直只是纯粹的数学理论——一个比希格斯玻色子更值得追寻的物理学大奖。自从被发现以来，它的实际应用少之又少。捕获并定向引导浪子粒子所需的设备过于笨重昂贵，无法用于单兵武器，不过你曾看过有关基哈集团在星球大淘金期间部署原型机进行测试的报道。不知为何，那些原型最终落进了鲁米商店里的残骸堆。

Somehow, they wound up in the wrecks in Rummi’s shop."

rows.original: Kinetic impact? Overrated. Electricity? Shockingly useless. Lasers? Optically unsound. Disassembling your target at the molecular level, atom-by-atom? Perfect. And now, thanks to Aegis Shipyards LLC, the power of atomic deconstruction is available to any private military corporation with sufficiently deep pockets - or Rushers on planets full of shot-down prototypes....
rows.translation: 动能冲击？名过其实。电力？没电到点子上。激光？光学上站不住脚。逐个原子地从分子层面拆解目标？完美。如今，多亏神盾造船有限责任公司，任何资金足够雄厚的私人军事企业——或是在遍地都是被击落原型机的行星上活动的探索者——都能掌握原子解构之力....

rows.original: Railguns were perfected decades ago. Most megacorps moved their research elsewhere, developing new techniques to harness plasma or deconstruct hardened materials at range. MaxCorp had no such desire. They took an established technology, discovered and refined by their competitors, and made it their own. They developed the highest caliber rail cannon available to non-government entities and jacked it up with the deepest capacitors their competitors would sell them, creating the MaxMag Rail Cannon.
rows.translation: 轨道炮早在几十年前就已臻于完善。大多数巨型企业把研究重点转向其他领域，开发远距离驾驭等离子体或解构硬化材料的新技术。麦克斯公司却毫无这种兴趣。他们拿起一项由竞争对手发现并完善的成熟技术，将其化为己用。他们开发出非政府组织所能取得的最大口径轨道炮，再装上竞争对手愿意出售的最深层电容器，最终造出了麦克斯巨磁轨道炮。
rows.raw: "Railguns were perfected decades ago. Most megacorps moved their research elsewhere, developing new techniques to harness plasma or deconstruct hardened materials at range. MaxCorp had no such desire. They took an established technology, discovered and refined by their competitors, and made it their own. They developed the highest caliber rail cannon available to non-government entities and jacked it up with the deepest capacitors their competitors would sell them, creating the MaxMag Rail Cannon."

rows.original:
As a turret, this requires a crew member to fire it.

While colloquially known as a howitzer, large caliber artillery cannons have been used in wars since the early age of gunpowder. Phaedrans have put their own twist on it, developing a crude but effective quad-barreled monstrosity capable of lobbing highly-explosive artillery shells at other vessels in orbit. Rummi’s technological wizardry is on full display, allowing the primitive systems to integrate seamlessly with a true U.G.C.-affiliated vessel like your own.
rows.translation:
作为炮塔，它需要一名船员负责开火。

尽管俗称榴弹炮，大口径火炮自火药时代早期起就已投入战争。菲德拉人赋予了它自己的特色，造出一台粗糙却有效的四联装怪物，能够向轨道上的其他舰船抛射高爆炮弹。鲁米的技术奇才本领展露无遗，使这些原始系统能够与像你的飞船这样真正隶属联合银河邦联的舰艇无缝整合。

Rummi’s technological wizardry is on full display, allowing the primitive systems to integrate seamlessly with a true U.G.C.-affiliated vessel like your own."

rows.original:
Quantum lattice is a relatively new armor technology that maximizes durability for a minimum gain of additional weight, thanks to its porous, rigid, and self-stitching nature. Quantum lattice-equipped vessels have reportedly endured massive flak barrages with only visual scratches left as damage.

(+50 Armor Defense)
rows.translation:
量子晶格是一种相对较新的装甲技术；凭借多孔、刚性且能够自我缝合的结构，它能以最少的额外重量获得最大的耐久度。据报告，装备量子晶格的舰船经受大规模高射炮火洗礼后，留下的损伤也不过是表面划痕。

（+50 装甲防御）
