rows.original:
Rather than stacking on additional heavy armor plates, this kit utilizes a hexagonal weave of interlocking geddanium shells, creating a low-mass way to add more sacrificial armor than an equivalent mass of solid, hardened steel.

(+2500 Armor)
rows.translation:
这套组件没有继续堆叠沉重的装甲板，而是采用相互咬合的六边形杰达尼姆外壳编织结构；与同等质量的实心淬硬钢相比，它能以更低的质量提供更多消耗式装甲。

（+2500 装甲）

rows.original:
Redundant micro-projector networks, additional oxonium capacitors, and two backup power delivery systems all come together to increase your ship’s ability to take a beating in vacuum.

(+2000 shields)
rows.translation:
冗余的微型投影器网络、额外的奥克索尼姆电容器以及两套备用供能系统共同作用，提高你的飞船在真空中承受打击的能力。

（+2000 护盾）

rows.original:
By tuning a vessel’s shield emitters to the tightest tolerances, it is possible to further “harden” its shields against damage, making it more able to defend against large volleys of lightly damaging projectiles. This advanced kit makes use of an onboard V.I. that continually adjusts emitter aperture, power, and balance across the network to maintain the most resilient shield surface possible.

(+40 shield defense)
rows.translation:
通过将飞船的护盾发射器调校至最严苛的公差，可以进一步“硬化”护盾，使其更能抵御大量低伤害弹丸的齐射。这套高级组件使用舰载 V.I. 持续调节整个网络中的发射器孔径、功率与平衡，以维持尽可能坚韧的护盾表面。

（护盾防御 +40）

rows.original: Sparks fizz, and a primitive speaker crackles to life from the nearest shipwreck. “Kzzt - CLOSED for new business. Further intrusion will be considered a HOSTILE ACT.” It cuts back off with a startling crackle. You glance north, noting other hulls. Some are rusted and of local manufacture while others sport holes blasted through their scorched hulls. Those are unanimously of modern, UGC make. They appear to be arranged by their state of disrepair - the more intact the hull, the further to the north the vessel has been positioned. The speaker interrupts your thoughts, “Kzzt-eriously, we’re not open right now. I don’t care if you’re by yourself. Don’t.” It clicks back off. Someone really doesn’t want you coming north.
rows.translation: 火花噼啪迸溅，最近的那艘船骸上传来原始扬声器的沙沙声。“滋——暂停接待新业务。继续入侵将被视为敌对行为。”扬声器伴着一声惊人的爆响再次断线。 你向北望去，注意到其他船体。有些锈迹斑斑，是本地制造；另一些烧焦的船壳上则布满爆破留下的孔洞。后者无一例外都是现代的UGC制式。它们似乎按破损程度排列——船体越完整，安放的位置就越靠北。 扬声器打断了你的思绪：“滋——说真的，我们现在不营业。我不在乎你是不是独自一人。别来。”随后又咔哒一声关闭。 看来有人非常不愿意让你继续向北。

The speaker interrupts your thoughts, “Kzzt-eriously, we’re not open right now. I don’t care if you’re by yourself. Don’t.” It clicks back off. Someone really doesn’t want you coming north."

rows.original: An electronic speaker buzzes from one of the nearby shipwrecks. “Kzzt-the feeling you didn’t listen the first time, but we are CLOSED. Do not approach.” The speaker clicks off, then back on with startling immediacy. “Seriously, stop setting off the prox alarms, I have WORK TO DO.” This time, silence reigns amongst the shattered ship remains. Curiosity licks at you, but you should probably avoid going north for now.
rows.translation: 附近一艘飞船残骸上的电子扬声器嗡嗡作响。“滋——感觉你第一次没听懂，但我们已经打烊了。不要靠近。”扬声器咔哒一声关闭，却又立刻重新响起，快得令人吃惊。“说真的，别再触发接近警报了，我还有活要干。” 这一次，破碎的飞船残骸间只剩寂静。好奇心挠得你心痒，但现在最好还是别往北走。
rows.raw: "An electronic speaker buzzes from one of the nearby shipwrecks. “Kzzt-the feeling you didn’t listen the first time, but we are CLOSED. Curiosity licks at you, but you should probably avoid going north for now."

rows.original: One of the more intact wrecks to the north abruptly whirrs to life, its heavy servomotors purring as effectively as when they were fresh from the factory. The capital-class turret rotating in your direction looks similarly well maintained, even if the ship housing it is a mere piece of a much grander whole. Power thrums. There’s a glow inside the barrels. The aim is shallow, just short of you, but it’s a damn big gun. You hop back with all the speed you can muster, and just in time too. A blast of radioactive dirt and pulverized glass washes over you before you’re even aware that the weapon fired, digging a fresh, eight-foot crater into the ground. The Codex’s geiger counter is going crazy, but it quiets before the dust finishes settling. Another speaker, somewhere closer declares. “Kzzt-arning shot. We’re closed. Please don’t make me murder you. You can leave.” It turns off. Five seconds later, it’s on again. “Kzzt-ou look like you can understand me at least, so maybe I won’t have to kill a confused alien today. Yay me! Go southeast - and watch out for Hyrax. If you make it far enough east, then turn north, you’ll be on your way to shineglass. Maybe you can find what you’re looking for that way.” It cuts off once more. You should definitely not step any further north, even if there’s some nice looking shipwrecks over there.
rows.translation: 北方一艘较为完整的残骸突然嗡鸣着启动，沉重的伺服电机运作得如同刚刚出厂时一般流畅。那座转向你的主力舰级炮塔似乎也保养得同样良好，尽管承载它的飞船如今只剩昔日庞然巨物的一块碎片。 能源低鸣。炮管内部亮起光芒。 炮口瞄得很低，落点就在你面前不远处，但那可是一门该死的巨炮。你使出全身力气向后跃去，而且正好及时。你甚至还没意识到武器已经开火，放射性尘土与粉碎玻璃形成的冲击波便迎面袭来，在地上挖出一个崭新、深达八英尺的弹坑。 Codex的盖革计数器彻底发疯，但尘埃尚未完全落定，它便安静下来。 近处某个地方的另一只扬声器宣布：“滋——警告射击。我们关门了。请别逼我杀了你。你可以走了。”它随即关闭。五秒后又重新响起。“滋——你至少看起来听得懂我说话，所以今天也许不用杀死一个迷路的外星人。好耶！往东南走——小心海拉克西。要是能向东走得足够远，再转向北方，就能去往辉玻城。或许你能在那里找到想要的东西。”声音再次中断。 即使那边确实有些看起来不错的飞船残骸，你也绝对不该再向北迈进一步。

rows.original: A gigantic cannon swivels to face you. The speaker doesn’t turn on this time, but the cannon does nudge its way slightly off-axis just before it blasts another giant warning-crater in the ground. Whoever is at the controls REALLY doesn’t want you going north. Danger!
rows.translation: 一门巨炮转向你。这次扬声器没有开启，但大炮在开火前确实稍稍偏离了轴线，又在地面轰出一个巨大的警告弹坑。控制它的人真的、真的不想让你继续往北走。 危险！

rows.original: As you’re circling around the freshly dug crater, you hear the sound of power surging into that turret once more. This time, it’s pointed directly at you. No matter how you juke or dodge, it follows you effortlessly. “Kzzt-ish I didn’t have to do thi-” At least your final perception was of a voice.
rows.translation: 当你绕过新鲜炸出的弹坑时，再次听见能量涌入那座炮塔的声音。这一次，它正直指着你。无论你如何急转闪避，它都能轻松锁定你。 “滋——真希望我不必这么——” 至少，你最后感知到的是一个声音。

rows.original: “Right, what I’m saying is - do you want some proper transpo back? The only groundpath from is fuck-nasty walking filled with fuck-nasty scum under some fuck-nasty weather.” She tucks her fingers behind her shieldbelt casually. “You slogged it out once, no need to hike that shithill again.” A quick transport back to your ship - or closer to it - would be lovely. You say as much. “Great. Only costs 10 K’s.” The nuka’s smile turns wolfish. “Credits, right? Rummi says they’re gonna be standard going forward, once more of you Star Rushers make it down here.” Wait,
rows.translation: “好吧，我的意思是，你想搭真正的交通工具回去吗？从这里离开的唯一陆路又他妈难走，沿途全是他妈的人渣，天气也他妈糟糕。”她随意把手指别在护盾腰带后。“你已经苦撑过一次，没必要再爬那座屎山。” 能快速返回飞船，或至少靠近飞船，当然很棒。你如实回答。 “很好。只收一万。”努卡露出狼一般的笑。“信用点，对吧？鲁米说以后会成为通用货币，等更多星际冒险者来这里之后。” 等等，

rows.original: credits? For a ride back to your own ship? You balk. “Aww, what’s the matter? Ain’t you star-folk rich as all hell? It’s just made up money anyway.” She nudges your shoulder firmly, maybe a little more firmly than she might have meant. “Look, fork over those credits, and I’ll give you as many rides as you want. Rummi’ll be happy I charged money for a change, and you’ll be able to get back and forth to your ship without fighting off a bunch of sex-crazed wasters.” Now that’s a little better.
rows.translation: 信用点？就为了回自己的飞船？你难以接受。 “哎呀，怎么了？你们星际人不是富得流油吗？反正都是凭空造出来的钱。”她用力顶了顶你的肩膀，也许比原本打算的更用力。“听着，付钱后想搭多少次都行。鲁米会很高兴我终于收费，而你也能往返飞船，不必一路击退那群性欲疯狂的荒民。” 这样就好些了。

rows.original: You load the credits on a chit and toss it into the biker’s waiting hand. She turns it over cautiously, examining it. Uncertainty rests on her face for all of a single blink before the mask of confidence slides back into place. “Yeah that’ll do nicely, but before you ride, there’s a few rods to pull out of the reactor. Firstly, introductions.” She grabs your hand in a firm grip and squeezes tightly. “Name’s Gayll. What’s your label?”
rows.translation: 你把信用点存进一张信用片，扔进骑手等候着的手里。 她谨慎地翻看着信用片。疑虑只在她脸上停留了一眨眼的工夫，自信的面具便重新归位。“嗯，这就很不错，不过上车之前，还有几根反应堆里的控制棒得先拔出来。第一件事，自我介绍。”她一把握住你的手，紧紧捏了捏。“我叫盖尔。你的标签是什么？”

rows.original: You shake your head. “10 K is outrageous.” For that price, you could get a JoyCo hoverbike of your own, and you say as much. You neglect to mention that JoyCo’s hoverbikes are well documented deathtraps, unlikely to survive more than a pair of seasons on a pastoral planet, let alone on an irradiated hellscape. “Half that is more than reasonable.” You fold your arms across your [pc.fullChest], confident in your haggling skills. The nuka laughs. “All right then. 5 K.” She looks back over her shoulder at the bike. “Honestly I bet you’re low-balling me.” Her head-tendril twitches. “No Gasm-Corp or whatever bike is going to survive Phaedra, let alone multiple trips, but you’re still a more trustworthy sort than the raiders and cultists I usually bump into. Maybe offworld evil’s just different, I don’t know, but yeah, 5 K. Let’s do it.” She holds out her hand expectantly. You transfer
rows.translation: 你摇摇头。“一万太离谱了。”这价格足够买一辆JoyCo悬浮摩托，你也这样告诉她，只是没提JoyCo摩托出了名是死亡陷阱，在田园星球都很难撑过两个季节，更别说辐射地狱。“一半已经绰绰有余。”你双臂抱住[pc.fullChest]，对议价能力信心十足。 努卡笑道：“好吧，五千。”她回头望向摩托。“老实说，我敢说你还在故意压价。”头部触须抽动。“什么高潮公司之类的摩托都不可能撑过菲德拉，更别说跑上好几趟。但你总比我平时遇到的劫掠者和邪教徒可信。也许外星恶人就是不一样吧，我不知道。总之五千，成交。”她期待地伸出手。 你把

rows.original: “For serious?” Gayll searches your features for a sign of dishonesty, and finding none, she relaxes further. “Small galaxy I guess. Well, from one Gayll to another, congratulations on lucking into a prime name.”
rows.translation: “认真的？”盖尔打量着你的神情，寻找说谎的迹象；确认没有后，她进一步放松下来。“我猜这银河还真小。同为盖尔，恭喜你有幸得到了一个上等名字。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“For serious?” Gayll searches your features for a sign of dishonesty, and finding none, she relaxes further. “Small galaxy I guess. Well, from one Gayll to another, congratulations on lucking into a prime name.”"

rows.original: “Huh, I like the sound of it.” The corner of her crimson lips rises pleasantly. “You must have had a creative sire. Unique, and kinda sexy, if I say so myself.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我喜欢这个名字的感觉。”她深红色的嘴角愉快地扬起。“你的生父一定很有创意。独特，而且要我说，还有点性感。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh, I like the sound of it.” The corner of her crimson lips rises pleasantly. “You must have had a creative sire. Unique, and kinda sexy, if I say so myself.”"

rows.original: “Ouch, sorry you’re stuck with tha- oh wait, cultural differences. It’s probably a totally normal thing to call someone out there in the stars, huh? Fuckin’ crazy. For a second I thought your sire must have hated you or something.” She chuckles.
rows.translation: “哎哟，真遗憾你得顶着这——噢，等等，文化差异。在星海之外，这大概是个完全正常的称呼，对吧？真他妈疯狂。我刚才还以为你的生父肯定很恨你之类的。”她轻笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ouch, sorry you’re stuck with tha- oh wait, cultural differences. It’s probably a totally normal thing to call someone out there in the stars, huh? Fuckin’ crazy. For a second I thought your sire must have hated you or something.” She chuckles."

rows.original: Behind her, the nuka’s bike looms, long and gleaming. She catches your looking and nods with a smile. “Second thing - when you’re riding, you strap the fuck in, and you don’t touch anything.” She looks you up and down. “
rows.translation: 她身后，那辆努卡摩托修长而锃亮，巍然耸立。她发现你在看，便微笑着点点头。“第二件事——骑车的时候，你他妈得把自己绑牢，而且什么都不许碰。”她上下打量着你。“

rows.original: Not that I’m sayin’ you would. You look a reasonable sort.
rows.translation: 不是说你一定会这么做。你看起来还算讲道理。
rows.raw: "Not that I’m sayin’ you would. You look a reasonable sort."

rows.original: No splits off your atom, but you look a curious sort. Best I let you know in advance.
rows.translation: 没说你脑子缺根弦，不过你好像挺好奇的。最好提前告诉你。
rows.raw: "No splits off your atom, but you look a curious sort. Best I let you know in advance."

rows.original: Seriously. It’s important. No getting handsy with the bike or myself, least not while we’re flyin’. I know you’re thinking about it.
rows.translation: 我是认真的，这很重要。别对摩托或我动手动脚，至少飞行时不行。我知道你在打什么主意。
rows.raw: "Seriously. It’s important. No getting handsy with the bike or myself, least not while we’re flyin’. I know you’re thinking about it."

rows.original: ” The orange alien turns toward the distant horizon, eyes narrowing. “It’s hard enough dodging hyraxi missile locks on my own, and I cannot afford to be paying attention to you when I’m skimming ground to stay under the cult’s radar.” That sounds reasonable, if a little worrisome. Gayll appears unbothered by the prospect of lethal danger. A lifetime on this apocalyptic planet has inured her to the myriad dangers, but a capable nature has kept her alive this long. Your gut read is that you’ll be safe riding with her, so long as you don’t distract her.
rows.translation: ”这个橙色外星人转头望向远方的地平线，眯起双眼。“我一个人躲海拉希导弹锁定就已经够难了；贴地飞行来避开邪教雷达时，我可没余力分心照顾你。” 这话听起来有道理，只是稍微有些令人担忧。盖尔对致命危险的可能性毫不在意。她在这颗末日星球上生活了一辈子，早已习惯这里形形色色的危险；而她过硬的本事则让她一直活到了现在。 你的直觉告诉你，只要别让她分心，搭她的车就是安全的。

Gayll appears unbothered by the prospect of lethal danger. A lifetime on this apocalyptic planet has inured her to the myriad dangers, but a capable nature has kept her alive this long. Your gut read is that you’ll be safe riding with her, so long as you don’t distract her."

rows.translation: [flags.DIV_GARD_ENCOUNTER |你偶然闯入了又一座长满腐化植物的花园。想起上次与这些植物相遇的经过，你小心避开柔软湿润的泥土，时刻保持警惕；在这里挑起战斗，后果可不只是喉咙疼痛。 “哦！你又找到了一座由我栽培的华美灌木园。”迪弗拉尼园丁咯咯笑着，从茂密的灌木中现身。“[var0 |真高兴你回来了，余烬之民。辐射林的恩赐已经在你身上牢牢扎根。用不了多久，你就能升华成崭新而荣耀的形态。” 无论她让你转化多少次，似乎总也不够。或许你现在应该及时收手。没人知道她那些腐化药剂还会对你的身体和灵魂造成什么影响。 外星植物学家咯咯笑着，友善地伸出一只手。“我知道你心中仍有疑虑，但不必害怕。你早已准备好向启蒙迈出下一步。来吧，余烬之民。让我带你领略更多天堂般的欢愉。” 你会再次把自己交给她，还是勇敢地拒绝这份浮士德式契约？ |[var1 |我看得出，[silly |你的身体已经准备好 |你已经准备好 ]迎接光辉最后的祝福。来吧，余烬之民：众灵正在等待她们的新勇士。” 你已经走了很远。你准备好把自己献给辐射林了吗，还是要在距离终点如此之近时退缩？[silly |你的这轮游戏就要结束了呜呼 |这或许是你最后一次抉择 ] |是好奇心把你带回我这丰饶的领地，还是你听见了众灵的召唤？” 你神情困惑地看着她。看来她并没有从上次相遇中吸取教训。 这个遭到腐化的外星人微笑着，友善地伸出一只手。“来吧，余烬之民。接受辐射林的恩赐、与它融为一体，永远都不会太迟。” 你会接受她的提议，让她用腐化精华填满你吗？ ] ] |你来到一片宜人的林间空地。这里的外星植物显得格外奇异：发光的蘑菇、渗出花蜜的茎秆、血管遍布的球茎、曲线丰腴的花朵，还有更令人担忧的幼年辐光怪和生命根须嫩芽。仔细观察后，你注意到这座伪花园中有一条浑浊的柔软泥带。你谨慎靠近，让[pc.isNaga |蛇躯 |[pc.feet] ]停在湿地边缘。 你身下有东西开始扭动。[pc.reflexesRange 0 40|你听从突然涌现的直觉，及时迅速后退，避开了一根破土而出的饥饿卷须|凭借先进的反射神经，你及时向后跃开，躲过了从地下钻出的饥饿卷须]。浸满水的土地化作一个类似流沙的坑洞，其中爬满不断扭动的触手状藤蔓。幸好你没有径直走进去！ “嚯嚯嚯嚯！这是什么呀？”一个充满好奇、带着咬舌口音的声音问道。 你迅速转身面向她。[pc.eyes]落在一个身材纤细的迪弗拉尼身上。她只穿着一条由腰带系住的暴露围裙，头戴一顶饰有花朵与藤蔓的宽檐帽。腰带上众多口袋装满了种子、常春藤与蔬菜，其中有些依然在富有生命力地扭动。她盘卷的肉棒和能够插入、花朵般的乳房早已滴下乳白美味，用滋养的汁液浇灌着娇嫩苔藓。接下来，事情变得更加古怪。她身后本该长着爬族长尾的位置，却摇摆着一条渗出毒液的甲壳蝎尾。她的舌头是一根末端张开的辐光怪状触手，显然是过度接触那些生物造成的结果。她贪婪地舔着嘴唇，将黏[silly |稠 |稠 ]的唾液喷得到处都是，沾满丰厚双唇。 “刚、刚才那是什么？” 外星植物学家咯咯笑了起来。“看来我的小花园令你十分满意，余烬之民。我和姐妹们培育了许多这样的林间空地，用来满足族人的各种需要，也感谢辐射林赐下仁慈沃土。这里的圣地最适合传播它丰饶的恩赐。你能感觉到新鲜空气如何充盈肺部吗？柔软草地如何逗弄你的[pc.isNaga |分节下身 |[pc.feet] ]？植物又是如何恳求你为它们授粉？” 你确实闻到了混有信息素的花粉，也看见繁茂植被的奇特形状。[pc.eyes]望向哪里，哪里就有阴茎状、肿胀、带褶边而成熟的作物渴求你的关注。五彩斑斓、散发光芒的球茎、茎秆与蘑菇渗出淫靡液体，怀着腐化意图阵阵抽动。你竟然还没掉进它们遭腐化的藤蔓，简直是个奇迹。 “很壮丽，不是吗？没有它们，辐射林便会远不如现在鲜艳而生机勃勃。只要与它们共同生活得足够久，你就会听见它们说话...而且只要仔细倾听，它们就会用伟大力量奖励你。”她低声说道。 她显然已经疯了，你也把这话告诉了她。辐光怪的根须一定已经侵入她的大脑！ 这个身体柔软的蜥蜴女孩咯咯笑了。“我曾经也是这么想的，但如今我已看见真理。我们的血肉容器生来就是为了侍奉、养育它们。我可以向你展示丰饶迪弗拉尼的道路。我可以重塑你，让你变成一座足以容纳远古众灵祝福的圣殿！它们会回报你给予的信任！相信吧，余烬之民！相信吧！” 你会信任这个疯狂的狂信徒，还是拒绝她难以置信的提议？ ]
rows.raw: " [flags.DIV_GARD_ENCOUNTER |You stumble across yet another garden filled with tainted vegetation. Remembering how your last meeting with these plants went, you carefully avoid the soft, wet mud and stay on alert — starting a fight here can lead to more than a sore throat. “Oh! You found another of my splendid shrubberies,” the divrani gardener giggles, emerging from a dense bush. “[var0 |I’m glad you came back, Emberian. The Radwoods’ gifts have taken root on you well. Soon, you’ll be ready to ascend to a new, glorious form.” No matter how many times she transforms you, it never seems to be enough. Maybe you should pull the plug now. There’s no way to know what else her tainted tinctures will do to your body and soul. The alien botanist giggles and extends a kind hand. “I know there’s still doubt in your head, but have no fear. You are more than ready to make the next step toward illumination. Come, Emberian. Let me show you more heavenly delights.” Will you offer yourself to her again or boldly refuse her faustian pact? |[var1 |I see that [silly |your body is ready |you are ready ] to welcome the Glow’s final blessing. Come, Emberian: the spirits await their new champion.” You’ve come a long way. Are you ready to offer yourself to the Radwoods or will you back down so close to the end? [silly |Your run is about to come to an end UwU |This might be your last decision ] |Is it curiosity that brought you back to my bountiful domain or have you heard the spirits’ call?” You look at her with a puzzled expression. She didn’t learn the lesson of your last encounter. The tainted alien smiles and extends a kind hand. “Come, Emberian. It’s never too late to accept the Radwoods’ gifts and to become one with it.” Do you accept her offer and let her fill you with tainted essence? ] ] |You come across a pleasant glade. The alien plants look particularly exotic here: glowing mushrooms, nectar-oozing stalks, veiny bulbs, curvaceous flowers, and — more concerningly — premature radglow and liferoot sprouts. Looking at it more closely, you notice a murky band of soft mud amidst this pseudo garden. You carefully approach, bringing your [pc.isNaga |coils |[pc.feet] ] up to the wet field’s edge. Something starts wriggling under you. [pc.reflexesRange 0 40|Listening to a sudden gut feeling, you quickly back down just in time to avoid a ravenous tendril emerging from the ground|Thanks to your advanced reflexes, you leap back just in time to evade the ravenous tendrils emerging from underground]. The drenched earth turns into a quicksand-like pit infested with writhing, tentacular vines. It’s fortunate that you didn’t walk right into it! “Ho ho ho ho! What have we here?” a curious, lisp-filled voice asks. You swiftly turn around in her direction. Your [pc.eyes] set on a slender divrani. She’s wearing nothing but a revealing apron fastened with a belt and a wide-brimmed hat decorated with flowers and vines. Her belt’s many pouches overflow with seeds, ivy, and vegetables, some still wriggling with life. Her coiled cock and penetrable, flowery boobs already drip with creamy goodness, showering delicate moss with nourishing juices. Then, things get weirder. A chitinous, scorpion tail oozing with venom wags behind her where a long, reptilian tail should be. She’s got a flared, radglow-like tentacle for a tongue — certainly the result of an overexposure to them. She greedily licks her lips, spraying thic[silly |c |k ] spittle all over her full smackers. “W-What was that?” The alien botanist giggles. “I see that my small garden pleased you, Emberian. My sisters and I cultivated many glades to fulfill our races’ many needs and to thank the Radwoods for their benevolent soils. Their hallowed grounds are perfect to spread its bountiful gifts. Can you feel how the fresh air inflates your lungs? How the soft grass titillates your [pc.isNaga |segmented lower body |[pc.feet] ]? How the plants plead you to fertilize them?” You do indeed smell the pheromone-laced pollens and see the lush vegetation’s peculiar shapes. Wherever you set your [pc.eyes], there’s phallic, bulging, frilly, and ripe crops begging for your attention. Colorful, glowing bulbs, stalks, and mushrooms ooze lurid fluids and twitch with tainted intent. It’s a miracle you didn’t fall into their corrupted vines already. “Magnificent, aren’t they? Without them, the Radwoods would be far less vibrant and lively. If you live long enough with them, you’ll hear them talk... and if you listen carefully, they’ll reward you with greatness,” she whispers. She’s clearly insane and you tell her so. Radglow roots must have infiltrated into her brain! The soft lizard girl giggles. “That’s what I thought too, but now I see the truth. Our fleshy vessels were born to serve and raise them. I can show you the path of the fertile divrani. I can remake you into a cathedral worthy of housing the ancient spirits’ blessings! They’ll reward your trust in them! Believe, Emberian! Believe!” Do you trust this mad zealot or reject her improbable offer? ] "

rows.original: This is Johana Creed's personal concussion pistol, extensively modified for power and ease of use. It looks to have started life as a high-caliber combination powder-coil slug-thrower, but someone reworked the guts to accept Peacekeeper Elite grade concussion munitions. Concussion shells launch hardlight-jacketed shockwaves the target, dealing incapacitating kinetic damage without the large, bloody holes typical of most kinetic rounds. Servo-assisted reloads keep downtime to a minimum, and the ergonomic handgrip makes it feel like it belongs in the hand more than any holster.
rows.translation: 这是乔安娜·克里德的私人震荡手枪，经过大幅改装，以提升威力和易用性。它原本似乎是一把大口径火药—线圈混合式实弹武器，但有人改造了内部结构，使其能够使用维和精英级震荡弹药。震荡弹发射由硬光包覆的冲击波，以致残性动能伤害制服目标，却不会留下大多数动能武器常见的巨大血洞。伺服辅助装填把停机时间压到最低，符合人体工学的握把则让它握在手中时比放进枪套更显得理所当然。

rows.original: This is probably the best chance you’ve ever had to get the drop on your cousin - to pay [rival.himHer] back for all the ass-pain [rival.heShe]’s caused since your father’s funeral. Your hand tightens around your [pc.weapon] as you step out of the brush and onto the sandy lakeside. “Truce is over,” you say, closing the distance between yourself and [rival.name] before [rival.heShe] can turn around. Johana bellows an impotent “Stay back!” from a hundred feet into the water, starting to paddle towards you as quick as she can, but you’ve got the upper hand with room to spare. The trussed-up leithan looks at you

rows.original: [rival.name] scrambles back, reaching for [rival.hisHer] discarded clothes - presumably where [rival.heShe]’s left [rival.hisHer] pocket pistol. You kick them away from [rival.himHer], and level your [pc.weapon] at [rival.name]’s head. “Enough.” “Woah! Hold on!” “No,” you say, pushing [rival.name] down. “You’ve been trying to steal what’s mine from day one! You’ve shot at me, you’ve sicced your guards on me, and here you are ready to steal from me again. I’m tired of it!” “Like you deserve it!” [rival.heShe] whinges, squirming away before you cuff [rival.himHer]. “Your dad was a scoundrel and a thief, and I’m just taking back what should belong to my family!” “Delusional little [rival.mf|prick|bitch].” “Stupid nepo-baby!” “Like you’re any better!” God you feel like you’re back in middle school! Arguing with [rival.name] on the rare family get together, you never thought it would come to this. And just like then, it’s getting you nowhere. [rival.name]’s brain is just so... so rotten with whatever poison your uncle fed [rival.himHer], mixed with a vicious cocktail of [rival.hisHer] own ambition. [rival.HeShe]’s never going to stop coming for what’s yours, is [rival.heShe]?
rows.translation: [rival.name]慌忙后退，伸手去够[rival.hisHer]扔在一旁的衣物——[rival.heShe]大概把[rival.hisHer]袖珍手枪留在了里面。你一脚把衣服从[rival.himHer]身边踢开，用[pc.weapon]瞄准[rival.name]的脑袋。“够了。” “哇！等等！” “不，”你说着，将[rival.name]推倒在地。“从第一天开始，你就一直想偷走属于我的东西！你朝我开过枪，放你的护卫来对付我，如今又准备再次偷我的东西。我受够了！” “说得好像你配拥有一样！”[rival.heShe]一边抱怨，一边在你铐住[rival.himHer]前扭身躲开。“你爸就是个恶棍和小偷，我只是要拿回本该属于我家的东西！” “妄想成狂的小[rival.mf|prick|bitch]。” “愚蠢的裙带关系宝宝！” “说得好像你自己强到哪去！” 天啊，你感觉自己仿佛回到了中学！在难得的家庭聚会上与[rival.name]争吵时，你从没想过事情会走到今天这一步。可就像当年一样，这样争下去毫无意义。[rival.name]的脑子已经...已经被你叔叔灌给[rival.himHer]的毒素彻底腐蚀，其中又混进了[rival.hisHer]自身野心调制出的剧毒鸡尾酒。 [rival.HeShe]永远不会停止觊觎你的东西，对吧，[rival.heShe]？

rows.original: “One last warning,” you say, lowering your [pc.weapon]. “Get out of here and don’t come back. Next time, I’ll kill you.” [rival.name] snarls wordlessly at you, while Johana finally stomps out of the water and grabs her clothes. You glance at her, then away when you see her fat cock still hanging in the breeze. “Keep [rival.himHer] away from me. I mean it.” “I go where my employer goes, not the other way ‘round,” Johana says evenly. She stuffs herself back into her pants. “Y’all’s family drama ain’t my business. Though I told [rival.mf|Mister|Miss] Steele here we should skedaddle as soon as we got off the train.” Your cousin scowls. “Not without the probe.” Fucking hell. You turn to Johana and jam a finger in her chest. “What happens to [rival.himHer] is on your ass now. Get out of here.” The gunslinger bristles. “You did us a good turn back on the train, but we ain’t friends. What happens between you two is not up to me.” You’ve done your last due diligence to stop what’s coming. You stow your weapon and storm off the shore, heading back into the forest. rows.original: You’ve suffered enough of the little shit’s interference. There’s no dissuading [rival.himHer] from trying to take what your father meant to be yours, and so you’ll have to do what your father never had the balls to do: take out the competition. [rival.name] must see the change in your demeanor the moment you’ve made up your mind. [rival.HeShe] draws a sharp breath and starts trying to scramble back, blabbering “No, no, no!” Not a hint of regret in [rival.hisHer] voice, of course, just animal panic; self-preservation finally kicking in. You lift your [pc.weapon] and steel yourself for what you have to do to protect your family’s legacy from the pathetic, whimpering creature in front of you. And then something slams into your side with the force of a rocket hammer. The leithan girl, even with her arms and head all bound up, has managed to get on her feet and slam her whole flank into you. The weight of impact sends you tumbling, barely holding onto your weapon. You manage to roll onto your [pc.knees] and into a fighting stance, shoving the giant bug-horse away before she can body-slam you again. She’s not much of a threat now that you can see her coming, but she’s been just enough of a distraction to let your cousin squirm away - and for Johana to make it ashore. The dusky gunslinger rolls over her discarded clothes, throwing on her poncho and gunbelt in one smooth movement, and comes out of it in a fighting stance not unlike yours, with the butt of her gun in her hand. “[pc.mf|Bastard|Bitch]!” she growls, narrowing her eyes. “Draw!”
rows.translation: 你已经受够了那个小混蛋的干扰。你不可能劝阻[rival.himHer]停止抢夺你父亲本打算留给你的东西，所以你只能去做你父亲从来没胆量做的事：除掉竞争对手。 你刚下定决心，[rival.name]想必便看出了你神情的变化。[rival.HeShe]猛吸一口气，开始拼命往后爬，嘴里不停叫着“不，不，不！”[rival.hisHer]语气中当然没有半点悔意，只有动物般的惊慌；求生本能终于发作了。你举起[pc.weapon]，硬下心肠，准备采取必要手段，保护家族遗产不被眼前这个可悲又呜咽不止的家伙夺走。 随后，有什么东西以火箭锤般的力道猛撞上你的侧身。 那个莱森女孩即使双臂和脑袋都被捆住，依然设法站起身，用整个侧腹撞向你。撞击的重量令你翻滚出去，险些没能握住武器。你设法翻身以[pc.knees]着地，摆出战斗姿势，并在她再次冲撞前推开了这匹巨大的虫马。既然你能看清她的动作，她如今便算不上多大威胁，但她争取的时间已经足够让你的表亲蠕动着逃开——也足够约翰娜上岸。那名深色皮肤的枪手从扔在地上的衣服上翻滚而过，流畅地穿上斗篷、系好枪带，起身时已经摆出了与你相似的战斗架势，手中握着枪柄。 “[pc.mf|混蛋|婊子]！”她眯起眼睛吼道。“拔枪！”

rows.original:
Johana Creed may have been caught with her pants down, but she’s far from out. Thanks to Howinn’s intervention, she was able to roll into her poncho and gunbelt with one smooth movement - almost like she’s practiced for just this sort of occasion. Now she hefts her concussion pistol one-handed, holding a wary combat stance. She knows this is a battle for keeps, and she intends to win!

The dusky gunslinger is one of the galaxy’s finest mercenaries, but does she have what it takes to handle you?
rows.translation:
乔安娜·克里德虽然被打了个措手不及，却远未出局。多亏霍温出手干预，她一个流畅的翻滚便套上斗篷、系好枪带—简直像专门演练过这种场面。此刻她单手举起震荡手枪，摆出警戒的战斗姿势。她知道这是一场不留余地的战斗，也决心取胜！

这位肤色黝黑的枪手是银河系最出色的佣兵之一，但她真能应付你吗？

rows.original: You’re bowled over by the impact of Johana’s concussion pistol, sent flopping onto your back and seeing stars. “Dick!” [rival.name] shrieks, kicking you in the side. Johana looms over you, shoving the barrel of her gun into your neck. “Drop it.” You do so with a groan. “Fucking kill [pc.himHer]!” [rival.name] says, waving an arm at you. “[pc.HeShe] was going to kill me.” “Not my style, sorry,” Johana says, kneeling down. “But I can make sure [pc.heShe] ain’t a threat for a while.” She grabs your [pc.weapon] and tosses it into one of her leithan’s saddlebags... and then grabs your whole satchel and pulls it over your shoulder. “Good luck getting all the way back to civilization,” she snorts, standing up and spitting in the sand. “You’ll need it.” She turns and gives your cousin a push towards [rival.hisHer] clothes. “Get dressed. We ought to move.” You roll onto your side, watching Johana lift [rival.name] up onto the leithan’s back before the three of them take off into the forest. God damn it, not again. This time that bitch has really crossed the line - she took everything you have.

rows.original: Johana’s panting hard now, and her gun slips from her fingers, dropping like a brick into the dirt. “Fuck,” she groans. “You’re good.” Damn right you are. You take a step up, meaning to go disarm her, but that damned leithan shows she’s not just furniture once again - she body-charges Johana, scooping the gunslinger up over her back and onto her carapace before you can get at her. You try and grab her reins, but a heavily armored tail slaps your hands away, and then you’re eating dust as she gallops away into the treeline. Your cousin’s nowhere to be seen either. God damn it. You look down at the sandy shore to see what your attempted murder actually wrought you. Johana’s gun and hat have been left in the dust. You certainly remember the thunder that hand-cannon brought with it. Memorable enough that you bet it’s not the only one she brought to the planet with her, but hey, finders keepers here.

Uncle Vic left this ripe for any of his relatives to take. It might as well be me! I’m sure use it better than you!”

rows.original: You come to slowly, out of what feels like an eternity of sleep. You dreamt of a pattern that underpins all things which, whatever you did, remained frustratingly just out of reach. If only you could delve a little bit deeper... You blink. You’re still in the break room, that humid fastness of perfumed plant and dozing divrani, lying in a pile of cushions. By Kiha, you needed that rest! What a party that was! Although ‘party’ barely does it justice, does it? You feel slightly dirty calling it that. Celebration. That’s more like it. You yawn and stretch... then frown. Something feels different — a warm, pinching sensation in your nose and [pc.ear]. You bring your finger up to your nostril, and find there a hard, round piercing. It’s attached by a slim golden chain to your earlobe, where you find a similar piercing. Green gemstones, going off your reflection on the wet tiles. They are cool to the touch, but make you feel warm for some reason. Like you really want to be touched, and to touch back. The reflection also tells you that you’re wearing something. Didn’t you fall asleep naked? Well, now you are wearing [pc.mf |a firm, felt red collar around your neck |a silken crimson headscarf over your [pc.hair] ]. Not only that, but crimson robes, lined with gold. Very fine and loose about the wrist and [pc.feet], but daringly cut around the [pc.chest] and [pc.thigh]. This is all very nice... and it makes you think about how nice it would be to dance, and join hands, and do other very lovely things, while dressed in this... but it’s time to shake off the last of your strange, steamy sleep and get back to... whatever it was you were doing before this. The thing. The quest. Where are your clothes? Where is your [pc.weapon]? “[pc.mf |Brother |Sister ]! You’re awake!” One of the divrani hurries across to you, eyes shining. “You must be a little discombobulated, waking up in your new raiments, but you were sleeping so soundly... we couldn’t wait to get you galvanized for your new role!” What in the name of Kiha is he babbling about? “Your new role, silly.” Other curvy, green-fingered devotees are crowding around you now, looking[pc.isHeight 72| up] at you with a mixture of coyness and mischief. “We, and the actuators, all agree — this is the place you will be most of Use!” “You’re soooo good at meshing, [pc.mf |brother |sister ]!” “How you dance and sing...” “...and do the other stuff...” “You thread the Chorus together like no-one else can!” “And we know you love it.” This is said in a slightly slyer tone and look. “You don’t really want to be anywhere else in the golden machine, do you?” “Nooooooooo!” This is chorused, in disbelief. You try and clear your head, which is very difficult when they’re all crowding around you like this, reminding you with their smell and tactility just how very pleasant it is to ‘mesh’ with a smooth, warm, energetic, empathetic reptile-snack. Several of them at the same time, even better. You suck in a deep breath of air... and are reminded of the pattern, the beautiful pattern which joins together everything, machine, plant and animal, which you access when you dance with them. You almost saw the whole thing, last time. You almost understood it in its mind-wiping entirety. No. Even with the piercings making you feel oh so tender and frustrated, [pc.eachCock] already thickening again[pc.hasBalls|, [pc.balls] swelling with fresh urge], [pc.eachVagina] widening and moistening like all the happy plantlife in here. No, you need to get out of here. Return to your dumb, stupid quest that is only going to leave you feeling alone, cold and unfulfilled. “Awwwwwwww!” The divrani groan as you push them away as politely as you can and make your way towards the exit. “Can you do us one favor then, [pc.mf |brother |sister ]?” Says one. You recognise her as the bookish one you made melt in your arms, many hours ago. She blinks[pc.isHeight 72| up] at you through her thick glasses. “One meshing? Just one. Then we’ll let you go.” You pause and gaze back at the room. The garden of Kiha, so effortlessly timeless and blissful with its falling beams of sunshine, filled with beings who have only ever offered you openness, companionship, and the touch of the divine. You sigh, toying with your golden chain distractedly, and then turn back, to a chorus of cheers, and the outbreak of the first stanza of the Kihandala. Just one more.

rows.original: [flags.CHORUS_ROOM|Some of the divrani are busy with aerosols, tending to the pillars of foliage (or, giggling, attacking each other with them), but most of them are lolling on giant piles of cushions and carpets, sunning themselves in the divine light, or singing together soulfully in little groups, hair and arms entwined. They come and go as the turning of the gears demand; in their scant crimson uniforms, it is difficult for your eyes to tell them apart. Time, here in the pungent, sunlit garden of Kiha, is meaningless.|You are momentarily alarmed at being confronted by so many Kihan cultists - you are after all a trespasser in this, their most sacred temple - but you quickly relax. This is somewhat unavoidable: the atmosphere is warm, humid and redolent with the herbal smell of divrani pheromones, layered into all the other verdure breathing into the air here, reaching into your mouth and nose, loosening your collar and stroking the back of your neck. And it’s also because everyone looks extremely chilled out. Some of the divrani are busy with aerosols, tending to the pillars of foliage (or, giggling, attacking each other with them), but most of them are lolling on giant piles of cushions and carpets, sunning themselves in the divine light, or singing soulful hymns in little groups, hair and arms entwined. The only ones doing anything more vigorous are the ones making out, or copulating with the Liferoot blossoms that nestle in amongst the planted columns. It’s a garden of sighing, singing free love.] Sweat prickles your brow. The longer you remain here, the[pc.hasVagina| moister[pc.hasCock| and]][pc.hasCock| more wooden] you become, the hazy, sensual atmosphere [pc.hasArmor|permeating even your [pc.armor]|spreading itself over your [pc.skinFurScales]]. A few of the divrani gaze at you with dozy, tranquil curiosity. [flags.CHORUS_ROOM|As ever, the temptation to[pc.isNude|| loosen your clothes and] spend time amongst the lounging lizards, partaking of affection offered like black soil to a budding plant, is undeniable. It is nice when time stands still, is it not?|You could, you suppose... spend some time getting to know them. They look friendly.[pc.lustRange 50| Interested, perhaps, in relieving you of those increasingly pressing spiritual burdens of yours.]]
rows.translation: [flags.CHORUS_ROOM|一些迪芙拉尼人正忙着使用喷雾，照料一根根植物柱（或者一边咯咯笑，一边拿喷雾相互袭击），但大多数人都懒散地躺在巨大的软垫与地毯堆上，沐浴在神圣光辉中，或三五成群、发丝与手臂彼此交缠，深情地一同歌唱。随着齿轮运转的需要，她们来来去去；身上都穿着单薄的深红制服，你的眼睛很难将她们区分开来。在基哈这座气味浓烈、阳光普照的花园里，时间毫无意义。|面对如此众多的基哈教徒，你一时感到警惕——毕竟你是闯入这座至圣神殿的入侵者——但你很快便放松下来。这多少是不可避免的：空气温暖潮湿，弥漫着迪芙拉尼信息素的草药气味，与这里所有其他植物呼吸出的气息层层交织，钻进你的口鼻，松开你的衣领，轻抚你的后颈。 另一个原因则是，所有人看起来都极其放松。一些迪芙拉尼人正忙着使用喷雾，照料一根根植物柱（或者一边咯咯笑，一边拿喷雾相互袭击），但大多数人都懒散地躺在巨大的软垫与地毯堆上，沐浴在神圣光辉中，或三五成群、发丝与手臂彼此交缠，吟唱深情的圣歌。唯一在做更激烈活动的，是那些相互热吻的人，或是与栽种在植物柱间的生命根花朵交媾的人。这里是一座充满叹息、歌声与自由之爱的花园。] 汗珠刺痒着你的额头。你在这里待得越久，就变得[pc.hasVagina|越湿润[pc.hasCock|，也]][pc.hasCock|越坚挺]；朦胧而感性的氛围[pc.hasArmor|甚至渗透进你的[pc.armor]|在你的[pc.skinFurScales]上铺展开来]。几个迪芙拉尼人带着慵懒而安详的好奇看着你。[flags.CHORUS_ROOM|一如既往，[pc.isNude||松开衣服、]在这些闲躺的蜥蜴间消磨时光，享受如黑土奉给萌芽植物般主动送上的爱意，这份诱惑无可否认。时间静止的感觉确实很美妙，不是吗？|你想，自己或许可以... 花点时间了解她们。她们看起来很友善。[pc.lustRange 50|也许还愿意帮你卸下那些日渐沉重的精神负担。]]
